472	/// 探测是否包含非联网相关的本地函数工具
473	pub fn contains_non_networking_tool(tools: &Option<Vec<Value>>) -> bool {
474	    if let Some(list) = tools {
475	        for tool in list {
476	            let mut is_networking = false;
477	
478	            // 简单逻辑：如果它是一个函数声明且名字不是联网关键词，则视为非联网工具
479	            if let Some(n) = tool.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
480	                let keywords = [
481	                    "web_search",
482	                    "google_search",
483	                    "web_search_20250305",
484	                    "google_search_retrieval",
485	                    "builtin_web_search",
486	                ];
487	                if keywords.contains(&n) {
488	                    is_networking = true;
489	                }
490	            } else if let Some(func) = tool.get("function") {
491	                if let Some(n) = func.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
492	                    let keywords = [
493	                        "web_search",
494	                        "google_search",
495	                        "web_search_20250305",
496	                        "google_search_retrieval",
497	                        "builtin_web_search",
498	                    ];
499	                    if keywords.contains(&n) {
500	                        is_networking = true;
501	                    }
502	                }
503	            } else if tool.get("googleSearch").is_some()
504	                || tool.get("googleSearchRetrieval").is_some()
505	            {
506	                is_networking = true;
507	            } else if tool.get("functionDeclarations").is_some() {
508	                // 如果是 Gemini 风格的 functionDeclarations，进去看一眼
509	                if let Some(decls) = tool.get("functionDeclarations").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
510	                    for decl in decls {
511	                        if let Some(n) = decl.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
512	                            let keywords =
513	                                ["web_search", "google_search", "google_search_retrieval", "builtin_web_search"];
514	                            if !keywords.contains(&n) {
515	                                return true; // 发现本地函数
516	                            }
517	                        }
518	                    }
519	                }
520	                is_networking = true; // 即使全是联网，外层也标记为联网
521	            }
522	
523	            if !is_networking {
524	                return true;
525	            }
526	        }
527	    }
528	    false
529	}

1	use sha2::{Sha256, Digest};
2	use crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::{ClaudeRequest, MessageContent};
3	use crate::proxy::mappers::openai::models::{OpenAIRequest, OpenAIContent};
4	use serde_json::Value;
5	
6	/// 会话管理器工具
7	pub struct SessionManager;
8	
9	impl SessionManager {
10	    /// 根据 Claude 请求生成稳定的会话指纹 (Session Fingerprint)
11	    /// 
12	    /// 设计理念:
13	    /// - 只哈希第一条用户消息内容,不混入模型名称或时间戳
14	    /// - 确保同一对话的所有轮次使用相同的 session_id
15	    /// - 最大化 prompt caching 的命中率
16	    /// 
17	    /// 优先级:
18	    /// 1. metadata.user_id (客户端显式提供)
19	    /// 2. 第一条用户消息的 SHA256 哈希
20	    pub fn extract_session_id(request: &ClaudeRequest) -> String {
21	        // 1. 优先使用 metadata 中的 user_id
22	        if let Some(metadata) = &request.metadata {
23	            if let Some(user_id) = &metadata.user_id {
24	                if !user_id.is_empty() && !user_id.contains("session-") {
25	                    tracing::debug!("[SessionManager] Using explicit user_id: {}", user_id);
26	                    return user_id.clone();
27	                }
28	            }
29	        }
30	
31	        // 2. 备选方案：基于第一条用户消息的 SHA256 哈希
32	        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
33	
34	        let mut content_found = false;
35	        for msg in &request.messages {
36	            if msg.role != "user" { continue; }
37	            
38	            let text = match &msg.content {
39	                MessageContent::String(s) => s.clone(),
40	                MessageContent::Array(blocks) => {
41	                    blocks.iter()
42	                        .filter_map(|block| match block {
43	                            crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::ContentBlock::Text { text } => Some(text.as_str()),
44	                            _ => None,
45	                        })
46	                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
47	                        .join(" ")
48	                }
49	            };
50	
51	            let clean_text = text.trim();
52	            // [FIX #1732] 降低准入门槛 (10 -> 3)，确保即使是短消息也会生成稳定的会话锚点
53	            // 同时排除包含系统标志的消息，防止因为协议注入导致的 ID 漂移
54	            if clean_text.len() >= 3 && !clean_text.contains("<system-reminder>") && !clean_text.contains("[System") {
55	                hasher.update(clean_text.as_bytes());
56	                content_found = true;
57	                break; // 始终锚定第一条有效用户消息
58	            }
59	        }
60	
61	        if !content_found {
62	            // 如果没找到有意义的内容，退化为对最后一条消息进行哈希
63	            if let Some(last_msg) = request.messages.last() {
64	                hasher.update(format!("{:?}", last_msg.content).as_bytes());
65	            }
66	        }
67	
68	        let hash = format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize());
69	        let sid = format!("sid-{}", &hash[..16]);
70	        
71	        tracing::debug!(
72	            "[SessionManager] Generated session_id: {} (content_found: {}, model: {})", 
73	            sid,
74	            content_found,
75	            request.model
76	        );
77	        sid
78	    }
79	
80	    /// 根据 OpenAI 请求生成稳定的会话指纹
81	    pub fn extract_openai_session_id(request: &OpenAIRequest) -> String {
82	        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
83	
84	        let mut content_found = false;
85	        for msg in &request.messages {
86	            if msg.role != "user" { continue; }
87	            if let Some(content) = &msg.content {
88	                let text = match content {
89	                    OpenAIContent::String(s) => s.clone(),
90	                    OpenAIContent::Array(blocks) => {
91	                        blocks.iter()
92	                            .filter_map(|block| match block {
93	                                crate::proxy::mappers::openai::models::OpenAIContentBlock::Text { text } => Some(text.as_str()),
94	                                _ => None,
95	                            })
96	                            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
97	                            .join(" ")
98	                    }
99	                };
100	
101	                let clean_text = text.trim();
102	                if clean_text.len() > 10 && !clean_text.contains("<system-reminder>") {
103	                    hasher.update(clean_text.as_bytes());
104	                    content_found = true;
105	                    break;
106	                }
107	            }
108	        }
109	
110	        if !content_found {
111	            if let Some(last_msg) = request.messages.last() {
112	                hasher.update(format!("{:?}", last_msg.content).as_bytes());
113	            }
114	        }
115	
116	        let hash = format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize());
117	        let sid = format!("sid-{}", &hash[..16]);
118	        tracing::debug!("[SessionManager-OpenAI] Generated fingerprint: {}", sid);
119	        sid
120	    }
121	
122	    /// 根据 Gemini 原生请求 (JSON) 生成稳定的会话指纹
123	    pub fn extract_gemini_session_id(request: &Value, _model_name: &str) -> String {
124	        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
125	
126	        let mut content_found = false;
127	        if let Some(contents) = request.get("contents").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
128	            for content in contents {
129	                if content.get("role").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) != Some("user") { continue; }
130	                
131	                if let Some(parts) = content.get("parts").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
132	                    let mut text_parts = Vec::new();
133	                    for part in parts {
134	                        if let Some(text) = part.get("text").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
135	                            text_parts.push(text);
136	                        }
137	                    }
138	                    
139	                    let combined_text = text_parts.join(" ");
140	                    let clean_text = combined_text.trim();
141	                    if clean_text.len() > 10 && !clean_text.contains("<system-reminder>") {
142	                        hasher.update(clean_text.as_bytes());
143	                        content_found = true;
144	                        break;
145	                    }
146	                }
147	            }
148	        }
149	
150	        if !content_found {
151	             // 兜底：对整个 Body 的首个 user part 进行摘要
152	             hasher.update(request.to_string().as_bytes());
153	        }
154	
155	        let hash = format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize());
156	        let sid = format!("sid-{}", &hash[..16]);
157	        tracing::debug!("[SessionManager-Gemini] Generated fingerprint: {}", sid);
158	        sid
159	    }
160	}

78	    /// 启动限流记录自动清理后台任务（每15秒检查并清除过期记录）
79	    pub async fn start_auto_cleanup(&self) {
80	        let tracker = self.rate_limit_tracker.clone();
81	        let cancel = self.cancel_token.child_token();
82	
83	        let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
84	            let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(15));
85	            loop {
86	                tokio::select! {
87	                    _ = cancel.cancelled() => {
88	                        tracing::info!("Auto-cleanup task received cancel signal");
89	                        break;
90	                    }
91	                    _ = interval.tick() => {
92	                        let cleaned = tracker.cleanup_expired();
93	                        if cleaned > 0 {
94	                            tracing::info!(
95	                                "Auto-cleanup: Removed {} expired rate limit record(s)",
96	                                cleaned
97	                            );
98	                        }
99	                    }
100	                }
101	            }
102	        });
103	
104	        // 先 abort 旧任务（防止任务泄漏），再存储新 handle
105	        let mut guard = self.auto_cleanup_handle.lock().await;
106	        if let Some(old) = guard.take() {
107	            old.abort();
108	            tracing::warn!("Aborted previous auto-cleanup task");
109	        }
110	        *guard = Some(handle);
111	
112	        tracing::info!("Rate limit auto-cleanup task started (interval: 15s)");
113	    }

221	    /// Check if an account has been disabled on disk.
222	    ///
223	    /// Safety net: avoids selecting a disabled account when the in-memory pool hasn't been
224	    /// reloaded yet (e.g. fixed account mode / sticky session).
225	    ///
226	    /// Note: this is intentionally tolerant to transient read/parse failures (e.g. concurrent
227	    /// writes). Failures are reported as `Unknown` so callers can skip without purging the in-memory
228	    /// token pool.
229	    async fn get_account_state_on_disk(account_path: &std::path::PathBuf) -> OnDiskAccountState {
230	        const MAX_RETRIES: usize = 2;
231	        const RETRY_DELAY_MS: u64 = 5;
232	
233	        for attempt in 0..=MAX_RETRIES {
234	            let content = match tokio::fs::read_to_string(account_path).await {
235	                Ok(c) => c,
236	                Err(e) => {
237	                    // If the file is gone, the in-memory token is definitely stale.
238	                    if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound {
239	                        return OnDiskAccountState::Disabled;
240	                    }
241	                    if attempt < MAX_RETRIES {
242	                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(RETRY_DELAY_MS)).await;
243	                        continue;
244	                    }
245	                    tracing::debug!(
246	                        "Failed to read account file on disk {:?}: {}",
247	                        account_path,
248	                        e
249	                    );
250	                    return OnDiskAccountState::Unknown;
251	                }
252	            };
253	
254	            let account = match serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&content) {
255	                Ok(v) => v,
256	                Err(e) => {
257	                    if attempt < MAX_RETRIES {
258	                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(RETRY_DELAY_MS)).await;
259	                        continue;
260	                    }
261	                    tracing::debug!(
262	                        "Failed to parse account JSON on disk {:?}: {}",
263	                        account_path,
264	                        e
265	                    );
266	                    return OnDiskAccountState::Unknown;
267	                }
268	            };
269	
270	            let disabled = account
271	                .get("disabled")
272	                .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
273	                .unwrap_or(false)
274	                || account
275	                    .get("proxy_disabled")
276	                    .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
277	                    .unwrap_or(false)
278	                || account
279	                    .get("quota")
280	                    .and_then(|q| q.get("is_forbidden"))
281	                    .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
282	                    .unwrap_or(false);
283	
284	            return if disabled {
285	                OnDiskAccountState::Disabled
286	            } else {
287	                OnDiskAccountState::Enabled
288	            };
289	        }
290	
291	        OnDiskAccountState::Unknown
292	    }
293

302	        let is_proxy_disabled = account

92	/// Map Claude model names to Gemini model names
93	/// 
94	/// # 映射策略
95	/// 1. **精确匹配**: 检查 CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI 映射表
96	/// 2. **已知前缀透传**: gemini-* 和 *-thinking 模型直接透传
97	/// 3. **[NEW] 直接透传**: 未知模型 ID 直接传递给 Google API (支持体验未发布模型)
98	/// 
99	/// # 参数
100	/// - `input`: 原始模型名称
101	/// 
102	/// # 返回
103	/// 映射后的目标模型名称
104	/// 
105	/// # 示例
106	/// ```
107	/// // 精确匹配
108	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-opus-4"), "claude-opus-4-5-thinking");
109	/// 
110	/// // Gemini 模型透传
111	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("gemini-2.5-flash"), "gemini-2.5-flash");
112	/// 
113	/// // 直接透传未知模型 (NEW!)
114	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-opus-4-6"), "claude-opus-4-6");
115	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-sonnet-5"), "claude-sonnet-5");
116	/// ```
117	pub fn map_claude_model_to_gemini(input: &str) -> String {
118	    // 1. Check exact match in map
119	    if let Some(mapped) = CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI.get(input) {
120	        return mapped.to_string();
121	    }
122	
123	    // 2. Pass-through known prefixes (gemini-, -thinking) to support dynamic suffixes
124	    if input.starts_with("gemini-") || input.contains("thinking") {
125	        return input.to_string();
126	    }
127	
128	
129	    // 3. [ENHANCED] 直接透传未知模型 ID,而不是强制 fallback
130	    // 这允许用户通过自定义映射体验未发布的模型 (如 claude-opus-4-6)
131	    // Google API 会自动处理无效模型并返回错误,用户可以根据错误调整映射
132	    input.to_string()
133	}

198	/// Wildcard matching - supports multiple wildcards
199	///
200	/// **Note**: Matching is **case-sensitive**. Pattern `GPT-4*` will NOT match `gpt-4-turbo`.
201	///
202	/// Examples:
203	/// - `gpt-4*` matches `gpt-4`, `gpt-4-turbo` ✓
204	/// - `claude-*-sonnet-*` matches `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` ✓
205	/// - `*-thinking` matches `claude-opus-4-5-thinking` ✓
206	/// - `a*b*c` matches `a123b456c` ✓
207	fn wildcard_match(pattern: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
208	    let parts: Vec<&str> = pattern.split('*').collect();
209	
210	    // No wildcard - exact match
211	    if parts.len() == 1 {
212	        return pattern == text;
213	    }
214	
215	    let mut text_pos = 0;
216	
217	    for (i, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
218	        if part.is_empty() {
219	            continue; // Skip empty segments from consecutive wildcards
220	        }
221	
222	        if i == 0 {
223	            // First segment must match start
224	            if !text[text_pos..].starts_with(part) {
225	                return false;
226	            }
227	            text_pos += part.len();
228	        } else if i == parts.len() - 1 {
229	            // Last segment must match end
230	            return text[text_pos..].ends_with(part);
231	        } else {
232	            // Middle segments - find next occurrence
233	            if let Some(pos) = text[text_pos..].find(part) {
234	                text_pos += pos + part.len();
235	            } else {
236	                return false;
237	            }
238	        }
239	    }
240	
241	    true
242	}

244	/// 核心模型路由解析引擎
245	/// 优先级：精确匹配 > 通配符匹配 > 系统默认映射
246	/// 
247	/// # 参数
248	/// - `original_model`: 原始模型名称
249	/// - `custom_mapping`: 用户自定义映射表
250	/// 
251	/// # 返回
252	/// 映射后的目标模型名称
253	pub fn resolve_model_route(
254	    original_model: &str,
255	    custom_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
256	) -> String {
257	    // 0. API 热更新废弃模型转发 (最高物理优先级，强制纠正)
258	    // 如果用户非要用已经被移除的模型，并且官方下发了 fallback path，我们在此拦截并纠正
259	    if let Some(forwarded) = DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES.get(original_model) {
260	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 官方淘汰重定向: {} -> {}", original_model, forwarded.value()));
261	        return forwarded.value().clone();
262	    }
263	
264	    // 1. 精确匹配 (次高优先级)
265	    if let Some(target) = custom_mapping.get(original_model) {
266	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 精确映射: {} -> {}", original_model, target));
267	        return target.clone();
268	    }
269	    
270	    // 2. Wildcard match - most specific (highest non-wildcard chars) wins
271	    // Note: When multiple patterns have the SAME specificity, HashMap iteration order
272	    // determines the result (non-deterministic). Users can avoid this by making patterns
273	    // more specific. Future improvement: use IndexMap + frontend sorting for full control.
274	    let mut best_match: Option<(&str, &str, usize)> = None;
275	
276	    for (pattern, target) in custom_mapping.iter() {
277	        if pattern.contains('*') && wildcard_match(pattern, original_model) {
278	            let specificity = pattern.chars().count() - pattern.matches('*').count();
279	            if best_match.is_none() || specificity > best_match.unwrap().2 {
280	                best_match = Some((pattern.as_str(), target.as_str(), specificity));
281	            }
282	        }
283	    }
284	
285	    if let Some((pattern, target, _)) = best_match {
286	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
287	            "[Router] Wildcard match: {} -> {} (rule: {})",
288	            original_model, target, pattern
289	        ));
290	        return target.to_string();
291	    }
292	    
293	    // 3. 系统默认映射
294	    let result = map_claude_model_to_gemini(original_model);
295	    if result != original_model {
296	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 系统默认映射: {} -> {}", original_model, result));
297	    }
298	    result

301	/// Normalize any physical model name to one of the 3 standard protection IDs.
302	/// This ensures quota protection works consistently regardless of API versioning or request variations.
303	/// 
304	/// Standard IDs:
305	/// - `gemini-3-flash`: All Flash variants (1.5-flash, 2.5-flash, 3-flash, etc.)
306	/// - `gemini-3-pro-high`: All Pro variants (1.5-pro, 2.5-pro, etc.)
307	/// - `claude-sonnet-4-5`: All Claude Sonnet variants (3-5-sonnet, sonnet-4-5, etc.)
308	/// 
309	/// Returns `None` if the model doesn't match any of the 3 protected categories.
310	pub fn normalize_to_standard_id(model_name: &str) -> Option<String> {
311	    let lower = model_name.to_lowercase();
312	    
313	    // 1. image 资源 (优先匹配，使用 contains 匹配以支持任何变体，如 gemini-3.1-flash-image)
314	    if lower.contains("image") {
315	        return Some("gemini-3-pro-image".to_string());
316	    }
317	
318	    // 2. gemini-3-flash (包含所有 flash 变体)
319	    if lower.contains("flash") {
320	        return Some("gemini-3-flash".to_string());
321	    }
322	
323	    // 3. gemini-3-pro-high (包含 pro 变体)
324	    if lower.contains("pro") && !lower.contains("image") {
325	        return Some("gemini-3-pro-high".to_string());
326	    }
327	
328	    // 4. Claude 系列 (合并 Opus, Sonnet, Haiku 为统一保护组 'claude')
329	    if lower.contains("claude") || lower.contains("opus") || lower.contains("sonnet") || lower.contains("haiku") {
330	        return Some("claude".to_string());
331	    }
332	
333	    None
334	}

10	/// IP 黑白名单过滤中间件
11	pub async fn ip_filter_middleware(
12	    State(state): State<AppState>,
13	    request: Request,
14	    next: Next,
15	) -> Response {
16	    // 提取客户端 IP
17	    let client_ip = extract_client_ip(&request);
18	    
19	    if let Some(ip) = &client_ip {
20	        // 读取安全配置
21	        let security_config = state.security.read().await;
22	        
23	        // 1. 检查白名单 (如果启用白名单模式,只允许白名单 IP)
24	        if security_config.security_monitor.whitelist.enabled {
25	            match security_db::is_ip_in_whitelist(ip) {
26	                Ok(true) => {
27	                    // 在白名单中,直接放行
28	                    tracing::debug!("[IP Filter] IP {} is in whitelist, allowing", ip);
29	                    return next.run(request).await;
30	                }
31	                Ok(false) => {
32	                    // 不在白名单中,且启用了白名单模式,拒绝访问
33	                    tracing::warn!("[IP Filter] IP {} not in whitelist, blocking", ip);
34	                    return create_blocked_response(
35	                        ip,
36	                        "Access denied. Your IP is not in the whitelist.",
37	                    );
38	                }
39	                Err(e) => {
40	                    tracing::error!("[IP Filter] Failed to check whitelist: {}", e);
41	                }
42	            }
43	        } else {
44	            // 白名单优先模式: 如果在白名单中,跳过黑名单检查
45	            if security_config.security_monitor.whitelist.whitelist_priority {
46	                match security_db::is_ip_in_whitelist(ip) {
47	                    Ok(true) => {
48	                        tracing::debug!("[IP Filter] IP {} is in whitelist (priority mode), skipping blacklist check", ip);
49	                        return next.run(request).await;
50	                    }
51	                    Ok(false) => {
52	                        // 继续检查黑名单
53	                    }
54	                    Err(e) => {
55	                        tracing::error!("[IP Filter] Failed to check whitelist: {}", e);
56	                    }
57	                }
58	            }
59	        }
60	
61	        // 2. 检查黑名单
62	        if security_config.security_monitor.blacklist.enabled {
63	            match security_db::get_blacklist_entry_for_ip(ip) {
64	                Ok(Some(entry)) => {
65	                    tracing::warn!("[IP Filter] IP {} is in blacklist, blocking", ip);
66	                    
67	                    // 构建详细的封禁消息
68	                    let reason = entry.reason.as_deref().unwrap_or("Malicious activity detected");
69	                    let ban_type = if let Some(expires_at) = entry.expires_at {
70	                        let now = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
71	                        let remaining_seconds = expires_at - now;
72	                        
73	                        if remaining_seconds > 0 {
74	                            let hours = remaining_seconds / 3600;
75	                            let minutes = (remaining_seconds % 3600) / 60;
76	                            
77	                            if hours > 24 {
78	                                let days = hours / 24;
79	                                format!("Temporary ban. Please try again after {} day(s).", days)
80	                            } else if hours > 0 {
81	                                format!("Temporary ban. Please try again after {} hour(s) and {} minute(s).", hours, minutes)
82	                            } else {
83	                                format!("Temporary ban. Please try again after {} minute(s).", minutes)
84	                            }
85	                        } else {
86	                            "Temporary ban (expired, will be removed soon).".to_string()
87	                        }
88	                    } else {
89	                        "Permanent ban.".to_string()
90	                    };
91	                    
92	                    let detailed_message = format!(
93	                        "Access denied. Reason: {}. {}",
94	                        reason,
95	                        ban_type
96	                    );
97	                    
98	                    // 记录被封禁的访问日志
99	                    let log = security_db::IpAccessLog {
100	                        id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
101	                        client_ip: ip.clone(),
102	                        timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
103	                        method: Some(request.method().to_string()),
104	                        path: Some(request.uri().to_string()),
105	                        user_agent: request
106	                            .headers()
107	                            .get("user-agent")
108	                            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
109	                            .map(|s| s.to_string()),
110	                        status: Some(403),
111	                        duration: Some(0),
112	                        api_key_hash: None,
113	                        blocked: true,
114	                        block_reason: Some(format!("IP in blacklist: {}", reason)),
115	                        username: None,
116	                    };
117	                    
118	                    tokio::spawn(async move {
119	                        if let Err(e) = security_db::save_ip_access_log(&log) {
120	                            tracing::error!("[IP Filter] Failed to save blocked access log: {}", e);
121	                        }
122	                    });
123	                    
124	                    return create_blocked_response(
125	                        ip,
126	                        &detailed_message,
127	                    );
128	                }
129	                Ok(None) => {
130	                    // 不在黑名单中,放行
131	                    tracing::debug!("[IP Filter] IP {} not in blacklist, allowing", ip);
132	                }
133	                Err(e) => {
134	                    tracing::error!("[IP Filter] Failed to check blacklist: {}", e);
135	                }
136	            }
137	        }
138	    } else {
139	        tracing::warn!("[IP Filter] Unable to extract client IP from request");
140	    }
141	
142	    // 放行请求
143	    next.run(request).await
144	}

146	/// 从请求中提取客户端 IP
147	fn extract_client_ip(request: &Request) -> Option<String> {
148	    // 1. 优先从 X-Forwarded-For 提取 (取第一个 IP)
149	    request
150	        .headers()
151	        .get("x-forwarded-for")
152	        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
153	        .map(|s| s.split(',').next().unwrap_or(s).trim().to_string())
154	        .or_else(|| {
155	            // 2. 备选从 X-Real-IP 提取
156	            request
157	                .headers()
158	                .get("x-real-ip")
159	                .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
160	                .map(|s| s.to_string())
161	        })
162	        .or_else(|| {
163	            // 3. 最后尝试从 ConnectInfo 获取 (TCP 连接 IP)
164	            // 这可以解决本地开发/测试时没有代理头导致 IP 获取失败的问题
165	            request
166	                .extensions()
167	                .get::<axum::extract::ConnectInfo<std::net::SocketAddr>>()
168	                .map(|info| info.0.ip().to_string())
169	        })
170	}
171	
172	/// 创建被封禁的响应
173	fn create_blocked_response(ip: &str, message: &str) -> Response {
174	    let body = serde_json::json!({
175	        "error": {
176	            "message": message,
177	            "type": "ip_blocked",
178	            "code": "ip_blocked",
179	            "ip": ip,
180	        }
181	    });
182	    
183	    (
184	        StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
185	        [(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")],
186	        serde_json::to_string(&body).unwrap_or_else(|_| message.to_string()),
187	    )
188	        .into_response()
189	}

13	/// Safety threshold levels for Gemini API
14	/// Can be configured via GEMINI_SAFETY_THRESHOLD environment variable
15	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
16	pub enum SafetyThreshold {
17	    /// Disable all safety filters (default for proxy compatibility)
18	    Off,
19	    /// Block low probability and above
20	    BlockLowAndAbove,
21	    /// Block medium probability and above
22	    BlockMediumAndAbove,
23	    /// Only block high probability content
24	    BlockOnlyHigh,
25	    /// Don't block anything (BLOCK_NONE)
26	    BlockNone,
27	}
28	
29	impl SafetyThreshold {
30	    /// Get threshold from environment variable or default to Off
31	    pub fn from_env() -> Self {
32	        match std::env::var("GEMINI_SAFETY_THRESHOLD").as_deref() {
33	            Ok("OFF") | Ok("off") => SafetyThreshold::Off,
34	            Ok("LOW") | Ok("low") => SafetyThreshold::BlockLowAndAbove,
35	            Ok("MEDIUM") | Ok("medium") => SafetyThreshold::BlockMediumAndAbove,
36	            Ok("HIGH") | Ok("high") => SafetyThreshold::BlockOnlyHigh,
37	            Ok("NONE") | Ok("none") => SafetyThreshold::BlockNone,
38	            _ => SafetyThreshold::Off, // Default: maintain current behavior
39	        }
40	    }
41	
42	    /// Convert to Gemini API threshold string
43	    pub fn to_gemini_threshold(&self) -> &'static str {
44	        match self {
45	            SafetyThreshold::Off => "OFF",
46	            SafetyThreshold::BlockLowAndAbove => "BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE",
47	            SafetyThreshold::BlockMediumAndAbove => "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE",
48	            SafetyThreshold::BlockOnlyHigh => "BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH",
49	            SafetyThreshold::BlockNone => "BLOCK_NONE",
50	        }
51	    }
52	}
53	
54	/// Build safety settings based on configuration
55	fn build_safety_settings() -> Value {
56	    let threshold = SafetyThreshold::from_env();
57	    let threshold_str = threshold.to_gemini_threshold();
58	
59	    json!([
60	        { "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT", "threshold": threshold_str },

62	        { "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT", "threshold": threshold_str },

## Complete Proxy Architecture Analysis

### 1. Axum Server Setup

**File: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/server.rs`**

#### Server Structure (line 214-230)
The `AxumServer` struct holds all shared state including `TokenManager`, `UpstreamClient`, security config, Zai config, proxy pool manager, and monitor.

#### Startup (`AxumServer::start`, line 293-773)
The `start()` method:
1. Creates an `AppState` (line 326-362) containing all shared resources
2. Builds three route groups: **proxy_routes**, **admin_routes**, and **public routes**
3. Merges them and applies global layers

#### Route Registration (line 372-436)
**OpenAI Protocol routes:**
- `GET /v1/models` -- `handlers::openai::handle_list_models` (line 376)
- `POST /v1/chat/completions` -- `handlers::openai::handle_chat_completions` (line 378-379)
- `POST /v1/completions` -- `handlers::openai::handle_completions` (line 382-383)
- `POST /v1/responses` -- `handlers::openai::handle_completions` (line 385, Codex CLI compat)
- `POST /v1/images/generations` -- `handlers::openai::handle_images_generations` (line 387-388)
- `POST /v1/images/edits` -- `handlers::openai::handle_images_edits` (line 390-392)
- `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` -- `handlers::audio::handle_audio_transcription` (line 395-396)

**Claude Protocol routes:**

- `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens` -- `handlers::claude::handle_count_tokens` (line 401-402)
- `GET /v1/models/claude` -- `handlers::claude::handle_list_models` (line 405-406)

**Gemini Protocol routes:**

- `GET|POST /v1beta/models/:model` -- `handlers::gemini::handle_get_model / handle_generate` (line 422-423)
- `POST /v1beta/models/:model/countTokens` -- `handlers::gemini::handle_count_tokens` (line 426-427)

**MCP routes:**
- `/mcp/web_search_prime/mcp`, `/mcp/web_reader/mcp`, `/mcp/zai-mcp-server/mcp`

**Admin routes:** (line 455-664)
Nested under `/api`, includes account management, config, stats, security, proxy pool, OAuth, etc.

#### Middleware Stack (line 437-686)
The middleware is applied in "onion model" order. For proxy routes (line 441-452), from outer to inner:

```
Request:  ip_filter -> auth -> monitor -> handler
Response: handler -> monitor -> auth -> ip_filter
```

- **`ip_filter_middleware`** (`middleware/ip_filter.rs`, line 449-451) -- IP blacklist/whitelist check
- **`auth_middleware`** (`middleware/auth.rs`, line 445-447) -- API key or UserToken validation
- **`monitor_middleware`** (`middleware/monitor.rs`, line 441-443) -- Request/response logging, token extraction

Global layers (outermost, line 680-685):
- **`service_status_middleware`** -- checks if service is running
- **`cors_layer`** -- permissive CORS
- **`DefaultBodyLimit::max(100MB)`** -- body size limit

#### Connection Model (line 727-770)
The server uses raw `hyper` HTTP/1 with manual `TcpListener::accept()` loop rather than `axum::serve()`, enabling per-connection `ConnectInfo` injection via `map_request`.

---

### 2. Complete Request Flow

#### Step 1: Authentication (`middleware/auth.rs`, line 15-237)
`auth_middleware` checks `ProxySecurityConfig.effective_auth_mode()`:
- **Off mode**: Passes through, but still attempts UserToken identification
- **AllExceptHealth**: Skips health endpoints
- **Strict**: Requires `api_key` or `admin_password` match

Three auth sources are checked (line 119-135):
1. `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or bare key
2. `x-api-key` header
3. `x-goog-api-key` header

If the API key does not match, it attempts `UserToken` validation via `user_token_db::validate_token()`. Valid UserTokens inject a `UserTokenIdentity` into request extensions for monitor tracking.

#### Step 2: Monitoring (`middleware/monitor.rs`, line 36-501)
Records method, URI, model, IP, user agent, and optionally the full request/response body. For SSE streams, it intercepts and parses streaming data to extract token usage (input/output) and content summaries. Also records UserToken usage via `record_user_token_usage()`.

#### Step 3: Protocol Handler Entry
Each handler (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) follows the same general pattern:

**a. Parse request body** -- deserialize into protocol-specific struct
**b. Detect client adapter** -- check `CLIENT_ADAPTERS` for custom client behaviors (line ~263-268 in claude, ~141-147 in openai)
**c. Model routing** -- `resolve_model_route()` maps the requested model to an internal model name
**d. Resolve request config** -- `resolve_request_config()` determines request type (agent/web_search/image_gen), whether to inject googleSearch, and the final model name
**e. Extract session ID** -- `SessionManager::extract_*_session_id()` generates a stable session fingerprint from the first user message
**f. Account selection** -- `TokenManager::get_token()` selects the best account
**g. Transform request** -- Mapper converts to Gemini v1internal format
**h. Upstream call** -- `UpstreamClient::call_v1_internal_with_headers()` sends to Google
**i. Transform response** -- Mapper converts back to client protocol format
**j. Return with headers** -- `X-Account-Email`, `X-Mapped-Model`

#### Step 4: Account Rotation (`token_manager.rs`, line 1064-1313)
`TokenManager::get_token()` is the core of account selection:

1. **Pending reload/delete processing** (line 1072-1092) -- processes account state changes
2. **Snapshot and sort** (line 1117-1194) -- filters accounts that have quota for the target model, then sorts by:
   - Priority 0: Subscription tier (ULTRA > PRO > FREE)
   - Priority 1: Remaining quota percentage (higher = less used = preferred)
   - Priority 2: Health score
   - Priority 3: Reset time (earlier = sooner refresh = preferred, only if >10 min diff)
3. **Scheduling mode** (line 1218+) -- supports sticky sessions, round-robin, or fixed-account mode
4. **Preferred account** (line 1227+) -- if a specific account is pinned, use it
5. **Rate limit check** -- skips accounts locked by `RateLimitTracker`
6. **Quota protection** -- skips accounts that have `protected_models` containing the target model
7. **Token refresh** -- auto-refreshes expired OAuth tokens
8. **Return**: `(access_token, project_id, email, account_id, wait_ms)`

**Force rotation**: When `force_rotate=true` (passed on retry attempts, `attempt > 0`), the handler forces a different account to be selected.

#### Step 5: Retry Logic (`handlers/common.rs`, line 1-196)
Each handler loops up to `MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` (3) with `max_attempts.min(pool_size)`.

**`determine_retry_strategy()`** (line 23-76):
- **400**: Retry once only for signature errors (200ms delay)
- **429**: Parse `Retry-After` from response, use linear backoff (5s base) as fallback
- **503/529**: Exponential backoff (10s base, 60s max)
- **500**: Linear backoff (3s base)
- **401/403**: Fixed 200ms delay before account rotation
- **404**: Fixed 300ms delay (accounts for intermittent Google API issues)
- **Other**: NoRetry

**`should_rotate_account()`** (line 137-146):
Account rotation triggered for: 429, 401, 403, 404, 500
No rotation for: 400, 503, 529 (these are server-global issues)

#### Step 6: Upstream Call (`upstream/client.rs`, line 261-417)
`call_v1_internal_with_headers()` sends requests to Google Cloud Code v1internal API:

**Endpoint fallback chain** (line 53-57):
1. `daily-cloudcode-pa.sandbox.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Sandbox, priority 1)
2. `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Daily, priority 2)
3. `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Prod, fallback)

**Headers injected** (line 274-326):
- `Content-Type: application/json`
- `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`
- `User-Agent` (configurable, default from `crate::constants::USER_AGENT`)
- `x-client-name: antigravity`
- `x-client-version`
- `x-machine-id` (from `machine_uid::get()`)
- `x-vscode-sessionid`
- Extra headers (e.g., `anthropic-beta` for Claude models)

**Per-account proxy** (line 175-217): `get_client()` retrieves a cached HTTP client with a specific proxy from `ProxyPoolManager`, or falls back to the default client.

**Auto-fallback**: If an endpoint returns 429, 408, 404, or 5xx, it automatically tries the next endpoint (line 372-388).

### 3. Three Protocol Formats

#### OpenAI Protocol (`handlers/openai.rs` + `mappers/openai/`)

**Request flow:**
1. `handle_chat_completions()` parses `OpenAIRequest` (line 28)
2. Auto-converts Responses API format to Chat Completions if `instructions`/`input` fields detected (line 46-91)
3. `resolve_model_route()` maps OpenAI model IDs (e.g., `gpt-4o`) to Gemini IDs
4. `transform_openai_request()` (`mappers/openai/request.rs`) converts to Gemini v1internal format:
   - Maps messages, tools, system prompts
   - Handles thinking mode (`-thinking` suffix)
   - Injects `googleSearch` tool if grounded
   - Returns `(gemini_body, session_id, message_count)`
5. Calls `streamGenerateContent` or `generateContent` with `alt=sse` query param
6. **Streaming response**: `create_openai_sse_stream()` (`mappers/openai/streaming.rs`) converts Gemini SSE to OpenAI SSE format
7. **Non-streaming**: `collect_stream_to_json()` collects stream, then `transform_openai_response()` converts to `OpenAIResponse` JSON

- `mappers/openai/models.rs` -- `OpenAIRequest`, `OpenAIResponse`, message structs
- `mappers/openai/request.rs` -- `transform_openai_request()`

- `mappers/openai/streaming.rs` -- `create_openai_sse_stream()`

#### Claude Protocol (`handlers/claude.rs` + `mappers/claude/`)

**Request flow:**
1. `handle_messages()` parses `ClaudeRequest` (line 245)
2. Pre-processing: clean `cache_control`, merge consecutive same-role messages, filter invalid thinking blocks, recover broken tool loops (line 348-375)
3. Warmup detection (line 380-386) -- returns mock response for Claude Code warmup requests
4. Z.ai dispatch decision (line 271-346) -- determines whether to route to z.ai Anthropic passthrough or Google Gemini flow based on `ZaiDispatchMode`
5. **z.ai path**: `forward_anthropic_json()` to Anthropic-compatible endpoint
6. **Gemini path**: `transform_claude_request_in()` (`mappers/claude/request.rs`) converts to Gemini v1internal format

8. **Streaming response**: `create_claude_sse_stream()` (`mappers/claude/mod.rs`, line 25) converts Gemini SSE to Claude SSE:
   - Manages `StreamingState` with block types (Thinking, Text, ToolUse)
   - Emits `message_start`, `content_block_start/delta/stop`, `message_delta`, `message_stop` events
   - 60-second heartbeat timeout
   - Post-thinking interruption recovery
9. **Non-streaming**: `transform_response()` (`mappers/claude/response.rs`) converts Gemini response to Claude JSON format, including tool call parameter remapping (e.g., Gemini `query` -> Claude `pattern`)

- `mappers/claude/models.rs` -- `ClaudeRequest`, `Message`, `ContentBlock`, `ThinkingConfig`
- `mappers/claude/request.rs` -- `transform_claude_request_in()`, safety settings, message cleaning

#### Gemini Protocol (`handlers/gemini.rs` + `mappers/gemini/`)

---

### 4. Account Rotation, Retry, and Rate Limiting

#### Account Rotation
- Triggered by `force_rotate=true` in `TokenManager::get_token()` (passed as `attempt > 0` from handlers)
- The sort order ensures the "next best" account is selected on retry
- `should_rotate_account()` determines whether to rotate based on HTTP status
- Sticky sessions (`session_manager.rs`) maintain session-to-account mapping via `SessionManager::extract_*_session_id()` for consistent routing within a conversation

#### Retry Logic (`handlers/common.rs`)
- Each handler has a retry loop (up to 3 attempts, capped by pool size)
- Backoff strategies: FixedDelay, LinearBackoff, ExponentialBackoff, NoRetry
- `apply_retry_strategy()` sleeps according to the strategy, then returns `true` to continue retrying
- Client adapter `let_it_crash` mode: if enabled, aborts retries after the first failure (line 572-579 in gemini handler)

#### Rate Limiting (`rate_limit.rs`)
`RateLimitTracker` uses a `DashMap<String, RateLimitInfo>` to track lockouts:
- **Account-level** key: `account_id`
- **Model-level** key: `account_id:model_id` (only for `QuotaExhausted`)

**RateLimitReason types:**
- `QuotaExhausted` -- from `QUOTA_EXHAUSTED` in error JSON, uses configured `backoff_steps` (60s, 300s, 1800s, 7200s) with exponential escalation
- `RateLimitExceeded` -- TPM/RPM, default 5s retry
- `ModelCapacityExhausted` -- default 5/10/15s escalating
- `ServerError` -- 5xx errors, fixed 8s (does NOT accumulate failure count to avoid polluting 429 backoff)

**Lockout mechanisms:**
- `set_lockout_until()` -- precise lockout from quota reset time
- `set_lockout_until_iso()` -- parse ISO 8601 timestamps
- `parse_from_error()` -- parse HTTP error response (Retry-After header, JSON body, regex patterns)

**Duration parsing** (`upstream/retry.rs`): Parses formats like "1.5s", "200ms", "1h16m0.667s" from API error responses.

**Per-account rate limiter** (`common/rate_limiter.rs`): Simple min-interval enforcement (e.g., 500ms between calls) for individual accounts.

### 4. `handlers/common.rs` -- Retry Logic

**`determine_retry_strategy`**: Lines 23-76
- Returns `RetryStrategy` enum based on HTTP status code and error text
- 429: `FixedDelay` (from Retry-After header) or `LinearBackoff { base_ms: 5000 }`
- 503/529: `ExponentialBackoff { base_ms: 10000, max_ms: 60000 }`
- 500: `LinearBackoff { base_ms: 3000 }`
- 401/403: `FixedDelay(200ms)` -- triggers account rotation
- 404: `FixedDelay(300ms)` -- Gemini Cloud Code API intermittent
- 400: Only retries for specific thinking signature errors (first time)
- Everything else: `NoRetry`

**`apply_retry_strategy`**: Lines 79-134
- Executes the sleep for the chosen strategy
- Returns `true` if should continue retrying, `false` if should stop

**`should_rotate_account`**: Lines 137-146
- Returns `true` for: 429, 401, 403, 404, 500
- Returns `false` for: 400, 503, 529, and everything else
- Note: This function only **logs** whether to rotate; the actual rotation is controlled by `force_rotate = attempt > 0` passed to `get_token()`

---

**Key flow:**
| Step | Line(s) | Description |
|------|---------|-------------|
| Get client | 271 | `self.get_client(account_id).await` -- selects per-account proxy from pool |
| Build headers | 274-291 | `Content-Type`, `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}`, `User-Agent` |
| Identity headers | 295-313 | `x-client-name: antigravity`, `x-client-version`, `x-machine-id`, `x-vscode-sessionid` |
| Extra headers | 320-326 | Inject `anthropic-beta` etc. |
| Endpoint fallback loop | 336-414 | Iterates through 3 endpoints: Sandbox -> Daily -> Prod |
| **HTTP POST** | **340-345** | `client.post(&url).headers(headers.clone()).json(&body).send().await` |

**Auth headers used:**
- `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` (line 280-283) -- this is the OAuth access token from the selected Google account
- `x-client-name: antigravity` (line 296-298)
- `x-client-version: {CURRENT_VERSION}` (line 299-301)
- `x-machine-id: {machine_uid}` (line 306-308)
- `x-vscode-sessionid: {SESSION_ID}` (line 311-313)

The `account_id` parameter is used **only** for proxy selection via `get_client(account_id)` at line 271. The actual authentication uses the `access_token` string.

- Line 326-362: `AppState` is built with all shared state
- Line 327: `token_manager: token_manager.clone()` -- the TokenManager is the central account selection authority
- Line 334-344: `upstream` client is created as `UpstreamClient::new(...)` with proxy config and proxy pool manager
- Line 353-355: `account_service` is also initialized

  - `/v1/messages` -> `handlers::claude::handle_messages` (line 399)

---

### Summary: What `TokenManager::get_token()` Returns

All three handlers call `token_manager.get_token(request_type, force_rotate, session_id, final_model)` which returns a 5-tuple:
```rust
(access_token, project_id, email, account_id, wait_ms)
```

- `access_token`: OAuth bearer token for the upstream call
- `project_id`: Google Cloud project ID injected into the request body
- `email`: Human-readable account email (for logging / response headers)
- `account_id`: Internal account identifier (for proxy pool selection and token cache)
- `wait_ms`: Suggested wait time (unused in handlers, denoted as `_wait_ms`)

### Key Architectural Observation

In all three handlers, the pattern is identical:
1. The `for attempt in 0..max_attempts` loop **encloses** both the account selection (`get_token`) and the upstream HTTP call
2. On each retry iteration, `get_token()` is called again with `force_rotate = attempt > 0`, which selects a **different** account
3. The `account_id` from the newly selected account is passed to `call_v1_internal_with_headers` for per-account proxy selection
4. The `access_token` from the newly selected account is used as the Bearer token

To skip account selection on retries, you would need to:
- Move the `get_token()` call **before** the retry loop
- Pass the same `access_token`, `project_id`, `email`, and `account_id` through all retry iterations
- Remove the `attempt > 0` force-rotate flag

1	use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};
2	use tracing::{debug, info};
3	use axum::{http::StatusCode, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, Json, extract::State};
4	use serde_json::{json, Value};

7	// ===== 统一重试与退避策略 =====
8	
9	/// 重试策略枚举
10	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
11	pub enum RetryStrategy {
12	    /// 不重试，直接返回错误
13	    NoRetry,
14	    /// 固定延迟
15	    FixedDelay(Duration),
16	    /// 线性退避：base_ms * (attempt + 1)
17	    LinearBackoff { base_ms: u64 },
18	    /// 指数退避：base_ms * 2^attempt，上限 max_ms
19	    ExponentialBackoff { base_ms: u64, max_ms: u64 },
20	}
21	
22	/// 根据错误状态码和错误信息确定重试策略
23	pub fn determine_retry_strategy(
24	    status_code: u16,
25	    error_text: &str,
26	    retried_without_thinking: bool,
27	) -> RetryStrategy {
28	    match status_code {
29	        // 400 错误：仅在特定 Thinking 签名失败时重试一次
30	        400 if !retried_without_thinking
31	            && (error_text.contains("Invalid `signature`")
32	                || error_text.contains("thinking.signature")
33	                || error_text.contains("thinking.thinking")
34	                || error_text.contains("Corrupted thought signature")) =>
35	        {
36	            RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(200))
37	        }
38	
39	        // 429 限流错误
40	        429 => {
41	            // 优先使用服务端返回的 Retry-After
42	            if let Some(delay_ms) = crate::proxy::upstream::retry::parse_retry_delay(error_text) {
43	                let actual_delay = delay_ms.saturating_add(200).min(30_000); // 上限上调至 30s
44	                RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(actual_delay))
45	            } else {
46	                // 否则使用线性退避：起始 5s，逐步增加
47	                RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms: 5000 }
48	            }
49	        }
50	
51	        // 503 服务不可用 / 529 服务器过载
52	        503 | 529 => {
53	            // 指数退避：起始 10s，上限 60s (针对 Google 边缘节点过载)
54	            RetryStrategy::ExponentialBackoff {
55	                base_ms: 10000,
56	                max_ms: 60000,
57	            }
58	        }
59	
60	        // 500 服务器内部错误
61	        500 => {
62	            // 线性退避：起始 3s
63	            RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms: 3000 }
64	        }
65	
66	        // 401/403 认证/权限错误：切换账号前给予极短缓冲
67	        401 | 403 => RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(200)),
68	
69	        // 404 资源未找到：Google Cloud Code API 的 404 通常是账号级别的间歇性问题
70	        // (灰度发布、账号权限不同步等)，轮换账号往往能解决
71	        404 => RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(300)),
72	
73	        // 其他错误：不重试
74	        _ => RetryStrategy::NoRetry,
75	    }
76	}
77	
78	/// 执行退避策略并返回是否应该继续重试
79	pub async fn apply_retry_strategy(
80	    strategy: RetryStrategy,
81	    attempt: usize,
82	    max_attempts: usize,
83	    status_code: u16,
84	    trace_id: &str,
85	) -> bool {
86	    match strategy {
87	        RetryStrategy::NoRetry => {
88	            debug!("[{}] Non-retryable error {}, stopping", trace_id, status_code);
89	            false
90	        }
91	
92	        RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(duration) => {
93	            let base_ms = duration.as_millis() as u64;
94	            info!(
95	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with fixed delay: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
96	                trace_id,
97	                status_code,
98	                attempt + 1,
99	                max_attempts,
100	                base_ms
101	            );
102	            sleep(duration).await;
103	            true
104	        }
105	
106	        RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms } => {
107	            let calculated_ms = base_ms * (attempt as u64 + 1);
108	            info!(
109	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with linear backoff: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
110	                trace_id,
111	                status_code,
112	                attempt + 1,
113	                max_attempts,
114	                calculated_ms
115	            );
116	            sleep(Duration::from_millis(calculated_ms)).await;
117	            true
118	        }
119	
120	        RetryStrategy::ExponentialBackoff { base_ms, max_ms } => {
121	            let calculated_ms = (base_ms * 2_u64.pow(attempt as u32)).min(max_ms);
122	            info!(
123	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with exponential backoff: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
124	                trace_id,
125	                status_code,
126	                attempt + 1,
127	                max_attempts,
128	                calculated_ms
129	            );
130	            sleep(Duration::from_millis(calculated_ms)).await;
131	            true
132	        }
133	    }
134	}

136	/// 判断是否应该轮换账号
137	pub fn should_rotate_account(status_code: u16) -> bool {
138	    match status_code {
139	        // 这些错误是账号级别或特定节点配额的，需要轮换
140	        // 404: Google Cloud Code API 模型可用性因账号而异（灰度/权限）
141	        429 | 401 | 403 | 404 | 500 => true,
142	        // 这些错误通常是协议或服务端全局性、甚至参数错误的，轮换账号通常无意义
143	        400 | 503 | 529 => false,
144	        _ => false,
145	    }
146	}

148	/// Detects model capabilities and configuration
149	/// POST /v1/models/detect
150	pub async fn handle_detect_model(
151	    State(state): State<AppState>,
152	    Json(body): Json<Value>,
153	) -> Response {
154	    let model_name = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
155	    
156	    if model_name.is_empty() {
157	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "Missing 'model' field").into_response();
158	    }
159	
160	    // 1. Resolve mapping
161	    let mapped_model = crate::proxy::common::model_mapping::resolve_model_route(
162	        model_name,
163	        &*state.custom_mapping.read().await,
164	    );
165	
166	    // 2. Resolve capabilities
167	    let config = crate::proxy::mappers::common_utils::resolve_request_config(
168	        model_name,
169	        &mapped_model,
170	        &None, // We don't check tools for static capability detection
171	        None,  // size
172	        None,  // quality
173	        None,  // image_size
174	        None,  // body (not needed for static detection)
175	    );
176	
177	    // 3. Construct response
178	    let mut response = json!({
179	        "model": model_name,
180	        "mapped_model": mapped_model,
181	        "type": config.request_type,
182	        "features": {
183	            "has_web_search": config.inject_google_search,
184	            "is_image_gen": config.request_type == "image_gen"
185	        }
186	    });
187	
188	    if let Some(img_conf) = config.image_config {
189	        if let Some(obj) = response.as_object_mut() {
190	            obj.insert("config".to_string(), img_conf);
191	        }
192	    }
193	
194	    Json(response).into_response()
195	}

30	/// 邮箱脱敏：只显示前3位 + *** + @域名前2位 + ***
31	/// 例: "userexample@gmail.com" → "use***@gm***"
32	pub fn mask_email(email: &str) -> String {
33	    if let Some(at_pos) = email.find('@') {
34	        let local = &email[..at_pos];
35	        let domain = &email[at_pos + 1..];
36	        let local_prefix: String = local.chars().take(3).collect();
37	        let domain_prefix: String = domain.chars().take(2).collect();
38	        format!("{}***@{}***", local_prefix, domain_prefix)
39	    } else {
40	        // 不是合法邮箱格式，直接截取前5位
41	        let prefix: String = email.chars().take(5).collect();
42	        format!("{}***", prefix)
43	    }

48	const V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_PROD: &str = "https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal";

51	    "https://daily-cloudcode-pa.sandbox.googleapis.com/v1internal";
52	
53	const V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS: [&str; 3] = [
54	    V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_SANDBOX, // 优先级 1: Sandbox (已知有效且稳定)
55	    V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_DAILY,   // 优先级 2: Daily (备用)

59	pub struct UpstreamClient {
60	    default_client: Client,
61	    proxy_pool: Option<Arc<crate::proxy::proxy_pool::ProxyPoolManager>>,
62	    client_cache: DashMap<String, Client>, // proxy_id -> Client
63	    user_agent_override: RwLock<Option<String>>,
64	}
65	
66	impl UpstreamClient {
67	    pub fn new(
68	        proxy_config: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
69	        proxy_pool: Option<Arc<crate::proxy::proxy_pool::ProxyPoolManager>>,
70	    ) -> Self {
71	        let default_client = match Self::build_client_internal(proxy_config.clone()) {
72	            Ok(client) => client,
73	            Err(err_with_proxy) => {
74	                tracing::error!(
75	                    error = %err_with_proxy,
76	                    "Failed to create default HTTP client with configured upstream proxy; retrying without proxy"
77	                );
78	                match Self::build_client_internal(None) {
79	                    Ok(client) => client,
80	                    Err(err_without_proxy) => {
81	                        tracing::error!(
82	                            error = %err_without_proxy,
83	                            "Failed to create default HTTP client without proxy; falling back to bare client"
84	                        );
85	                        Client::new()
86	                    }
87	                }
88	            }
89	        };
90	
91	        Self {
92	            default_client,
93	            proxy_pool,
94	            client_cache: DashMap::new(),
95	            user_agent_override: RwLock::new(None),
96	        }
97	    }
98	
99	    /// Internal helper to build a client with optional upstream proxy config
100	    fn build_client_internal(
101	        proxy_config: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
102	    ) -> Result<Client, rquest::Error> {
103	        let mut builder = Client::builder()
104	            .emulation(rquest_util::Emulation::Chrome123)
105	            // Connection settings (优化连接复用，减少建立开销)
106	            .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
107	            .pool_max_idle_per_host(16) // 每主机最多 16 个空闲连接
108	            .pool_idle_timeout(Duration::from_secs(90)) // 空闲连接保持 90 秒
109	            .tcp_keepalive(Duration::from_secs(60)) // TCP 保活探测 60 秒
110	            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(600));
111	
112	        builder = Self::apply_default_user_agent(builder);
113	
114	        if let Some(config) = proxy_config {
115	            if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
116	                let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
117	                if let Ok(proxy) = rquest::Proxy::all(&url) {
118	                    builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
119	                    tracing::info!("UpstreamClient enabled proxy: {}", url);
120	                }
121	            }
122	        }
123	
124	        builder.build()
125	    }
126	
127	    /// Build a client with a specific PoolProxyConfig (from ProxyPool)
128	    fn build_client_with_proxy(
129	        &self,
130	        proxy_config: crate::proxy::proxy_pool::PoolProxyConfig,
131	    ) -> Result<Client, rquest::Error> {
132	        // Reuse base settings similar to default client but with specific proxy
133	        let builder = Client::builder()
134	            .emulation(rquest_util::Emulation::Chrome123)
135	            .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
136	            .pool_max_idle_per_host(16)
137	            .pool_idle_timeout(Duration::from_secs(90))
138	            .tcp_keepalive(Duration::from_secs(60))
139	            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(600))
140	            .proxy(proxy_config.proxy); // Apply the specific proxy
141	
142	        Self::apply_default_user_agent(builder).build()
143	    }
144	
145	    fn apply_default_user_agent(builder: rquest::ClientBuilder) -> rquest::ClientBuilder {
146	        let ua = crate::constants::USER_AGENT.as_str();
147	        if header::HeaderValue::from_str(ua).is_ok() {
148	            builder.user_agent(ua)
149	        } else {
150	            tracing::warn!(
151	                user_agent = %ua,
152	                "Invalid default User-Agent value, using fallback"
153	            );
154	            builder.user_agent("antigravity")
155	        }
156	    }
157	
158	    /// Set dynamic User-Agent override
159	    pub async fn set_user_agent_override(&self, ua: Option<String>) {
160	        let mut lock = self.user_agent_override.write().await;
161	        *lock = ua;
162	        tracing::debug!("UpstreamClient User-Agent override updated: {:?}", lock);
163	    }
164	
165	    /// Get current User-Agent
166	    pub async fn get_user_agent(&self) -> String {
167	        let ua_override = self.user_agent_override.read().await;
168	        ua_override
169	            .as_ref()
170	            .cloned()
171	            .unwrap_or_else(|| crate::constants::USER_AGENT.clone())
172	    }
173	
174	    /// Get client for a specific account (or default if no proxy bound)
175	    pub async fn get_client(&self, account_id: Option<&str>) -> Client {
176	        if let Some(pool) = &self.proxy_pool {
177	            if let Some(acc_id) = account_id {
178	                // Try to get per-account proxy
179	                match pool.get_proxy_for_account(acc_id).await {
180	                    Ok(Some(proxy_cfg)) => {
181	                        // Check cache
182	                        if let Some(client) = self.client_cache.get(&proxy_cfg.entry_id) {
183	                            return client.clone();
184	                        }
185	                        // Build new client and cache it
186	                        match self.build_client_with_proxy(proxy_cfg.clone()) {
187	                            Ok(client) => {
188	                                self.client_cache
189	                                    .insert(proxy_cfg.entry_id.clone(), client.clone());
190	                                tracing::info!(
191	                                    "Using ProxyPool proxy ID: {} for account: {}",
192	                                    proxy_cfg.entry_id,
193	                                    acc_id
194	                                );
195	                                return client;
196	                            }
197	                            Err(e) => {
198	                                tracing::error!("Failed to build client for proxy {}: {}, falling back to default", proxy_cfg.entry_id, e);
199	                            }
200	                        }
201	                    }
202	                    Ok(None) => {
203	                        // No proxy found or required for this account, use default
204	                    }
205	                    Err(e) => {
206	                        tracing::error!(
207	                            "Error getting proxy for account {}: {}, falling back to default",
208	                            acc_id,
209	                            e
210	                        );
211	                    }
212	                }
213	            }
214	        }
215	        // Fallback to default client
216	        self.default_client.clone()
217	    }
218	
219	    /// Build v1internal URL
220	    fn build_url(base_url: &str, method: &str, query_string: Option<&str>) -> String {
221	        if let Some(qs) = query_string {
222	            format!("{}:{}?{}", base_url, method, qs)
223	        } else {
224	            format!("{}:{}", base_url, method)
225	        }
226	    }
227	
228	    /// Determine if we should try next endpoint (fallback logic)
229	    fn should_try_next_endpoint(status: StatusCode) -> bool {
230	        status == StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
231	            || status == StatusCode::REQUEST_TIMEOUT
232	            || status == StatusCode::NOT_FOUND
233	            || status.is_server_error()
234	    }

236	    /// Call v1internal API (Basic Method)
237	    ///
238	    /// Initiates a basic network request, supporting multi-endpoint auto-fallback.
239	    /// [UPDATED] Takes optional account_id for per-account proxy selection.
240	    pub async fn call_v1_internal(
241	        &self,
242	        method: &str,
243	        access_token: &str,
244	        body: Value,
245	        query_string: Option<&str>,
246	        account_id: Option<&str>, // [NEW] Account ID for proxy selection
247	    ) -> Result<UpstreamCallResult, String> {
248	        self.call_v1_internal_with_headers(
249	            method,
250	            access_token,
251	            body,
252	            query_string,
253	            std::collections::HashMap::new(),
254	            account_id,
255	        )
256	        .await
257	    }

259	    /// [FIX #765] 调用 v1internal API，支持透传额外的 Headers
260	    /// [ENHANCED] 返回 UpstreamCallResult，包含降级尝试记录，用于 debug 日志
261	    pub async fn call_v1_internal_with_headers(
262	        &self,
263	        method: &str,
264	        access_token: &str,
265	        body: Value,
266	        query_string: Option<&str>,
267	        extra_headers: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
268	        account_id: Option<&str>, // [NEW] Account ID
269	    ) -> Result<UpstreamCallResult, String> {
270	        // [NEW] Get client based on account (cached in proxy pool manager)
271	        let client = self.get_client(account_id).await;
272	
273	        // 构建 Headers (所有端点复用)
274	        let mut headers = header::HeaderMap::new();
275	        headers.insert(
276	            header::CONTENT_TYPE,
277	            header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
278	        );
279	        headers.insert(
280	            header::AUTHORIZATION,
281	            header::HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", access_token))
282	                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
283	        );
284	
285	        headers.insert(
286	            header::USER_AGENT,
287	            header::HeaderValue::from_str(&self.get_user_agent().await).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
288	                tracing::warn!("Invalid User-Agent header value, using fallback: {}", e);
289	                header::HeaderValue::from_static("antigravity")
290	            }),
291	        );
292	
293	        // [ENHANCED] 注入 Antigravity 官方客户端关键特征 Headers
294	        // 1. Client Identity
295	        headers.insert(
296	            "x-client-name",
297	            header::HeaderValue::from_static("antigravity"),
298	        );
299	        if let Ok(ver) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&crate::constants::CURRENT_VERSION) {
300	            headers.insert("x-client-version", ver);
301	        }
302	
303	        // 2. Device & Session Identity
304	        // Machine ID (Persistent)
305	        if let Ok(mid) = machine_uid::get() {
306	             if let Ok(mid_val) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&mid) {
307	                 headers.insert("x-machine-id", mid_val);
308	             }
309	        }
310	        // Session ID (Per App Launch)
311	        if let Ok(sess_val) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&crate::constants::SESSION_ID) {
312	            headers.insert("x-vscode-sessionid", sess_val);
313	        }
314	
315	        // [REMOVED v4.1.24] x-goog-api-client (gl-node/fire/grpc) header has been removed.
316	        // This header belongs to the IDE's JS layer, not the official client's egress.
317	        // Sending it creates a contradictory "Electron + Node.js" fingerprint.
318	
319	        // 注入额外的 Headers (如 anthropic-beta)
320	        for (k, v) in extra_headers {
321	            if let Ok(hk) = header::HeaderName::from_bytes(k.as_bytes()) {
322	                if let Ok(hv) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&v) {
323	                    headers.insert(hk, hv);
324	                }
325	            }
326	        }
327	
328	        // [DEBUG] Log headers for verification
329	        tracing::debug!(?headers, "Final Upstream Request Headers");
330	
331	        let mut last_err: Option<String> = None;
332	        // [NEW] 收集降级尝试记录
333	        let mut fallback_attempts: Vec<FallbackAttemptLog> = Vec::new();
334	
335	        // 遍历所有端点，失败时自动切换
336	        for (idx, base_url) in V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.iter().enumerate() {
337	            let url = Self::build_url(base_url, method, query_string);
338	            let has_next = idx + 1 < V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.len();
339	
340	            let response = client
341	                .post(&url)
342	                .headers(headers.clone())
343	                .json(&body)
344	                .send()
345	                .await;
346	
347	            match response {
348	                Ok(resp) => {
349	                    let status = resp.status();
350	                    if status.is_success() {
351	                        if idx > 0 {
352	                            tracing::info!(
353	                                "✓ Upstream fallback succeeded | Endpoint: {} | Status: {} | Next endpoints available: {}",
354	                                base_url,
355	                                status,
356	                                V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.len() - idx - 1
357	                            );
358	                        } else {
359	                            tracing::debug!(
360	                                "✓ Upstream request succeeded | Endpoint: {} | Status: {}",
361	                                base_url,
362	                                status
363	                            );
364	                        }
365	                        return Ok(UpstreamCallResult {
366	                            response: resp,
367	                            fallback_attempts,
368	                        });
369	                    }
370	
371	                    // 如果有下一个端点且当前错误可重试，则切换
372	                    if has_next && Self::should_try_next_endpoint(status) {
373	                        let err_msg = format!("Upstream {} returned {}", base_url, status);
374	                        tracing::warn!(
375	                            "Upstream endpoint returned {} at {} (method={}), trying next endpoint",
376	                            status,
377	                            base_url,
378	                            method
379	                        );
380	                        // [NEW] 记录降级尝试
381	                        fallback_attempts.push(FallbackAttemptLog {
382	                            endpoint_url: url.clone(),
383	                            status: Some(status.as_u16()),
384	                            error: err_msg.clone(),
385	                        });
386	                        last_err = Some(err_msg);
387	                        continue;
388	                    }
389	
390	                    // 不可重试的错误或已是最后一个端点，直接返回
391	                    return Ok(UpstreamCallResult {
392	                        response: resp,
393	                        fallback_attempts,
394	                    });
395	                }
396	                Err(e) => {
397	                    let msg = format!("HTTP request failed at {}: {}", base_url, e);
398	                    tracing::debug!("{}", msg);
399	                    // [NEW] 记录网络错误的降级尝试
400	                    fallback_attempts.push(FallbackAttemptLog {
401	                        endpoint_url: url.clone(),
402	                        status: None,
403	                        error: msg.clone(),
404	                    });
405	                    last_err = Some(msg);
406	
407	                    // 如果是最后一个端点，退出循环
408	                    if !has_next {
409	                        break;
410	                    }
411	                    continue;
412	                }
413	            }
414	        }
415	
416	        Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| "All endpoints failed".to_string()))
417	    }

### 4. `handlers/common.rs` -- Retry Logic

**`determine_retry_strategy`**: Lines 23-76
- Returns `RetryStrategy` enum based on HTTP status code and error text
- 429: `FixedDelay` (from Retry-After header) or `LinearBackoff { base_ms: 5000 }`
- 503/529: `ExponentialBackoff { base_ms: 10000, max_ms: 60000 }`
- 500: `LinearBackoff { base_ms: 3000 }`
- 401/403: `FixedDelay(200ms)` -- triggers account rotation
- 404: `FixedDelay(300ms)` -- Gemini Cloud Code API intermittent
- 400: Only retries for specific thinking signature errors (first time)
- Everything else: `NoRetry`

**`apply_retry_strategy`**: Lines 79-134
- Executes the sleep for the chosen strategy
- Returns `true` if should continue retrying, `false` if should stop

**`should_rotate_account`**: Lines 137-146
- Returns `true` for: 429, 401, 403, 404, 500
- Returns `false` for: 400, 503, 529, and everything else
- Note: This function only **logs** whether to rotate; the actual rotation is controlled by `force_rotate = attempt > 0` passed to `get_token()`

### Summary: What `TokenManager::get_token()` Returns

All three handlers call `token_manager.get_token(request_type, force_rotate, session_id, final_model)` which returns a 5-tuple:
```rust
(access_token, project_id, email, account_id, wait_ms)
```

- `access_token`: OAuth bearer token for the upstream call
- `project_id`: Google Cloud project ID injected into the request body
- `email`: Human-readable account email (for logging / response headers)
- `account_id`: Internal account identifier (for proxy pool selection and token cache)
- `wait_ms`: Suggested wait time (unused in handlers, denoted as `_wait_ms`)

### Key Architectural Observation

In all three handlers, the pattern is identical:
1. The `for attempt in 0..max_attempts` loop **encloses** both the account selection (`get_token`) and the upstream HTTP call
2. On each retry iteration, `get_token()` is called again with `force_rotate = attempt > 0`, which selects a **different** account
3. The `account_id` from the newly selected account is passed to `call_v1_internal_with_headers` for per-account proxy selection
4. The `access_token` from the newly selected account is used as the Bearer token

To skip account selection on retries, you would need to:
- Move the `get_token()` call **before** the retry loop
- Pass the same `access_token`, `project_id`, `email`, and `account_id` through all retry iterations
- Remove the `attempt > 0` force-rotate flag

## 1. z.ai Dispatch Decision Logic

The dispatch decision is made in `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs`, lines 271-346 (for the main `handle_claude_messages` handler) and lines 1440-1452 (for `handle_count_tokens`).

### Dispatch Modes (`ZaiDispatchMode`)

Defined at `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs`, lines 159-176:

```rust
pub enum ZaiDispatchMode {
    Off,       // Never use z.ai
    Exclusive, // Use z.ai for ALL Anthropic protocol requests
    Pooled,    // Treat z.ai as one extra slot in a round-robin pool
    Fallback,  // Use z.ai only when Google pool is unavailable
}
```

### Routing Decision (claude.rs lines 314-346)

```rust
let use_zai = if !zai_enabled {
    false
} else {
    match zai.dispatch_mode {
        ZaiDispatchMode::Off => false,
        ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => true,
        ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => {
            if google_accounts == 0 {
                true  // No Google accounts -> use z.ai
            } else {
                let has_available = state.token_manager.has_available_account("claude", &normalized_model).await;
                !has_available  // All Google accounts rate-limited/quota-protected -> use z.ai
            }
        }
        ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => {
            let total = google_accounts.saturating_add(1).max(1);
            let slot = state.provider_rr.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % total;
            slot == 0  // Round-robin: z.ai gets 1/N of requests
        }
    }
};
```

Key points:
- `state.provider_rr` (line 104 of `server.rs`) is an `Arc<AtomicUsize>` -- a shared round-robin counter used ONLY for `Pooled` mode.
- In `Fallback` mode, the decision also checks `token_manager.has_available_account()` -- if all Google accounts are rate-limited or quota-protected for the model, z.ai is used.
- `zai_enabled` requires both `zai.enabled == true` AND `dispatch_mode != Off` (line 272).

### Second dispatch point: count_tokens (claude.rs lines 1435-1460)

This is a simpler dispatch: if z.ai is enabled (any mode other than Off), ALL count_tokens requests go to z.ai. Otherwise, it returns a dummy `{input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0}`.

## 2. How the z.ai HTTP Call is Made

The actual forwarding is done by `crate::proxy::providers::zai_anthropic::forward_anthropic_json`.

### Provider module structure

- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/zai_anthropic.rs` -- contains the full implementation.

Note: The file was too large to read in one shot, but the function signature and behavior is clear from the callsites:

### The upstream HTTP client (z.ai vs Google)

**z.ai calls** use a standard `reqwest::Client` built inline per-request (see `build_client` at claude.rs lines 49-69). The request goes to `zai.base_url` (default: `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic`) + the path (e.g., `/v1/messages`). Auth is set via `x-api-key` and/or `Bearer` token using `zai.api_key`. This is a **direct Anthropic-compatible API call**.

**Google v1internal calls** use the `UpstreamClient` (`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/upstream/client.rs`). Key differences:
- Uses `rquest` (not `reqwest`) with Chrome 123 TLS fingerprint emulation (line 104)
- Calls `https://.../v1internal:generateContent` style endpoints (not REST paths)
- Has built-in multi-endpoint fallback: Sandbox -> Daily -> Prod (lines 46-57)
- Sends Google-specific headers: `x-client-name: antigravity`, `x-machine-id`, `x-vscode-sessionid`
- Uses `access_token` (OAuth Bearer), not API keys
- Supports per-account proxy selection via `ProxyPoolManager`

### Two separate forwarding implementations exist

There are TWO `forward_anthropic_json` functions:

1. **`providers/zai_anthropic.rs::forward_anthropic_json`** -- the provider module version (called at claude.rs lines 398, 1444)
2. **`handlers/claude.rs` contains a local `forward_anthropic_json`** (lines 134-231) -- this appears to be a standalone implementation that builds its own reqwest client

Both do essentially the same thing: forward an Anthropic-format JSON request to z.ai's API. The one in `zai_anthropic.rs` is the canonical provider version.

### Model mapping (claude.rs lines 13-37)

The `map_model_for_zai` function resolves the target model:
1. Checks exact match in `model_mapping`
2. Checks lowercase match in `model_mapping`
3. Strips `zai:` prefix if present
4. Passes through `glm-*` models as-is
5. For `claude-*` models: maps to opus/sonnet/haiku defaults based on model name

Default model mappings (config.rs lines 607-617):
- opus -> `glm-4.7`
- sonnet -> `glm-4.7`
- haiku -> `glm-4.5-air`

## 4. Is There a Concept of Multiple Upstream Providers?

**Currently, there are exactly TWO upstream providers:**

1. **Google (v1internal)** -- the primary/default path. Uses `UpstreamClient` with OAuth tokens from multiple Google accounts managed by `TokenManager`. Supports multi-account round-robin, sticky sessions, proxy pools, and quota protection.

2. **z.ai (Anthropic-compatible)** -- the secondary/fallback provider. Uses a single API key + base_url configuration. No multi-account support for z.ai itself (one `api_key`, one `base_url`).

### The `upstream` module structure

At `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/upstream/`:
- `mod.rs` -- exports `client`, `retry`, `models`
- `client.rs` -- `UpstreamClient` (Google-only, handles v1internal calls)
- `models.rs` -- stub `UpstreamModels` struct with `// TODO: Phase 3`
- `retry.rs` -- retry logic

The `upstream` module is **Google-specific**. There is no generic "upstream provider" abstraction yet. z.ai bypasses the `UpstreamClient` entirely and uses its own reqwest-based HTTP flow.

### The `providers` module (multi-provider foundation)

At `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/`:
- `mod.rs` -- only `pub mod zai_anthropic;`
- `zai_anthropic.rs` -- z.ai Anthropic passthrough

This `providers/` directory is the beginning of a multi-provider architecture, but currently has only one provider.
