260	    /// [ENHANCED] 返回 UpstreamCallResult，包含降级尝试记录，用于 debug 日志
261	    pub async fn call_v1_internal_with_headers(
262	        &self,
263	        method: &str,
264	        access_token: &str,
265	        body: Value,
266	        query_string: Option<&str>,
267	        extra_headers: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
268	        account_id: Option<&str>, // [NEW] Account ID
269	    ) -> Result<UpstreamCallResult, String> {
270	        // [NEW] Get client based on account (cached in proxy pool manager)
271	        let client = self.get_client(account_id).await;
272	
273	        // 构建 Headers (所有端点复用)
274	        let mut headers = header::HeaderMap::new();
275	        headers.insert(
276	            header::CONTENT_TYPE,
277	            header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
278	        );
279	        headers.insert(
280	            header::AUTHORIZATION,
281	            header::HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", access_token))
282	                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
283	        );
284	
285	        headers.insert(
286	            header::USER_AGENT,
287	            header::HeaderValue::from_str(&self.get_user_agent().await).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
288	                tracing::warn!("Invalid User-Agent header value, using fallback: {}", e);
289	                header::HeaderValue::from_static("antigravity")
290	            }),
291	        );
292	
293	        // [ENHANCED] 注入 Antigravity 官方客户端关键特征 Headers
294	        // 1. Client Identity
295	        headers.insert(
296	            "x-client-name",
297	            header::HeaderValue::from_static("antigravity"),
298	        );
299	        if let Ok(ver) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&crate::constants::CURRENT_VERSION) {
300	            headers.insert("x-client-version", ver);
301	        }
302	
303	        // 2. Device & Session Identity
304	        // Machine ID (Persistent)
305	        if let Ok(mid) = machine_uid::get() {
306	             if let Ok(mid_val) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&mid) {
307	                 headers.insert("x-machine-id", mid_val);
308	             }
309	        }
310	        // Session ID (Per App Launch)
311	        if let Ok(sess_val) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&crate::constants::SESSION_ID) {
312	            headers.insert("x-vscode-sessionid", sess_val);
313	        }
314	
315	        // [REMOVED v4.1.24] x-goog-api-client (gl-node/fire/grpc) header has been removed.
316	        // This header belongs to the IDE's JS layer, not the official client's egress.
317	        // Sending it creates a contradictory "Electron + Node.js" fingerprint.
318	
319	        // 注入额外的 Headers (如 anthropic-beta)
320	        for (k, v) in extra_headers {
321	            if let Ok(hk) = header::HeaderName::from_bytes(k.as_bytes()) {
322	                if let Ok(hv) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&v) {
323	                    headers.insert(hk, hv);
324	                }
325	            }
326	        }
327	
328	        // [DEBUG] Log headers for verification
329	        tracing::debug!(?headers, "Final Upstream Request Headers");
330	
331	        let mut last_err: Option<String> = None;
332	        // [NEW] 收集降级尝试记录
333	        let mut fallback_attempts: Vec<FallbackAttemptLog> = Vec::new();
334	
335	        // 遍历所有端点，失败时自动切换
336	        for (idx, base_url) in V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.iter().enumerate() {
337	            let url = Self::build_url(base_url, method, query_string);
338	            let has_next = idx + 1 < V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.len();
339	
340	            let response = client
341	                .post(&url)
342	                .headers(headers.clone())
343	                .json(&body)
344	                .send()
345	                .await;
346	
347	            match response {
348	                Ok(resp) => {
349	                    let status = resp.status();
350	                    if status.is_success() {
351	                        if idx > 0 {
352	                            tracing::info!(
353	                                "✓ Upstream fallback succeeded | Endpoint: {} | Status: {} | Next endpoints available: {}",
354	                                base_url,
355	                                status,
356	                                V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.len() - idx - 1
357	                            );
358	                        } else {
359	                            tracing::debug!(
360	                                "✓ Upstream request succeeded | Endpoint: {} | Status: {}",
361	                                base_url,
362	                                status
363	                            );
364	                        }
365	                        return Ok(UpstreamCallResult {
366	                            response: resp,
367	                            fallback_attempts,
368	                        });
369	                    }
370	
371	                    // 如果有下一个端点且当前错误可重试，则切换
372	                    if has_next && Self::should_try_next_endpoint(status) {
373	                        let err_msg = format!("Upstream {} returned {}", base_url, status);
374	                        tracing::warn!(
375	                            "Upstream endpoint returned {} at {} (method={}), trying next endpoint",
376	                            status,
377	                            base_url,
378	                            method
379	                        );
380	                        // [NEW] 记录降级尝试
381	                        fallback_attempts.push(FallbackAttemptLog {
382	                            endpoint_url: url.clone(),
383	                            status: Some(status.as_u16()),
384	                            error: err_msg.clone(),
385	                        });
386	                        last_err = Some(err_msg);
387	                        continue;
388	                    }
389	
390	                    // 不可重试的错误或已是最后一个端点，直接返回
391	                    return Ok(UpstreamCallResult {
392	                        response: resp,
393	                        fallback_attempts,
394	                    });
395	                }
396	                Err(e) => {
397	                    let msg = format!("HTTP request failed at {}: {}", base_url, e);
398	                    tracing::debug!("{}", msg);
399	                    // [NEW] 记录网络错误的降级尝试
400	                    fallback_attempts.push(FallbackAttemptLog {
401	                        endpoint_url: url.clone(),
402	                        status: None,
403	                        error: msg.clone(),
404	                    });
405	                    last_err = Some(msg);
406	
407	                    // 如果是最后一个端点，退出循环
408	                    if !has_next {
409	                        break;
410	                    }
411	                    continue;
412	                }
413	            }
414	        }
415	
416	        Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| "All endpoints failed".to_string()))
417	    }
418

1	use std::fs;

4	use crate::models::AppConfig;

8	const CONFIG_FILE: &str = "gui_config.json";
9	
10	/// Load application configuration
11	pub fn load_app_config() -> Result<AppConfig, String> {
12	    let data_dir = get_data_dir()?;
13	    let config_path = data_dir.join(CONFIG_FILE);
14	    
15	    if !config_path.exists() {
16	        let config = AppConfig::new();
17	        // [FIX #1460] Persist initial config to prevent new API Key on every refresh
18	        let _ = save_app_config(&config);
19	        return Ok(config);
20	    }
21	    
22	    let content = fs::read_to_string(&config_path)
23	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_read_config_file: {}", e))?;
24	    
25	    let mut v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content)
26	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_parse_config_file: {}", e))?;
27	    
28	    let mut modified = false;
29	
30	    // Migration logic
31	    if let Some(proxy) = v.get_mut("proxy") {
32	        // [FIX #1738] Enhanced type checking for custom_mapping
33	        // Ensures the field is always parsed as an object, preventing type mismatch errors
34	        let mut custom_mapping = match proxy.get("custom_mapping") {
35	            Some(m) if m.is_object() => m.as_object().unwrap().clone(),
36	            Some(m) => {
37	                // If custom_mapping is not an object type (e.g., string), log warning and reset to empty
38	                tracing::warn!("Invalid custom_mapping type (expected object, got {:?}), resetting to empty", m);
39	                serde_json::Map::new()
40	            }
41	            None => serde_json::Map::new(),
42	        };
43	
44	        // Migrate Anthropic mapping
45	        if let Some(anthropic) = proxy.get_mut("anthropic_mapping").and_then(|m| m.as_object_mut()) {
46	            for (k, v) in anthropic.iter() {
47	                // Only move non-series fields, as series fields are now handled by Preset logic or builtin tables
48	                if !k.ends_with("-series") {
49	                    if !custom_mapping.contains_key(k) {
50	                        custom_mapping.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
51	                    }
52	                }
53	            }
54	            // Remove old field
55	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("anthropic_mapping");
56	            modified = true;
57	        }
58	
59	        // Migrate OpenAI mapping
60	        if let Some(openai) = proxy.get_mut("openai_mapping").and_then(|m| m.as_object_mut()) {
61	            for (k, v) in openai.iter() {
62	                if !k.ends_with("-series") {
63	                    if !custom_mapping.contains_key(k) {
64	                        custom_mapping.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
65	                    }
66	                }
67	            }
68	            // Remove old field
69	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("openai_mapping");
70	            modified = true;
71	        }
72	
73	        if modified {
74	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().insert("custom_mapping".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(custom_mapping));
75	        }
76	    }
77	
78	    let config: AppConfig = serde_json::from_value(v)
79	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_convert_config_after_migration: {}", e))?;
80	    
81	    // If migration occurred, auto-save once to clean up the file
82	    if modified {
83	        let _ = save_app_config(&config);
84	    }
85	
86	    Ok(config)
87	}
88	
89	/// Save application configuration
90	pub fn save_app_config(config: &AppConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
91	    let data_dir = get_data_dir()?;
92	    let config_path = data_dir.join(CONFIG_FILE);
93	    
94	    let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(config)
95	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_serialize_config: {}", e))?;
96	    
97	    fs::write(&config_path, content)
98	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_save_config: {}", e))
99	}

13	fn map_model_for_zai(original: &str, state: &crate::proxy::ZaiConfig) -> String {
14	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
15	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(original) {
16	        return mapped.clone();
17	    }
18	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(&m) {
19	        return mapped.clone();
20	    }
21	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
22	        return original[4..].to_string();
23	    }
24	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
25	        return original.to_string();
26	    }
27	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
28	        return original.to_string();
29	    }
30	    if m.contains("opus") {
31	        return state.models.opus.clone();
32	    }
33	    if m.contains("haiku") {
34	        return state.models.haiku.clone();
35	    }

50	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
51	    timeout_secs: u64,
52	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
54	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
55	
56	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
57	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
58	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
59	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
60	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
61	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    builder
66	        .tcp_nodelay(true) // [FIX #307] Disable Nagle's algorithm to improve latency for small requests
67	        .build()

71	fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap {
72	    // Only forward a conservative set of headers to avoid leaking the local proxy key or cookies.
73	    let mut out = HeaderMap::new();
74	
75	    for (k, v) in incoming.iter() {
76	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
77	        match key.as_str() {
78	            "content-type" | "accept" | "anthropic-version" | "user-agent" => {
79	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
80	            }
81	            // Some clients use these for streaming; safe to pass through.
82	            "accept-encoding" | "cache-control" => {
83	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
84	            }
85	            _ => {}
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    out
90	}

92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}

120	            }
121	            for v in map.values_mut() {
122	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {
127	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}
133	
134	pub async fn forward_anthropic_json(
135	    state: &AppState,
136	    method: Method,
137	    path: &str,
138	    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
139	    mut body: Value,
140	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Pass message count for rewind detection
141	) -> Response {
142	    let zai = state.zai.read().await.clone();
143	    if !zai.enabled || zai.dispatch_mode == crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
144	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai is disabled").into_response();
145	    }
146	
147	    if zai.api_key.trim().is_empty() {
148	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai api_key is not set").into_response();
149	    }
150	
151	    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
152	        let mapped = map_model_for_zai(model, &zai);
153	        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
154	
155	        // [FIX] Caching for z.ai (to support thinking-filter)
156	        if let Some(sig) = body.get("thinking").and_then(|t| t.get("signature")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
157	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_session_signature(
158	                "zai-session", 
159	                sig.to_string(), 
160	                message_count
161	            );
162	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), mapped);
163	        }
164	    }
165	
166	    let url = match join_base_url(&zai.base_url, path) {
167	        Ok(u) => u,
168	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
169	    };
170	
171	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);
172	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
173	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
174	        Ok(c) => c,
175	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
176	    };
177	
178	    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
179	    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, &zai.api_key);
180	
181	    // Ensure JSON content type.
182	    headers
183	        .entry(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
184	        .or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));
185	
186	    // [FIX #290] Clean cache_control before sending to Anthropic API
187	    // This prevents "Extra inputs are not permitted" errors
188	    if let Some(cc) = body.get("cache_control") {
189	        tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep cleaning cache_control from ROOT: {:?}", cc);
190	    }
191	    deep_remove_cache_control(&mut body);
192	
193	    // [FIX #307] Explicitly serialize body to Vec<u8> to ensure Content-Length is set correctly.
194	    // This avoids "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" for small bodies which caused connection errors.
195	    let body_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap_or_default();
196	    let body_len = body_bytes.len();
197	    
198	    tracing::debug!("Forwarding request to z.ai (len: {} bytes): {}", body_len, url);
199	
200	    let req = client.request(method, &url)
201	        .headers(headers)
202	        .body(body_bytes); // Use .body(Vec<u8>) instead of .json()
203	
204	    let resp = match req.send().await {
205	        Ok(r) => r,
206	        Err(e) => {
207	            return (
208	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
209	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
210	            )
211	                .into_response();
212	        }
213	    };
214	
215	    let status = StatusCode::from_u16(resp.status().as_u16()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
216	
217	    let mut out = Response::builder().status(status);
218	    if let Some(ct) = resp.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE) {
219	        out = out.header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct.clone());
220	    }
221	
222	    // Stream response body to the client (covers SSE and non-SSE).
223	    let stream = resp.bytes_stream().map(|chunk| match chunk {
224	        Ok(b) => Ok::<Bytes, std::io::Error>(b),
225	        Err(e) => Ok(Bytes::from(format!("Upstream stream error: {}", e))),
226	    });
227	
228	    out.body(Body::from_stream(stream)).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
229	        (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to build response").into_response()
230	    })
231	}
232

83	/// Map thinking level to suggested budget tokens
84	fn level_to_budget(level: &str, cap: u64) -> u32 {
85	    let base = match level {

87	        "low" => 8192,
88	        "medium" => 16384,
89	        "high" => 24576,
90	        _ => 8192, // default to low
91	    };
92	    base.min(cap as u32)
93	}

## 1. z.ai Dispatch Decision Logic

The dispatch decision is made in `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs`, lines 271-346 (for the main `handle_claude_messages` handler) and lines 1440-1452 (for `handle_count_tokens`).

### Dispatch Modes (`ZaiDispatchMode`)

Defined at `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs`, lines 159-176:

```rust
pub enum ZaiDispatchMode {
    Off,       // Never use z.ai
    Exclusive, // Use z.ai for ALL Anthropic protocol requests
    Pooled,    // Treat z.ai as one extra slot in a round-robin pool
    Fallback,  // Use z.ai only when Google pool is unavailable
}
```

### Routing Decision (claude.rs lines 314-346)

```rust
let use_zai = if !zai_enabled {
    false
} else {
    match zai.dispatch_mode {
        ZaiDispatchMode::Off => false,
        ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => true,
        ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => {
            if google_accounts == 0 {
                true  // No Google accounts -> use z.ai
            } else {
                let has_available = state.token_manager.has_available_account("claude", &normalized_model).await;
                !has_available  // All Google accounts rate-limited/quota-protected -> use z.ai
            }
        }
        ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => {
            let total = google_accounts.saturating_add(1).max(1);
            let slot = state.provider_rr.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % total;
            slot == 0  // Round-robin: z.ai gets 1/N of requests
        }
    }
};
```

Key points:
- `state.provider_rr` (line 104 of `server.rs`) is an `Arc<AtomicUsize>` -- a shared round-robin counter used ONLY for `Pooled` mode.
- In `Fallback` mode, the decision also checks `token_manager.has_available_account()` -- if all Google accounts are rate-limited or quota-protected for the model, z.ai is used.
- `zai_enabled` requires both `zai.enabled == true` AND `dispatch_mode != Off` (line 272).

### Second dispatch point: count_tokens (claude.rs lines 1435-1460)

This is a simpler dispatch: if z.ai is enabled (any mode other than Off), ALL count_tokens requests go to z.ai. Otherwise, it returns a dummy `{input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0}`.

### The upstream HTTP client (z.ai vs Google)

**z.ai calls** use a standard `reqwest::Client` built inline per-request (see `build_client` at claude.rs lines 49-69). The request goes to `zai.base_url` (default: `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic`) + the path (e.g., `/v1/messages`). Auth is set via `x-api-key` and/or `Bearer` token using `zai.api_key`. **Google v1internal calls** use the `UpstreamClient` (`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/upstream/client.rs`). Key differences:
- Uses `rquest` (not `reqwest`) with Chrome 123 TLS fingerprint emulation (line 104)

- Sends Google-specific headers: `x-client-name: antigravity`, `x-machine-id`, `x-vscode-sessionid`
- Uses `access_token` (OAuth Bearer), not API keys
- Supports per-account proxy selection via `ProxyPoolManager`

# Implementation Plan: Multi-Provider API Key Gateway

## Current State Summary

The proxy has two upstream paths:

1. **Google v1internal** (primary): OAuth access_token based, multi-account rotation via `TokenManager`, calls `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal`. Used by all 3 handlers (openai.rs, claude.rs, gemini.rs) with retry loops that rotate accounts on failure.

2. **z.ai** (secondary, Claude-only): API Key based, single provider, Anthropic-compatible passthrough via `providers/zai_anthropic.rs`. No account selection, no protocol transformation -- just `reqwest` forwarding with `x-api-key` auth.

The dispatch decision lives in `claude.rs` lines 271-346, checking `ZaiConfig.enabled` + `ZaiDispatchMode` (Off/Exclusive/Pooled/Fallback). z.ai is NOT available to openai.rs or gemini.rs handlers.

## Target State

A generic multi-provider API Key gateway where:
- No TokenManager, no OAuth, no account rotation
- Multiple upstream providers configured by name, base_url, api_key, protocol_type
- Model-based routing with round-robin among same-capability providers and fallback chains
- Protocol transformation layer preserved (OpenAI/Claude clients can target any provider)

/// What protocol the provider natively speaks.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ProviderProtocol {
    /// Provider speaks Anthropic Messages API. Requests forwarded as-is.
    AnthropicPassthrough,
    /// Provider speaks OpenAI Chat Completions API.
    OpenAICompatible,
    /// Provider speaks Google v1internal (Gemini) API.
    /// Requests are transformed from OpenAI/Claude to Gemini format.
    GeminiV1Internal,
}

impl Default for ProviderProtocol {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::AnthropicPassthrough }
}

/// Dispatch mode within the routing chain.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ProviderDispatchMode {
    Exclusive,   // Always use this provider for matching models
    Pooled,      // Round-robin among pooled providers
    Fallback,    // Only when higher-priority providers fail
}

impl Default for ProviderDispatchMode {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::Pooled }
}

/// A single upstream provider configured by API Key + Base URL.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UpstreamProvider {
    pub name: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub base_url: String,
    #[serde(default)]

    pub protocol: ProviderProtocol,

    #[serde(default = "default_priority")]

    /// Explicit per-model overrides: incoming model -> upstream model name.

    /// Default model mapping by family (for AnthropicPassthrough providers).

    /// Optional HTTP request timeout in seconds.

}

## Step 2: ProviderRouter

**New file**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs`

```rust
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use crate::proxy::config::{UpstreamProvider, ProviderProtocol, ProviderDispatchMode};

pub struct ProviderRouter {
    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
}

impl ProviderRouter {
    /// Build from config. If providers list is empty, migrate from legacy ZaiConfig.
    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
        if providers.is_empty() {
            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
                if zai.enabled {
                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
                }
            }
        }
        Self {
            providers: providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect(),
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
        }
    }

    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
        let m = model.to_lowercase();
        self.providers.iter()
            .filter(|p| {
                p.model_prefixes.is_empty() ||
                p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
            })
            .collect()
    }

    /// Select the next provider. Excludes previous_failed from candidates.
    pub fn select(&self, model: &str, previous_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
        let mut candidates: Vec<_> = self.candidates_for_model(model)
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|p| previous_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
            .collect();

        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates.iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
            .collect();
        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
            return Some(*p);
        }

        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates.iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
            .collect();
        if !pooled.is_empty() {
            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
            return Some(pooled[idx]);
        }

        // 3. Fallback providers
        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates.iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
            .collect();
        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
        fallback.first().copied()
    }

    /// Map incoming model name to provider's native model ID.
    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
        // 1. Explicit mapping
        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
            return mapped.clone();
        }
        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
        {
            return mapped.1.clone();
        }
        // 2. zai: prefix strip
        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
            return incoming[4..].to_string();
        }
        // 3. Family defaults for Claude models
        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
            if m.contains("opus") { return provider.default_models.opus.clone(); }
            if m.contains("haiku") { return provider.default_models.haiku.clone(); }
            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
        }
        incoming.to_string()
    }
}
```

pub async fn forward_anthropic_with_provider(
    state: &AppState,
    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
    method: Method,
    path: &str,
    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
    mut body: Value,
    message_count: usize,
) -> Response {
    // Model mapping
    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
        let mapped = state.provider_router.read().await
            .map_model(provider, model);
        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
    }

    let url = match join_base_url(&provider.base_url, path) {
        Ok(u) => u,
        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
    };

    let timeout_secs = provider.request_timeout_secs
        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout).max(5);
    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
    };

    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, &provider.api_key);
    // ... rest mirrors existing forward_anthropic_json logic
}

Design an implementation plan for transforming this proxy from a multi-account OAuth-based system to a multi-provider API Key-based API gateway.

## Current Architecture

**Two providers exist:**
1. **Google v1internal** — OAuth access_token based, multi-account rotation via TokenManager, calls `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal`
2. **z.ai** — API Key based, single provider, Anthropic-compatible passthrough via `providers/zai_anthropic.rs`

**Current handler flow (all 3 handlers):**
```
Request → Auth Middleware → Monitor → Handler:
  └─ for attempt in 0..max_attempts:
       ├─ resolve_model_route()
       ├─ resolve_request_config()
       ├─ TokenManager::get_token(force_rotate=attempt>0)  ← ACCOUNT SELECTION
       ├─ Protocol transform (OpenAI/Claude→Gemini v1internal)
       ├─ UpstreamClient::call_v1_internal_with_headers(access_token, ...)
       └─ Retry/error handling with account rotation
```

**z.ai dispatch (claude.rs only, lines 271-346):**
- Checks `ZaiConfig.enabled` + `ZaiDispatchMode`
- Modes: Off, Exclusive, Pooled, Fallback
- When z.ai path: `forward_anthropic_json()` → direct reqwest call to z.ai base_url + api_key
- No account selection, no OAuth — just API Key auth

## User Requirements

The user wants to:
1. **Skip account selection entirely** — no TokenManager, no OAuth, no multi-account rotation
2. **Use API Key + Base URL authentication** for upstream providers (like z.ai does)
3. **Support multiple upstream providers** — z.ai is the first, but they want to add more
4. **Keep the protocol transformation layer** — OpenAI/Claude clients should still work

## Key Files

- `src/proxy/config.rs` — ZaiConfig, ZaiDispatchMode, ProxyConfig (line 511: `pub zai: ZaiConfig`)
- `src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs` — Dispatch logic (lines 271-346), model mapping (lines 13-37)
- `src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` — handle_chat_completions, retry loop (lines 165-735)
- `src/proxy/handlers/gemini.rs` — handle_generate, retry loop (lines 97-642)
- `src/proxy/handlers/common.rs` — Retry logic (determine_retry_strategy, apply_retry_strategy)
- `src/proxy/providers/zai_anthropic.rs` — z.ai forwarding implementation
- `src/proxy/providers/mod.rs` — Only exports `pub mod zai_anthropic;`
- `src/proxy/upstream/client.rs` — Google v1internal client (will no longer be primary path)
- `src/proxy/server.rs` — AppState (line 93), route wiring
- `src/modules/config.rs` — File-based config persistence

## Design Requirements

Please design:

1. **Provider configuration model**: A generic `UpstreamProvider` struct that replaces `ZaiConfig`. Should support: name, enabled, base_url, api_key, protocol_type (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini compatible), model_mapping, dispatch_priority.

2. **Provider dispatch/routing**: How requests route to the correct provider. Should support:
   - Model-based routing (e.g. `gpt-*` → provider A, `claude-*` → provider B)
   - Round-robin among providers with same model capability
   - Fallback chain

3. **Handler refactoring**: The 3 handlers currently have OAuth-specific retry loops with account rotation. How to restructure them to:
   - Skip TokenManager entirely
   - Use ProviderRouter instead
   - Keep protocol transformation
   - Keep retry logic (but retry on same provider or switch to next provider)

4. **Minimal changes approach**: What's the smallest set of changes to get this working? Can we build on the existing z.ai pattern rather than rewriting everything?

5. **Backward compatibility**: Should the old TokenManager/Google flow still be available as a fallback, or completely removed?

Provide concrete struct definitions, file paths, and a step-by-step implementation plan.

13	fn map_model_for_zai(original: &str, state: &crate::proxy::ZaiConfig) -> String {
14	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
15	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(original) {
16	        return mapped.clone();
17	    }
18	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(&m) {
19	        return mapped.clone();
20	    }
21	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
22	        return original[4..].to_string();
23	    }
24	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
25	        return original.to_string();
26	    }
27	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
28	        return original.to_string();
29	    }
30	    if m.contains("opus") {
31	        return state.models.opus.clone();
32	    }
33	    if m.contains("haiku") {
34	        return state.models.haiku.clone();
35	    }
36	    state.models.sonnet.clone()
37	}

39	fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
40	    let base = base.trim_end_matches('/');
41	    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
42	        path.to_string()
43	    } else {
44	        format!("/{}", path)
45	    };
46	    Ok(format!("{}{}", base, path))
47	}

49	fn build_client(
50	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
51	    timeout_secs: u64,
52	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
54	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
55	
56	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
57	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
58	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
59	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
60	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
61	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    builder
66	        .tcp_nodelay(true) // [FIX #307] Disable Nagle's algorithm to improve latency for small requests
67	        .build()
68	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
69	}

71	fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap {
72	    // Only forward a conservative set of headers to avoid leaking the local proxy key or cookies.
73	    let mut out = HeaderMap::new();
74	
75	    for (k, v) in incoming.iter() {
76	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
77	        match key.as_str() {
78	            "content-type" | "accept" | "anthropic-version" | "user-agent" => {
79	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
80	            }
81	            // Some clients use these for streaming; safe to pass through.
82	            "accept-encoding" | "cache-control" => {
83	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
84	            }
85	            _ => {}
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    out
90	}

92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}

113	/// Recursively remove cache_control from all nested objects/arrays
114	/// [FIX #290] This is a defensive fix that works regardless of serde annotations
115	pub fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
116	    match value {
117	        Value::Object(map) => {
118	            if let Some(v) = map.remove("cache_control") {
119	                tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep Cleaning found nested cache_control: {:?}", v);
120	            }
121	            for v in map.values_mut() {
122	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {
127	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}

134	pub async fn forward_anthropic_json(
135	    state: &AppState,
136	    method: Method,
137	    path: &str,
138	    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
139	    mut body: Value,
140	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Pass message count for rewind detection
141	) -> Response {
142	    let zai = state.zai.read().await.clone();
143	    if !zai.enabled || zai.dispatch_mode == crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
144	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai is disabled").into_response();
145	    }
146	
147	    if zai.api_key.trim().is_empty() {
148	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai api_key is not set").into_response();
149	    }
150	
151	    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
152	        let mapped = map_model_for_zai(model, &zai);
153	        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
154	
155	        // [FIX] Caching for z.ai (to support thinking-filter)
156	        if let Some(sig) = body.get("thinking").and_then(|t| t.get("signature")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
157	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_session_signature(
158	                "zai-session", 
159	                sig.to_string(), 
160	                message_count
161	            );
162	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), mapped);
163	        }
164	    }
165	
166	    let url = match join_base_url(&zai.base_url, path) {
167	        Ok(u) => u,
168	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
169	    };
170	
171	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);
172	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
173	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
174	        Ok(c) => c,
175	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
176	    };
177	
178	    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
179	    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, &zai.api_key);
180	
181	    // Ensure JSON content type.
182	    headers
183	        .entry(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
184	        .or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));

8	
9	/// 重试策略枚举
10	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
11	pub enum RetryStrategy {
12	    /// 不重试，直接返回错误
13	    NoRetry,
14	    /// 固定延迟
15	    FixedDelay(Duration),
16	    /// 线性退避：base_ms * (attempt + 1)
17	    LinearBackoff { base_ms: u64 },
18	    /// 指数退避：base_ms * 2^attempt，上限 max_ms
19	    ExponentialBackoff { base_ms: u64, max_ms: u64 },
20	}
21	
22	/// 根据错误状态码和错误信息确定重试策略
23	pub fn determine_retry_strategy(
24	    status_code: u16,
25	    error_text: &str,
26	    retried_without_thinking: bool,
27	) -> RetryStrategy {
28	    match status_code {
29	        // 400 错误：仅在特定 Thinking 签名失败时重试一次
30	        400 if !retried_without_thinking
31	            && (error_text.contains("Invalid `signature`")
32	                || error_text.contains("thinking.signature")
33	                || error_text.contains("thinking.thinking")
34	                || error_text.contains("Corrupted thought signature")) =>
35	        {
36	            RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(200))
37	        }
38	
39	        // 429 限流错误
40	        429 => {
41	            // 优先使用服务端返回的 Retry-After
42	            if let Some(delay_ms) = crate::proxy::upstream::retry::parse_retry_delay(error_text) {
43	                let actual_delay = delay_ms.saturating_add(200).min(30_000); // 上限上调至 30s
44	                RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(actual_delay))
45	            } else {
46	                // 否则使用线性退避：起始 5s，逐步增加
47	                RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms: 5000 }
48	            }
49	        }
50	
51	        // 503 服务不可用 / 529 服务器过载
52	        503 | 529 => {
53	            // 指数退避：起始 10s，上限 60s (针对 Google 边缘节点过载)
54	            RetryStrategy::ExponentialBackoff {
55	                base_ms: 10000,
56	                max_ms: 60000,
57	            }
58	        }
59	
60	        // 500 服务器内部错误
61	        500 => {
62	            // 线性退避：起始 3s
63	            RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms: 3000 }
64	        }
65	
66	        // 401/403 认证/权限错误：切换账号前给予极短缓冲
67	        401 | 403 => RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(200)),
68	
69	        // 404 资源未找到：Google Cloud Code API 的 404 通常是账号级别的间歇性问题
70	        // (灰度发布、账号权限不同步等)，轮换账号往往能解决
71	        404 => RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(300)),
72	
73	        // 其他错误：不重试
74	        _ => RetryStrategy::NoRetry,
75	    }
76	}
77	
78	/// 执行退避策略并返回是否应该继续重试
79	pub async fn apply_retry_strategy(
80	    strategy: RetryStrategy,
81	    attempt: usize,
82	    max_attempts: usize,
83	    status_code: u16,
84	    trace_id: &str,
85	) -> bool {
86	    match strategy {
87	        RetryStrategy::NoRetry => {
88	            debug!("[{}] Non-retryable error {}, stopping", trace_id, status_code);
89	            false
90	        }
91	
92	        RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(duration) => {
93	            let base_ms = duration.as_millis() as u64;
94	            info!(
95	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with fixed delay: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
96	                trace_id,
97	                status_code,
98	                attempt + 1,
99	                max_attempts,
100	                base_ms
101	            );
102	            sleep(duration).await;
103	            true
104	        }
105	
106	        RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms } => {
107	            let calculated_ms = base_ms * (attempt as u64 + 1);
108	            info!(
109	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with linear backoff: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
110	                trace_id,
111	                status_code,
112	                attempt + 1,
113	                max_attempts,
114	                calculated_ms
115	            );
116	            sleep(Duration::from_millis(calculated_ms)).await;
117	            true
118	        }
119	
120	        RetryStrategy::ExponentialBackoff { base_ms, max_ms } => {
121	            let calculated_ms = (base_ms * 2_u64.pow(attempt as u32)).min(max_ms);
122	            info!(
123	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with exponential backoff: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
124	                trace_id,
125	                status_code,
126	                attempt + 1,
127	                max_attempts,
128	                calculated_ms
129	            );
130	            sleep(Duration::from_millis(calculated_ms)).await;
131	            true
132	        }
133	    }
134	}
135	
136	/// 判断是否应该轮换账号
137	pub fn should_rotate_account(status_code: u16) -> bool {
138	    match status_code {
139	        // 这些错误是账号级别或特定节点配额的，需要轮换
140	        // 404: Google Cloud Code API 模型可用性因账号而异（灰度/权限）
141	        429 | 401 | 403 | 404 | 500 => true,
142	        // 这些错误通常是协议或服务端全局性、甚至参数错误的，轮换账号通常无意义
143	        400 | 503 | 529 => false,
144	        _ => false,
145	    }
146	}

30	/// 邮箱脱敏：只显示前3位 + *** + @域名前2位 + ***
31	/// 例: "userexample@gmail.com" → "use***@gm***"
32	pub fn mask_email(email: &str) -> String {
33	    if let Some(at_pos) = email.find('@') {
34	        let local = &email[..at_pos];
35	        let domain = &email[at_pos + 1..];
36	        let local_prefix: String = local.chars().take(3).collect();
37	        let domain_prefix: String = domain.chars().take(2).collect();
38	        format!("{}***@{}***", local_prefix, domain_prefix)
39	    } else {
40	        // 不是合法邮箱格式，直接截取前5位
41	        let prefix: String = email.chars().take(5).collect();
42	        format!("{}***", prefix)
43	    }
44	}

10	/// Load application configuration
11	pub fn load_app_config() -> Result<AppConfig, String> {
12	    let data_dir = get_data_dir()?;
13	    let config_path = data_dir.join(CONFIG_FILE);
14	    
15	    if !config_path.exists() {
16	        let config = AppConfig::new();
17	        // [FIX #1460] Persist initial config to prevent new API Key on every refresh
18	        let _ = save_app_config(&config);
19	        return Ok(config);
20	    }
21	    
22	    let content = fs::read_to_string(&config_path)
23	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_read_config_file: {}", e))?;
24	    
25	    let mut v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content)
26	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_parse_config_file: {}", e))?;
27	    
28	    let mut modified = false;
29	
30	    // Migration logic
31	    if let Some(proxy) = v.get_mut("proxy") {
32	        // [FIX #1738] Enhanced type checking for custom_mapping
33	        // Ensures the field is always parsed as an object, preventing type mismatch errors
34	        let mut custom_mapping = match proxy.get("custom_mapping") {
35	            Some(m) if m.is_object() => m.as_object().unwrap().clone(),
36	            Some(m) => {
37	                // If custom_mapping is not an object type (e.g., string), log warning and reset to empty
38	                tracing::warn!("Invalid custom_mapping type (expected object, got {:?}), resetting to empty", m);
39	                serde_json::Map::new()
40	            }
41	            None => serde_json::Map::new(),
42	        };
43	
44	        // Migrate Anthropic mapping
45	        if let Some(anthropic) = proxy.get_mut("anthropic_mapping").and_then(|m| m.as_object_mut()) {
46	            for (k, v) in anthropic.iter() {
47	                // Only move non-series fields, as series fields are now handled by Preset logic or builtin tables
48	                if !k.ends_with("-series") {
49	                    if !custom_mapping.contains_key(k) {
50	                        custom_mapping.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
51	                    }
52	                }
53	            }
54	            // Remove old field
55	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("anthropic_mapping");
56	            modified = true;
57	        }
58	
59	        // Migrate OpenAI mapping
60	        if let Some(openai) = proxy.get_mut("openai_mapping").and_then(|m| m.as_object_mut()) {
61	            for (k, v) in openai.iter() {
62	                if !k.ends_with("-series") {
63	                    if !custom_mapping.contains_key(k) {
64	                        custom_mapping.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
65	                    }
66	                }
67	            }
68	            // Remove old field
69	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("openai_mapping");
70	            modified = true;
71	        }
72	
73	        if modified {
74	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().insert("custom_mapping".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(custom_mapping));
75	        }
76	    }
77	
78	    let config: AppConfig = serde_json::from_value(v)
79	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_convert_config_after_migration: {}", e))?;

# Plan: Multi-Provider API Key Gateway

## Current State Summary

The proxy has two upstream paths:

1. **Google v1internal** (primary): OAuth access_token based, multi-account rotation via `TokenManager`, calls `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal`. Used by all 3 handlers (openai.rs, claude.rs, gemini.rs) with retry loops that rotate accounts on failure.

2. **z.ai** (secondary, Claude-only): API Key based, single provider, Anthropic-compatible passthrough via `providers/zai_anthropic.rs`. No account selection, no protocol transformation -- just `reqwest` forwarding with `x-api-key` auth.

The dispatch decision lives in `claude.rs` lines 271-346, checking `ZaiConfig.enabled` + `ZaiDispatchMode` (Off/Exclusive/Pooled/Fallback). z.ai is NOT available to openai.rs or gemini.rs handlers.

## Target State

A generic multi-provider API Key gateway where:
- No TokenManager, no OAuth, no account rotation
- Multiple upstream providers configured by name, base_url, api_key, protocol_type
- Model-based routing with round-robin among same-capability providers and fallback chains
- Protocol transformation layer preserved (OpenAI/Claude clients can target any provider)

---

## Step 1: New Provider Configuration Model

**File**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs`

Add these new types alongside the existing `ZaiConfig`:

\```rust
/// Protocol type of the upstream provider -- determines what the provider natively speaks.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ProviderProtocol {
    /// Provider speaks Anthropic Messages API (e.g. z.ai, Anthropic direct).
    /// Requests are forwarded as-is with no protocol transformation.
    AnthropicPassthrough,
    /// Provider speaks OpenAI Chat Completions API.
    OpenAICompatible,
    /// Provider speaks Google v1internal (Gemini) API.
    /// Requests are transformed from OpenAI/Claude to Gemini format.
    GeminiV1Internal,
}

impl Default for ProviderProtocol {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::AnthropicPassthrough }
}

/// Dispatch mode for a single provider within the routing chain.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ProviderDispatchMode {
    /// Always use this provider for matching models.
    Exclusive,
    /// Include this provider in the round-robin pool for matching models.
    Pooled,
    /// Only use when higher-priority pooled/exclusive providers fail.
    Fallback,
}

impl Default for ProviderDispatchMode {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::Pooled }
}

/// A single upstream provider configured by API Key + Base URL.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UpstreamProvider {
    /// Human-readable unique name (e.g. "zai", "anthropic-direct", "openrouter").
    pub name: String,
    /// Whether this provider is enabled.
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// Base URL for the provider API (e.g. "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic").
    pub base_url: String,
    /// API Key for authentication.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub api_key: String,
    /// What protocol this provider natively speaks.
    pub protocol: ProviderProtocol,
    /// Dispatch mode: exclusive, pooled, or fallback.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode,
    /// Priority within the same dispatch_mode group (lower = higher priority).
    #[serde(default = "default_priority")]
    pub priority: u8,
    /// Model name prefix patterns this provider supports (e.g. "claude-", "gpt-").
    /// Empty list means "supports all models".
    #[serde(default)]
    pub model_prefixes: Vec<String>,
    /// Explicit per-model overrides: incoming model -> upstream model name.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub model_mapping: HashMap<String, String>,
    /// Default model mapping by family (used when incoming model is a Claude ID
    /// and this provider is AnthropicPassthrough).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub default_models: ProviderModelDefaults,
    /// Optional HTTP request timeout in seconds (overrides global default).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub request_timeout_secs: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ProviderModelDefaults {
    #[serde(default = "default_sonnet_model")]
    pub sonnet: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_opus_model")]
    pub opus: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_haiku_model")]
    pub haiku: String,
}

impl Default for ProviderModelDefaults {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            sonnet: default_sonnet_model(),
            opus: default_opus_model(),
            haiku: default_haiku_model(),
        }
    }
}
\```

## Step 2: ProviderRouter

**New file**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs`

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use crate::proxy::config::{UpstreamProvider, ProviderProtocol, ProviderDispatchMode};

pub struct ProviderRouter {
    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
}

impl ProviderRouter {
    /// Build from config. If providers list is empty, migrate from legacy ZaiConfig.
    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self { ... }

    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model, sorted by dispatch
    /// mode priority (exclusive > pooled > fallback) then by `priority` field.
    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> { ... }

    /// Select the next provider for a request using round-robin among pooled candidates.
    /// Falls back to exclusive first, then pooled (rr), then fallback.
    pub fn select(&self, model: &str, previous_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> { ... }

    /// Map an incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
    /// Checks: explicit model_mapping > zai: prefix strip > family defaults.
    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming_model: &str) -> String { ... }
}
\```

**Routing algorithm** in `select()`:
1. If `previous_failed` is set, exclude it from candidates.
2. Among remaining candidates, prefer `Exclusive` providers first (by priority).
3. If no exclusive, use round-robin among `Pooled` providers.
4. If none, try `Fallback` providers.

**File model_prefixes matching**: A provider matches a model if `model_prefixes` is empty (wildcard) OR any prefix matches `model.to_lowercase()`.

### 4a. Claude Handler (`claude.rs`)

  AnthropicPassthrough: forward_anthropic_with_provider (NO TokenManager, NO transform)
  GeminiV1Internal:     transform + TokenManager retry loop (legacy path)

let provider = match state.provider_router.read().await.select(&openai_req.model, None) {
    Some(p) => p,
    None => return existing_token_manager_path(), // legacy fallback
};

match provider.protocol {
    ProviderProtocol::OpenAICompatible => {
        return forward_openai_with_provider(&state, &provider, &openai_req, &headers).await;
    }
    ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough => {
        // Transform OpenAI -> Claude JSON, then forward
        let claude_body = transform_openai_to_claude(&openai_req);
        return forward_anthropic_with_provider(...).await;
    }
    ProviderProtocol::GeminiV1Internal => {
        // Fall through to existing TokenManager + transform path
    }
}
\```

# Implementation Plan: Multi-Provider API Key Gateway

## Current State Summary

The proxy has two upstream paths:

1. **Google v1internal** (primary): OAuth access_token based, multi-account rotation via `TokenManager`, calls `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal`. Used by all 3 handlers (openai.rs, claude.rs, gemini.rs) with retry loops that rotate accounts on failure.

2. **z.ai** (secondary, Claude-only): API Key based, single provider, Anthropic-compatible passthrough via `providers/zai_anthropic.rs`. No account selection, no protocol transformation -- just `reqwest` forwarding with `x-api-key` auth.

The dispatch decision lives in `claude.rs` lines 271-346, checking `ZaiConfig.enabled` + `ZaiDispatchMode` (Off/Exclusive/Pooled/Fallback). z.ai is NOT available to openai.rs or gemini.rs handlers.

## Target State

A generic multi-provider API Key gateway where:
- No TokenManager, no OAuth, no account rotation
- Multiple upstream providers configured by name, base_url, api_key, protocol_type
- Model-based routing with round-robin among same-capability providers and fallback chains
- Protocol transformation layer preserved (OpenAI/Claude clients can target any provider)

---

Add these new types:

```rust
/// What protocol the provider natively speaks.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ProviderProtocol {
    /// Provider speaks Anthropic Messages API. Requests forwarded as-is.
    AnthropicPassthrough,
    /// Provider speaks OpenAI Chat Completions API.
    OpenAICompatible,
    /// Provider speaks Google v1internal (Gemini) API.
    /// Requests are transformed from OpenAI/Claude to Gemini format.
    GeminiV1Internal,
}

impl Default for ProviderProtocol {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::AnthropicPassthrough }
}

/// Dispatch mode within the routing chain.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ProviderDispatchMode {
    Exclusive,   // Always use this provider for matching models
    Pooled,      // Round-robin among pooled providers
    Fallback,    // Only when higher-priority providers fail
}

impl Default for ProviderDispatchMode {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::Pooled }
}

/// A single upstream provider configured by API Key + Base URL.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UpstreamProvider {
    pub name: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub base_url: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub api_key: String,
    pub protocol: ProviderProtocol,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode,
    #[serde(default = "default_priority")]
    pub priority: u8,
    /// Model prefix patterns this provider supports (empty = wildcard).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub model_prefixes: Vec<String>,
    /// Explicit per-model overrides: incoming model -> upstream model name.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub model_mapping: HashMap<String, String>,
    /// Default model mapping by family (for AnthropicPassthrough providers).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub default_models: ProviderModelDefaults,
    /// Optional HTTP request timeout in seconds.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub request_timeout_secs: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ProviderModelDefaults {
    #[serde(default = "default_sonnet_model")]
    pub sonnet: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_opus_model")]
    pub opus: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_haiku_model")]
    pub haiku: String,
}

impl Default for ProviderModelDefaults {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            sonnet: default_sonnet_model(),
            opus: default_opus_model(),
            haiku: default_haiku_model(),
        }
    }
}

## Step 2: ProviderRouter

**New file**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs`

```rust
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use crate::proxy::config::{UpstreamProvider, ProviderProtocol, ProviderDispatchMode};

pub struct ProviderRouter {
    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
}

impl ProviderRouter {
    /// Build from config. If providers list is empty, migrate from legacy ZaiConfig.
    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
        if providers.is_empty() {
            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
                if zai.enabled {
                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
                }
            }
        }
        Self {
            providers: providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect(),
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
        }
    }

    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
        let m = model.to_lowercase();
        self.providers.iter()
            .filter(|p| {
                p.model_prefixes.is_empty() ||
                p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
            })
            .collect()
    }

    /// Select the next provider. Excludes previous_failed from candidates.
    pub fn select(&self, model: &str, previous_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
        let mut candidates: Vec<_> = self.candidates_for_model(model)
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|p| previous_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
            .collect();

        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates.iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
            .collect();
        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
            return Some(*p);
        }

        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates.iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
            .collect();
        if !pooled.is_empty() {
            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
            return Some(pooled[idx]);
        }

        // 3. Fallback providers
        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates.iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
            .collect();
        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
        fallback.first().copied()
    }

    /// Map incoming model name to provider's native model ID.
    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
        // 1. Explicit mapping
        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
            return mapped.clone();
        }
        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
        {
            return mapped.1.clone();
        }
        // 2. zai: prefix strip
        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
            return incoming[4..].to_string();
        }
        // 3. Family defaults for Claude models
        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
            if m.contains("opus") { return provider.default_models.opus.clone(); }
            if m.contains("haiku") { return provider.default_models.haiku.clone(); }
            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
        }
        incoming.to_string()
    }
}
```

```rust
pub async fn forward_anthropic_with_provider(
    state: &AppState,
    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
    method: Method,
    path: &str,
    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
    mut body: Value,
    message_count: usize,
) -> Response {
    // Model mapping
    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
        let mapped = state.provider_router.read().await
            .map_model(provider, model);
        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
    }

    let url = match join_base_url(&provider.base_url, path) {
        Ok(u) => u,
        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
    };

    let timeout_secs = provider.request_timeout_secs
        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout).max(5);
    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
    };

    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, &provider.api_key);
    // ... rest mirrors existing forward_anthropic_json logic
}
```

## Backward Compatibility Strategy

1. **Dual-mode**: When `providers` is empty, the system uses the legacy `ZaiConfig` + `TokenManager` path exactly as before. Zero behavior change for existing users.

2. **Auto-migration**: On first config load after upgrade, if `zai.enabled == true` and `providers` is empty, auto-create a provider entry from the z.ai config.

3. **Google OAuth as optional**: Users who still need Google OAuth can keep it -- the TokenManager path is entered when a provider with `protocol: GeminiV1Internal` is selected, or as the ultimate fallback when `providers` is empty.

4. **Gradual deprecation**: `ZaiConfig`, `ZaiDispatchMode`, `state.zai` are kept but marked `#[deprecated]`.

# 计划：多供应商 API 网关

## Context

当前反代系统使用 TokenManager（OAuth 多账户轮换）+ Google v1internal 作为主要上游路径，z.ai 作为 Anthropic 协议的备选路径。用户希望跳过账户选择，改为**基于 API Key 的多供应商网关**模式：配置多个供应商（base_url + api_key + 兼容协议），请求自动路由到对应供应商。

**核心变更：** 引入 `ProviderRouter` 替代 TokenManager 的账户选择逻辑，保留协议转换层。

## 步骤

### 1. 配置模型 (`proxy/config.rs`)

新增结构体：

\```rust
pub enum ProviderProtocol {
    AnthropicPassthrough,   // 透传 Anthropic API
    OpenAICompatible,       // OpenAI 兼容
    GeminiV1Internal,       // Google v1internal（保留旧路径）
}

pub enum ProviderDispatchMode {
    Exclusive,   // 独占：匹配即用
    Pooled,      // 轮询池
    Fallback,    // 降级备用
}

pub struct UpstreamProvider {
    pub name: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub base_url: String,
    pub api_key: String,
    pub protocol: ProviderProtocol,
    pub dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode,
    pub priority: u8,
    pub model_prefixes: Vec<String>,    // 空 = 通配
    pub model_mapping: HashMap<String, String>,
    pub default_models: ProviderModelDefaults,
    pub request_timeout_secs: Option<u64>,
}
\```

在 `ProxyConfig` 中添加 `pub providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>`，保留 `zai` 字段做向后兼容（providers 为空时回退到旧逻辑）。

### 2. ProviderRouter (`providers/router.rs` — 新文件)

ProviderRouter::select(model, prev_failed)

```
ProviderRouter::select(model, prev_failed)
  ├─ 按 model_prefixes 过滤候选供应商
  ├─ Exclusive 模式 → 按 priority 排序，直接选中
  ├─ Pooled 模式 → 按 priority 排序，原子计数器轮询
  └─ Fallback 模式 → 按 priority 排序，取第一个
```

`ProviderRouter::map_model(provider, model)` 处理模型名映射（显式映射 → 前缀匹配 → `zai:` 前缀剥离 → 家族默认值）。

### 3. 通用转发函数 (`providers/zai_anthropic.rs`)

在现有 `forward_anthropic_json` 旁新增 `forward_anthropic_with_provider()`：
- 使用 provider 的 `base_url` + `api_key` 构建请求
- 应用 `model_mapping` 转换模型名
- 复用现有的 header 透传和重试逻辑

### 4. 集成到 AppState (`server.rs`)

`AppState` 新增 `provider_router: Arc<RwLock<ProviderRouter>>`。

启动时初始化 ProviderRouter，传入 config.providers + legacy zai。

### 5. Handler 改造

**claude.rs (lines 271-346):**
- 删除 z.ai dispatch 判断块
- 改为 `provider_router.select(&model, None)`
- AnthropicPassthrough → 调用 `forward_anthropic_with_provider`
- GeminiV1Internal → 走现有 TokenManager 路径
- 无可用供应商 → 回退 TokenManager（兼容旧配置）

**openai.rs (line 165 前插入):**
- `provider_router.select(&model, None)`
- OpenAICompatible → 直接转发
- AnthropicPassthrough → OpenAI→Claude 转换后转发
- GeminiV1Internal → 走现有 TokenManager 路径

**gemini.rs (line 97 前插入):**
- `provider_router.select(&model, None)`
- GeminiV1Internal → 使用 provider 的 base_url + api_key
- 其他 → 走现有路径

### 6. 模块导出 (`providers/mod.rs`, `proxy/mod.rs`)

- `providers/mod.rs` 新增 `pub mod router;`
- `proxy/mod.rs` 导出新增类型

## 关键文件

| 文件 | 操作 |
|------|------|
| `proxy/config.rs` | 新增 UpstreamProvider 等结构体 |
| `providers/router.rs` | **新文件** ProviderRouter |
| `providers/mod.rs` | 新增 router 导出 |
| `providers/zai_anthropic.rs` | 新增通用转发函数 |
| `proxy/server.rs` | AppState + 初始化 |
| `proxy/handlers/claude.rs` | 替换 z.ai dispatch 块 |
| `proxy/handlers/openai.rs` | 新增 provider 选择逻辑 |
| `proxy/handlers/gemini.rs` | 新增 provider 选择逻辑 |
| `proxy/mod.rs` | 模块导出 |

## 向后兼容

- `providers` 为空时 → 完全回退到旧 TokenManager + ZaiConfig 路径，零行为变化
- 旧 `zai` 配置保留，不破坏现有用户
- Google OAuth 路径保留，作为 GeminiV1Internal 供应商的底层实现

## 验证

1. `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
2. `cargo test`
3. headless 启动，测试 OpenAI/Claude/Gemini 三种协议格式请求
4. 配置多个供应商，验证模型路由和轮询

42	        path.to_string()
43	    } else {

53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
54	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
55	
56	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
57	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {

59	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
60	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;

64

92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}
112	
113	/// Recursively remove cache_control from all nested objects/arrays
114	/// [FIX #290] This is a defensive fix that works regardless of serde annotations
115	pub fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
116	    match value {
117	        Value::Object(map) => {
118	            if let Some(v) = map.remove("cache_control") {
119	                tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep Cleaning found nested cache_control: {:?}", v);
120	            }
121	            for v in map.values_mut() {
122	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {
127	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}
133	
134	pub async fn forward_anthropic_json(
135	    state: &AppState,
136	    method: Method,
137	    path: &str,
138	    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
139	    mut body: Value,
140	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Pass message count for rewind detection
141	) -> Response {
142	    let zai = state.zai.read().await.clone();
143	    if !zai.enabled || zai.dispatch_mode == crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
144	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai is disabled").into_response();
145	    }
146	
147	    if zai.api_key.trim().is_empty() {
148	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai api_key is not set").into_response();
149	    }
150	
151	    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
152	        let mapped = map_model_for_zai(model, &zai);
153	        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
154	
155	        // [FIX] Caching for z.ai (to support thinking-filter)
156	        if let Some(sig) = body.get("thinking").and_then(|t| t.get("signature")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
157	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_session_signature(
158	                "zai-session", 
159	                sig.to_string(), 
160	                message_count
161	            );
162	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), mapped);
163	        }
164	    }
165	
166	    let url = match join_base_url(&zai.base_url, path) {
167	        Ok(u) => u,
168	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
169	    };
170	
171	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);
172	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
173	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
174	        Ok(c) => c,
175	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
176	    };
177	
178	    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
179	    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, &zai.api_key);
180	
181	    // Ensure JSON content type.
182	    headers
183	        .entry(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
184	        .or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));
185	
186	    // [FIX #290] Clean cache_control before sending to Anthropic API
187	    // This prevents "Extra inputs are not permitted" errors
188	    if let Some(cc) = body.get("cache_control") {
189	        tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep cleaning cache_control from ROOT: {:?}", cc);
190	    }
191	    deep_remove_cache_control(&mut body);
192	
193	    // [FIX #307] Explicitly serialize body to Vec<u8> to ensure Content-Length is set correctly.
194	    // This avoids "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" for small bodies which caused connection errors.
195	    let body_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap_or_default();
196	    let body_len = body_bytes.len();
197	    
198	    tracing::debug!("Forwarding request to z.ai (len: {} bytes): {}", body_len, url);
