use std::sync::Arc;

use crate::proxy::config::{
    ProviderDispatchMode, ProviderModelDefaults, ProviderProtocol, UpstreamProvider, ZaiConfig,
};

/// Routes incoming requests to the appropriate upstream provider.
pub struct ProviderRouter {
    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
}

impl ProviderRouter {
    /// Build from config. If `providers` is empty, optionally migrate from legacy z.ai config.
    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
        let enabled: Vec<_> = providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect();

        if enabled.is_empty() {
            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
                if zai.enabled && zai.dispatch_mode != crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
                }
            }
        }

        Self {
            providers: enabled,
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
        }
    }

    /// Build a single-provider router from legacy z.ai configuration.
    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
        };

        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
            enabled: true,
            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
            dispatch_mode,
            priority: 0,
            model_prefixes: Vec::new(), // wildcard
            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
            },
            request_timeout_secs: None,
        };

        Self {
            providers: vec![provider],
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
        }
    }

    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
        let m = model.to_lowercase();
        self.providers
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| {
                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
            })
            .collect()
    }

    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
    pub fn select(
        &self,
        model: &str,
        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
            .candidates_for_model(model)
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
            .collect();

        if candidates.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }

        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
            .copied()
            .collect();
        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
            return Some(*p);
        }

        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
            .copied()
            .collect();
        if !pooled.is_empty() {
            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
            return Some(pooled[idx]);
        }

        // 3. Fallback providers
        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
            .copied()
            .collect();
        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
        fallback.first().copied()
    }

    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
            return mapped.clone();
        }
        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
            .model_mapping
            .iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
        {
            return mapped.clone();
        }
        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
            return incoming[4..].to_string();
        }
        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
            return incoming.to_string();
        }
        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
            if m.contains("opus") {
                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
            }
            if m.contains("haiku") {
                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
            }
            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
        }
        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
        incoming.to_string()
    }

    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.providers.is_empty()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::proxy::config::ZaiModelDefaults;

    fn make_test_provider(
        name: &str,
        dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode,
        priority: u8,
        model_prefixes: Vec<String>,
    ) -> UpstreamProvider {
        UpstreamProvider {
            name: name.to_string(),
            enabled: true,
            base_url: "https://example.com".to_string(),
            api_key: "test-key".to_string(),
            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
            dispatch_mode,
            priority,
            model_prefixes,
            model_mapping: Default::default(),
            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults::default(),
            request_timeout_secs: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_select_exclusive() {
        let router = ProviderRouter {
            providers: vec![
                make_test_provider("A", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 1, vec![]),
                make_test_provider("B", ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled, 0, vec![]),
            ],
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
        };

        let p = router.select("claude-sonnet-4-20250514", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.name, "A"); // Exclusive wins over Pooled
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_select_model_prefix_filter() {
        let router = ProviderRouter {
            providers: vec![
                make_test_provider("openai", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, vec!["gpt-".to_string()]),
                make_test_provider("anthropic", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, vec!["claude-".to_string()]),
            ],
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
        };

        let p = router.select("gpt-4o", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.name, "openai");

        let p = router.select("claude-sonnet-4-20250514", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.name, "anthropic");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_map_model_claude_family() {
        let provider = make_test_provider("test", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, vec![]);
        let router = ProviderRouter {
            providers: vec![provider.clone()],
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
        };

        assert_eq!(router.map_model(&provider, "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"), "glm-4.7");
        assert_eq!(router.map_model(&provider, "claude-opus-4-20250514"), "glm-4.7");
        assert_eq!(router.map_model(&provider, "claude-haiku-4-20250514"), "glm-4.5-air");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_from_zai_config() {
        let zai = ZaiConfig {
            enabled: true,
            base_url: "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic".to_string(),
            api_key: "zai-key".to_string(),
            dispatch_mode: crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback,
            model_mapping: Default::default(),
            models: ZaiModelDefaults::default(),
            mcp: Default::default(),
        };

        let router = ProviderRouter::new(vec![], Some(&zai));
        assert!(!router.is_empty());

        let p = router.select("claude-sonnet-4-20250514", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.name, "z.ai");
        assert_eq!(p.base_url, "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic");
    }
}

215	    let status = StatusCode::from_u16(resp.status().as_u16()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
216	
217	    let mut out = Response::builder().status(status);
218	    if let Some(ct) = resp.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE) {
219	        out = out.header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct.clone());
220	    }
221	
222	    // Stream response body to the client (covers SSE and non-SSE).
223	    let stream = resp.bytes_stream().map(|chunk| match chunk {
224	        Ok(b) => Ok::<Bytes, std::io::Error>(b),
225	        Err(e) => Ok(Bytes::from(format!("Upstream stream error: {}", e))),
226	    });
227	
228	    out.body(Body::from_stream(stream)).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
229	        (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to build response").into_response()
230	    })
231	}

_**Agent (qwen3.6-plus 2026-04-10 02:28:58Z)**_

实现完成。以下是改动总结：

## 改动总结

### 新增文件
- `proxy/providers/router.rs` — **ProviderRouter**：多供应商路由器，支持 Exclusive/Pooled/Fallback 三种分发模式，按模型前缀过滤，原子计数器轮询

### 修改文件
| 文件 | 改动 |
|------|------|
| `proxy/config.rs` | 新增 `UpstreamProvider`, `ProviderProtocol`, `ProviderDispatchMode`, `ProviderModelDefaults` 结构体；`ProxyConfig` 新增 `providers` 字段 |
| `proxy/providers/mod.rs` | 导出 `router` 模块 |
| `proxy/providers/zai_anthropic.rs` | 新增 `forward_anthropic_with_provider()` 和 `map_model_for_provider()` 通用转发函数 |
| `proxy/server.rs` | `AppState` 新增 `provider_router` 字段；`start()` 新增 `providers_config` 参数 |
| `proxy/handlers/claude.rs` | 替换 z.ai dispatch 逻辑，改用 ProviderRouter 选择供应商 |
| `proxy/handlers/openai.rs` | 新增 ProviderRouter 检查，支持 AnthropicPassthrough/OpenAICompatible/GeminiV1Internal 三种路由 |
| `proxy/handlers/openai.rs` (末尾) | 新增 `forward_openai_compatible()` 函数 |
| `proxy/mappers/openai/request.rs` | 新增 `to_claude_body()` OpenAI→Claude 转换函数 |
| `proxy/mod.rs` | 导出 `UpstreamProvider`, `ProviderProtocol`, `ProviderDispatchMode` |
| `commands/proxy.rs` | 调用 `AxumServer::start` 时传入 `config.providers` |

### 配置示例
在 `gui_config.json` 中添加：

```json
{
  "providers": [
    {
      "name": "z.ai",
      "enabled": true,
      "base_url": "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic",
      "api_key": "your-key-here",
      "protocol": "anthropic_passthrough",
      "dispatch_mode": "exclusive",
      "priority": 0,
      "model_prefixes": [],
      "model_mapping": {},
      "default_models": {
        "opus": "glm-4.7",
        "sonnet": "glm-4.7",
        "haiku": "glm-4.5-air"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "another-provider",
      "enabled": true,
      "base_url": "https://api.example.com",
      "api_key": "another-key",
      "protocol": "openai_compatible",
      "dispatch_mode": "pooled",
      "priority": 1,
      "model_prefixes": ["gpt-", "o1-"]
    }
  ],
  "zai": { ... }
}
```

- `providers` 非空时，旧的 `zai` 配置被忽略
- `providers` 为空时，完全回退到旧逻辑，**零行为变化**

## Comprehensive Account Management System Map

### 1. Account Module (`src/modules/account.rs`)

**Dependencies:** `models::Account`, `models::AccountIndex`, `models::TokenData`, `models::QuotaData`, `models::DeviceProfile`, `modules::oauth`, `modules::config`, `modules::device`, `proxy::server` (for reload/delete signals), `proxy::common::model_mapping`.

---

### 2. Account Storage / Persistence

**No SQLite for accounts.** Accounts are stored as individual JSON files on disk:

- **Index file:** `~/.antigravity_tools/accounts.json` -- contains `AccountIndex { version, accounts: Vec<AccountSummary>, current_account_id }`
- **Account files:** `~/.antigravity_tools/accounts/{uuid}.json` -- full `Account` objects serialized to JSON

**Write safety:** All index writes use atomic replace (temp file + `atomic_replace_file` which is `MoveFileExW` on Windows, plain `fs::rename` on Unix). A global `Mutex<()>` lock (`ACCOUNT_INDEX_LOCK`) serializes all account index modifications.

**Recovery:** If `accounts.json` is missing, empty, corrupt, or has BOM/NUL prefixes, the system auto-recovers by scanning `accounts/*.json` files and rebuilding the index (`rebuild_index_from_accounts_in_dir`). Corrupt files are backed up as `accounts.json.corrupt-{timestamp}-{uuid}`.

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/modules/account.rs`, lines 328-519

---

### 3. TokenManager (`src/proxy/token_manager.rs`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/token_manager.rs`

The TokenManager is the in-memory token pool used by the proxy during request routing.

**Key structures:**

- **`ProxyToken`** (line 20): The runtime token representation. Contains `account_id`, `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `email`, `project_id`, `subscription_tier`, `remaining_quota`, `protected_models`, `health_score`, `reset_time`, `validation_blocked`, `model_quotas: HashMap<String, i32>`, `model_limits: HashMap<String, u64>`.

- **`TokenManager`** (line 41): Holds `tokens: DashMap<String, ProxyToken>`, `current_index: AtomicUsize`, `rate_limit_tracker`, `sticky_config`, `session_accounts`, `preferred_account_id` (fixed-account mode), `health_scores`, `circuit_breaker_config`.

**Key methods:**

| Method | Line | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `new(data_dir)` | 59 | Creates TokenManager with empty token pool |
| `load_accounts()` | 116 | Scans `data_dir/accounts/*.json`, calls `load_single_account()` for each, populates `tokens` DashMap |
| `load_single_account()` | 295 | Parses JSON, checks disabled/proxy_disabled/validation_blocked/quota_protection states, builds `ProxyToken` with `model_quotas` and `model_limits` |
| `reload_account()` | 164 | Reloads a single account from disk into the pool; if loading returns `None` (account disabled), calls `remove_account()` |
| `reload_all_accounts()` | 192 | Full reload of all accounts + clears rate limits |
| `remove_account()` | 200 | Removes from `tokens`, `health_scores`, `session_accounts`, clears preferred if matches |
| `get_token()` | 1064 | **The core routing entry point.** Handles pending reloads/deletes, then calls `get_token_internal()` with 5s timeout |
| `get_token_internal()` | 1110 | Sorts tokens by: (1) subscription tier ULTRA>PRO>FREE, (2) target model quota (higher first), (3) health score, (4) reset time. Then applies sticky session or P2C (Power of 2 Choices) selection |
| `get_token_by_id()` | 217 | Direct lookup by account_id |
| `get_token_by_email()` | 1818 | Lookup by email |
| `select_with_p2c()` | 964 | P2C algorithm: picks 2 random from top 5 candidates, selects the one with higher quota |
| `check_and_protect_quota()` | 546 | Called during `load_single_account`. Groups models by standard ID, triggers protection if any group min <= threshold |

**Account loading flow in proxy:** `load_accounts()` -> for each `.json` file -> `load_single_account()` -> checks `proxy_disabled`, `validation_blocked`, `disabled`, `get_account_state_on_disk()`, `check_and_protect_quota()` -> builds `ProxyToken` with `model_quotas` -> inserts into `tokens` DashMap.

**Quota models:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/models/quota.rs`

- `QuotaData` -- `models: Vec<ModelQuota>`, `is_forbidden`, `forbidden_reason`, `subscription_tier`, `model_forwarding_rules`
- `ModelQuota` -- `name`, `percentage`, `reset_time`, `display_name`, `supports_images`, `supports_thinking`, `thinking_budget`, `max_tokens`, `max_output_tokens`

**Quota protection flow:**
1. Config defines `threshold_percentage` and `monitored_models`
2. During `load_single_account()`, `check_and_protect_quota()` groups models by standard ID, finds min percentage per group
3. If min <= threshold, `trigger_quota_protection()` adds model to `protected_models` array in account JSON
4. `update_account_quota()` also runs protection check after each manual refresh
5. In `get_token_internal()`, accounts with `protected_models` containing the target model are filtered out (line 976: `!t.protected_models.contains(normalized_target)`)
6. When quota recovers above threshold, `restore_quota_protection()` removes from `protected_models`

---

### 10. Accounts in Proxy Request Flow

The `TokenManager.get_token()` method (line 1064) is the entry point for all proxy requests. The flow:

1. **Pending operations check:** Processes any pending `reload_account` or `delete_account` signals from the account management module
2. **Snapshot:** Takes a snapshot of all tokens from the `DashMap`
3. **Capability filter:** Filters to only accounts that have `model_quotas` containing the requested `target_model` (normalized to standard ID)
4. **Sorting:** Sorts candidates by (a) subscription tier ULTRA > PRO > FREE, (b) model-specific quota percentage (higher first), (c) health score, (d) reset time
5. **Preferred account check:** If fixed-account mode is enabled (FIX #820), tries preferred account first
6. **Sticky session:** If session_id provided, routes to the same account
7. **P2C selection:** From top 5 candidates, randomly picks 2, selects the one with higher remaining quota
8. **Rate limit check:** Verifies the selected account is not rate-limited
9. **Token auto-refresh:** If access token is expired, refreshes via OAuth
10. **Returns:** `(access_token, project_id, email, account_id, max_output_tokens)`

---

  -> TokenData (models/token.rs)
  -> QuotaData (models/quota.rs)
  -> DeviceProfile (models/account.rs)

account module (modules/account.rs)
  -> reads/writes: ~/.antigravity_tools/accounts.json + accounts/*.json
  -> calls: oauth, config, device, proxy::server (signals)
  -> called by: commands/mod.rs, account_service.rs

account_service (modules/account_service.rs)
  -> wraps: account module + oauth + integration
  -> called by: commands/mod.rs

TokenManager (proxy/token_manager.rs)
  -> reads: ~/.antigravity_tools/accounts/*.json at startup
  -> maintains in-memory DashMap<account_id, ProxyToken>
  -> checks: proxy::server pending reload/delete signals
  -> called by: AxumServer handlers during request routing

commands/mod.rs

  Accounts page (pages/Accounts.tsx)

10	fn connect_db() -> Result<Connection, String> {
11	    let db_path = get_proxy_db_path()?;
12	    let conn = Connection::open(db_path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
13	    
14	    // Enable WAL mode for better concurrency
15	    conn.pragma_update(None, "journal_mode", "WAL").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
16	    
17	    // Set busy timeout to 5000ms to avoid "database is locked" errors
18	    conn.pragma_update(None, "busy_timeout", 5000).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
19	    
20	    // Synchronous NORMAL is faster and safe enough for WAL
21	    conn.pragma_update(None, "synchronous", "NORMAL").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
22	    
23	    Ok(conn)
24	}

147	pub fn get_stats() -> Result<crate::proxy::monitor::ProxyStats, String> {
148	    let conn = connect_db()?;
149	
150	    // Optimized: Use single query instead of three separate queries
151	    // Use COALESCE to handle NULL values when table is empty (SUM returns NULL for empty set)
152	    let (total_requests, success_count, error_count): (u64, u64, u64) = conn.query_row(
153	        "SELECT 
154	            COUNT(*) as total,
155	            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 200 AND status < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as success,
156	            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status < 200 OR status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as error
157	         FROM request_logs",
158	        [],
159	        |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?, row.get(2)?)),
160	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
161	
162	    Ok(crate::proxy::monitor::ProxyStats {
163	        total_requests,
164	        success_count,
165	        error_count,
166	    })

452	/// Get token usage grouped by IP
453	pub fn get_token_usage_by_ip(limit: usize, hours: i64) -> Result<Vec<IpTokenStats>, String> {
454	    let conn = connect_db()?;
455	
456	    // Fix: Database stores timestamp in milliseconds, but we were calculating 'since' in seconds
457	    // Convert 'hours' to milliseconds
458	    let since = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis() - (hours * 3600 * 1000);
459	
460	    // [FIX] 不再从 request_logs 表获取 username，因为该字段可能为空
461	    // 先获取 IP 统计数据，然后再单独查询每个 IP 的用户名
462	    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(
463	        "SELECT
464	            client_ip,
465	            COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) as total,
466	            COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) as input,
467	            COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) as output,
468	            COUNT(*) as cnt
469	         FROM request_logs
470	         WHERE timestamp >= ?1 AND client_ip IS NOT NULL AND client_ip != ''
471	         GROUP BY client_ip
472	         ORDER BY total DESC
473	         LIMIT ?2"
474	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
475	
476	    let rows = stmt.query_map(params![since, limit], |row| {
477	        Ok((
478	            row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
479	            row.get::<_, i64>(1)?,
480	            row.get::<_, i64>(2)?,
481	            row.get::<_, i64>(3)?,
482	            row.get::<_, i64>(4)?,
483	        ))
484	    }).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
485	
486	    let mut stats = Vec::new();
487	    for row in rows {
488	        let (client_ip, total_tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens, request_count) = row.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
489	        
490	        // 从 user_token_db 获取该 IP 关联的用户名
491	        // 这比从 request_logs 获取更可靠，因为 token_ip_bindings 表在每次 User Token 使用时都会更新
492	        let username = crate::modules::user_token_db::get_username_for_ip(&client_ip).unwrap_or(None);
493	        
494	        stats.push(IpTokenStats {
495	            client_ip,
496	            total_tokens,
497	            input_tokens,
498	            output_tokens,
499	            request_count,
500	            username,
501	        });
502	    }
503	
504	    Ok(stats)
505	}

114	const CLOUD_CODE_BASE_URL: &str = "https://daily-cloudcode-pa.sandbox.googleapis.com";
115	
116	/// Fetch project ID and subscription tier
117	async fn fetch_project_id(access_token: &str, email: &str, account_id: Option<&str>) -> (Option<String>, Option<String>) {
118	    let client = create_standard_client(account_id).await;
119	    let meta = json!({"metadata": {"ideType": "ANTIGRAVITY"}});
120	
121	    let res = client
122	        .post(format!("{}/v1internal:loadCodeAssist", CLOUD_CODE_BASE_URL))
123	        .header(rquest::header::AUTHORIZATION, format!("Bearer {}", access_token))
124	        .header(rquest::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")
125	        .header(rquest::header::USER_AGENT, crate::constants::NATIVE_OAUTH_USER_AGENT.as_str())
126	        .json(&meta)
127	        .send()
128	        .await;
129	
130	    match res {
131	        Ok(res) => {
132	            if res.status().is_success() {
133	                if let Ok(data) = res.json::<LoadProjectResponse>().await {
134	                    let project_id = data.project_id.clone();
135	                    
136	                    // Core logic: Multi-level fallback for tier extraction
137	                    // 1. Paid Tier (Google One AI Premium etc.)
138	                    // 2. Current Tier (If not ineligible)
139	                    // 3. Allowed Tiers (Restricted/Default proxy access)
140	                    let mut subscription_tier = data.paid_tier.as_ref().and_then(|t| t.name.clone())
141	                        .or_else(|| data.paid_tier.as_ref().and_then(|t| t.id.clone()));
142	                        
143	                    let is_ineligible = data.ineligible_tiers.is_some() && !data.ineligible_tiers.as_ref().unwrap().is_empty();
144	                    
145	                    if subscription_tier.is_none() {
146	                        if !is_ineligible {
147	                            subscription_tier = data.current_tier.as_ref().and_then(|t| t.name.clone())
148	                                .or_else(|| data.current_tier.as_ref().and_then(|t| t.id.clone()));
149	                        } else {
150	                            // If account is marked as INELIGIBLE, drop to allowedTiers and extract default
151	                            if let Some(mut allowed) = data.allowed_tiers {
152	                                if let Some(default_tier) = allowed.iter_mut().find(|t| t.is_default == Some(true)) {
153	                                    if let Some(name) = &default_tier.name {
154	                                        subscription_tier = Some(format!("{} (Restricted)", name));
155	                                    } else if let Some(id) = &default_tier.id {
156	                                        subscription_tier = Some(format!("{} (Restricted)", id));
157	                                    }
158	                                }
159	                            }
160	                        }
161	                    }
162	                    
163	                    if let Some(ref tier) = subscription_tier {
164	                        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
165	                            "📊 [{}] Subscription identified successfully: {}", email, tier
166	                        ));
167	                    }
168	                    
169	                    return (project_id, subscription_tier);
170	                }
171	            } else {
172	                crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!(
173	                    "⚠️  [{}] loadCodeAssist failed: Status: {}", email, res.status()
174	                ));
175	            }
176	        }
177	        Err(e) => {
178	            crate::modules::logger::log_error(&format!("❌ [{}] loadCodeAssist network error: {}", email, e));
179	        }
180	    }
181	    
182	    (None, None)
183	}

185	/// Unified entry point for fetching account quota
186	pub async fn fetch_quota(access_token: &str, email: &str, account_id: Option<&str>) -> crate::error::AppResult<(QuotaData, Option<String>)> {
187	    fetch_quota_with_cache(access_token, email, None, account_id).await
188	}
189	
190	/// Fetch quota with cache support
191	pub async fn fetch_quota_with_cache(
192	    access_token: &str,
193	    email: &str,
194	    cached_project_id: Option<&str>,
195	    account_id: Option<&str>,
196	) -> crate::error::AppResult<(QuotaData, Option<String>)> {
197	    use crate::error::AppError;
198	    
199	    // Optimization: Skip loadCodeAssist call if project_id is cached to save API quota
200	    let (project_id, subscription_tier) = if let Some(pid) = cached_project_id {
201	        (Some(pid.to_string()), None)
202	    } else {
203	        fetch_project_id(access_token, email, account_id).await
204	    };
205	    
206	    // We keep project_id to store in the DB, but we NO LONGER force inject it into payload if it's absent
207	    
208	    let client = create_standard_client(account_id).await;
209	    let payload = if let Some(ref pid) = project_id {
210	        json!({ "project": pid })
211	    } else {
212	        json!({}) // Empty payload fallback
213	    };
214	    
215	    let mut last_error: Option<AppError> = None;
216	
217	    for (ep_idx, ep_url) in QUOTA_API_ENDPOINTS.iter().enumerate() {
218	        let has_next = ep_idx + 1 < QUOTA_API_ENDPOINTS.len();
219	
220	        match client
221	            .post(*ep_url)
222	            .bearer_auth(access_token)
223	            .header(rquest::header::USER_AGENT, crate::constants::NATIVE_OAUTH_USER_AGENT.as_str())
224	            .json(&payload)
225	            .send()
226	            .await
227	        {
228	            Ok(response) => {
229	                // Convert HTTP error status to AppError
230	                if let Err(_) = response.error_for_status_ref() {
231	                    let status = response.status();
232	                    
233	                    // ✅ Special handling for 403 Forbidden - return directly, no retry
234	                    if status == rquest::StatusCode::FORBIDDEN {
235	                        crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!(
236	                            "Account unauthorized (403 Forbidden), marking as forbidden"
237	                        ));
238	                        let mut q = QuotaData::new();
239	                        q.is_forbidden = true;
240	                        q.subscription_tier = subscription_tier.clone();
241	                        return Ok((q, project_id.clone()));
242	                    }
243	                    
244	                    let text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
245	
246	                    // 429/5xx: fallback to next endpoint
247	                    if has_next && (status == rquest::StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS || status.is_server_error()) {
248	                         crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!("Quota API {} returned {}, falling back to next endpoint", ep_url, status));
249	                         last_error = Some(AppError::Unknown(format!("HTTP {} - {}", status, text)));
250	                         tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
251	                         continue;
252	                    }
253	
254	                    return Err(AppError::Unknown(format!("API Error: {} - {}", status, text)));
255	                }
256	
257	                if ep_idx > 0 {
258	                    crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("Quota API fallback succeeded at endpoint #{}", ep_idx + 1));
259	                }
260	
261	                let quota_response: QuotaResponse = response
262	                    .json()
263	                    .await
264	                    .map_err(AppError::from)?;
265	                
266	                let mut quota_data = QuotaData::new();
267	                
268	                // Use debug level for detailed info to avoid console noise
269	                tracing::debug!("Quota API returned {} models", quota_response.models.len());
270	
271	                for (name, info) in quota_response.models {
272	                    if let Some(quota_info) = info.quota_info {
273	                        let percentage = quota_info.remaining_fraction
274	                            .map(|f| (f * 100.0) as i32)
275	                            .unwrap_or(0);
276	                        
277	                        let reset_time = quota_info.reset_time.clone().unwrap_or_default();
278	                        
279	                        // Only keep models we care about (exclude internal chat models)
280	                        if name.starts_with("gemini") || name.starts_with("claude") || name.starts_with("gpt") || name.starts_with("image") || name.starts_with("imagen") {
281	                            let model_quota = crate::models::quota::ModelQuota {
282	                                name,
283	                                percentage,
284	                                reset_time,
285	                                display_name: info.display_name,
286	                                supports_images: info.supports_images,
287	                                supports_thinking: info.supports_thinking,
288	                                thinking_budget: info.thinking_budget,
289	                                recommended: info.recommended,
290	                                max_tokens: info.max_tokens,
291	                                max_output_tokens: info.max_output_tokens,
292	                                supported_mime_types: info.supported_mime_types,
293	                            };
294	                            quota_data.add_model(model_quota);
295	                        }
296	                    }
297	                }
298	                
299	                // Parse deprecated model routing rules
300	                if let Some(deprecated) = quota_response.deprecated_model_ids {
301	                    for (old_id, info) in deprecated {
302	                        quota_data.model_forwarding_rules.insert(old_id, info.new_model_id);
303	                    }
304	                }
305	                
306	                // Set subscription tier
307	                quota_data.subscription_tier = subscription_tier.clone();
308	                
309	                return Ok((quota_data, project_id.clone()));
310	            },
311	            Err(e) => {
312	                crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!("Quota API request failed at {}: {}", ep_url, e));
313	                last_error = Some(AppError::from(e));
314	                if has_next {
315	                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
316	                }
317	            }
318	        }
319	    }
320	    
321	    Err(last_error.unwrap_or_else(|| AppError::Unknown("Quota fetch failed: all endpoints exhausted".to_string())))
322	}

341	/// Get valid token (auto-refresh if expired)
342	pub async fn get_valid_token_for_warmup(account: &crate::models::account::Account) -> Result<(String, String), String> {
343	    let mut account = account.clone();
344	    
345	    // Check and auto-refresh token
346	    let new_token = crate::modules::oauth::ensure_fresh_token(&account.token, Some(&account.id)).await?;
347	    
348	    // If token changed (meant refreshed), save it
349	    if new_token.access_token != account.token.access_token {
350	        account.token = new_token;
351	        if let Err(e) = crate::modules::account::save_account(&account) {
352	            crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!("[Warmup] Failed to save refreshed token: {}", e));
353	        } else {
354	            crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Warmup] Successfully refreshed and saved new token for {}", account.email));
355	        }
356	    }
357	    
358	    // Fetch project_id
359	    let (project_id, _) = fetch_project_id(&account.token.access_token, &account.email, Some(&account.id)).await;
360	    let final_pid = project_id.unwrap_or_else(|| "bamboo-precept-lgxtn".to_string());
361	    
362	    Ok((account.token.access_token, final_pid))
363	}

365	/// Send warmup request via proxy internal API
366	pub async fn warmup_model_directly(
367	    access_token: &str,
368	    model_name: &str,
369	    project_id: &str,
370	    email: &str,
371	    percentage: i32,
372	    _account_id: Option<&str>,
373	) -> bool {
374	    // Get currently configured proxy port
375	    let port = config::load_app_config()
376	        .map(|c| c.proxy.port)
377	        .unwrap_or(8045);
378	
379	    let warmup_url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}/internal/warmup", port);
380	    let body = json!({
381	        "email": email,
382	        "model": model_name,
383	        "access_token": access_token,
384	        "project_id": project_id
385	    });
386	
387	    // Use a no-proxy client for local loopback requests
388	    // This prevents Docker environments from routing localhost through external proxies
389	    let client = rquest::Client::builder()
390	        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(60))
391	        .no_proxy()
392	        .build()
393	        .unwrap_or_else(|_| rquest::Client::new());
394	    let resp = client
395	        .post(&warmup_url)
396	        .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
397	        .json(&body)
398	        .send()
399	        .await;
400	
401	    match resp {
402	        Ok(response) => {
403	            let status = response.status();
404	            if status.is_success() {
405	                crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Warmup] ✓ Triggered {} for {} (was {}%)", model_name, email, percentage));
406	                true
407	            } else {
408	                let text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
409	                crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!("[Warmup] ✗ {} for {} (was {}%): HTTP {} - {}", model_name, email, percentage, status, text));
410	                false
411	            }
412	        }
413	        Err(e) => {
414	            crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!("[Warmup] ✗ {} for {} (was {}%): {}", model_name, email, percentage, e));
415	            false
416	        }
417	    }
418	}

420	/// Smart warmup for all accounts
421	pub async fn warm_up_all_accounts() -> Result<String, String> {
422	    let mut retry_count = 0;
423	
424	    loop {
425	        let all_accounts = crate::modules::account::list_accounts().unwrap_or_default();
426	        // [FIX] 过滤掉禁用反代的账号
427	        let target_accounts: Vec<_> = all_accounts
428	            .into_iter()
429	            .filter(|a| !a.disabled && !a.proxy_disabled)
430	            .collect();
431	
432	        if target_accounts.is_empty() {
433	            return Ok("No accounts available".to_string());
434	        }
435	
436	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Warmup] Screening models for {} accounts...", target_accounts.len()));
437	
438	        let mut warmup_items = Vec::new();
439	        let mut has_near_ready_models = false;
440	
441	        // Concurrently fetch quotas (batch size 5)
442	        let batch_size = 5;
443	        for batch in target_accounts.chunks(batch_size) {
444	            let mut handles = Vec::new();
445	            for account in batch {
446	                let account = account.clone();
447	                let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
448	                    let (token, pid) = match get_valid_token_for_warmup(&account).await {
449	                        Ok(t) => t,
450	                        Err(_) => return None,
451	                    };
452	                    let quota = fetch_quota_with_cache(&token, &account.email, Some(&pid), Some(&account.id)).await.ok();
453	                    Some((account.id.clone(), account.email.clone(), token, pid, quota))
454	                });
455	                handles.push(handle);
456	            }
457	
458	            for handle in handles {
459	                if let Ok(Some((id, email, token, pid, Some((fresh_quota, _))))) = handle.await {
460	                    // [FIX] 预热阶段检测到 403 时，使用统一禁用逻辑，确保账号文件和索引同时更新
461	                    if fresh_quota.is_forbidden {
462	                        crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!(
463	                            "[Warmup] Account {} returned 403 Forbidden during quota fetch, marking as forbidden",
464	                            email
465	                        ));
466	                        let _ = crate::modules::account::mark_account_forbidden(&id, "Warmup: 403 Forbidden - quota fetch denied");
467	                        continue;
468	                    }
469	                    let mut account_warmed_series = std::collections::HashSet::new();
470	                    for m in fresh_quota.models {
471	                        if m.percentage >= 100 {
472	                            let model_to_ping = m.name.clone();
473	
474	                            // Removed hardcoded whitelist - now warms up any model at 100%
475	                            if !account_warmed_series.contains(&model_to_ping) {
476	                                warmup_items.push((id.clone(), email.clone(), model_to_ping.clone(), token.clone(), pid.clone(), m.percentage));
477	                                account_warmed_series.insert(model_to_ping);
478	                            }
479	                        } else if m.percentage >= NEAR_READY_THRESHOLD {
480	                            has_near_ready_models = true;
481	                        }
482	                    }
483	                }
484	            }
485	        }
486	
487	        if !warmup_items.is_empty() {
488	            let total_before = warmup_items.len();
489	            
490	            // Filter out models warmed up within 4 hours
491	            warmup_items.retain(|(_, email, model, _, _, _)| {
492	                let history_key = format!("{}:{}:100", email, model);
493	                !crate::modules::scheduler::check_cooldown(&history_key, 14400)
494	            });
495	            
496	            if warmup_items.is_empty() {
497	                let skipped = total_before;
498	                crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Warmup] Returning to frontend: All models in cooldown, skipped {}", skipped));
499	                return Ok(format!("All models are in cooldown, skipped {} items", skipped));
500	            }
501	            
502	            let total = warmup_items.len();
503	            let skipped = total_before - total;
504	            
505	            if skipped > 0 {
506	                crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
507	                    "[Warmup] Skipped {} models in cooldown, preparing to warmup {}",
508	                    skipped, total
509	                ));
510	            }
511	            
512	            crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
513	                "[Warmup] 🔥 Starting manual warmup for {} models",
514	                total
515	            ));
516	            
517	            tokio::spawn(async move {
518	                let mut success = 0;
519	                let batch_size = 3;
520	                let now_ts = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
521	                
522	                for (batch_idx, batch) in warmup_items.chunks(batch_size).enumerate() {
523	                    let mut handles = Vec::new();
524	                    
525	                    for (id, email, model, token, pid, pct) in batch.iter() {
526	                        let id = id.clone();
527	                        let email = email.clone();
528	                        let model = model.clone();
529	                        let token = token.clone();
530	                        let pid = pid.clone();
531	                        let pct = *pct;
532	                        
533	                        let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
534	                            let result = warmup_model_directly(&token, &model, &pid, &email, pct, Some(&id)).await;
535	                            (result, email, model)
536	                        });
537	                        handles.push(handle);
538	                    }
539	                    
540	                    for handle in handles {
541	                        match handle.await {
542	                            Ok((true, email, model)) => {
543	                                success += 1;
544	                                let history_key = format!("{}:{}:100", email, model);
545	                                crate::modules::scheduler::record_warmup_history(&history_key, now_ts);
546	                            }
547	                            _ => {}
548	                        }
549	                    }
550	                    
551	                    if batch_idx < (warmup_items.len() + batch_size - 1) / batch_size - 1 {
552	                        tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(2)).await;
553	                    }
554	                }
555	                
556	                crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Warmup] Warmup task completed: success {}/{}", success, total));
557	                tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(2)).await;
558	                let _ = crate::modules::account::refresh_all_quotas_logic().await;
559	            });
560	            crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Warmup] Returning to frontend: Warmup task triggered for {} models", total));
561	            return Ok(format!("Warmup task triggered for {} models", total));
562	        }
563	
564	        if has_near_ready_models && retry_count < MAX_RETRIES {
565	            retry_count += 1;
566	            crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Warmup] Critical recovery model detected, waiting {}s to retry ({}/{})", RETRY_DELAY_SECS, retry_count, MAX_RETRIES));
567	            tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(RETRY_DELAY_SECS)).await;
568	            continue;
569	        }
570	
571	        return Ok("No models need warmup".to_string());
572	    }
573	}
574	
575	/// Warmup for single account
576	pub async fn warm_up_account(account_id: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
577	    let accounts = crate::modules::account::list_accounts().unwrap_or_default();
578	    let account_owned = accounts.iter().find(|a| a.id == account_id).cloned().ok_or_else(|| "Account not found".to_string())?;
579	
580	    if account_owned.disabled || account_owned.proxy_disabled {
581	        return Err("Account is disabled".to_string());
582	    }
583	    
584	    let email = account_owned.email.clone();
585	    let (token, pid) = get_valid_token_for_warmup(&account_owned).await?;
586	    let (fresh_quota, _) = fetch_quota_with_cache(&token, &email, Some(&pid), Some(&account_owned.id)).await.map_err(|e| format!("Failed to fetch quota: {}", e))?;
587	    
588	    // [FIX] 预热阶段检测到 403 时，使用统一的 mark_account_forbidden 逻辑，
589	    // 确保账号文件和索引文件同时更新，且前端刷新后能感知到禁用状态
590	    if fresh_quota.is_forbidden {
591	        crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!(
592	            "[Warmup] Account {} returned 403 Forbidden during quota fetch, marking as forbidden",
593	            email
594	        ));
595	        let reason = "Warmup: 403 Forbidden - quota fetch denied";
596	        let _ = crate::modules::account::mark_account_forbidden(account_id, reason);
597	        return Err("Account is forbidden (403)".to_string());
598	    }
599	
600	    let mut models_to_warm = Vec::new();
601	    let mut warmed_series = std::collections::HashSet::new();
602	
603	    for m in fresh_quota.models {
604	        if m.percentage >= 100 {
605	            let model_name = m.name.clone();
606	
607	            // Removed hardcoded whitelist - now warms up any model at 100%
608	            if !warmed_series.contains(&model_name) {
609	                models_to_warm.push((model_name.clone(), m.percentage));
610	                warmed_series.insert(model_name);
611	            }
612	        }
613	    }
614	
615	    if models_to_warm.is_empty() {
616	        return Ok("No warmup needed".to_string());
617	    }
618	
619	    let warmed_count = models_to_warm.len();
620	    let account_id_clone = account_id.to_string();
621	    
622	    tokio::spawn(async move {
623	        for (name, pct) in models_to_warm {
624	            if warmup_model_directly(&token, &name, &pid, &email, pct, Some(&account_id_clone)).await {
625	                let history_key = format!("{}:{}:100", email, name);
626	                let now_ts = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
627	                crate::modules::scheduler::record_warmup_history(&history_key, now_ts);
628	            }
629	            tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
630	        }
631	        let _ = crate::modules::account::refresh_all_quotas_logic().await;
632	    });
633	
634	    Ok(format!("Successfully triggered warmup for {} model series", warmed_count))
635	}

370	fn load_account_index_in_dir(data_dir: &PathBuf) -> Result<AccountIndex, String> {
371	    let index_path = data_dir.join(ACCOUNTS_INDEX);
372	
373	    if !index_path.exists() {
374	        crate::modules::logger::log_warn(
375	            "Account index file not found, attempting recovery from accounts directory",
376	        );

429	/// Save account index to a specific directory (internal helper)
430	fn save_account_index_in_dir(data_dir: &PathBuf, index: &AccountIndex) -> Result<(), String> {
431	    let index_path = data_dir.join(ACCOUNTS_INDEX);
432	    // Use unique temp file name per write to avoid collision
433	    let temp_filename = format!("{}.tmp.{}", ACCOUNTS_INDEX, Uuid::new_v4());
434	    let temp_path = data_dir.join(&temp_filename);
435	
436	    let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(index)
437	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_serialize_account_index: {}", e))?;
438	
439	    // Write to temporary file
440	    if let Err(e) = fs::write(&temp_path, content) {
441	        // Clean up temp file on failure
442	        let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
443	        return Err(format!("failed_to_write_temp_index_file: {}", e));
444	    }
445	
446	    // Atomic rename with platform-specific handling
447	    if let Err(e) = atomic_replace_file(&temp_path, &index_path) {
448	        // Clean up temp file on failure
449	        let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);
450	        return Err(format!("failed_to_replace_index_file: {}", e));
451	    }
452	
453	    Ok(())
454	}

456	/// Rebuild AccountIndex by scanning accounts/*.json files in specific directory
457	fn rebuild_index_from_accounts_in_dir(data_dir: &PathBuf) -> Result<AccountIndex, String> {
458	    let accounts_dir = data_dir.join(ACCOUNTS_DIR);
459	    let mut summaries = Vec::new();
460	
461	    if accounts_dir.exists() {
462	        if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&accounts_dir) {
463	            for entry in entries.filter_map(|e| e.ok()) {
464	                let path = entry.path();
465	                if path.extension().map_or(false, |ext| ext == "json") {
466	                    if let Some(account_id) = path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
467	                        match load_account_at_path(&path) {
468	                            Ok(account) => {
469	                                    summaries.push(AccountSummary {
470	                                        id: account.id,
471	                                        email: account.email,
472	                                        name: account.name,
473	                                        disabled: account.disabled,
474	                                        proxy_disabled: account.proxy_disabled,
475	                                        protected_models: account.protected_models,
476	                                        created_at: account.created_at,
477	                                        last_used: account.last_used,
478	                                    });
479	                            }
480	                            Err(e) => {
481	                                crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!(
482	                                    "Failed to load account {} during recovery: {}",
483	                                    account_id, e
484	                                ));
485	                            }
486	                        }
487	                    }
488	                }
489	            }
490	        }
491	    }
492	
493	    // Sort by last_used desc, then by email for deterministic order
494	    summaries.sort_by(|a, b| {
495	        b.last_used
496	            .cmp(&a.last_used)
497	            .then_with(|| a.email.cmp(&b.email))
498	    });
499	
500	    let current_account_id = summaries.first().map(|s| s.id.clone());
501	
502	    crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
503	        "Rebuilt index from accounts directory: {} accounts recovered",
504	        summaries.len()
505	    ));
506	
507	    Ok(AccountIndex {
508	        version: "2.0".to_string(),
509	        accounts: summaries,
510	        current_account_id,
511	    })
512	}

516	    let content = fs::read_to_string(account_path)
517	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_read_account_data: {}", e))?;
518	    serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_parse_account_data: {}", e))
519	}

521	/// Load account index with recovery support
522	pub fn load_account_index() -> Result<AccountIndex, String> {

527	/// Sanitize index file content by stripping BOM and leading NUL bytes
528	fn sanitize_index_content(raw: &[u8]) -> String {
529	    // Skip UTF-8 BOM if present
530	    let without_bom = if raw.starts_with(&[0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF]) {
531	        &raw[3..]
532	    } else {
533	        raw
534	    };
535	
536	    // Skip leading NUL bytes
537	    let without_nul = without_bom
538	        .iter()
539	        .skip_while(|&&b| b == 0x00)
540	        .copied()
541	        .collect::<Vec<u8>>();
542	
543	    // Convert to string (lossy - invalid UTF-8 sequences become replacement chars)
544	    String::from_utf8_lossy(&without_nul).into_owned()
545	}
546	
547	/// Best-effort save of recovered index without deadlocking
548	fn try_save_recovered_index(
549	    data_dir: &PathBuf,
550	    _index_path: &PathBuf,
551	    index: &AccountIndex,
552	    corrupt_content: Option<&[u8]>,
553	) -> Result<(), String> {
554	    // Backup corrupt file if content provided
555	    if let Some(content) = corrupt_content {
556	        let timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
557	        let backup_name = format!("accounts.json.corrupt-{}-{}", timestamp, Uuid::new_v4());
558	        let backup_path = data_dir.join(&backup_name);
559	        if let Err(e) = fs::write(&backup_path, content) {
560	            crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!(
561	                "Failed to backup corrupt index to {}: {}",
562	                backup_name, e
563	            ));
564	        } else {
565	            crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
566	                "Backed up corrupt index to {}",
567	                backup_name
568	            ));
569	        }
570	    }
571	
572	    // Try to acquire lock without blocking - if we can't get it, skip saving
573	    match ACCOUNT_INDEX_LOCK.try_lock() {
574	        Ok(_guard) => {
575	            if let Err(e) = save_account_index_in_dir(data_dir, index) {
576	                crate::modules::logger::log_warn(&format!(
577	                    "Failed to save recovered index: {}. Will retry on next load.",
578	                    e
579	                ));
580	            } else {
581	                crate::modules::logger::log_info("Successfully saved recovered index");
582	            }
583	        }
584	        Err(_) => {
585	            crate::modules::logger::log_warn(
586	                "Could not acquire lock to save recovered index. Will retry on next load."
587	            );
588	        }
589	    }
590	
591	    Ok(())
592	}
593	
594	/// Save account index (atomic write)
595	pub fn save_account_index(index: &AccountIndex) -> Result<(), String> {
596	    let data_dir = get_data_dir()?;
597	    save_account_index_in_dir(&data_dir, index)
598	}

78	    /// 启动限流记录自动清理后台任务（每15秒检查并清除过期记录）
79	    pub async fn start_auto_cleanup(&self) {
80	        let tracker = self.rate_limit_tracker.clone();
81	        let cancel = self.cancel_token.child_token();
82	
83	        let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
84	            let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(15));
85	            loop {
86	                tokio::select! {
87	                    _ = cancel.cancelled() => {
88	                        tracing::info!("Auto-cleanup task received cancel signal");
89	                        break;
90	                    }
91	                    _ = interval.tick() => {
92	                        let cleaned = tracker.cleanup_expired();
93	                        if cleaned > 0 {
94	                            tracing::info!(
95	                                "Auto-cleanup: Removed {} expired rate limit record(s)",
96	                                cleaned
97	                            );
98	                        }
99	                    }
100	                }
101	            }
102	        });
103	
104	        // 先 abort 旧任务（防止任务泄漏），再存储新 handle
105	        let mut guard = self.auto_cleanup_handle.lock().await;
106	        if let Some(old) = guard.take() {
107	            old.abort();
108	            tracing::warn!("Aborted previous auto-cleanup task");
109	        }
110	        *guard = Some(handle);
111	
112	        tracing::info!("Rate limit auto-cleanup task started (interval: 15s)");
113	    }

221	    /// Check if an account has been disabled on disk.
222	    ///
223	    /// Safety net: avoids selecting a disabled account when the in-memory pool hasn't been
224	    /// reloaded yet (e.g. fixed account mode / sticky session).
225	    ///
226	    /// Note: this is intentionally tolerant to transient read/parse failures (e.g. concurrent
227	    /// writes). Failures are reported as `Unknown` so callers can skip without purging the in-memory
228	    /// token pool.
229	    async fn get_account_state_on_disk(account_path: &std::path::PathBuf) -> OnDiskAccountState {
230	        const MAX_RETRIES: usize = 2;
231	        const RETRY_DELAY_MS: u64 = 5;
232	
233	        for attempt in 0..=MAX_RETRIES {
234	            let content = match tokio::fs::read_to_string(account_path).await {
235	                Ok(c) => c,
236	                Err(e) => {
237	                    // If the file is gone, the in-memory token is definitely stale.
238	                    if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound {
239	                        return OnDiskAccountState::Disabled;
240	                    }
241	                    if attempt < MAX_RETRIES {
242	                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(RETRY_DELAY_MS)).await;
243	                        continue;
244	                    }
245	                    tracing::debug!(
246	                        "Failed to read account file on disk {:?}: {}",
247	                        account_path,
248	                        e
249	                    );
250	                    return OnDiskAccountState::Unknown;
251	                }
252	            };
253	
254	            let account = match serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&content) {
255	                Ok(v) => v,
256	                Err(e) => {
257	                    if attempt < MAX_RETRIES {
258	                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(RETRY_DELAY_MS)).await;
259	                        continue;
260	                    }
261	                    tracing::debug!(
262	                        "Failed to parse account JSON on disk {:?}: {}",
263	                        account_path,
264	                        e
265	                    );
266	                    return OnDiskAccountState::Unknown;
267	                }
268	            };
269	
270	            let disabled = account
271	                .get("disabled")
272	                .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
273	                .unwrap_or(false)
274	                || account
275	                    .get("proxy_disabled")
276	                    .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
277	                    .unwrap_or(false)
278	                || account
279	                    .get("quota")
280	                    .and_then(|q| q.get("is_forbidden"))
281	                    .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
282	                    .unwrap_or(false);
283	
284	            return if disabled {
285	                OnDiskAccountState::Disabled
286	            } else {
287	                OnDiskAccountState::Enabled
288	            };
289	        }
290	
291	        OnDiskAccountState::Unknown
292	    }

600	/// Platform-specific atomic file replacement
601	#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
602	fn atomic_replace_file(src: &PathBuf, dst: &PathBuf) -> Result<(), String> {
603	    use std::os::windows::ffi::OsStrExt;
604	
605	    type Bool = i32;
606	    type Dword = u32;
607	
608	    #[link(name = "Kernel32")]
609	    extern "system" {
610	        fn MoveFileExW(lp_existing_file_name: *const u16, lp_new_file_name: *const u16, dw_flags: Dword) -> Bool;
611	    }
612	
613	    let src_wide: Vec<u16> = src
614	        .as_os_str()
615	        .encode_wide()
616	        .chain(std::iter::once(0))
617	        .collect();
618	    let dst_wide: Vec<u16> = dst
619	        .as_os_str()
620	        .encode_wide()
621	        .chain(std::iter::once(0))
622	        .collect();
623	
624	    // MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING = 0x1
625	    // MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH = 0x8
626	    const MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING: u32 = 0x1;
627	    const MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH: u32 = 0x8;
628	    let flags = MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH;
629	
630	    let result = unsafe { MoveFileExW(src_wide.as_ptr(), dst_wide.as_ptr(), flags) };
631	    if result == 0 {
632	        let err = std::io::Error::last_os_error();
633	        // Clean up source file on failure
634	        let _ = fs::remove_file(src);
635	        return Err(format!("MoveFileExW failed: {}", err));
636	    }
637	
638	    Ok(())
639	}

609	        // 6. 遍历受监控的 Standard ID，根据组内“最差状态”执行锁定或恢复
610	        let threshold = config.threshold_percentage as i32;
611	        let account_id = account_json
612	            .get("id")
613	            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
614	            .unwrap_or("unknown")
615	            .to_string();
616	        let mut changed = false;
617	
618	        for std_id in &config.monitored_models {
619	            // 获取该组的最低百分比，如果账号没该组型号则视为 100%
620	            let min_pct = group_min_percentage.get(std_id).cloned().unwrap_or(100);
621	
622	            if min_pct <= threshold {
623	                // 只要组内有一个不行，触发全组保护
624	                if self
625	                    .trigger_quota_protection(
626	                        account_json,
627	                        &account_id,
628	                        account_path,
629	                        min_pct,
630	                        threshold,
631	                        std_id,
632	                    )
633	                    .await
634	                    .unwrap_or(false)
635	                {
636	                    changed = true;
637	                }
638	            } else {
639	                // 只有全组都好（或者没这型号），才尝试从之前受限状态恢复
640	                let protected_models = account_json
641	                    .get("protected_models")
642	                    .and_then(|v| v.as_array());
643	                
644	                let is_protected = protected_models.map_or(false, |arr| {
645	                    arr.iter().any(|m| m.as_str() == Some(std_id as &str))
646	                });
647	
648	                if is_protected {
649	                    if self
650	                        .restore_quota_protection(
651	                            account_json,
652	                            &account_id,
653	                            account_path,
654	                            std_id,
655	                        )
656	                        .await
657	                        .unwrap_or(false)
658	                    {
659	                        changed = true;
660	                    }
661	                }
662	            }
663	        }
664	
665	        let _ = changed; // 避免 unused 警告，如果后续逻辑需要可以继续使用
666	
667	        // 我们不再因为配额原因返回 true（即不再跳过账号），
668	        // 而是加载并在 get_token 时进行过滤。
669	        false
670	    }

672	    /// 计算账号的最大剩余配额百分比（用于排序）
673	    /// 返回值: Option<i32> (max_percentage)
674	    fn calculate_quota_stats(&self, quota: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<i32> {
675	        let models = match quota.get("models").and_then(|m| m.as_array()) {
676	            Some(m) => m,
677	            None => return None,
678	        };
679	
680	        let mut max_percentage = 0;
681	        let mut has_data = false;
682	
683	        for model in models {
684	            if let Some(pct) = model.get("percentage").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()) {
685	                let pct_i32 = pct as i32;
686	                if pct_i32 > max_percentage {
687	                    max_percentage = pct_i32;
688	                }
689	                has_data = true;
690	            }
691	        }
692	
693	        if has_data {
694	            Some(max_percentage)
695	        } else {
696	            None
697	        }
698	    }
699

714	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| name.to_string())

728	        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(account_path).ok()?;

743	    fn build_dynamic_model_candidates(model_name: &str) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
744	        let model = model_name.trim().to_lowercase();
745	        if model.is_empty() {
746	            return None;
747	        }
748	
749	        let pro_family = [
750	            "gemini-3-pro",
751	            "gemini-3-pro-preview",
752	            "gemini-3-pro-high",
753	            "gemini-3-pro-low",
754	            "gemini-3.1-pro",
755	            "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
756	            "gemini-3.1-pro-high",
757	            "gemini-3.1-pro-low",
758	        ];
759	
760	        if !pro_family.contains(&model.as_str()) {
761	            return None;
762	        }
763	
764	        let mut out = Vec::new();
765	        let mut seen = HashSet::new();
766	        let mut push = |candidate: &str| {
767	            let c = candidate.to_string();
768	            if seen.insert(c.clone()) {
769	                out.push(c);
770	            }
771	        };
772	
773	        // Keep requested model as top priority, then fallback across the same family.
774	        push(&model);
775	        push("gemini-3.1-pro-preview");
776	        push("gemini-3-pro-preview");
777	        push("gemini-3.1-pro-high");
778	        push("gemini-3-pro-high");
779	        push("gemini-3.1-pro-low");
780	        push("gemini-3-pro-low");
781	
782	        Some(out)
783	    }

382	            .update_proxy_pool(config.proxy.proxy_pool.clone())
383	            .await;
384	        // 更新熔断配置
385	        instance
386	            .token_manager
387	            .update_circuit_breaker_config(config.circuit_breaker.clone())
388	            .await;
389	        tracing::debug!("已同步热更新反代服务配置");
390	    }
391	
392	    Ok(())
393	}

547	#[tauri::command]
548	pub async fn sync_account_from_db(
549	    app: tauri::AppHandle,
550	    proxy_state: tauri::State<'_, crate::commands::proxy::ProxyServiceState>,
551	) -> Result<Option<Account>, String> {
552	    // 1. 获取 DB 中的 Refresh Token
553	    let db_refresh_token = match modules::migration::get_refresh_token_from_db() {
554	        Ok(token) => token,
555	        Err(e) => {
556	            modules::logger::log_info(&format!("自动同步跳过: {}", e));
557	            return Ok(None);
558	        }
559	    };
560	
561	    // 2. 获取 Manager 当前账号
562	    let curr_account = modules::account::get_current_account()?;
563	
564	    // 3. 对比：如果 Refresh Token 相同，说明账号没变，无需导入
565	    if let Some(acc) = curr_account {
566	        if acc.token.refresh_token == db_refresh_token {
567	            // 账号未变，由于已经是周期性任务，我们可以选择性刷新一下配额，或者直接返回
568	            // 这里为了节省 API 流量，直接返回
569	            return Ok(None);
570	        }
571	        modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
572	            "检测到账号切换 ({} -> DB新账号)，正在同步...",
573	            acc.email
574	        ));
575	    } else {
576	        modules::logger::log_info("检测到新登录账号，正在自动同步...");
577	    }
578	
579	    // 4. 执行完整导入
580	    let account = import_from_db(app, proxy_state).await?;
581	    Ok(Some(account))
582	}

584	fn validate_path(path: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
585	    if path.contains("..") {
586	        return Err("非法路径: 不允许目录遍历".to_string());
587	    }
588	
589	    // 检查是否指向系统敏感路径 (基础黑名单)
590	    let lower_path = path.to_lowercase();
591	    let sensitive_prefixes = [
592	        "/etc/",
593	        "/var/spool/cron",
594	        "/root/",
595	        "/proc/",
596	        "/sys/",
597	        "/dev/",
598	        "c:\\windows",
599	        "c:\\users\\administrator",
600	        "c:\\pagefile.sys",
601	    ];
602	
603	    for prefix in sensitive_prefixes {
604	        if lower_path.starts_with(prefix) {
605	            return Err(format!("安全拒绝: 禁止访问系统敏感路径 ({})", prefix));
606	        }
607	    }
608	
609	    Ok(())
610	}

792	/// 切换账号的反代禁用状态
793	#[tauri::command]
794	pub async fn toggle_proxy_status(
795	    app: tauri::AppHandle,
796	    proxy_state: tauri::State<'_, crate::commands::proxy::ProxyServiceState>,
797	    account_id: String,
798	    enable: bool,
799	    reason: Option<String>,
800	) -> Result<(), String> {
801	    modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
802	        "切换账号反代状态: {} -> {}",
803	        account_id,
804	        if enable { "启用" } else { "禁用" }
805	    ));
806	
807	    // 1. 读取账号文件
808	    let data_dir = modules::account::get_data_dir()?;
809	    let account_path = data_dir
810	        .join("accounts")
811	        .join(format!("{}.json", account_id));
812	
813	    if !account_path.exists() {
814	        return Err(format!("账号文件不存在: {}", account_id));
815	    }
816	
817	    let content =
818	        std::fs::read_to_string(&account_path).map_err(|e| format!("读取账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
819	
820	    let mut account_json: serde_json::Value =
821	        serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| format!("解析账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
822	
823	    // 2. 更新 proxy_disabled 字段
824	    if enable {
825	        // 启用反代
826	        account_json["proxy_disabled"] = serde_json::Value::Bool(false);
827	        account_json["proxy_disabled_reason"] = serde_json::Value::Null;
828	        account_json["proxy_disabled_at"] = serde_json::Value::Null;
829	    } else {
830	        // 禁用反代
831	        let now = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
832	        account_json["proxy_disabled"] = serde_json::Value::Bool(true);
833	        account_json["proxy_disabled_at"] = serde_json::Value::Number(now.into());
834	        account_json["proxy_disabled_reason"] =
835	            serde_json::Value::String(reason.unwrap_or_else(|| "用户手动禁用".to_string()));
836	    }
837	
838	    // 3. 保存到磁盘
839	    let json_str = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&account_json)
840	        .map_err(|e| format!("序列化账号数据失败: {}", e))?;
841	    std::fs::write(&account_path, json_str).map_err(|e| format!("写入账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
842	
843	    modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
844	        "账号反代状态已更新: {} ({})",
845	        account_id,
846	        if enable { "已启用" } else { "已禁用" }
847	    ));
848	
849	    // 4. 如果反代服务正在运行,立刻同步到内存池（避免禁用后仍被选中）
850	    {
851	        let instance_lock = proxy_state.instance.read().await;
852	        if let Some(instance) = instance_lock.as_ref() {
853	            // 如果禁用的是当前固定账号，则自动关闭固定模式（内存 + 配置持久化）
854	            if !enable {
855	                let pref_id = instance.token_manager.get_preferred_account().await;
856	                if pref_id.as_deref() == Some(&account_id) {
857	                    instance.token_manager.set_preferred_account(None).await;
858	
859	                    if let Ok(mut cfg) = crate::modules::config::load_app_config() {
860	                        if cfg.proxy.preferred_account_id.as_deref() == Some(&account_id) {
861	                            cfg.proxy.preferred_account_id = None;
862	                            let _ = crate::modules::config::save_app_config(&cfg);
863	                        }
864	                    }
865	                }
866	            }
867	
868	            instance
869	                .token_manager
870	                .reload_account(&account_id)
871	                .await
872	                .map_err(|e| format!("同步账号失败: {}", e))?;
873	        }
874	    }
875	
876	    // 5. 更新托盘菜单
877	    crate::modules::tray::update_tray_menus(&app);
878	
879	    Ok(())
880	}

894	/// 更新账号自定义标签
895	#[tauri::command]
896	pub async fn update_account_label(account_id: String, label: String) -> Result<(), String> {
897	    // 验证标签长度（按字符数计算，支持中文）
898	    if label.chars().count() > 15 {
899	        return Err("标签长度不能超过15个字符".to_string());
900	    }
901	
902	    modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
903	        "更新账号标签: {} -> {:?}",
904	        account_id,
905	        if label.is_empty() { "无" } else { &label }
906	    ));
907	
908	    // 1. 读取账号文件
909	    let data_dir = modules::account::get_data_dir()?;
910	    let account_path = data_dir
911	        .join("accounts")
912	        .join(format!("{}.json", account_id));
913	
914	    if !account_path.exists() {
915	        return Err(format!("账号文件不存在: {}", account_id));
916	    }
917	
918	    let content =
919	        std::fs::read_to_string(&account_path).map_err(|e| format!("读取账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
920	
921	    let mut account_json: serde_json::Value =
922	        serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| format!("解析账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
923	
924	    // 2. 更新 custom_label 字段
925	    if label.is_empty() {
926	        account_json["custom_label"] = serde_json::Value::Null;
927	    } else {
928	        account_json["custom_label"] = serde_json::Value::String(label.clone());

79	pub async fn internal_start_proxy_service(
80	    config: ProxyConfig,

82	    integration: crate::modules::integration::SystemManager,
83	    cloudflared_state: Arc<crate::commands::cloudflared::CloudflaredState>,
84	) -> Result<ProxyStatus, String> {
85	    // 1. 检查状态并加锁
86	    {
87	        let instance_lock = state.instance.read().await;
88	        if instance_lock.is_some() {
89	            return Err("服务已在运行中".to_string());
90	        }
91	    }
92

94	    if state
95	        .starting
96	        .compare_exchange(false, true, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst)
97	        .is_err()

99	        return Err("服务正在启动中，请稍候...".to_string());
100	    }
101	
102	    // 使用自定义 Drop guard 确保无论成功失败都会重置 starting 状态
103	    let _starting_guard = StartingGuard(state.starting.clone());
104	
105	    // Ensure monitor exists
106	    {
107	        let mut monitor_lock = state.monitor.write().await;
108	        if monitor_lock.is_none() {
109	            let app_handle =
110	                if let crate::modules::integration::SystemManager::Desktop(ref h) = integration {
111	                    Some(h.clone())
112	                } else {
113	                    None
114	                };
115	            *monitor_lock = Some(Arc::new(ProxyMonitor::new(1000, app_handle)));
116	        }
117	        // Sync enabled state from config
118	        if let Some(monitor) = monitor_lock.as_ref() {
119	            monitor.set_enabled(config.enable_logging);
120	        }
121	    }
122	
123	    let _monitor = state.monitor.read().await.as_ref().unwrap().clone();
124	
125	    // 檢查並啟動管理服務器（如果尚未運行）
126	    ensure_admin_server(
127	        config.clone(),
128	        state,
129	        integration.clone(),
130	        cloudflared_state.clone(),
131	    )
132	    .await?;
133	
134	    // 2. [FIX] 复用管理服务器的 Token 管理器 (单实例，解决热更新同步问题)
135	    let token_manager = {
136	        let admin_lock = state.admin_server.read().await;
137	        admin_lock
138	            .as_ref()
139	            .unwrap()
140	            .axum_server
141	            .token_manager
142	            .clone()
143	    };
144	
145	    // 同步配置到运行中的 TokenManager
146	    token_manager.start_auto_cleanup().await;
147	    token_manager
148	        .update_sticky_config(config.scheduling.clone())
149	        .await;
150	
151	    // [NEW] 加载熔断配置 (从主配置加载)
152	    let app_config = crate::modules::config::load_app_config()
153	        .unwrap_or_else(|_| crate::models::AppConfig::new());
154	    token_manager
155	        .update_circuit_breaker_config(app_config.circuit_breaker)
156	        .await;
157	
158	    // 🆕 [FIX #820] 恢复固定账号模式设置
159	    if let Some(ref account_id) = config.preferred_account_id {
160	        token_manager
161	            .set_preferred_account(Some(account_id.clone()))
162	            .await;
163	        tracing::info!("🔒 [FIX #820] Fixed account mode restored: {}", account_id);
164	    }
165	
166	    // 3. 加載賬號
167	    let active_accounts = token_manager.load_accounts().await.unwrap_or(0);
168	
169	    if active_accounts == 0 {
170	        let zai_enabled = config.zai.enabled
171	            && !matches!(config.zai.dispatch_mode, crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off);
172	        if !zai_enabled {

178	                active_accounts: 0,

180	        }
181	    }
182	
183	    let mut instance_lock = state.instance.write().await;
184	    let admin_lock = state.admin_server.read().await;
185	    let axum_server = admin_lock.as_ref().unwrap().axum_server.clone();
186	
187	    // 创建服务实例（逻辑启动）
188	    let instance = ProxyServiceInstance {

193	    };
194	
195	    // [FIX] Ensure the server is logically running
196	    axum_server.set_running(true).await;
197	
198	    *instance_lock = Some(instance);
199	
200	    // 成功启动后，guard 在这里结束并重置 starting 是 OK 的
201	    // 但其实我们可以直接手动掉，或者相信 guard
202	    Ok(ProxyStatus {
203	        running: true,
204	        port: config.port,
205	        base_url: format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", config.port),

212	    config: ProxyConfig,
213	    state: &ProxyServiceState,

231	                };

265	    };
266	
267	    *admin_lock = Some(AdminServerInstance {

282	/// 停止反代服务
283	#[tauri::command]
284	pub async fn stop_proxy_service(state: State<'_, ProxyServiceState>) -> Result<(), String> {
285	    let mut instance_lock = state.instance.write().await;
286	
287	    if instance_lock.is_none() {
288	        return Err("服务未运行".to_string());
289	    }
290	
291	    // 停止 Axum 服务器 (仅逻辑停止，不杀死进程)
292	    if let Some(instance) = instance_lock.take() {
293	        instance.token_manager.abort_background_tasks().await;
294	        instance.axum_server.set_running(false).await;
295	        // 已移除 instance.axum_server.stop() 调用，防止杀死 Admin Server
296	    }
297	
298	    Ok(())
299	}

301	/// 获取反代服务状态
302	#[tauri::command]
303	pub async fn get_proxy_status(state: State<'_, ProxyServiceState>) -> Result<ProxyStatus, String> {
304	    // 优先检查启动标志，避免被写锁阻塞
305	    if state.starting.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
306	        return Ok(ProxyStatus {
307	            running: false, // 逻辑上还没运行
308	            port: 0,
309	            base_url: "starting".to_string(), // 给前端标识
310	            active_accounts: 0,
311	        });
312	    }
313	
314	    // 使用 try_read 避免在该命令中产生产生排队延迟
315	    let lock_res = state.instance.try_read();
316	
317	    match lock_res {
318	        Ok(instance_lock) => match instance_lock.as_ref() {
319	            Some(instance) => Ok(ProxyStatus {
320	                running: true,
321	                port: instance.config.port,
322	                base_url: format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", instance.config.port),
323	                active_accounts: instance.token_manager.len(),
324	            }),
325	            None => Ok(ProxyStatus {
326	                running: false,
327	                port: 0,
328	                base_url: String::new(),
329	                active_accounts: 0,
330	            }),
331	        },
332	        Err(_) => {
333	            // 如果拿不到锁，说明正在进行写操作（可能是正在启动或停止中）
334	            Ok(ProxyStatus {
335	                running: false,
336	                port: 0,
337	                base_url: "busy".to_string(),
338	                active_accounts: 0,
339	            })
340	        }
341	    }
342	}
