```text
516	fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> String {
517	    let base = base.trim_end_matches('/');
518	    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
519	        path.to_string()
520	    } else {
521	        format!("/{}", path)
522	    };
523	    format!("{}{}", base, path)
524	}
525	
526	fn extract_model_ids(value: &serde_json::Value) -> Vec<String> {
527	    let mut out = Vec::new();
528	
529	    fn push_from_item(out: &mut Vec<String>, item: &serde_json::Value) {
530	        match item {
531	            serde_json::Value::String(s) => out.push(s.to_string()),
532	            serde_json::Value::Object(map) => {
533	                if let Some(id) = map.get("id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
534	                    out.push(id.to_string());
535	                } else if let Some(name) = map.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
536	                    out.push(name.to_string());
537	                }
538	            }
539	            _ => {}
540	        }
541	    }
542	
543	    match value {
544	        serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => {
545	            for item in arr {
546	                push_from_item(&mut out, item);
547	            }
548	        }
549	        serde_json::Value::Object(map) => {
550	            if let Some(data) = map.get("data") {
551	                if let serde_json::Value::Array(arr) = data {
552	                    for item in arr {
553	                        push_from_item(&mut out, item);
554	                    }
555	                }
556	            }
557	            if let Some(models) = map.get("models") {
558	                match models {
559	                    serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => {
560	                        for item in arr {
561	                            push_from_item(&mut out, item);
562	                        }
563	                    }
564	                    other => push_from_item(&mut out, other),
565	                }
566	            }
567	        }
568	        _ => {}
569	    }
570	
571	    out
572	}

574	/// Fetch available models from the configured z.ai Anthropic-compatible API (`/v1/models`).
575	#[tauri::command]
576	pub async fn fetch_zai_models(
577	    zai: crate::proxy::ZaiConfig,
578	    upstream_proxy: crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig,
579	    request_timeout: u64,
580	) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
581	    if zai.base_url.trim().is_empty() {
582	        return Err("z.ai base_url is empty".to_string());
583	    }
584	    if zai.api_key.trim().is_empty() {
585	        return Err("z.ai api_key is not set".to_string());
586	    }
587	
588	    let url = join_base_url(&zai.base_url, "/v1/models");
589	
590	    let mut builder =
591	        reqwest::Client::builder().timeout(Duration::from_secs(request_timeout.max(5)));
592	    if upstream_proxy.enabled && !upstream_proxy.url.is_empty() {
593	        let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&upstream_proxy.url)
594	            .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
595	        builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
596	    }
597	    let client = builder
598	        .build()
599	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))?;
600	
601	    let resp = client
602	        .get(&url)
603	        .header("Authorization", format!("Bearer {}", zai.api_key))
604	        .header("x-api-key", zai.api_key)
605	        .header("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
606	        .header("accept", "application/json")
607	        .send()
608	        .await
609	        .map_err(|e| format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e))?;
610	
611	    let status = resp.status();
612	    let text = resp
613	        .text()
614	        .await
615	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to read response: {}", e))?;
616	
617	    if !status.is_success() {
618	        let preview = if text.len() > 4000 {
619	            &text[..4000]
620	        } else {
621	            &text
622	        };
623	        return Err(format!("Upstream returned {}: {}", status, preview));
624	    }
625	
626	    let json: serde_json::Value =
627	        serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| format!("Invalid JSON response: {}", e))?;
628	    let mut models = extract_model_ids(&json);
629	    models.retain(|s| !s.trim().is_empty());
630	    models.sort();
631	    models.dedup();
632	    Ok(models)
633	}

702	            .map_err(|e| format!("保存配置失败: {}", e))?;
```

```text
862	/// Batch delete accounts (atomic index operation)
863	pub fn delete_accounts(account_ids: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
864	    let _lock = ACCOUNT_INDEX_LOCK
865	        .lock()
866	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_acquire_lock: {}", e))?;
867	    let mut index = load_account_index()?;
868	
869	    let accounts_dir = get_accounts_dir()?;
870	
871	    for account_id in account_ids {
872	        // Remove from index
873	        index.accounts.retain(|s| &s.id != account_id);
874	
875	        // Clear current account if it's being deleted
876	        if index.current_account_id.as_deref() == Some(account_id) {
877	            index.current_account_id = None;
878	        }
879	
880	        // Delete account file

889	
890	    // If current account is empty, use first one as default
891	    if index.current_account_id.is_none() {

893	    }
```

```text
23	
24	function includesAny(text: string, hints: string[]): boolean {
25	    return hints.some((hint) => text.includes(hint));
26	}
27	
28	export function getValidationBlockedStatusLabel(
29	    reason: string | undefined,
30	    t: TFunction,
31	): string {
32	    const normalizedReason = (reason || '').toLowerCase();
33	
34	    if (includesAny(normalizedReason, RATE_LIMIT_HINTS)) {
35	        return t('accounts.status.risk_controlled', { defaultValue: 'Risk / Rate Limited' });
36	    }
37	
38	    if (includesAny(normalizedReason, OAUTH_HINTS)) {
39	        return t('accounts.status.oauth_reauth_required', { defaultValue: 'OAuth Re-auth Required' });
40	    }
41	
42	    return t('accounts.status.validation_required', { defaultValue: 'Verification Required' });
43	}
```

### 2. Account Storage / Persistence

**No SQLite for accounts.** Accounts are stored as individual JSON files on disk:

- **Index file:** `~/.antigravity_tools/accounts.json` -- contains `AccountIndex { version, accounts: Vec<AccountSummary>, current_account_id }`
- **Account files:** `~/.antigravity_tools/accounts/{uuid}.json` -- full `Account` objects serialized to JSON

**Write safety:** All index writes use atomic replace (temp file + `atomic_replace_file` which is `MoveFileExW` on Windows, plain `fs::rename` on Unix). A global `Mutex<()>` lock (`ACCOUNT_INDEX_LOCK`) serializes all account index modifications.

**Recovery:** If `accounts.json` is missing, empty, corrupt, or has BOM/NUL prefixes, the system auto-recovers by scanning `accounts/*.json` files and rebuilding the index (`rebuild_index_from_accounts_in_dir`). Corrupt files are backed up as `accounts.json.corrupt-{timestamp}-{uuid}`.

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/modules/account.rs`, lines 328-519

### 3. TokenManager (`src/proxy/token_manager.rs`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/token_manager.rs`

The TokenManager is the in-memory token pool used by the proxy during request routing.

**Key structures:**

- **`ProxyToken`** (line 20): The runtime token representation. Contains `account_id`, `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `email`, `project_id`, `subscription_tier`, `remaining_quota`, `protected_models`, `health_score`, `reset_time`, `validation_blocked`, `model_quotas: HashMap<String, i32>`, `model_limits: HashMap<String, u64>`.

- **`TokenManager`** (line 41): Holds `tokens: DashMap<String, ProxyToken>`, `current_index: AtomicUsize`, `rate_limit_tracker`, `sticky_config`, `session_accounts`, `preferred_account_id` (fixed-account mode), `health_scores`, `circuit_breaker_config`.

**Key methods:**

| Method | Line | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `new(data_dir)` | 59 | Creates TokenManager with empty token pool |
| `load_accounts()` | 116 | Scans `data_dir/accounts/*.json`, calls `load_single_account()` for each, populates `tokens` DashMap |
| `load_single_account()` | 295 | Parses JSON, checks disabled/proxy_disabled/validation_blocked/quota_protection states, builds `ProxyToken` with `model_quotas` and `model_limits` |
| `reload_account()` | 164 | Reloads a single account from disk into the pool; if loading returns `None` (account disabled), calls `remove_account()` |
| `reload_all_accounts()` | 192 | Full reload of all accounts + clears rate limits |
| `remove_account()` | 200 | Removes from `tokens`, `health_scores`, `session_accounts`, clears preferred if matches |
| `get_token()` | 1064 | **The core routing entry point.** Handles pending reloads/deletes, then calls `get_token_internal()` with 5s timeout |
| `get_token_internal()` | 1110 | Sorts tokens by: (1) subscription tier ULTRA>PRO>FREE, (2) target model quota (higher first), (3) health score, (4) reset time. Then applies sticky session or P2C (Power of 2 Choices) selection |
| `get_token_by_id()` | 217 | Direct lookup by account_id |
| `get_token_by_email()` | 1818 | Lookup by email |

| `check_and_protect_quota()` | 546 | Called during `load_single_account`. Groups models by standard ID, triggers protection if any group min <= threshold |

**Account loading flow in proxy:** `load_accounts()` -> for each `.json` file -> `load_single_account()` -> checks `proxy_disabled`, `validation_blocked`, `disabled`, `get_account_state_on_disk()`, `check_and_protect_quota()` -> builds `ProxyToken` with `model_quotas` -> inserts into `tokens` DashMap.

### 9. Quota and Validation

**Quota module:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/modules/quota.rs`

- `fetch_quota()` (line 186) -- Calls 3 API endpoints in fallback order (Sandbox -> Daily -> Prod)
- `fetch_quota_with_cache()` (line 191) -- Skips `loadCodeAssist` if project_id cached
- 403 handling: Sets `QuotaData.is_forbidden = true`, returns immediately without retry
- `warm_up_all_accounts()` (line 421) -- Screens all accounts, filters those with 100% quota, sends warmup requests via proxy internal API
- `warm_up_account()` (line 576) -- Single account warmup
- `get_valid_token_for_warmup()` (line 342) -- Auto-refreshes token for warmup

**Quota models:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/models/quota.rs`

- `QuotaData` -- `models: Vec<ModelQuota>`, `is_forbidden`, `forbidden_reason`, `subscription_tier`, `model_forwarding_rules`
- `ModelQuota` -- `name`, `percentage`, `reset_time`, `display_name`, `supports_images`, `supports_thinking`, `thinking_budget`, `max_tokens`, `max_output_tokens`

**Quota protection flow:**
1. Config defines `threshold_percentage` and `monitored_models`
2. During `load_single_account()`, `check_and_protect_quota()` groups models by standard ID, finds min percentage per group
3. If min <= threshold, `trigger_quota_protection()` adds model to `protected_models` array in account JSON
4. `update_account_quota()` also runs protection check after each manual refresh
5. In `get_token_internal()`, accounts with `protected_models` containing the target model are filtered out (line 976: `!t.protected_models.contains(normalized_target)`)
6. When quota recovers above threshold, `restore_quota_protection()` removes from `protected_models`

---

### 10. Accounts in Proxy Request Flow

The `TokenManager.get_token()` method (line 1064) is the entry point for all proxy requests. The flow:

1. **Pending operations check:** Processes any pending `reload_account` or `delete_account` signals from the account management module
2. **Snapshot:** Takes a snapshot of all tokens from the `DashMap`
3. **Capability filter:** Filters to only accounts that have `model_quotas` containing the requested `target_model` (normalized to standard ID)
4. **Sorting:** Sorts candidates by (a) subscription tier ULTRA > PRO > FREE, (b) model-specific quota percentage (higher first), (c) health score, (d) reset time
5. **Preferred account check:** If fixed-account mode is enabled (FIX #820), tries preferred account first
6. **Sticky session:** If session_id provided, routes to the same account
7. **P2C selection:** From top 5 candidates, randomly picks 2, selects the one with higher remaining quota
8. **Rate limit check:** Verifies the selected account is not rate-limited
9. **Token auto-refresh:** If access token is expired, refreshes via OAuth
10. **Returns:** `(access_token, project_id, email, account_id, max_output_tokens)`

---

## 账号管理系统全链路依赖图

### 核心数据结构

```
Account (models/account.rs)
  ├── TokenData          ← OAuth 认证信息 (access_token, refresh_token, project_id)
  ├── QuotaData          ← 配额数据 (models, percentage, reset_time)
  ├── DeviceProfile      ← 设备指纹 (device_id, installation_id, fingerprint)
  └── 扩展字段: proxy_disabled, validation_blocked, protected_models, custom_label
```

### 1. 持久化层

```
~/.antigravity_tools/
├── accounts.json          ← 账号索引 (AccountIndex: summaries + current_account_id)
└── accounts/
    ├── {uuid1}.json       ← 完整账号数据 (含 refresh_token, device_profiles 等)
    ├── {uuid2}.json
    └── ...
```

- 所有写入使用原子替换（临时文件 + rename）
- 全局 `Mutex<()>` 串行化所有索引修改
- 索引损坏时自动从单个账号文件重建

### 2. 模块间依赖关系

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    账号管理系统依赖全景图                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                 │
│  modules/account.rs (核心枢纽)                                   │
│    ├── 读/写: ~/.antigravity_tools/accounts/                    │
│    ├── 依赖: modules/oauth (token 刷新)                          │
│    ├── 依赖: modules/config (配置加载)                           │
│    ├── 依赖: modules/device (设备指纹)                           │

│    └── 信号 → proxy::server (trigger_account_reload/delete)     │
│                                                                 │
│  modules/account_service.rs (服务封装层)                         │
│    ├── 封装 account 模块 + oauth + integration                  │
│    ├── 集成 SystemManager (Desktop vs Headless)                 │
│    └── 被 commands/mod.rs 调用                                  │
│                                                                 │
│  proxy/token_manager.rs (内存 Token 池)                         │
│    ├── 启动时: 扫描 accounts/*.json → 构建 DashMap              │
│    ├── 运行时: 监听 reload/delete 信号 → 热更新                  │
│    ├── 请求路由: get_token() → 多账户选择算法                    │
│    └── 包含: RateLimitTracker, StickySession, 配额保护           │
│                                                                 │
│  commands/mod.rs (30+ Tauri 命令)                               │
│    ├── CRUD: list_accounts, add_account, delete_account         │
│    ├── OAuth: start_oauth_login, complete_oauth_login            │
│    ├── 配额: fetch_account_quota, refresh_all_quotas             │
│    ├── 预热: warm_up_all_accounts, warm_up_account              │
│    ├── 代理: toggle_proxy_status                                │
│    ├── 排序: reorder_accounts, switch_account                   │
│    ├── 导入: import_v1_accounts, import_from_db, sync_account    │
│    ├── 设备: get_device_profiles, bind_device_profile            │
│    └── 其他: update_account_label, export_accounts              │
│                                                                 │
│  前端 (React + Zustand)                                         │
│    ├── stores/useAccountStore.ts   ← 状态管理                   │
│    ├── services/accountService.ts  ← Tauri invoke 封装          │
│    ├── pages/Accounts.tsx          ← 主页面                      │
│    ├── components/accounts/        ← 8 个组件                    │
│    └── 事件监听: accounts://refreshed, tray://account-switched  │
│                                                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 3. 关键交叉引用

| 模块 | 依赖账号系统的方式 | 文件/行号 |
|------|-------------------|-----------|
| **TokenManager** | 启动时加载 accounts/*.json 构建内存池 | `proxy/token_manager.rs:116` |
| **Proxy 请求路由** | `get_token()` 按配额/健康度/订阅等级排序选账户 | `proxy/token_manager.rs:1064` |
| **配额保护** | `check_and_protect_quota()` 标记 protected_models | `proxy/token_manager.rs:546` |
| **重试轮换** | `force_rotate=true` 选下一个最佳账户 | `proxy/token_manager.rs:1110` |
| **粘性会话** | session_id → 固定账户路由 | `proxy/token_manager.rs` + `sticky_config` |
| **系统托盘** | 托盘切换账号 → 触发 `switch_account()` | `modules/tray.rs` |
| **Scheduler** | 定时 warmup 刷新账户 token | `modules/scheduler.rs` (已禁用) |
| **AccountService** | 封装 CRUD + tray 更新 | `modules/account_service.rs` |
| **前端事件** | `accounts://refreshed` 触发全量刷新 | `App.tsx:112` |

### 4. 账号在 Proxy 请求中的流转

```
请求到达
  └─ TokenManager::get_token(target_model, force_rotate, session_id)
       │
       ├─ ① 检查 pending_reload / pending_delete 信号 (热更新)
       │
       ├─ ② 快照所有 ProxyToken (DashMap → Vec)
       │
       ├─ ③ 能力过滤: 过滤有 target_model 配额的账户
       │
       ├─ ④ 排序: 订阅等级 > 剩余配额 > 健康分 > 重置时间
       │
       ├─ ⑤ 固定账户模式: 优先使用 preferred_account_id
       │
       ├─ ⑥ 粘性会话: session_id → 固定账户
       │
       ├─ ⑦ P2C 选择: 从 top5 随机选2，取配额高的
       │
       ├─ ⑧ 限速检查: 排除 RateLimitTracker 锁定的账户
       │
       ├─ ⑨ Token 刷新: OAuth 过期自动刷新
       │
       └─ 返回: (access_token, project_id, email, account_id, wait_ms)
```

### 5. 信号机制 (In-Process)

```
账号管理操作 (delete/update_account)
  │
  ├─ trigger_account_delete(account_id)    → 写入 PENDING_DELETE_ACCOUNTS
  │
  └─ trigger_account_reload(account_id)    → 写入 PENDING_RELOAD_ACCOUNTS
       │
       ▼
  下次 TokenManager::get_token() 调用时
  ├─ take_pending_reload_accounts()  → 从磁盘重新加载指定账户
  └─ take_pending_delete_accounts()  → 从内存池移除指定账户
```

### 6. 前端组件树

```
Accounts.tsx (页面)
  ├── AccountGrid.tsx / AccountTable.tsx (视图容器)
  │     ├── AccountCard.tsx (卡片视图)
  │     └── AccountRow.tsx (列表视图)
  ├── AccountDetailsDialog.tsx (详情弹窗)
  ├── AddAccountDialog.tsx (添加弹窗)
  ├── DeviceFingerprintDialog.tsx (设备指纹)
  ├── QuotaItem.tsx (配额展示)
  └── accountValidationStatus.ts (状态标签)
```

### 总结

账号系统与以下 **9 个模块** 存在直接依赖：

1. `modules/oauth` — Token 刷新和 OAuth 流程
2. `modules/config` — 配置加载和持久化
3. `modules/device` — 设备指纹管理
4. `modules/quota` — 配额查询和预热
5. `proxy/token_manager.rs` — 内存 Token 池和请求路由
6. `proxy/server.rs` — reload/delete 信号通道
7. `commands/mod.rs` — 30+ Tauri 命令暴露
8. `modules/tray.rs` — 系统托盘集成
9. `frontend` — Zustand store + 8 个组件 + 事件监听

## 8045 服务支持的协议

### AI 代理协议 (Proxy Routes)

| 协议 | 端点 | Handler | 说明 |
|------|------|---------|------|
| **OpenAI** | `POST /v1/chat/completions` | `handlers::openai::handle_chat_completions` | 对话补全 |
| | `POST /v1/completions` | `handlers::openai::handle_completions` | 文本补全 |
| | `POST /v1/responses` | `handlers::openai::handle_completions` | Responses API (Codex CLI 兼容) |
| | `POST /v1/images/generations` | `handlers::openai::handle_images_generations` | 图像生成 |
| | `POST /v1/images/edits` | `handlers::openai::handle_images_edits` | 图像编辑 |
| | `GET /v1/models` | `handlers::openai::handle_list_models` | 模型列表 |
| **Anthropic (Claude)** | `POST /v1/messages` | `handlers::claude::handle_messages` | 消息补全 |
| | `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens` | `handlers::claude::handle_count_tokens` | Token 计数 |
| | `GET /v1/models/claude` | `handlers::claude::handle_list_models` | Claude 模型列表 |
| **Gemini** | `GET/POST /v1beta/models/:model` | `handlers::gemini::handle_generate` | 内容生成 |
| | `POST /v1beta/models/:model/countTokens` | `handlers::gemini::handle_count_tokens` | Token 计数 |
| | `GET /v1beta/models` | `handlers::gemini::handle_list_models` | 模型列表 |
| **音频** | `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` | `handlers::audio::handle_audio_transcription` | 语音转文字 |
| **MCP** | `/mcp/web_search_prime/mcp` | `handlers::mcp::handle_*` | Web Search MCP |
| | `/mcp/web_reader/mcp` | `handlers::mcp::handle_web_reader` | Web Reader MCP |
| | `/mcp/zai-mcp-server/mcp` | `handlers::mcp::handle_*` | z.ai MCP Server |
| **内部** | `POST /internal/warmup` | `handlers::warmup::handle_warmup` | 账号预热 |

### 协议转换映射

```
客户端请求格式              上游转换                 响应返回格式
─────────────────    ──────────────────    ──────────────────
OpenAI Chat API     →  Gemini v1internal   →  OpenAI SSE/JSON
OpenAI Images API   →  Gemini v1internal   →  OpenAI JSON
OpenAI Audio API    →  Gemini v1internal   →  OpenAI JSON
Claude Messages API →  Gemini v1internal   →  Claude SSE/JSON
Claude Messages API →  z.ai (Anthropic)    →  Claude SSE/JSON  (当 Provider 为 AnthropicPassthrough)
Gemini API          →  Gemini v1internal   →  Gemini JSON
```

### 管理 API (Admin Routes)

| 分类 | 主要端点 |
|------|----------|
| **账号管理** | `/accounts/*` — CRUD、排序、切换、刷新配额、预热、导入/导出 |
| **配置管理** | `/config` — 获取/保存配置 |
| **统计** | `/stats/*` — Token 统计 (按小时/天/周/账号/模型) |
| **代理** | `/proxy/*` — 状态、代理池、模型映射、启动/停止 |
| **安全** | `/security/*` — 黑白名单、IP 日志、封禁管理 |
| **用户 Token** | `/user-tokens/*` — 创建/删除/续期 |
| **OAuth** | `/accounts/oauth/*` — OAuth 登录流程 |
| **z.ai** | `/zai/models/fetch` — 获取 z.ai 模型 |
| **Cloudflared** | `/proxy/cloudflared/*` — 隧道管理 |
| **系统** | `/system/*` — 更新、自启、缓存清理 |
| **健康检查** | `/health`, `/healthz` — 服务状态 |
| **日志** | `/logs/*` — 请求日志 |
| **Debug** | `/debug/*` — Debug Console |

Key points to explain:

2. It's tightly coupled with Google OAuth accounts (TokenManager)
3. The upstream format is Google's proprietary v1internal API, not OpenAI
4. Client-side uses OpenAI/Claude formats, but these are TRANSFORMED to Gemini v1internal format before sending upstream

_**Agent (qwen3.6-plus 2026-04-10 02:57:58Z)**_

不是。`Gemini v1internal` 是 **Google Cloud Code 的私有 API**，不是 OpenAI 兼容格式。

### 上游请求的真实格式

```
客户端发来的 (OpenAI 格式):                    实际发到上游的 (Gemini v1internal 格式):
───────────────────────────                    ──────────────────────────────────────
POST /v1/chat/completions                       POST https://.../v1internal:generateContent
Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx                    Authorization: Bearer {OAuth access_token}

{                                               {
  "model": "gpt-4o",                              "model": "google/gemini-2.5-pro@thinking@automatic"
  "messages": [                                   "contents": [
    {"role": "user", "content": "你好"}               {"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": "你好"}]}
  ],                                              ],
  "stream": true                                  "systemInstruction": {"parts": [...]},
}                                                 "safetySettings": [...],
                                                  "generationConfig": {...},
                                                  "tools": {"functionDeclarations": [...]},
                                                  "requestMetadata": {"project_id": "..."}
                                                }
```

### 与账户系统的关系

```
账户系统 (accounts/*.json)
  │
  ├─ refresh_token ──→ OAuth 刷新 ──→ access_token  ←── 这就是上游请求的 Bearer Token
  ├─ project_id      ──────────────────────────────→ 注入到 requestMetadata 中
  │
  └─ 多账户轮换: 每个账户有自己独立的 OAuth token 和 project_id
       └─ TokenManager::get_token() 选出最佳账户
            └─ 用该账户的 access_token + project_id 构建 v1internal 请求
```

所以 **是的，Gemini v1internal 就是跟账户直接绑定的**：
- 每个 Google 账户通过 OAuth 获得 `access_token`（鉴权凭证）和 `project_id`（项目标识）
- 每次请求都带上对应账户的这两个参数去调 Google 上游
- TokenManager 的核心作用就是在多个账户之间轮换这些 OAuth 凭证

### 三种上游路径对比

| 路径 | 上游协议 | 认证方式 | 账户关联 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|
| **Gemini v1internal** | Google 私有 API | OAuth `access_token` | 多账户轮换 |
| **z.ai (AnthropicPassthrough)** | Anthropic 兼容 API | `x-api-key` / `Bearer API_KEY` | 单 Key |
| **OpenAICompatible (新增)** | OpenAI 兼容 API | `Bearer API_KEY` | 单 Key |

_**Agent (qwen3.6-plus 2026-04-10 03:43:15Z)**_

你的理解基本正确，但有一个**关键区别**——不是完全透传，中间有预处理。完整流程是：

```
客户端发来 Claude Messages API 请求
  POST /v1/messages  (Claude 格式)
       │
       ▼
  ① 解析为 ClaudeRequest 结构体
       │
       ▼
  ② 预处理 (不是完全透传！)
       ├─ clean_cache_control_from_messages()  ← 清理 cache_control 字段
       ├─ merge_consecutive_messages()         ← 合并连续同角色消息
       ├─ filter_invalid_thinking_blocks()     ← 过滤无效 thinking 块签名
       ├─ close_tool_loop_for_thinking()       ← 修复断开的 tool loop
       └─ apply_thinking_hints()               ← 注入 thinking 预算提示
       │
       ▼
  ③ 模型映射
       ├─ map_model_for_provider()             ← "claude-sonnet-4" → "glm-4.7"
       └─ 替换 body["model"] 字段
       │
       ▼
  ④ 转发到上游 (这才是透传部分)
       POST {base_url}/v1/messages             ← Claude 格式
       x-api-key: {api_key}
       请求体: 修复后的 Claude 格式 JSON
       │
       ▼
  ⑤ 上游响应流式转发
       上游返回 Claude SSE/JSON
         ──直接透传──▶ 客户端
```

所以更准确的说法是：**请求体结构保持 Claude 格式，但在转发前经过了修复和模型映射**。与 Gemini v1internal 路径的"完全协议转换"不同，这条路径不做 OpenAI↔Claude↔Gemini 的格式互转。

```text
## Complete Protocol Mapping Infrastructure Analysis

### 1. Protocol Formats

There are **three client-facing protocols** and **one internal wire format**:

| Protocol | Handler File | Key Characteristics |
|---|---|---|
| **OpenAI** (Chat Completions) | `handlers/openai.rs` | `messages[]`, `stream`, `tools[]`, `thinking` |
| **Claude** (Messages API) | `handlers/claude.rs` | `messages[]`, `system`, `tools[]`, `thinking`, `stream` |
| **Gemini Native** (v1beta) | `handlers/gemini.rs` | `contents[]`, `generationConfig`, `tools[]` |
| **Gemini v1internal** (upstream) | All mappers converge here | `{project, requestId, request, model, userAgent, requestType}` envelope |

### 2. All Mapper Modules and Their Public Functions

#### OpenAI Mapper (`proxy/mappers/openai/`)

| File | Public Functions | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `request.rs` | `transform_openai_request()` | OpenAI request -> Gemini v1internal JSON `Value` |
| `request.rs` (line 1204) | `to_claude_body()` | OpenAI request -> Claude-format JSON `Value` |
| `response.rs` | `transform_openai_response()` | Gemini JSON -> `OpenAIResponse` struct |
| `streaming.rs` | `create_openai_sse_stream()` | Gemini SSE -> OpenAI SSE stream |
| `streaming.rs` | `create_legacy_sse_stream()` | Gemini SSE -> OpenAI legacy text SSE |
| `streaming.rs` | `create_codex_sse_stream()` | Gemini SSE -> Codex Responses API SSE |
| `streaming.rs` | `store_thought_signature()` | Cache thoughtSignature to session |
| `collector.rs` | `collect_stream_to_json()` | Gemini SSE -> aggregated `OpenAIResponse` |
| `models.rs` | (types only) | `OpenAIRequest`, `OpenAIResponse`, `OpenAIMessage`, etc. |
| `thinking_recovery.rs` | `strip_all_thinking_blocks()` | Removes thinking parts from Gemini contents |

#### Claude Mapper (`proxy/mappers/claude/`)

| File | Public Functions | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `request.rs` | `transform_claude_request_in()` | Claude request -> Gemini v1internal JSON `Value` |
| `request.rs` | `clean_cache_control_from_messages()` | Strip cache_control from message blocks |
| `request.rs` | `merge_consecutive_messages()` | Merge same-role consecutive messages |
| `response.rs` | `transform_response()` | GeminiResponse -> `ClaudeResponse` via `NonStreamingProcessor` |
| `mod.rs` (line 25) | `create_claude_sse_stream()` | Gemini SSE -> Claude SSE stream |
| `mod.rs` | `emit_force_stop()` | Ensure message_stop SSE event |
| `collector.rs` | `collect_stream_to_json()` | Claude SSE -> aggregated `ClaudeResponse` JSON |
| `streaming.rs` | `PartProcessor::process()` | Process individual GeminiPart -> Claude SSE events |

#### Gemini Mapper (`proxy/mappers/gemini/`)

| File | Public Functions | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `wrapper.rs` | `wrap_request()` | Gemini native body -> Gemini v1internal envelope |
| `wrapper.rs` (line 568) | `unwrap_response()` | Extract `response` field from v1internal envelope |
| `wrapper.rs` (line 576) | `inject_ids_to_response()` | Inject tool IDs into response for Claude models |
| `collector.rs` | `collect_stream_to_json()` | Gemini SSE -> aggregated Gemini response JSON |

### 3. Model Mapping: `resolve_model_route()` (lines 253-299)

Resolution priority:
1. **Dynamic forwarding rules** (`DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES`) -- hot API updates, highest priority
2. **Exact match** in user `custom_mapping` HashMap
3. **Wildcard match** in `custom_mapping` -- most specific pattern wins (character count minus wildcards)
4. **System default** via `map_claude_model_to_gemini()` -- static `CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI` table

The `CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI` table (~80 entries) maps:
- All Claude family (Opus 4.x, Sonnet 4.x, Haiku) -> `claude-sonnet-4-6` or `claude-opus-4-6-thinking`
- All OpenAI family (gpt-4*, gpt-4o*, gpt-3.5*) -> `gemini-2.5-flash`
- Gemini aliases (`gemini-3-pro` -> `gemini-3-pro-preview`)
- Unknown models -> passthrough as-is

### 4. Handler Protocol Flows

#### OpenAI Handler Flow
```
Client: OpenAI Chat Completions JSON

  |    - OpenAICompatible -> forward_openai_compatible() -> stream back unchanged

  +--> transform_openai_request() -> Gemini v1internal JSON
  +--> upstream.call_v1_internal() -> SSE or JSON
  +--> If stream:  create_openai_sse_stream() -> OpenAI SSE to client
  +--> If no stream: transform_openai_response() OR collect_stream_to_json() -> JSON to client
```
**Auto-conversion**: Non-streaming client requests are internally forced to streaming (for quota), then collected back.

#### Claude Handler Flow
```
Client: Claude Messages API JSON
  |
  +--> Provider check (lines 312-446):
  |    - AnthropicPassthrough -> forward_anthropic_with_provider() -> stream back unchanged
  |    - Legacy z.ai -> forward_anthropic_json() -> stream back unchanged
  |    - No provider match -> continue below (Google path)
  |
  +--> transform_claude_request_in() -> Gemini v1internal JSON
  +--> upstream.call_v1_internal() -> SSE or JSON
  +--> If stream:  create_claude_sse_stream() -> Claude SSE to client
  +--> If no stream: transform_response() -> ClaudeResponse JSON to client
```

#### Gemini Handler Flow
```
Client: Gemini native JSON
  |
  +--> wrap_request() -> Gemini v1internal JSON
  +--> upstream.call_v1_internal() -> SSE or JSON
  +--> unwrap_response() -> strips v1internal envelope -> raw Gemini JSON to client
```

### 5. ProviderRouter (`proxy/providers/router.rs`)

- **`select(model, prev_failed)`** returns the next `UpstreamProvider` via: exclusive (by priority) -> round-robin pooled -> fallback
- **`map_model(provider, incoming)`** resolves to provider-native model ID via: exact match -> prefix match -> strip `zai:` -> Claude family defaults -> passthrough
- Each provider declares a `protocol`: `AnthropicPassthrough`, `OpenAICompatible`, or `GeminiV1Internal`

### 6. `forward_openai_compatible` (lines 2490-2567)

A raw HTTP passthrough for OpenAI-compatible upstream providers:
- Serializes `OpenAIRequest` to JSON, POSTs to `{base_url}/v1/chat/completions`
- Sets Bearer auth, forwards minimal headers
- Streams upstream response directly back to client with **zero conversion**

### 7. `forward_anthropic_with_provider` (lines 235-325 of `zai_anthropic.rs`)

Generic Anthropic-compatible HTTP passthrough:
- Applies model mapping, cleans `cache_control`, sets auth
- POSTs to provider base URL + `/v1/messages`
- Streams response back unchanged

### 8. Model Specs (`proxy/model_specs.rs`)

- `ModelSpec {max_output_tokens, thinking_budget, is_thinking}` from `resources/model_specs.json`
- `get_max_output_tokens()` -- dynamic account limits > static JSON > default 65535
- `get_thinking_budget()` -- static JSON > default 24576
- `is_thinking_model()` -- spec lookup or name contains "-thinking"/"thinking"

---

## Conversion Matrix: What Exists and What Is Missing

### Existing Converters

| From | To | Request Function | Response Function | Streaming Function |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OpenAI | v1internal | `transform_openai_request()` | N/A | N/A |
| v1internal | OpenAI | N/A | `transform_openai_response()` | `create_openai_sse_stream()` |
| OpenAI | Claude (JSON) | `to_claude_body()` | N/A | N/A |
| Claude | v1internal | `transform_claude_request_in()` | N/A | N/A |
| v1internal | Claude | N/A | `transform_response()` | `create_claude_sse_stream()` |
| Gemini native | v1internal | `wrap_request()` | N/A | N/A |
| v1internal | Gemini native | N/A | `unwrap_response()` | direct passthrough |
| OpenAI SSE | OpenAI JSON | N/A | N/A | `collector::collect_stream_to_json()` |
| Claude SSE | Claude JSON | N/A | N/A | `claude::collect_stream_to_json()` |
| Gemini SSE | Gemini JSON | N/A | N/A | `gemini::collector::collect_stream_to_json()` |

### Missing Conversions

The architecture currently **enforces input=output protocol**. Each handler is locked to a specific client protocol. To support a full matrix (any input -> any output), you would need:

**For cross-protocol response conversion (not going through v1internal):**
1. **v1internal -> OpenAI SSE** -- exists (`create_openai_sse_stream`)
2. **v1internal -> Claude SSE** -- exists (`create_claude_sse_stream`)
3. **v1internal -> Gemini native SSE** -- missing (would need a simple passthrough-with-unwrapper)
4. **OpenAI -> Claude request** -- exists (`to_claude_body`) but limited (no tool_calls, no multimodal in detail)
5. **Claude -> OpenAI request** -- missing entirely. Would need a `to_openai_body()` that converts Claude request format to OpenAI Chat Completions
6. **Gemini native -> OpenAI response** -- missing (would compose wrap + transform_openai_response)
7. **Gemini native -> Claude response** -- missing (would compose wrap + transform_response)

**For a true "any input -> any output" matrix**, the missing pieces are:
- **Claude -> OpenAI request converter**: `transform_claude_request_to_openai()` (ClaudeRequest -> OpenAI Chat Completions JSON)
- **OpenAI -> Claude response converter**: A version of `transform_openai_response` outputting `ClaudeResponse` format
- **Claude -> OpenAI response converter**: `ClaudeResponse` struct -> `OpenAIResponse` struct
- **Gemini native -> OpenAI/Claude**: These could be composed by chaining existing functions (wrap -> transform_response), but no dedicated handler routes currently do this

### Reusable Components

Nearly all existing conversion functions are self-contained and reusable:
- All request converters output `serde_json::Value`
- All response converters take structured input (either `Value` or typed structs)
- All streaming converters are generic over the input stream type
- The signature caching, schema cleaning, tool remapping, and thinking recovery logic are all in shared utilities
```

```text
1	// OpenAI 协议响应转换模块
2	use super::models::*;
3	use serde_json::Value;
4	
5	pub fn transform_openai_response(gemini_response: &Value, session_id: Option<&str>, message_count: usize) -> OpenAIResponse {
6	    // 解包 response 字段
7	    let raw = gemini_response.get("response").unwrap_or(gemini_response);
8	
9	    let mut choices = Vec::new();
10	
11	    // 支持多候选结果 (n > 1)
12	    if let Some(candidates) = raw.get("candidates").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {
13	        for (idx, candidate) in candidates.iter().enumerate() {
14	            let mut content_out = String::new();
15	            let mut thought_out = String::new();
16	            let mut tool_calls = Vec::new();
17	
18	            // 提取 content 和 tool_calls
19	            if let Some(parts) = candidate
20	                .get("content")
21	                .and_then(|c| c.get("parts"))
22	                .and_then(|p| p.as_array())
23	            {
24	                for part in parts {
25	                    // 捕获 thoughtSignature (Gemini 3 工具调用必需)
26	                    if let Some(sig) = part
27	                        .get("thoughtSignature")
28	                        .or(part.get("thought_signature"))
29	                        .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
30	                    {
31	                        if let Some(sid) = session_id {
32	                            super::streaming::store_thought_signature(sig, sid, message_count);
33	                        }
34	                    }
35	
36	                    // 检查该 part 是否是思考内容 (thought: true)
37	                    let is_thought_part = part
38	                        .get("thought")
39	                        .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
40	                        .unwrap_or(false);
41	
42	                    // 文本部分
43	                    if let Some(text) = part.get("text").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
44	                        if is_thought_part {
45	                            // thought: true 时，text 是思考内容
46	                            thought_out.push_str(text);
47	                        } else {
48	                            // 正常内容
49	                            content_out.push_str(text);
50	                        }
51	                    }
52	
53	                    // 工具调用部分
54	                    if let Some(fc) = part.get("functionCall") {
55	                        let name = fc.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("unknown");
56	                        let args = fc
57	                            .get("args")
58	                            .map(|v| v.to_string())
59	                            .unwrap_or_else(|| "{}".to_string());
60	                        let id = fc
61	                            .get("id")
62	                            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
63	                            .map(|s| s.to_string())
64	                            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{}-{}", name, uuid::Uuid::new_v4()));
65	
66	                        tool_calls.push(ToolCall {
67	                            id,
68	                            r#type: "function".to_string(),
69	                            function: ToolFunction {
70	                                name: name.to_string(),
71	                                arguments: args,
72	                            },
73	                        });
74	                    }
75	
76	                    // 图片处理 (响应中直接返回图片的情况)
77	                    if let Some(img) = part.get("inlineData") {
78	                        let mime_type = img
79	                            .get("mimeType")
80	                            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
81	                            .unwrap_or("image/png");
82	                        let data = img.get("data").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
83	                        if !data.is_empty() {
84	                            content_out
85	                                .push_str(&format!("![image](data:{};base64,{})", mime_type, data));
86	                        }
87	                    }
88	                }
89	            }
90	
91	            // 提取并处理该候选结果的联网搜索引文 (Grounding Metadata)
92	            if let Some(grounding) = candidate.get("groundingMetadata") {
93	                let mut grounding_text = String::new();
94	
95	                // 1. 处理搜索词
96	                if let Some(queries) = grounding.get("webSearchQueries").and_then(|q| q.as_array())
97	                {
98	                    let query_list: Vec<&str> = queries.iter().filter_map(|v| v.as_str()).collect();
99	                    if !query_list.is_empty() {
100	                        grounding_text.push_str("\n\n---\n**🔍 已为您搜索：** ");
101	                        grounding_text.push_str(&query_list.join(", "));
102	                    }
103	                }
104	
105	                // 2. 处理来源链接 (Chunks)
106	                if let Some(chunks) = grounding.get("groundingChunks").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {
107	                    let mut links = Vec::new();
108	                    for (i, chunk) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
109	                        if let Some(web) = chunk.get("web") {
110	                            let title = web
111	                                .get("title")
112	                                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
113	                                .unwrap_or("网页来源");
114	                            let uri = web.get("uri").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("#");
115	                            links.push(format!("[{}] [{}]({})", i + 1, title, uri));
116	                        }
117	                    }
118	
119	                    if !links.is_empty() {
120	                        grounding_text.push_str("\n\n**🌐 来源引文：**\n");
121	                        grounding_text.push_str(&links.join("\n"));
122	                    }
123	                }
124	
125	                if !grounding_text.is_empty() {
126	                    content_out.push_str(&grounding_text);
127	                }
128	            }
129	
130	            // 提取该候选结果的 finish_reason
131	            let finish_reason = candidate
132	                .get("finishReason")
133	                .and_then(|f| f.as_str())
134	                .map(|f| match f {
135	                    "STOP" => "stop",
136	                    "MAX_TOKENS" => "length",
137	                    "SAFETY" => "content_filter",
138	                    "RECITATION" => "content_filter",
139	                    _ => "stop",
140	                })
141	                .unwrap_or("stop");
142	
143	            choices.push(Choice {
144	                index: idx as u32,
145	                message: OpenAIMessage {
146	                    role: "assistant".to_string(),
147	                    content: if content_out.is_empty() {
148	                        None
149	                    } else {
150	                        Some(OpenAIContent::String(content_out))
151	                    },
152	                    reasoning_content: if thought_out.is_empty() {
153	                        None
154	                    } else {
155	                        Some(thought_out)
156	                    },
157	                    tool_calls: if tool_calls.is_empty() {
158	                        None
159	                    } else {
160	                        Some(tool_calls)
161	                    },
162	                    tool_call_id: None,
163	                    name: None,
164	                },
165	                finish_reason: Some(finish_reason.to_string()),
166	            });
167	        }
168	    }
169	
170	    // Extract and map usage metadata from Gemini to OpenAI format
171	    let usage = raw.get("usageMetadata").and_then(|u| {
172	        let prompt_tokens = u
173	            .get("promptTokenCount")
174	            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
175	            .unwrap_or(0) as u32;
176	        let completion_tokens = u
177	            .get("candidatesTokenCount")
178	            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
179	            .unwrap_or(0) as u32;
180	        let total_tokens = u
181	            .get("totalTokenCount")
182	            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
183	            .unwrap_or(0) as u32;
184	        let cached_tokens = u
185	            .get("cachedContentTokenCount")
186	            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
187	            .map(|v| v as u32);
188	
189	        Some(super::models::OpenAIUsage {
190	            prompt_tokens,
191	            completion_tokens,
192	            total_tokens,
193	            prompt_tokens_details: cached_tokens.map(|ct| super::models::PromptTokensDetails {
194	                cached_tokens: Some(ct),
195	            }),
196	            completion_tokens_details: None,
197	        })
198	    });
199	
200	    OpenAIResponse {
201	        id: raw
202	            .get("responseId")
203	            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
204	            .unwrap_or("resp_unknown")
205	            .to_string(),
206	        object: "chat.completion".to_string(),
207	        created: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() as u64,
208	        model: raw
209	            .get("modelVersion")
210	            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
211	            .unwrap_or("unknown")
212	            .to_string(),
213	        choices,
214	        usage,
215	    }
216	}
```

```text
1	// OpenAI Stream Collector
2	// Used for auto-converting streaming responses to JSON for non-streaming requests
3	
4	use super::models::*;
5	use bytes::Bytes;
6	use futures::StreamExt;
7	use serde_json::Value;
8	use std::collections::HashMap;
9	
10	/// Collects an OpenAI SSE stream into a complete OpenAIResponse
11	pub async fn collect_stream_to_json<S, E>(
12	    mut stream: S,
13	) -> Result<OpenAIResponse, String>
14	where
15	    S: futures::Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, E>> + Unpin,
16	    E: std::fmt::Display,
17	{
18	    let mut response = OpenAIResponse {
19	        id: "chatcmpl-unknown".to_string(),
20	        object: "chat.completion".to_string(),
21	        created: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() as u64,
22	        model: "unknown".to_string(),
23	        choices: Vec::new(),
24	        usage: None,
25	    };
26	
27	    let mut role: Option<String> = None;
28	    let mut content_parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
29	    let mut reasoning_parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
30	    let mut finish_reason: Option<String> = None;
31	    // Tool calls aggregation: index -> (id, type, name, arguments_parts)
32	    let mut tool_calls_map: HashMap<u32, (String, String, String, Vec<String>)> = HashMap::new();
33	
34	    while let Some(chunk_result) = stream.next().await {
35	        let chunk = chunk_result.map_err(|e| format!("Stream error: {}", e))?;
36	        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&chunk);
37	
38	        for line in text.lines() {
39	            let line = line.trim();
40	            if line.starts_with("data: ") {
41	                let data_str = line.trim_start_matches("data: ").trim();
42	                if data_str == "[DONE]" {
43	                    continue;
44	                }
45	
46	                if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(data_str) {
47	                    // Update meta fields
48	                    if let Some(id) = json.get("id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
49	                        response.id = id.to_string();
50	                    }
51	                    if let Some(model) = json.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
52	                        response.model = model.to_string();
53	                    }
54	                    if let Some(created) = json.get("created").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()) {
55	                        response.created = created;
56	                    }
57	
58	                    // Collect Usage
59	                    if let Some(usage) = json.get("usage") {
60	                        if let Ok(u) = serde_json::from_value::<OpenAIUsage>(usage.clone()) {
61	                            response.usage = Some(u);
62	                        }
63	                    }
64	
65	                    // Collect Choices Delta
66	                    if let Some(choices) = json.get("choices").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
67	                        if let Some(choice) = choices.first() {
68	                            if let Some(delta) = choice.get("delta") {
69	                                // Role
70	                                if let Some(r) = delta.get("role").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
71	                                    role = Some(r.to_string());
72	                                }
73	                                
74	                                // Content
75	                                if let Some(c) = delta.get("content").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
76	                                    content_parts.push(c.to_string());
77	                                }
78	
79	                                // Reasoning Content
80	                                if let Some(rc) = delta.get("reasoning_content").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
81	                                    reasoning_parts.push(rc.to_string());
82	                                }
83	
84	                                // Tool Calls aggregation by index
85	                                // [FIX] When multiple tool calls arrive with the same index but
86	                                // different IDs, treat them as SEPARATE tool calls instead of
87	                                // merging into one (which would concatenate their arguments).
88	                                if let Some(tcs) = delta.get("tool_calls").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
89	                                    for tc in tcs {
90	                                        let raw_index = tc.get("index").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0) as u32;
91	                                        let new_id = tc.get("id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
92	
93	                                        // If this index already has a DIFFERENT id, it's a new tool call
94	                                        // Assign it a unique index to avoid merging
95	                                        let index = if !new_id.is_empty() {
96	                                            if let Some(existing) = tool_calls_map.get(&raw_index) {
97	                                                if !existing.0.is_empty() && existing.0 != new_id {
98	                                                    // Find next available index
99	                                                    let mut next_idx = raw_index + 1;
100	                                                    while tool_calls_map.contains_key(&next_idx) {
101	                                                        next_idx += 1;
102	                                                    }
103	                                                    next_idx
104	                                                } else {
105	                                                    raw_index
106	                                                }
107	                                            } else {
108	                                                raw_index
109	                                            }
110	                                        } else {
111	                                            raw_index
112	                                        };
113	                                        
114	                                        let entry = tool_calls_map.entry(index).or_insert_with(|| {
115	                                            (String::new(), String::from("function"), String::new(), Vec::new())
116	                                        });
117	                                        
118	                                        if let Some(id) = tc.get("id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
119	                                            if !id.is_empty() {
120	                                                entry.0 = id.to_string();
121	                                            }
122	                                        }
123	                                        
124	                                        if let Some(tc_type) = tc.get("type").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
125	                                            if !tc_type.is_empty() {
126	                                                entry.1 = tc_type.to_string();
127	                                            }
128	                                        }
129	                                        
130	                                        if let Some(func) = tc.get("function") {
131	                                            if let Some(name) = func.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
132	                                                if !name.is_empty() {
133	                                                    entry.2 = name.to_string();
134	                                                }
135	                                            }
136	                                            if let Some(args) = func.get("arguments").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
137	                                                entry.3.push(args.to_string());
138	                                            }
139	                                        }
140	                                    }
141	                                }
142	                            }
143	
144	                            if let Some(fr) = choice.get("finish_reason").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
145	                                finish_reason = Some(fr.to_string());
146	                            }
147	                        }
148	                    }
149	                }
150	            }
151	        }
152	    }
153	
154	    // Construct final message
155	    let full_content = content_parts.join("");
156	    let full_reasoning = if reasoning_parts.is_empty() {
157	        None
158	    } else {
159	        Some(reasoning_parts.join(""))
160	    };
161	
162	    // Build aggregated tool_calls
163	    let final_tool_calls: Option<Vec<ToolCall>> = if tool_calls_map.is_empty() {
164	        None
165	    } else {
166	        let mut calls: Vec<(u32, ToolCall)> = tool_calls_map
167	            .into_iter()
168	            .map(|(index, (id, tc_type, name, args_parts))| {
169	                (index, ToolCall {
170	                    id,
171	                    r#type: tc_type,
172	                    function: ToolFunction {
173	                        name,
174	                        arguments: args_parts.join(""),
175	                    },
176	                })
```

```text
24	/// 创建从 Gemini SSE 流到 Claude SSE 流的转换
25	pub fn create_claude_sse_stream<S, E>(
26	    mut gemini_stream: Pin<Box<S>>,
27	    trace_id: String,
28	    email: String,
29	    session_id: Option<String>, // [NEW v3.3.17] Session ID for signature caching
30	    scaling_enabled: bool, // [NEW] Flag for context usage scaling
31	    context_limit: u32,
32	    estimated_prompt_tokens: Option<u32>, // [FIX] Estimated tokens for calibrator learning
33	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Message count for rewind detection
34	    client_adapter: Option<std::sync::Arc<dyn ClientAdapter>>, // [NEW] Adapter reference
35	    registered_tool_names: Vec<String>, // [FIX #MCP] Tool names for fuzzy matching
36	) -> Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, String>> + Send>> 
37	where
38	    S: Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, E>> + Send + ?Sized + 'static,
39	    E: std::fmt::Display + Send + 'static,
40	{
41	    use async_stream::stream;
42	    use bytes::BytesMut;
43	    use futures::StreamExt;
44	
45	    Box::pin(stream! {
46	        let mut state = StreamingState::new();
47	        state.session_id = session_id; // Set session ID for signature caching
48	        state.message_count = message_count; // [NEW v4.0.0] Set message count
49	        state.scaling_enabled = scaling_enabled; // Set scaling enabled flag
50	        state.context_limit = context_limit;
51	        state.estimated_prompt_tokens = estimated_prompt_tokens; // [FIX] Pass estimated tokens
52	        state.set_client_adapter(client_adapter); // [NEW] Set adapter
53	        state.set_registered_tool_names(registered_tool_names); // [FIX #MCP] Set tool names
54	        let mut buffer = BytesMut::new();
55	
56	        loop {
57	            // [NEW] 60秒心跳保活: 延长超时时间以增加网络抖动容错
58	            let next_chunk = tokio::time::timeout(
59	                std::time::Duration::from_secs(60),
60	                gemini_stream.next()
61	            ).await;
62	
63	            match next_chunk {
64	                Ok(Some(chunk_result)) => {
65	                    match chunk_result {
66	                        Ok(chunk) => {
67	                            buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
68	
69	                            // Process complete lines
70	                            while let Some(pos) = buffer.iter().position(|&b| b == b'\n') {
71	                                let line_raw = buffer.split_to(pos + 1);
72	                                if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&line_raw) {
73	                                    let line = line_str.trim();
74	                                    if line.is_empty() { continue; }
75	
76	                                    if let Some(sse_chunks) = process_sse_line(line, &mut state, &trace_id, &email) {
77	                                        for sse_chunk in sse_chunks {
78	                                            yield Ok(sse_chunk);
79	                                        }
80	                                    }
81	                                }
82	                            }
83	                        }
84	                        Err(e) => {
85	                            let error_json = serde_json::json!({
86	                                "error": {
87	                                    "message": format!("Stream error: {}", e),
88	                                    "type": "stream_error"
89	                                }
90	                            });
91	                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!("data: {}\n\n", error_json)));
92	                            break;
93	                        }
94	                    }
95	                }
96	                Ok(None) => break, // Stream 正常结束
97	                Err(_) => {
98	                    // 超时，发送心跳包 (SSE Comment 格式)
99	                    yield Ok(Bytes::from(": ping\n\n"));
100	                }
101	            }
102	        }
103	        
104	        // [FIX #1732] Mandatory Flush remaining buffer on stream termination
105	        // Prevents hangs when the last SSE chunk doesn't end with a newline (network fragmentation)
106	        if !buffer.is_empty() {
107	             if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&buffer) {
108	                 let line = line_str.trim();
109	                 if !line.is_empty() {
110	                     tracing::debug!("[{}] SSE Termination: Flushing remaining {} bytes in buffer", trace_id, buffer.len());
111	                     if let Some(sse_chunks) = process_sse_line(line, &mut state, &trace_id, &email) {
112	                         for sse_chunk in sse_chunks {
113	                             yield Ok(sse_chunk);
114	                         }
115	                     }
116	                 }
117	             }
118	             buffer.clear();
119	        }
120	
121	        // [FIX #859] Post-thinking interruption recovery
122	        // If we have sent thinking but NO content (text/tool_use) and the stream ended (or timed out without DONE),
123	        // we must provide a fallback to prevent 0-token errors on client side.
124	        if state.has_thinking && !state.has_content {
125	            tracing::warn!("[{}] Stream interrupted after thinking (No Content). Triggering recovery...", trace_id);
126	            
127	            // 1. Force close thinking block if open
128	            if state.current_block_type() == crate::proxy::mappers::claude::streaming::BlockType::Thinking {
129	               let close_chunks = state.end_block();
130	               for chunk in close_chunks {
131	                   yield Ok(chunk);
132	               }
133	            }
134	
135	            // 2. Inject system message to inform user
136	            // We use a new text block for this.
137	            let recovery_msg = "\n\n[System] Upstream model interrupted after thinking. (Recovered by Antigravity)";
138	            let start_chunks = state.start_block(
139	                crate::proxy::mappers::claude::streaming::BlockType::Text, 
140	                serde_json::json!({ "type": "text", "text": recovery_msg })
141	            );
142	            for chunk in start_chunks { yield Ok(chunk); }
143	            
144	            let stop_chunks = state.end_block();
145	            for chunk in stop_chunks { yield Ok(chunk); }
146	
147	            // 3. Mark as content received so we don't trigger this again (though loop is done)
148	            state.has_content = true;
149	
150	            // 4. Send a simulated usage update to ensure we have > 0 output tokens
151	            // Estimate based on some default if we didn't get any usage
152	            let recovery_usage = crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::Usage {
153	                input_tokens: 0, // We don't know input, but output is critical
154	                output_tokens: 100, // Arbitrary small number to satisfy client
155	                cache_read_input_tokens: None,
156	                cache_creation_input_tokens: None,
157	                server_tool_use: None,
158	            };
159	
160	            let delta = serde_json::json!({
161	                "type": "message_delta",
162	                "delta": { "stop_reason": "end_turn", "stop_sequence": null },
163	                "usage": recovery_usage
164	            });
165	
166	            yield Ok(state.emit("message_delta", delta));
167	        }
168	
169	        // Ensure termination events are sent
170	        for chunk in emit_force_stop(&mut state) {
171	            yield Ok(chunk);
172	        }
173	    })
174	}
```

```text
11	    // [DEBUG] Always log incoming tool usage for diagnosis
12	    if let Some(obj) = args.as_object() {
13	        tracing::debug!("[Response] Tool Call: '{}' Args: {:?}", tool_name, obj);
14	    }
15	
16	    if let Some(obj) = args.as_object_mut() {
17	        // [IMPROVED] Case-insensitive matching for tool names
18	        // [IMPROVED] Case-insensitive matching for tool names
19	        match tool_name.to_lowercase().as_str() {
20	            "grep" | "search" | "search_code_definitions" | "search_code_snippets" => {
21	                // [FIX] Gemini hallucination: maps parameter description to "description" field
22	                if let Some(desc) = obj.remove("description") {
23	                    if !obj.contains_key("pattern") {
24	                        obj.insert("pattern".to_string(), desc);
25	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Remapped Grep: description → pattern");
26	                    }
27	                }
28	
29	                // Gemini uses "query", Claude Code expects "pattern"
30	                if let Some(query) = obj.remove("query") {
31	                    if !obj.contains_key("pattern") {
32	                        obj.insert("pattern".to_string(), query);
33	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Remapped Grep: query → pattern");
34	                    }
35	                }
36	
37	                // [CRITICAL FIX] Claude Code uses "path" (string), NOT "paths" (array)!
38	                if !obj.contains_key("path") {
39	                    if let Some(paths) = obj.remove("paths") {
40	                        let path_str = if let Some(arr) = paths.as_array() {
41	                            arr.get(0)
42	                                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
43	                                .unwrap_or(".")
44	                                .to_string()
45	                        } else if let Some(s) = paths.as_str() {
46	                            s.to_string()
47	                        } else {
48	                            ".".to_string()
49	                        };
50	                        obj.insert("path".to_string(), serde_json::json!(path_str));
51	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Remapped Grep: paths → path(\"{}\")", path_str);
52	                    } else {
53	                        // Default to current directory if missing
54	                        obj.insert("path".to_string(), json!("."));
55	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Added default path: \".\"");
56	                    }
57	                }
58	
59	                // Note: We keep "-n" and "output_mode" if present as they are valid in Grep schema
60	            }
61	            "glob" => {
62	                // [FIX] Gemini hallucination: maps parameter description to "description" field
63	                if let Some(desc) = obj.remove("description") {
64	                    if !obj.contains_key("pattern") {
65	                        obj.insert("pattern".to_string(), desc);
66	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Remapped Glob: description → pattern");
67	                    }
68	                }
69	
70	                // Gemini uses "query", Claude Code expects "pattern"
71	                if let Some(query) = obj.remove("query") {
72	                    if !obj.contains_key("pattern") {
73	                        obj.insert("pattern".to_string(), query);
74	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Remapped Glob: query → pattern");
75	                    }
76	                }
77	
78	                // [CRITICAL FIX] Claude Code uses "path" (string), NOT "paths" (array)!
79	                if !obj.contains_key("path") {
80	                    if let Some(paths) = obj.remove("paths") {
81	                        let path_str = if let Some(arr) = paths.as_array() {
82	                            arr.get(0)
83	                                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
84	                                .unwrap_or(".")
85	                                .to_string()
86	                        } else if let Some(s) = paths.as_str() {
87	                            s.to_string()
88	                        } else {
89	                            ".".to_string()
90	                        };
91	                        obj.insert("path".to_string(), serde_json::json!(path_str));
92	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Remapped Glob: paths → path(\"{}\")", path_str);
93	                    } else {
94	                        // Default to current directory if missing
95	                        obj.insert("path".to_string(), json!("."));
96	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Added default path: \".\"");
97	                    }
98	                }
99	            }
100	            "read" => {
101	                // Gemini might use "path" vs "file_path"
102	                if let Some(path) = obj.remove("path") {
103	                    if !obj.contains_key("file_path") {
104	                        obj.insert("file_path".to_string(), path);
105	                        tracing::debug!("[Response] Remapped Read: path → file_path");
106	                    }
107	                }
108	            }
109	            "ls" => {
110	                // LS tool: ensure "path" parameter exists
111	                if !obj.contains_key("path") {
112	                    obj.insert("path".to_string(), serde_json::json!("."));
113	                    tracing::debug!("[Response] Remapped LS: default path → \".\"");
114	                }
115	            }
116	            other => {
117	                // [NEW] [Issue #785] Generic Property Mapping for all tools
118	                // If a tool has "paths" (array of 1) but no "path", convert it.
119	                let mut path_to_inject = None;
120	                if !obj.contains_key("path") {
121	                    if let Some(paths) = obj.get("paths").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
122	                        if paths.len() == 1 {
123	                            if let Some(p) = paths[0].as_str() {
124	                                path_to_inject = Some(p.to_string());
125	                            }
126	                        }
127	                    }
128	                }
129	
130	                if let Some(path) = path_to_inject {
131	                    obj.insert("path".to_string(), serde_json::json!(path));
132	                    tracing::debug!(
133	                        "[Response] Probabilistic fix for tool '{}': paths[0] → path(\"{}\")",
134	                        other,
135	                        path
136	                    );
137	                }
138	                tracing::debug!(
139	                    "[Response] Unmapped tool call processed via generic rules: {} (keys: {:?})",
140	                    other,
141	                    obj.keys()
142	                );
143	            }
144	        }
145	    }
146	}
```
