148	/// 非流式响应处理器
149	pub struct NonStreamingProcessor {
150	    content_blocks: Vec<ContentBlock>,
151	    text_builder: String,
152	    thinking_builder: String,
153	    thinking_signature: Option<String>,
154	    trailing_signature: Option<String>,
155	    pub has_tool_call: bool,
156	    pub scaling_enabled: bool,
157	    pub context_limit: u32,
158	    pub session_id: Option<String>,
159	    pub model_name: String,
160	    pub message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Message count for rewind detection
161	}
162	
163	impl NonStreamingProcessor {
164	    pub fn new(session_id: Option<String>, model_name: String, message_count: usize) -> Self {
165	        Self {
166	            content_blocks: Vec::new(),
167	            text_builder: String::new(),
168	            thinking_builder: String::new(),
169	            thinking_signature: None,
170	            trailing_signature: None,
171	            has_tool_call: false,
172	            scaling_enabled: false,
173	            context_limit: 1_048_576, // Default to 1M
174	            session_id,
175	            model_name,
176	            message_count,
177	        }
178	    }
179	
180	    /// 处理 Gemini 响应并转换为 Claude 响应
181	    pub fn process(
182	        &mut self,
183	        gemini_response: &GeminiResponse,
184	        scaling_enabled: bool,
185	        context_limit: u32,
186	    ) -> ClaudeResponse {
187	        self.scaling_enabled = scaling_enabled;
188	        self.context_limit = context_limit;
189	        // 获取 parts
190	        let empty_parts = vec![];
191	        let parts = gemini_response
192	            .candidates
193	            .as_ref()
194	            .and_then(|c| c.get(0))
195	            .and_then(|candidate| candidate.content.as_ref())
196	            .map(|content| &content.parts)
197	            .unwrap_or(&empty_parts);
198	
199	        // 处理所有 parts
200	        for part in parts {
201	            self.process_part(part);
202	        }
203	
204	        // 处理 grounding(web search) -> 转换为 server_tool_use / web_search_tool_result
205	        if let Some(candidate) = gemini_response.candidates.as_ref().and_then(|c| c.get(0)) {
206	            if let Some(grounding) = &candidate.grounding_metadata {
207	                self.process_grounding(grounding);
208	            }
209	        }
210	
211	        // 刷新剩余内容
212	        self.flush_thinking();
213	        self.flush_text();
214	
215	        // 处理 trailingSignature (空 text 带签名)
216	        if let Some(signature) = self.trailing_signature.take() {
217	            self.content_blocks.push(ContentBlock::Thinking {
218	                thinking: String::new(),
219	                signature: Some(signature),
220	                cache_control: None,
221	            });
222	        }
223	
224	        // 构建响应
225	        self.build_response(gemini_response)
226	    }
227	
228	    /// 处理单个 part
229	    fn process_part(&mut self, part: &GeminiPart) {
230	        let signature = part.thought_signature.as_ref().map(|sig| {
231	            use base64::Engine;
232	            match base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.decode(sig) {
233	                Ok(decoded_bytes) => {
234	                    match String::from_utf8(decoded_bytes) {
235	                        Ok(decoded_str) => {
236	                            tracing::debug!(
237	                                "[Response] Decoded base64 signature (len {} -> {})",
238	                                sig.len(),
239	                                decoded_str.len()
240	                            );
241	                            decoded_str
242	                        }
243	                        Err(_) => sig.clone(), // Not valid UTF-8, keep as is
244	                    }
245	                }
246	                Err(_) => sig.clone(), // Not base64, keep as is
247	            }
248	        });
249	
250	        // [FIX #765] Cache signature in NonStreamingProcessor
251	        if let Some(sig) = &signature {
252	            if let Some(s_id) = &self.session_id {
253	                crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global()
254	                    .cache_session_signature(s_id, sig.to_string(), self.message_count);
255	                crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global()
256	                    .cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), self.model_name.clone());
257	                tracing::debug!(
258	                    "[Claude-Response] Cached signature (len: {}) for session: {}",
259	                    sig.len(),
260	                    s_id
261	                );
262	            }
263	        }
264	
265	        // 1. FunctionCall 处理
266	        if let Some(fc) = &part.function_call {
267	            self.flush_thinking();
268	            self.flush_text();
269	
270	            // 处理 trailingSignature (B4/C3 场景)
271	            if let Some(trailing_sig) = self.trailing_signature.take() {
272	                self.content_blocks.push(ContentBlock::Thinking {
273	                    thinking: String::new(),
274	                    signature: Some(trailing_sig),
275	                    cache_control: None,
276	                });
277	            }
278	
279	            self.has_tool_call = true;
280	
281	            // 生成 tool_use id
282	            let tool_id = fc.id.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
283	                format!(
284	                    "{}-{}",
285	                    fc.name,
286	                    crate::proxy::common::utils::generate_random_id()
287	                )
288	            });
289	
290	            let mut tool_name = fc.name.clone();
291	            // [OPTIMIZED] Only rename if it's "search" which is a known hallucination.
292	            // Avoid renaming "grep" to "Grep" if possible to protect signature.
293	            if tool_name.to_lowercase() == "search" {
294	                tool_name = "Grep".to_string();
295	            }
296	
297	            // [FIX] Remap args for Gemini → Claude compatibility
298	            let mut args = fc.args.clone().unwrap_or(serde_json::json!({}));
299	            remap_function_call_args(&tool_name, &mut args);
300	
301	            let mut tool_use = ContentBlock::ToolUse {
302	                id: tool_id,
303	                name: tool_name,
304	                input: args.clone(),
305	                signature: None,
306	                cache_control: None,
307	            };
308	
309	            // 只使用 FC 自己的签名
310	            if let ContentBlock::ToolUse { signature: sig, .. } = &mut tool_use {
311	                *sig = signature;
312	            }
313	
314	            self.content_blocks.push(tool_use);
315	            return;
316	        }
317	
318	        // 2. Text 处理
319	        if let Some(text) = &part.text {
320	            if part.thought.unwrap_or(false) {
321	                // Thinking part
322	                self.flush_text();
323	
324	                // 处理 trailingSignature
325	                if let Some(trailing_sig) = self.trailing_signature.take() {
326	                    self.flush_thinking();
327	                    self.content_blocks.push(ContentBlock::Thinking {
328	                        thinking: String::new(),
329	                        signature: Some(trailing_sig),
330	                        cache_control: None,
331	                    });
332	                }
333	
334	                self.thinking_builder.push_str(text);
335	                if signature.is_some() {
336	                    self.thinking_signature = signature;
337	                }
338	            } else {
339	                // 普通 Text
340	                if text.is_empty() {
341	                    // 空 text 带签名 - 暂存到 trailingSignature
342	                    if signature.is_some() {
343	                        self.trailing_signature = signature;
344	                    }
345	                    return;
346	                }
347	
348	                self.flush_thinking();
349	
350	                // 处理之前的 trailingSignature
351	                if let Some(trailing_sig) = self.trailing_signature.take() {
352	                    self.flush_text();
353	                    self.content_blocks.push(ContentBlock::Thinking {
354	                        thinking: String::new(),
355	                        signature: Some(trailing_sig),
356	                        cache_control: None,
357	                    });
358	                }
359	
360	                self.text_builder.push_str(text);
361	
362	                // 非空 text 带签名 - 立即刷新并输出空 thinking 块
363	                if let Some(sig) = signature {
364	                    self.flush_text();
365	                    self.content_blocks.push(ContentBlock::Thinking {
366	                        thinking: String::new(),
367	                        signature: Some(sig),
368	                        cache_control: None,
369	                    });
370	                }
371	            }
372	        }
373	
374	        // 3. InlineData (Image) 处理
375	        if let Some(img) = &part.inline_data {
376	            self.flush_thinking();
377	
378	            let mime_type = &img.mime_type;
379	            let data = &img.data;
380	            if !data.is_empty() {
381	                let markdown_img = format!("![image](data:{};base64,{})", mime_type, data);
382	                self.text_builder.push_str(&markdown_img);
383	                self.flush_text();
384	            }
385	        }
386	    }
387	
388	    /// 处理 Grounding 元数据 (Web Search 结果)
389	    fn process_grounding(&mut self, grounding: &GroundingMetadata) {
390	        let mut grounding_text = String::new();
391	
392	        // 1. 处理搜索词
393	        if let Some(queries) = &grounding.web_search_queries {
394	            if !queries.is_empty() {
395	                grounding_text.push_str("\n\n---\n**🔍 已为您搜索：** ");
396	                grounding_text.push_str(&queries.join(", "));
397	            }
398	        }
399	
400	        // 2. 处理来源链接 (Chunks)
401	        if let Some(chunks) = &grounding.grounding_chunks {
402	            let mut links = Vec::new();
403	            for (i, chunk) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
404	                if let Some(web) = &chunk.web {
405	                    let title = web.title.as_deref().unwrap_or("网页来源");
406	                    let uri = web.uri.as_deref().unwrap_or("#");
407	                    links.push(format!("[{}] [{}]({})", i + 1, title, uri));
408	                }
409	            }
410	
411	            if !links.is_empty() {
412	                grounding_text.push_str("\n\n**🌐 来源引文：**\n");
413	                grounding_text.push_str(&links.join("\n"));
414	            }
415	        }
416	
417	        if !grounding_text.is_empty() {
418	            // 在常规内容前后刷新并插入文本
419	            self.flush_thinking();
420	            self.flush_text();
421	            self.text_builder.push_str(&grounding_text);
422	            self.flush_text();
423	        }
424	    }
425	
426	    /// 刷新 text builder
427	    fn flush_text(&mut self) {
428	        if self.text_builder.is_empty() {
429	            return;
430	        }
431	
432	        let mut current_text = self.text_builder.clone();
433	        self.text_builder.clear();
434	
435	        // [NEW] MCP XML Bridge: 循环解析文本中可能存在的 XML 标签
436	        while let Some(start_idx) = current_text.find("<mcp__") {
437	            if let Some(tag_end_idx) = current_text[start_idx..].find('>') {
438	                let actual_tag_end = start_idx + tag_end_idx;
439	                let tool_name = &current_text[start_idx + 1..actual_tag_end];
440	                let end_tag = format!("</{}>", tool_name);
441	
442	                if let Some(close_idx) = current_text.find(&end_tag) {
443	                    // 1. 处理标签前的文本
444	                    if start_idx > 0 {
445	                        self.content_blocks.push(ContentBlock::Text {
446	                            text: current_text[..start_idx].to_string(),
447	                        });
448	                    }
449	
450	                    // 2. 解析 XML 内容并转换为 ToolUse
451	                    let input_str = &current_text[actual_tag_end + 1..close_idx];
452	                    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(input_str.trim())
453	                        .unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({ "input": input_str.trim() }));
454	
455	                    self.content_blocks.push(ContentBlock::ToolUse {
456	                        id: format!("{}-xml", tool_name),
457	                        name: tool_name.to_string(),
458	                        input: input_json,
459	                        signature: None,
460	                        cache_control: None,
461	                    });
462	                    self.has_tool_call = true;
463	
464	                    // 3. 继续处理剩余文本
465	                    current_text = current_text[close_idx + end_tag.len()..].to_string();
466	                    continue;
467	                }
468	            }
469	            // 如果 XML 格式不完整, 退出循环并按普通文本处理
470	            break;
471	        }
472	
473	        if !current_text.is_empty() {
474	            self.content_blocks
475	                .push(ContentBlock::Text { text: current_text });
476	        }
477	    }
478	
479	    /// 刷新 thinking builder
480	    fn flush_thinking(&mut self) {
481	        // 如果既没有内容也没有签名，直接返回
482	        if self.thinking_builder.is_empty() && self.thinking_signature.is_none() {
483	            return;
484	        }
485	
486	        let thinking = self.thinking_builder.clone();
487	        let signature = self.thinking_signature.take();
488	
489	        self.content_blocks.push(ContentBlock::Thinking {
490	            thinking,
491	            signature,
492	            cache_control: None,
493	        });
494	        self.thinking_builder.clear();
495	    }
496	
497	    /// 构建最终响应
498	    fn build_response(&self, gemini_response: &GeminiResponse) -> ClaudeResponse {
499	        let finish_reason = gemini_response
500	            .candidates
501	            .as_ref()
502	            .and_then(|c| c.get(0))
503	            .and_then(|candidate| candidate.finish_reason.as_deref());
504	
505	        let stop_reason = if self.has_tool_call {
506	            "tool_use"
507	        } else if finish_reason == Some("MAX_TOKENS") {
508	            "max_tokens"
509	        } else {
510	            "end_turn"
511	        };
512	
513	        let usage = gemini_response
514	            .usage_metadata
515	            .as_ref()
516	            .map(|u| to_claude_usage(u, self.scaling_enabled, self.context_limit))
517	            .unwrap_or(Usage {
518	                input_tokens: 0,
519	                output_tokens: 0,
520	                cache_read_input_tokens: None,
521	                cache_creation_input_tokens: None,
522	                server_tool_use: None,
523	            });
524	
525	        ClaudeResponse {
526	            id: gemini_response.response_id.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
527	                format!("msg_{}", crate::proxy::common::utils::generate_random_id())
528	            }),
529	            type_: "message".to_string(),
530	            role: "assistant".to_string(),
531	            model: gemini_response.model_version.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
532	            content: self.content_blocks.clone(),
533	            stop_reason: stop_reason.to_string(),
534	            stop_sequence: None,
535	            usage,
536	        }
537	    }
538	}
539	
540	pub fn transform_response(
541	    gemini_response: &GeminiResponse,
542	    scaling_enabled: bool,
543	    context_limit: u32,
544	    session_id: Option<String>,
545	    model_name: String,
546	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Message count for rewind detection
547	) -> Result<ClaudeResponse, String> {
548	    let mut processor = NonStreamingProcessor::new(session_id, model_name, message_count);
549	    Ok(processor.process(gemini_response, scaling_enabled, context_limit))
550	}

68	/// 清理消息中的 cache_control 字段
69	///
70	/// 这个函数会深度遍历所有消息内容块,移除 cache_control 字段。
71	/// 这是必要的,因为:
72	/// 1. VS Code 等客户端会将历史消息(包含 cache_control)原封不动发回
73	/// 2. Anthropic API 不接受请求中包含 cache_control 字段
74	/// 3. 即使是转发到 Gemini,也应该清理以保持协议纯净性
75	///
76	/// [FIX #593] 增强版本:添加详细日志用于调试 MCP 工具兼容性问题
77	pub fn clean_cache_control_from_messages(messages: &mut [Message]) {
78	    tracing::info!(
79	        "[DEBUG-593] Starting cache_control cleanup for {} messages",
80	        messages.len()
81	    );
82	
83	    let mut total_cleaned = 0;
84	
85	    for (idx, msg) in messages.iter_mut().enumerate() {
86	        if let MessageContent::Array(blocks) = &mut msg.content {
87	            for (block_idx, block) in blocks.iter_mut().enumerate() {
88	                match block {
89	                    ContentBlock::Thinking { cache_control, .. } => {
90	                        if cache_control.is_some() {
91	                            tracing::info!(
92	                                "[ISSUE-744] Found cache_control in Thinking block at message[{}].content[{}]: {:?}",
93	                                idx,
94	                                block_idx,
95	                                cache_control
96	                            );
97	                            *cache_control = None;
98	                            total_cleaned += 1;
99	                        }
100	                    }
101	                    ContentBlock::Image { cache_control, .. } => {
102	                        if cache_control.is_some() {
103	                            tracing::debug!(
104	                                "[Cache-Control-Cleaner] Removed cache_control from Image block at message[{}].content[{}]",
105	                                idx,
106	                                block_idx
107	                            );
108	                            *cache_control = None;
109	                            total_cleaned += 1;
110	                        }
111	                    }
112	                    ContentBlock::Document { cache_control, .. } => {
113	                        if cache_control.is_some() {
114	                            tracing::debug!(
115	                                "[Cache-Control-Cleaner] Removed cache_control from Document block at message[{}].content[{}]",
116	                                idx,
117	                                block_idx
118	                            );
119	                            *cache_control = None;
120	                            total_cleaned += 1;
121	                        }
122	                    }
123	                    ContentBlock::ToolUse { cache_control, .. } => {
124	                        if cache_control.is_some() {
125	                            tracing::debug!(
126	                                "[Cache-Control-Cleaner] Removed cache_control from ToolUse block at message[{}].content[{}]",
127	                                idx,
128	                                block_idx
129	                            );
130	                            *cache_control = None;
131	                            total_cleaned += 1;
132	                        }
133	                    }
134	                    _ => {}
135	                }
136	            }
137	        }
138	    }
139	
140	    if total_cleaned > 0 {
141	        tracing::info!(
142	            "[DEBUG-593] Cache control cleanup complete: removed {} cache_control fields",
143	            total_cleaned
144	        );
145	    } else {
146	        tracing::debug!("[DEBUG-593] No cache_control fields found");
147	    }
148	}

150	/// [FIX #593] 递归深度清理 JSON 中的 cache_control 字段
151	///
152	/// 用于处理嵌套结构和非标准位置的 cache_control。
153	/// 这是最后一道防线,确保发送给 Antigravity 的请求中不包含任何 cache_control。
154	fn deep_clean_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
155	    match value {
156	        Value::Object(map) => {
157	            if map.remove("cache_control").is_some() {
158	                tracing::debug!("[DEBUG-593] Removed cache_control from nested JSON object");
159	            }
160	            for (_, v) in map.iter_mut() {
161	                deep_clean_cache_control(v);
162	            }
163	        }
164	        Value::Array(arr) => {
165	            for item in arr.iter_mut() {
166	                deep_clean_cache_control(item);
167	            }
168	        }
169	        _ => {}
170	    }
171	}

173	/// [FIX #564] Sort blocks in assistant messages to ensure thinking blocks are first
174	///
175	/// When context compression (kilo) reorders message blocks, thinking blocks may appear
176	/// after text blocks. Claude/Anthropic API requires thinking blocks to be first if
177	/// any thinking blocks exist in the message. This function pre-sorts blocks to ensure
178	/// thinking/redacted_thinking blocks always come before other block types.
179	fn sort_thinking_blocks_first(messages: &mut [Message]) {
180	    for msg in messages.iter_mut() {
181	        if msg.role == "assistant" {
182	            if let MessageContent::Array(blocks) = &mut msg.content {
183	                // [FIX #709] Triple-stage partition: [Thinking, Text, ToolUse]
184	                // This ensures protocol compliance while maintaining logical order.
185	
186	                let mut thinking_blocks: Vec<ContentBlock> = Vec::new();
187	                let mut text_blocks: Vec<ContentBlock> = Vec::new();
188	                let mut tool_blocks: Vec<ContentBlock> = Vec::new();
189	                let mut other_blocks: Vec<ContentBlock> = Vec::new();
190	
191	                let original_len = blocks.len();
192	                let mut needs_reorder = false;
193	                let mut saw_non_thinking = false;
194	
195	                for (_i, block) in blocks.iter().enumerate() {
196	                    match block {
197	                        ContentBlock::Thinking { .. } | ContentBlock::RedactedThinking { .. } => {
198	                            if saw_non_thinking {
199	                                needs_reorder = true;
200	                            }
201	                        }
202	                        ContentBlock::Text { .. } => {
203	                            saw_non_thinking = true;
204	                        }
205	                        ContentBlock::ToolUse { .. } => {
206	                            saw_non_thinking = true;
207	                            // Check if tool is after text (this is normal, but we want a strict group order)
208	                        }
209	                        _ => saw_non_thinking = true,
210	                    }
211	                }
212	
213	                if needs_reorder || original_len > 1 {
214	                    // For safety, we always perform the triple partition if there's more than one block.
215	                    // This also handles empty text block filtering.
216	                    for block in blocks.drain(..) {
217	                        match &block {
218	                            ContentBlock::Thinking { .. }
219	                            | ContentBlock::RedactedThinking { .. } => {
220	                                thinking_blocks.push(block);
221	                            }
222	                            ContentBlock::Text { text } => {
223	                                // Filter out purely empty or structural text like "(no content)"
224	                                if !text.trim().is_empty() && text != "(no content)" {
225	                                    text_blocks.push(block);
226	                                }
227	                            }
228	                            ContentBlock::ToolUse { .. } => {
229	                                tool_blocks.push(block);
230	                            }
231	                            _ => {
232	                                other_blocks.push(block);
233	                            }
234	                        }
235	                    }
236	
237	                    // Reconstruct in strict order: Thinking -> Text/Other -> Tool
238	                    blocks.extend(thinking_blocks);
239	                    blocks.extend(text_blocks);
240	                    blocks.extend(other_blocks);
241	                    blocks.extend(tool_blocks);
242	
243	                    if needs_reorder {
244	                        tracing::warn!(
245	                            "[FIX #709] Reordered assistant messages to [Thinking, Text, Tool] structure."
246	                        );
247	                    }
248	                }
249	            }
250	        }
251	    }
252	}
253	
254	/// 合并 ClaudeRequest 中连续的同角色消息
255	///
256	/// 场景: 当从 Spec/Plan 模式切换回编码模式时，可能出现连续两条 "user" 消息
257	/// (一条是 ToolResult，一条是 <system-reminder>)。
258	/// 这会违反角色交替规则，导致 400 报错。
259	pub fn merge_consecutive_messages(messages: &mut Vec<Message>) {
260	    if messages.len() <= 1 {
261	        return;
262	    }
263	
264	    let mut merged: Vec<Message> = Vec::with_capacity(messages.len());
265	    let old_messages = std::mem::take(messages);
266	    let mut messages_iter = old_messages.into_iter();
267	
268	    if let Some(mut current) = messages_iter.next() {
269	        for next in messages_iter {
270	            if current.role == next.role {
271	                // 合并内容
272	                match (&mut current.content, next.content) {
273	                    (MessageContent::Array(current_blocks), MessageContent::Array(next_blocks)) => {
274	                        current_blocks.extend(next_blocks);
275	                    }
276	                    (MessageContent::Array(current_blocks), MessageContent::String(next_text)) => {
277	                        current_blocks.push(ContentBlock::Text { text: next_text });
278	                    }
279	                    (MessageContent::String(current_text), MessageContent::String(next_text)) => {
280	                        *current_text = format!("{}\n\n{}", current_text, next_text);
281	                    }
282	                    (MessageContent::String(current_text), MessageContent::Array(next_blocks)) => {
283	                        let mut new_blocks = vec![ContentBlock::Text {
284	                            text: current_text.clone(),
285	                        }];
286	                        new_blocks.extend(next_blocks);
287	                        current.content = MessageContent::Array(new_blocks);
288	                    }
289	                }
290	            } else {
291	                merged.push(current);
292	                current = next;
293	            }
294	        }
295	        merged.push(current);
296	    }
297	
298	    *messages = merged;
299	}

301	/// 转换 Claude 请求为 Gemini v1internal 格式
302	
303	/// [FIX #709] Reorder serialized Gemini parts to ensure thinking blocks are first
304	fn reorder_gemini_parts(parts: &mut Vec<Value>) {
305	    if parts.len() <= 1 {
306	        return;
307	    }
308	
309	    let mut thinking_parts = Vec::new();
310	    let mut text_parts = Vec::new();
311	    let mut tool_parts = Vec::new();
312	    let mut other_parts = Vec::new();
313	
314	    for part in parts.drain(..) {
315	        if part.get("thought").and_then(|t| t.as_bool()) == Some(true) {
316	            thinking_parts.push(part);
317	        } else if part.get("functionCall").is_some() {
318	            tool_parts.push(part);
319	        } else if let Some(text) = part.get("text").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
320	            // Filter empty text parts that might have been created during merging
321	            if !text.trim().is_empty() && text != "(no content)" {
322	                text_parts.push(part);
323	            }
324	        } else {
325	            other_parts.push(part);
326	        }
327	    }
328	
329	    parts.extend(thinking_parts);
330	    parts.extend(text_parts);
331	    parts.extend(other_parts);
332	    parts.extend(tool_parts);
333	}

180	impl Tool {
181	    /// Check if this is the web_search server tool
182	    pub fn is_web_search(&self) -> bool {
183	        // Check by type (preferred for server tools)
184	        if let Some(ref t) = self.type_ {
185	            if t.starts_with("web_search") {
186	                return true;
187	            }
188	        }
189	        // Check by name (fallback)
190	        if let Some(ref n) = self.name {
191	            if n == "web_search" {
192	                return true;
193	            }
194	        }
195	        false
196	    }
197	
198	    /// Get the effective tool name
199	    #[allow(dead_code)]
200	    pub fn get_name(&self) -> String {
201	        self.name.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
202	            // For server tools, derive name from type
203	            if let Some(ref t) = self.type_ {
204	                if t.starts_with("web_search") {
205	                    return "web_search".to_string();
206	                }
207	            }
208	            "unknown".to_string()
209	        })
210	    }

92	/// Map Claude model names to Gemini model names
93	/// 
94	/// # 映射策略
95	/// 1. **精确匹配**: 检查 CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI 映射表
96	/// 2. **已知前缀透传**: gemini-* 和 *-thinking 模型直接透传
97	/// 3. **[NEW] 直接透传**: 未知模型 ID 直接传递给 Google API (支持体验未发布模型)
98	/// 
99	/// # 参数
100	/// - `input`: 原始模型名称
101	/// 
102	/// # 返回
103	/// 映射后的目标模型名称
104	/// 
105	/// # 示例
106	/// ```
107	/// // 精确匹配
108	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-opus-4"), "claude-opus-4-5-thinking");
109	/// 
110	/// // Gemini 模型透传
111	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("gemini-2.5-flash"), "gemini-2.5-flash");
112	/// 
113	/// // 直接透传未知模型 (NEW!)
114	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-opus-4-6"), "claude-opus-4-6");
115	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-sonnet-5"), "claude-sonnet-5");
116	/// ```
117	pub fn map_claude_model_to_gemini(input: &str) -> String {
118	    // 1. Check exact match in map
119	    if let Some(mapped) = CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI.get(input) {
120	        return mapped.to_string();
121	    }
122	
123	    // 2. Pass-through known prefixes (gemini-, -thinking) to support dynamic suffixes
124	    if input.starts_with("gemini-") || input.contains("thinking") {
125	        return input.to_string();
126	    }
127	
128	
129	    // 3. [ENHANCED] 直接透传未知模型 ID,而不是强制 fallback
130	    // 这允许用户通过自定义映射体验未发布的模型 (如 claude-opus-4-6)
131	    // Google API 会自动处理无效模型并返回错误,用户可以根据错误调整映射
132	    input.to_string()
133	}

198	/// Wildcard matching - supports multiple wildcards
199	///
200	/// **Note**: Matching is **case-sensitive**. Pattern `GPT-4*` will NOT match `gpt-4-turbo`.
201	///
202	/// Examples:
203	/// - `gpt-4*` matches `gpt-4`, `gpt-4-turbo` ✓
204	/// - `claude-*-sonnet-*` matches `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` ✓
205	/// - `*-thinking` matches `claude-opus-4-5-thinking` ✓
206	/// - `a*b*c` matches `a123b456c` ✓
207	fn wildcard_match(pattern: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
208	    let parts: Vec<&str> = pattern.split('*').collect();
209	
210	    // No wildcard - exact match
211	    if parts.len() == 1 {
212	        return pattern == text;
213	    }
214	
215	    let mut text_pos = 0;
216	
217	    for (i, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
218	        if part.is_empty() {
219	            continue; // Skip empty segments from consecutive wildcards
220	        }
221	
222	        if i == 0 {
223	            // First segment must match start
224	            if !text[text_pos..].starts_with(part) {
225	                return false;
226	            }
227	            text_pos += part.len();
228	        } else if i == parts.len() - 1 {
229	            // Last segment must match end
230	            return text[text_pos..].ends_with(part);
231	        } else {
232	            // Middle segments - find next occurrence
233	            if let Some(pos) = text[text_pos..].find(part) {
234	                text_pos += pos + part.len();
235	            } else {
236	                return false;
237	            }
238	        }
239	    }
240	
241	    true
242	}

244	/// 核心模型路由解析引擎
245	/// 优先级：精确匹配 > 通配符匹配 > 系统默认映射
246	/// 
247	/// # 参数
248	/// - `original_model`: 原始模型名称
249	/// - `custom_mapping`: 用户自定义映射表
250	/// 
251	/// # 返回
252	/// 映射后的目标模型名称
253	pub fn resolve_model_route(
254	    original_model: &str,
255	    custom_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
256	) -> String {
257	    // 0. API 热更新废弃模型转发 (最高物理优先级，强制纠正)
258	    // 如果用户非要用已经被移除的模型，并且官方下发了 fallback path，我们在此拦截并纠正
259	    if let Some(forwarded) = DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES.get(original_model) {
260	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 官方淘汰重定向: {} -> {}", original_model, forwarded.value()));
261	        return forwarded.value().clone();
262	    }
263	
264	    // 1. 精确匹配 (次高优先级)
265	    if let Some(target) = custom_mapping.get(original_model) {
266	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 精确映射: {} -> {}", original_model, target));
267	        return target.clone();
268	    }
269	    
270	    // 2. Wildcard match - most specific (highest non-wildcard chars) wins
271	    // Note: When multiple patterns have the SAME specificity, HashMap iteration order
272	    // determines the result (non-deterministic). Users can avoid this by making patterns
273	    // more specific. Future improvement: use IndexMap + frontend sorting for full control.
274	    let mut best_match: Option<(&str, &str, usize)> = None;
275	
276	    for (pattern, target) in custom_mapping.iter() {
277	        if pattern.contains('*') && wildcard_match(pattern, original_model) {
278	            let specificity = pattern.chars().count() - pattern.matches('*').count();
279	            if best_match.is_none() || specificity > best_match.unwrap().2 {
280	                best_match = Some((pattern.as_str(), target.as_str(), specificity));
281	            }
282	        }
283	    }
284	
285	    if let Some((pattern, target, _)) = best_match {
286	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
287	            "[Router] Wildcard match: {} -> {} (rule: {})",
288	            original_model, target, pattern
289	        ));
290	        return target.to_string();
291	    }
292	    
293	    // 3. 系统默认映射
294	    let result = map_claude_model_to_gemini(original_model);
295	    if result != original_model {
296	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 系统默认映射: {} -> {}", original_model, result));
297	    }
298	    result
299	}

301	/// Normalize any physical model name to one of the 3 standard protection IDs.
302	/// This ensures quota protection works consistently regardless of API versioning or request variations.
303	/// 
304	/// Standard IDs:
305	/// - `gemini-3-flash`: All Flash variants (1.5-flash, 2.5-flash, 3-flash, etc.)
306	/// - `gemini-3-pro-high`: All Pro variants (1.5-pro, 2.5-pro, etc.)
307	/// - `claude-sonnet-4-5`: All Claude Sonnet variants (3-5-sonnet, sonnet-4-5, etc.)
308	/// 
309	/// Returns `None` if the model doesn't match any of the 3 protected categories.
310	pub fn normalize_to_standard_id(model_name: &str) -> Option<String> {
311	    let lower = model_name.to_lowercase();
312	    
313	    // 1. image 资源 (优先匹配，使用 contains 匹配以支持任何变体，如 gemini-3.1-flash-image)
314	    if lower.contains("image") {
315	        return Some("gemini-3-pro-image".to_string());
316	    }
317	
318	    // 2. gemini-3-flash (包含所有 flash 变体)
319	    if lower.contains("flash") {
320	        return Some("gemini-3-flash".to_string());
321	    }
322	
323	    // 3. gemini-3-pro-high (包含 pro 变体)
324	    if lower.contains("pro") && !lower.contains("image") {
325	        return Some("gemini-3-pro-high".to_string());
326	    }
327	
328	    // 4. Claude 系列 (合并 Opus, Sonnet, Haiku 为统一保护组 'claude')
329	    if lower.contains("claude") || lower.contains("opus") || lower.contains("sonnet") || lower.contains("haiku") {
330	        return Some("claude".to_string());
331	    }
332	
333	    None
334	}

745	fn enforce_uppercase_types(value: &mut Value) {
746	    if let Value::Object(map) = value {
747	        if let Some(type_val) = map.get_mut("type") {
748	            if let Value::String(ref mut s) = type_val {
749	                *s = s.to_uppercase();
750	            }
751	        }
752	        if let Some(properties) = map.get_mut("properties") {
753	            if let Value::Object(ref mut props) = properties {
754	                for v in props.values_mut() {
755	                    enforce_uppercase_types(v);
756	                }
757	            }
758	        }
759	        if let Some(items) = map.get_mut("items") {
760	            enforce_uppercase_types(items);
761	        }
762	    } else if let Value::Array(arr) = value {
763	        for item in arr {
764	            enforce_uppercase_types(item);
765	        }
766	    }
767	}

35	fn extract_usage_metadata(u: &Value) -> Option<super::models::OpenAIUsage> {
36	    use super::models::{OpenAIUsage, PromptTokensDetails};

38	    let prompt_tokens = u
39	        .get("promptTokenCount")

41	        .unwrap_or(0) as u32;
42	    let completion_tokens = u
43	        .get("candidatesTokenCount")
44	        .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
45	        .unwrap_or(0) as u32;
46	    let total_tokens = u
47	        .get("totalTokenCount")
48	        .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
49	        .unwrap_or(0) as u32;
50	    let cached_tokens = u
51	        .get("cachedContentTokenCount")
52	        .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
53	        .map(|v| v as u32);

55	    Some(OpenAIUsage {
56	        prompt_tokens,
57	        completion_tokens,
58	        total_tokens,
59	        prompt_tokens_details: cached_tokens.map(|ct| PromptTokensDetails {
60	            cached_tokens: Some(ct),
61	        }),

63	    })

34	    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
35	        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
36	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
37	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
38	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
39	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
40	        };
41	
42	        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
43	            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
44	            enabled: true,
45	            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
46	            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
47	            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
48	            dispatch_mode,
49	            priority: 0,
50	            model_prefixes: Vec::new(), // wildcard
51	            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
52	            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
53	                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
54	                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
55	                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
56	            },
57	            request_timeout_secs: None,
58	        };
59	
60	        Self {
61	            providers: vec![provider],
62	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {
72	                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
73	                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
74	            })
75	            .collect()
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
129	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
130	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
131	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
132	            return mapped.clone();
133	        }
134	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
135	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
136	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
137	            .model_mapping
138	            .iter()
139	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
140	        {
141	            return mapped.clone();
142	        }
143	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
144	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
145	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
146	        }
147	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
148	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
149	            return incoming.to_string();
150	        }
151	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
152	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
153	            if m.contains("opus") {
154	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
155	            }
156	            if m.contains("haiku") {
157	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
158	            }
159	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
160	        }
161	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
162	        incoming.to_string()
163	    }
164	
165	    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
166	    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
167	        self.providers.is_empty()
168	    }
169	}

39	fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {

41	    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
42	        path.to_string()
43	    } else {

49	fn build_client(
50	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
51	    timeout_secs: u64,
52	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
54	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
55	
56	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
57	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
58	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
59	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
60	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
61	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    builder
66	        .tcp_nodelay(true) // [FIX #307] Disable Nagle's algorithm to improve latency for small requests
67	        .build()
68	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))

71	fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap {
72	    // Only forward a conservative set of headers to avoid leaking the local proxy key or cookies.
73	    let mut out = HeaderMap::new();
74	
75	    for (k, v) in incoming.iter() {
76	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
77	        match key.as_str() {
78	            "content-type" | "accept" | "anthropic-version" | "user-agent" => {
79	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
80	            }
81	            // Some clients use these for streaming; safe to pass through.
82	            "accept-encoding" | "cache-control" => {
83	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
84	            }
85	            _ => {}
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    out
90	}

92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}

113	/// Recursively remove cache_control from all nested objects/arrays
114	/// [FIX #290] This is a defensive fix that works regardless of serde annotations
115	pub fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
116	    match value {
117	        Value::Object(map) => {
118	            if let Some(v) = map.remove("cache_control") {
119	                tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep Cleaning found nested cache_control: {:?}", v);
120	            }
121	            for v in map.values_mut() {
122	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {
127	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}

331	    default_models: &crate::proxy::config::ProviderModelDefaults,
332	) -> String {
333	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
334	    // 1. Exact match
335	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
336	        return mapped.clone();
337	    }
338	    // 2. Lowercase match
339	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
340	        return mapped.clone();
341	    }
342	    // 3. zai: prefix strip
343	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
344	        return original[4..].to_string();
345	    }
346	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
347	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
348	        return original.to_string();
349	    }
350	    // 5. Claude family defaults
351	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
352	        return original.to_string();
353	    }
354	    if m.contains("opus") {
355	        return default_models.opus.clone();
356	    }
357	    if m.contains("haiku") {
358	        return default_models.haiku.clone();
359	    }
360	    default_models.sonnet.clone()
361	}

878	            chunks.push(self.state.emit_delta("text_delta", json!({ "text": text })));
879	            chunks.extend(self.state.end_block());
880	
881	            return chunks;
882	        }
883	
884	        // Ordinary text (without signature)
885	
886	        // [NEW] MCP XML Bridge: Intercept and parse <mcp__...> tags
887	        if text.contains("<mcp__") || self.state.in_mcp_xml {
888	            self.state.in_mcp_xml = true;
889	            self.state.mcp_xml_buffer.push_str(text);
890	
891	            // Check if we have a complete tag in the buffer
892	            if self.state.mcp_xml_buffer.contains("</mcp__")
893	                && self.state.mcp_xml_buffer.contains('>')
894	            {
895	                let buffer = self.state.mcp_xml_buffer.clone();
896	                if let Some(start_idx) = buffer.find("<mcp__") {
897	                    if let Some(tag_end_idx) = buffer[start_idx..].find('>') {
898	                        let actual_tag_end = start_idx + tag_end_idx;
899	                        let tool_name = &buffer[start_idx + 1..actual_tag_end];
900	                        let end_tag = format!("</{}>", tool_name);
901	
902	                        if let Some(close_idx) = buffer.find(&end_tag) {
903	                            let input_str = &buffer[actual_tag_end + 1..close_idx];
904	                            let input_json: serde_json::Value =
905	                                serde_json::from_str(input_str.trim())
906	                                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "input": input_str.trim() }));
907	
908	                            // 构造并发送 tool_use
909	                            let fc = FunctionCall {
910	                                name: tool_name.to_string(),
911	                                args: Some(input_json),
912	                                id: Some(format!("{}-xml", tool_name)),
913	                            };
914	
915	                            let tool_chunks = self.process_function_call(&fc, None);
916	
917	                            // 清理缓冲区并重置状态
918	                            self.state.mcp_xml_buffer.clear();
919	                            self.state.in_mcp_xml = false;
920	
921	                            // 处理标签之前可能存在的非 XML 文本
922	                            if start_idx > 0 {
923	                                let prefix_text = &buffer[..start_idx];
924	                                // 这里不能递归。直接 emit 之前的 text 块。
925	                                if self.state.current_block_type() != BlockType::Text {
926	                                    chunks.extend(self.state.start_block(
927	                                        BlockType::Text,
928	                                        json!({ "type": "text", "text": "" }),
929	                                    ));
930	                                }
931	                                chunks.push(

935	                            }
936	
937	                            chunks.extend(tool_chunks);

943	                                chunks.extend(self.process_text(suffix, None));
944	                            }
945	
946	                            return chunks;
947	                        }
948	                    }
949	                }
950	            }
951	            // While in XML, don't emit text deltas
952	            return vec![];
953	        }
954	
955	        if self.state.current_block_type() != BlockType::Text {
956	            chunks.extend(
957	                self.state

960	        }
961	
962	        chunks.push(self.state.emit_delta("text_delta", json!({ "text": text })));
963	
964	        chunks

39	/// Extract thinking hints from raw request JSON (OpenCode variants compatibility)
40	/// Checks multiple possible paths for budget and level configuration
41	fn extract_thinking_hint(body: &Value) -> ThinkingHint {
42	    let mut hint = ThinkingHint {
43	        budget_tokens: None,
44	        level: None,
45	    };
46	
47	    // Try to extract budget_tokens from various paths
48	    // Priority: thinking.budget_tokens > thinking.budgetTokens > thinking.budget > thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget
49	    if let Some(budget) = body
50	        .get("thinking")
51	        .and_then(|t| t.get("budget_tokens"))
52	        .and_then(|b| b.as_u64())
53	    {
54	        hint.budget_tokens = Some(budget as u32);
55	    } else if let Some(budget) = body
56	        .get("thinking")
57	        .and_then(|t| t.get("budgetTokens"))
58	        .and_then(|b| b.as_u64())
59	    {
60	        hint.budget_tokens = Some(budget as u32);
61	    } else if let Some(budget) = body
62	        .get("thinking")
63	        .and_then(|t| t.get("budget"))
64	        .and_then(|b| b.as_u64())
65	    {
66	        hint.budget_tokens = Some(budget as u32);
67	    } else if let Some(budget) = body
68	        .get("thinkingConfig")
69	        .and_then(|t| t.get("thinkingBudget"))
70	        .and_then(|b| b.as_u64())
71	    {
72	        hint.budget_tokens = Some(budget as u32);
73	    }
74	
75	    // Try to extract level from thinkingLevel
76	    if let Some(level) = body.get("thinkingLevel").and_then(|l| l.as_str()) {
77	        hint.level = Some(level.to_lowercase());
78	    }
79	
80	    hint
81	}
82	
83	/// Map thinking level to suggested budget tokens
84	fn level_to_budget(level: &str, cap: u64) -> u32 {
85	    let base = match level {
86	        "minimal" => 1024,
87	        "low" => 8192,
88	        "medium" => 16384,
89	        "high" => 24576,
90	        _ => 8192, // default to low
91	    };
92	    base.min(cap as u32)
93	}
94	
95	/// Map thinking level to effort level for output_config
96	fn level_to_effort(level: &str) -> String {
97	    match level {
98	        "minimal" | "low" => "low".to_string(),
99	        "medium" => "medium".to_string(),
100	        "high" => "high".to_string(),
101	        _ => "low".to_string(),
102	    }
103	}
104

123	            trace_id, budget
124	        );
125	        applied = true;
126	    }

134	            });
135	            tracing::debug!("[{}] Applied thinking hint: effort={}", trace_id, level);
136	            applied = true;
137	        }
138	
139	        // If no budget provided but level is, map level to budget
140	        if hint.budget_tokens.is_none() {
141	            let budget = level_to_budget(level, budget_cap);
142	            request.thinking = Some(crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::ThinkingConfig {

### 1. Protocol Formats in the System

There are **three** client-facing protocol formats and **one** internal upstream format:

| Protocol | Client Endpoint | Internal Format |
|---|---|---|
| **OpenAI** (Chat Completions) | `/v1/chat/completions` | Gemini v1internal |
| **Claude** (Messages API) | `/v1/messages` | Gemini v1internal |
| **Gemini** (Native) | `/generateContent`, `/streamGenerateContent` | Gemini v1internal |
| **v1internal** (upstream) | Google internal API | -- (this IS the wire format) |

### 3. Model Mapping (`proxy/common/model_mapping.rs`)

**`resolve_model_route()`** resolution priority:
1. **Dynamic forwarding rules** (hot API updates for deprecated models) -- highest priority
2. **Exact match** in `custom_mapping` (user-defined)
3. **Wildcard match** in `custom_mapping` (most specific pattern wins by char count minus wildcards)
4. **System default mapping** via `map_claude_model_to_gemini()`

**`CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI` mapping table** includes:
- Claude models: `claude-sonnet-4-5` -> `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-opus-4` -> `claude-opus-4-6-thinking`, old Sonnet 3.5 -> Sonnet 4.6, Haiku -> Sonnet 4.6
- OpenAI models: `gpt-4*`, `gpt-4o*`, `gpt-4o-mini*`, `gpt-3.5-turbo*` -> `gemini-2.5-flash`
- Gemini models: `gemini-2.5-flash` passthrough, `gemini-3.1-pro-low` passthrough, `gemini-3-pro` -> `gemini-3-pro-preview`, `gemini-3-flash` passthrough
- Special: `internal-background-task` -> `gemini-2.5-flash`

**`map_claude_model_to_gemini()`**: exact match -> gemini-/thinking- prefix passthrough -> unknown model passthrough (no forced fallback)

### 4. Handler Structure and Protocol Flows

#### OpenAI Handler (`proxy/handlers/openai.rs`)

- **Client sends**: OpenAI Chat Completions JSON
- **Provider dispatch check** (line 149-186):
  - If `AnthropicPassthrough` provider matches: calls `to_claude_body()` then `forward_anthropic_with_provider()` (OpenAI -> Claude -> upstream Anthropic-compatible API)
  - If `OpenAICompatible` provider: `forward_openai_compatible()` (raw passthrough, no conversion)
  - If `GeminiV1Internal`: falls through to main path
- **Main path (Gemini v1internal)**:
  - Request: `transform_openai_request()` -> Gemini v1internal JSON
  - Upstream call: `call_v1_internal()` (stream or non-stream)
  - Response streaming: `create_openai_sse_stream()` wraps Gemini SSE -> OpenAI SSE
  - Response non-streaming: `transform_openai_response()` or `collect_stream_to_json()`
  - **Auto-conversion**: non-streaming client requests are internally converted to streaming for quota benefits, then collected back to JSON

#### Claude Handler (`proxy/handlers/claude.rs`)

- **Client sends**: Claude Messages API JSON
- **Provider dispatch check** (line 312-446):
  - If `AnthropicPassthrough` provider matches: re-serializes Claude request and calls `forward_anthropic_with_provider()` (direct passthrough, NO conversion needed -- the upstream speaks Claude)
  - If legacy z.ai: same direct passthrough
- **Main path (Gemini v1internal)**:
  - Request: `transform_claude_request_in()` -> Gemini v1internal JSON
  - Upstream call: `call_v1_internal()` (stream or non-stream)
  - Response streaming: `create_claude_sse_stream()` wraps Gemini SSE -> Claude SSE
  - Response non-streaming: `transform_response()` via `NonStreamingProcessor`
  - Context management: 3-layer compression (tool trimming, thinking compression, fork+XML summary)
  - Background task detection and model downgrade

#### Gemini Handler (`proxy/handlers/gemini.rs`)

- **Client sends**: Gemini native v1beta JSON
- **No provider dispatch** -- always goes to Google v1internal
- Request: `wrap_request()` -> Gemini v1internal JSON
- Upstream call: `call_v1_internal()` (stream or non-stream)
- Response: `unwrap_response()` strips v1internal envelope, returns raw Gemini format
- **Auto-conversion**: non-streaming clients internally use streaming, then collected

### 5. Provider Dispatch (`proxy/providers/router.rs`)

**`ProviderRouter`**:
- Holds a list of `UpstreamProvider` configs
- `select(model, prev_failed)` -> picks provider by: exclusive (priority sort) -> round-robin pooled -> fallback
- `map_model(provider, incoming)` -> exact match -> prefix match -> strip `zai:` -> Claude family defaults -> passthrough
- Each provider has: `protocol` (AnthropicPassthrough | OpenAICompatible | GeminiV1Internal), `model_prefixes`, `model_mapping`, `dispatch_mode`, `priority`

**`forward_anthropic_with_provider()`** (`proxy/providers/zai_anthropic.rs`, lines 235-325):
- Generic Anthropic-compatible forwarding
- Model mapping via provider config
- Direct HTTP passthrough (no protocol conversion) -- sends Claude format to upstream, streams response back as-is
- Handles `cache_control` deep cleaning
- Sets auth headers

### 6. OpenAI Handler's `forward_openai_compatible` (lines 2490-2567)

This is a **raw passthrough** function for OpenAI-compatible upstream providers:
- Takes the OpenAI request as-is (serializes to JSON)
- POSTs to `{provider.base_url}/v1/chat/completions`
- Forwards a conservative set of headers
- Sets Bearer auth from provider API key
- Streams the response body back unchanged (no conversion)

### 7. Model Specs (`proxy/model_specs.rs`)

- `ModelSpec`: `{max_output_tokens, thinking_budget, is_thinking}`
- Loaded from `resources/model_specs.json`
- `get_max_output_tokens(model_id, token)` -- dynamic (from account) > static JSON > default 65535
- `get_thinking_budget(model_id, token)` -- static JSON > default 24576
- `is_thinking_model(model_id)` -- checks spec or contains "-thinking"/"thinking"
- Alias resolution: `resolve_alias()` normalizes model names

## Conversion Matrix: What Exists and What's Missing

### Existing Conversion Functions

| From Input | To Output | Request Converter | Response Converter | Streaming Converter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OpenAI | v1internal | `transform_openai_request()` | -- | -- |
| v1internal | OpenAI | -- | `transform_openai_response()` | `create_openai_sse_stream()` + `collect_stream_to_json()` |
| Claude | v1internal | `transform_claude_request_in()` | -- | -- |
| v1internal | Claude | -- | `transform_response()` (NonStreamingProcessor) | `create_claude_sse_stream()` + `collect_stream_to_json()` |
| Gemini native | v1internal | `wrap_request()` | -- | -- |
| v1internal | Gemini native | -- | `unwrap_response()` | -- (direct passthrough) |
| OpenAI | Claude (for AnthropicPassthrough provider) | `to_claude_body()` | -- | -- |
| OpenAI | OpenAI-compatible (passthrough) | none (`forward_openai_compatible`) | none | none |

### Missing Conversions (Not in the Matrix)

**Direct cross-protocol conversions that do NOT exist:**

1. **Claude -> OpenAI** (input Claude, return OpenAI): No direct converter. Currently this would require Claude->v1internal->OpenAI (two-hop via internal). Not needed in current architecture because the handler routing decides the protocol path upfront.

2. **OpenAI -> Claude** (input OpenAI, return Claude): Partially exists via `to_claude_body()` but only for AnthropicPassthrough provider passthrough (where the upstream speaks Claude). There is NO `transform_openai_request_to_claude()` for a full conversion chain.

3. **Gemini native -> OpenAI**: No converter. Would require Gemini->v1internal (wrap) -> OpenAI (transform_response + streaming).

4. **Gemini native -> Claude**: No converter. Would require Gemini->v1internal (wrap) -> Claude (transform_response + streaming).

5. **Any protocol -> any other protocol** as a general matrix: The architecture does NOT support arbitrary input-to-output. Instead, each handler is locked to a specific input protocol, converts to v1internal for upstream, then converts back to the SAME input protocol for the response.

### What Can Be Reused vs Needs Creation

**Reusable components:**
- All individual request converters (`transform_openai_request`, `transform_claude_request_in`, `wrap_request`)
- All individual response converters (`transform_openai_response`, `transform_response`, `unwrap_response`)
- All streaming converters (`create_openai_sse_stream`, `create_claude_sse_stream`)
- All stream collectors (`collect_stream_to_json` for both OpenAI and Claude)
- The model mapping/routing infrastructure
- The `common_utils::resolve_request_config()` for grounding detection
- Signature caching, tool schema cleaning, thinking recovery

**Would need to be created from scratch for a full matrix:**
- A **dispatcher** that can take any input protocol and route to any output protocol (the architecture currently locks input=output protocol)
- Cross-protocol response converters (e.g., OpenAI->Claude response, Claude->OpenAI response, Gemini->OpenAI, Gemini->Claude) if direct (non-v1internal) conversion is desired
- The `to_claude_body()` function referenced in the OpenAI handler (line 161) exists for AnthropicPassthrough routing but I did not find its definition in the files read -- it would need to be located in `openai/request.rs` or nearby

### 3. Model Mapping: `resolve_model_route()` (lines 253-299)

Resolution priority:
1. **Dynamic forwarding rules** (`DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES`) -- hot API updates, highest priority
2. **Exact match** in user `custom_mapping` HashMap

The `CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI` table (~80 entries) maps:

- All OpenAI family (gpt-4*, gpt-4o*, gpt-3.5*) -> `gemini-2.5-flash`
- Gemini aliases (`gemini-3-pro` -> `gemini-3-pro-preview`)
- Unknown models -> passthrough as-is

### 4. Handler Protocol Flows

#### OpenAI Handler Flow
```
Client: OpenAI Chat Completions JSON
  |
  +--> Provider check (lines 149-186):
  |    - AnthropicPassthrough -> to_claude_body() -> forward_anthropic_with_provider() -> stream back
  |    - OpenAICompatible -> forward_openai_compatible() -> stream back unchanged
  |    - GeminiV1Internal -> continue below
  |
  +--> transform_openai_request() -> Gemini v1internal JSON
  +--> upstream.call_v1_internal() -> SSE or JSON
  +--> If stream:  create_openai_sse_stream() -> OpenAI SSE to client
  +--> If no stream: transform_openai_response() OR collect_stream_to_json() -> JSON to client
```
**Auto-conversion**: Non-streaming client requests are internally forced to streaming (for quota), then collected back.

#### Claude Handler Flow
```
Client: Claude Messages API JSON
  |
  +--> Provider check (lines 312-446):
  |    - AnthropicPassthrough -> forward_anthropic_with_provider() -> stream back unchanged
  |    - Legacy z.ai -> forward_anthropic_json() -> stream back unchanged
  |    - No provider match -> continue below (Google path)
  |
  +--> transform_claude_request_in() -> Gemini v1internal JSON
  +--> upstream.call_v1_internal() -> SSE or JSON
  +--> If stream:  create_claude_sse_stream() -> Claude SSE to client
  +--> If no stream: transform_response() -> ClaudeResponse JSON to client
```

#### Gemini Handler Flow
```
Client: Gemini native JSON
  |
  +--> wrap_request() -> Gemini v1internal JSON
  +--> upstream.call_v1_internal() -> SSE or JSON
  +--> unwrap_response() -> strips v1internal envelope -> raw Gemini JSON to client
```

### 5. ProviderRouter (`proxy/providers/router.rs`)

- **`select(model, prev_failed)`** returns the next `UpstreamProvider` via: exclusive (by priority) -> round-robin pooled -> fallback
- **`map_model(provider, incoming)`** resolves to provider-native model ID via: exact match -> prefix match -> strip `zai:` -> Claude family defaults -> passthrough
- Each provider declares a `protocol`: `AnthropicPassthrough`, `OpenAICompatible`, or `GeminiV1Internal`

### 6. `forward_openai_compatible` (lines 2490-2567)

A raw HTTP passthrough for OpenAI-compatible upstream providers:
- Serializes `OpenAIRequest` to JSON, POSTs to `{base_url}/v1/chat/completions`
- Sets Bearer auth, forwards minimal headers
- Streams upstream response directly back to client with **zero conversion**

### 7. `forward_anthropic_with_provider` (lines 235-325 of `zai_anthropic.rs`)

Generic Anthropic-compatible HTTP passthrough:
- Applies model mapping, cleans `cache_control`, sets auth
- POSTs to provider base URL + `/v1/messages`
- Streams response back unchanged

### 8. Model Specs (`proxy/model_specs.rs`)

- `ModelSpec {max_output_tokens, thinking_budget, is_thinking}` from `resources/model_specs.json`
- `get_max_output_tokens()` -- dynamic account limits > static JSON > default 65535
- `get_thinking_budget()` -- static JSON > default 24576

## Conversion Matrix: What Exists and What Is Missing

### Existing Converters

| From | To | Request Function | Response Function | Streaming Function |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OpenAI | v1internal | `transform_openai_request()` | N/A | N/A |
| v1internal | OpenAI | N/A | `transform_openai_response()` | `create_openai_sse_stream()` |
| OpenAI | Claude (JSON) | `to_claude_body()` | N/A | N/A |
| Claude | v1internal | `transform_claude_request_in()` | N/A | N/A |
| v1internal | Claude | N/A | `transform_response()` | `create_claude_sse_stream()` |
| Gemini native | v1internal | `wrap_request()` | N/A | N/A |
| v1internal | Gemini native | N/A | `unwrap_response()` | direct passthrough |
| OpenAI SSE | OpenAI JSON | N/A | N/A | `collector::collect_stream_to_json()` |
| Claude SSE | Claude JSON | N/A | N/A | `claude::collect_stream_to_json()` |
| Gemini SSE | Gemini JSON | N/A | N/A | `gemini::collector::collect_stream_to_json()` |

### Missing Conversions

The architecture currently **enforces input=output protocol**. Each handler is locked to a specific client protocol. To support a full matrix (any input -> any output), you would need:

**For cross-protocol response conversion (not going through v1internal):**
1. **v1internal -> OpenAI SSE** -- exists (`create_openai_sse_stream`)
2. **v1internal -> Claude SSE** -- exists (`create_claude_sse_stream`)
3. **v1internal -> Gemini native SSE** -- missing (would need a simple passthrough-with-unwrapper)
4. **OpenAI -> Claude request** -- exists (`to_claude_body`) but limited (no tool_calls, no multimodal in detail)
5. **Claude -> OpenAI request** -- missing entirely. Would need a `to_openai_body()` that converts Claude request format to OpenAI Chat Completions
6. **Gemini native -> OpenAI response** -- missing (would compose wrap + transform_openai_response)
7. **Gemini native -> Claude response** -- missing (would compose wrap + transform_response)

**For a true "any input -> any output" matrix**, the missing pieces are:
- **Claude -> OpenAI request converter**: `transform_claude_request_to_openai()` (ClaudeRequest -> OpenAI Chat Completions JSON)
- **OpenAI -> Claude response converter**: A version of `transform_openai_response` outputting `ClaudeResponse` format
- **Claude -> OpenAI response converter**: `ClaudeResponse` struct -> `OpenAIResponse` struct
- **Gemini native -> OpenAI/Claude**: These could be composed by chaining existing functions (wrap -> transform_response), but no dedicated handler routes currently do this

### Reusable Components

Nearly all existing conversion functions are self-contained and reusable:
- All request converters output `serde_json::Value`
- All response converters take structured input (either `Value` or typed structs)
- All streaming converters are generic over the input stream type
- The signature caching, schema cleaning, tool remapping, and thinking recovery logic are all in shared utilities

### 5. Handler Dispatch Logic

#### 5a. OpenAI Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs`)

**`handle_chat_completions`** (line 28) -- Main dispatch:

1. **Image model redirection** (line 34-38): If model contains "image", "dall-e", or "midjourney", redirects to `intercept_chat_to_image` which internally calls the Gemini image generation path.

2. **Responses API auto-conversion** (line 46-91): Detects Responses API format (has `instructions`/`input` but no `messages`) and converts to Chat Completions format.

3. **ProviderRouter dispatch** (lines 150-186):
   ```
   router.select(&openai_req.model, None)
   ```
   - `AnthropicPassthrough` -> calls `to_claude_body()` then `forward_anthropic_with_provider()` to forward to upstream Anthropic-compatible provider
   - `OpenAICompatible` -> calls `forward_openai_compatible()` (direct passthrough, no conversion)
   - `GeminiV1Internal` -> falls through to the standard TokenManager + Gemini v1internal path

4. **Standard Gemini path** (lines 189+): Token acquisition, `transform_openai_request()` -> `call_v1_internal()` -> response via `create_openai_sse_stream()` or `transform_openai_response()`

**`forward_openai_compatible`** (line 2490):
- **Signature**: `async fn forward_openai_compatible(state, provider, openai_req, headers) -> Response`
- Pure passthrough: serializes `OpenAIRequest` to JSON, forwards to `{provider.base_url}/v1/chat/completions` with Bearer auth. No protocol conversion.

**`handle_images_generations`** (line ~1646): Image generation via Gemini API, wrapped as a chat response with image markdown.

#### 5b. Claude Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs`)

**`handle_messages`** (line 245) -- Main dispatch:

1. **Request parsing** with OpenCode variants thinking hints extraction (lines 40-158)

2. **ProviderRouter dispatch** (lines 313-356):
   ```
   router.select(&request.model, None)
   ```
   - If provider selected and protocol is `AnthropicPassthrough` -> `forward_anthropic_with_provider()` (direct Claude API passthrough, no Gemini conversion)
   - If no provider but `zai_enabled` in Fallback mode AND Google accounts unavailable -> falls back to legacy z.ai path via `forward_anthropic_json()`
   - Otherwise -> proceeds to Google Flow

3. **Pre-processing** (lines 358-385): clean_cache_control, merge_consecutive_messages, filter_invalid_thinking_blocks, close_tool_loop_for_thinking

4. **Warmup interception** (lines 390-396): Returns mock response to save quota

5. **Standard Gemini path**: `transform_claude_request_in()` -> `call_v1_internal()` -> response via `transform_response()` (non-streaming) or `create_claude_sse_stream()` (streaming)

#### 5c. Gemini Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/gemini.rs`)

**`handle_generate`** (line 26): Handles `generateContent` and `streamGenerateContent`

**ProviderRouter integration: NOT INTEGRATED.** The Gemini handler has zero references to `ProviderRouter`, `provider_router`, or `selected_provider`. It uses only the legacy `TokenManager` + `UpstreamClient.call_v1_internal()` path. This means:
- Gemini native protocol requests cannot be dispatched to multi-provider upstream targets
- No fallback from Gemini to other providers is possible
- The Gemini handler operates entirely on its own account pool system

---

### 6. ProviderRouter (`src/proxy/providers/router.rs`)

**Struct**: `ProviderRouter` -- holds `Vec<UpstreamProvider>` and an atomic round-robin counter.

**Key methods**:

| Method | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `new` | `fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self` | Builds router. Falls back to legacy z.ai config if providers list is empty. |
| `from_zai_config` | `fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self` | Creates single-provider router from legacy z.ai config. Protocol: `AnthropicPassthrough`. |
| `candidates_for_model` | `fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider>` | Filters providers by `model_prefixes` match (empty prefixes = wildcard). |
| `select` | `fn select(&self, model: &str, prev_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider>` | Selection priority: (1) Exclusive by priority sort, (2) Round-robin among Pooled, (3) First Fallback. |
| `map_model` | `fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String` | Model name resolution: exact match -> prefix match -> `zai:` prefix strip -> `glm-*` passthrough -> Claude family defaults -> passthrough. |
| `is_empty` | `fn is_empty(&self) -> bool` | Checks if any enabled providers exist. |

**Dispatch modes** (`ProviderDispatchMode`): `Exclusive`, `Pooled`, `Fallback`

**Protocol types** (`ProviderProtocol`): `AnthropicPassthrough`, `OpenAICompatible`, `GeminiV1Internal`

**Gap**: The `map_model` method is defined on `ProviderRouter` but is **never called** by any handler. The handlers use their own `map_model_for_zai` / `map_model_for_provider` functions in `zai_anthropic.rs` instead. This is dead code / duplicated logic.

---

### 7. zai_anthropic Forwarder (`src/proxy/providers/zai_anthropic.rs`)

**Key functions**:

| Function | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `forward_anthropic_json` | `async fn forward_anthropic_json(state, method, path, headers, body, message_count) -> Response` | Legacy z.ai passthrough. Validates z.ai is enabled, maps model name, builds HTTP client, copies passthrough headers, sets auth, cleans cache_control, forwards request, streams response back. |
| `forward_anthropic_with_provider` | `async fn forward_anthropic_with_provider(state, base_url, api_key, model_mapping, default_models, method, path, headers, body, message_count) -> Response` | Generic version of above. Used by ProviderRouter dispatch. Same logic but takes provider config directly instead of reading from state.zai. |
| `map_model_for_zai` | `fn map_model_for_zai(original: &str, state: &ZaiConfig) -> String` | Legacy model mapping for z.ai only. |
| `map_model_for_provider` | `fn map_model_for_provider(original: &str, model_mapping, default_models) -> String` | Generic model mapping for any provider. |
| `deep_remove_cache_control` | `fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value)` | Recursively strips `cache_control` fields from JSON. |
| `copy_passthrough_headers` | `fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap` | Conservative header forwarding: content-type, accept, anthropic-version, user-agent, accept-encoding, cache-control. |
| `set_zai_auth` | `fn set_zai_auth(headers, incoming, api_key)` | Sets x-api-key and/or Authorization Bearer based on what the incoming client used. |
| `join_base_url` | `fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String>` | URL path joining. |
| `build_client` | `fn build_client(upstream_proxy, timeout_secs) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String>` | HTTP client builder with optional proxy. |

**Note**: Both forwarding functions are **passthrough** -- they do NOT do protocol conversion. They forward Anthropic-format requests directly to Anthropic-compatible upstreams with model name mapping and cache_control cleaning.

### 8. Audio / Images / Other API Handlers

#### 8a. Audio Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/audio.rs`)

**`handle_audio_transcription`** (line 14)
- **Route**: `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions`
- **Input**: multipart/form-data with `file`, `model`, `prompt` fields (Whisper API compatible)
- **Output**: `{"text": "..."}` JSON
- **Flow**: Extracts audio bytes -> detects MIME type -> validates size (max 15MB) -> base64 encodes -> builds Gemini request with `inlineData` -> wraps in v1internal -> calls `call_v1_internal("generateContent")` -> extracts text response
- **Gap**: Uses the legacy TokenManager path only. No ProviderRouter integration. Hardcoded to `requestType: "text"`. No retry logic. No streaming support.

#### 8b. Audio Processor (`src/proxy/audio/mod.rs`)

Simple utility struct with three methods:
- `detect_mime_type(filename) -> Result<String, String>` -- mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, aiff/aif
- `encode_to_base64(audio_data) -> String`
- `exceeds_size_limit(size_bytes) -> bool` -- max 15MB

#### 8c. Image Handlers (in `openai.rs`)

- **Route**: `POST /v1/images/generations` -> `handle_images_generations`
- **Route**: `POST /v1/images/edits` -> `handle_images_edits`
- **Auto-redirect**: If a `/v1/chat/completions` request has a model containing "image", "dall-e", or "midjourney", it intercepts and calls `intercept_chat_to_image` which calls `handle_images_generations_internal`
- **Flow**: Extracts prompt from messages -> builds image generation request -> calls Gemini via internal path -> returns image URL as markdown in a chat completion response
- **Gap**: Images handlers also use only the legacy TokenManager path. No ProviderRouter integration.

### 9. Route Definitions (`src/proxy/server.rs`, lines 382-417)

```
POST /v1/chat/completions       -> handlers::openai::handle_chat_completions
POST /v1/completions            -> handlers::openai::handle_completions
POST /v1/responses              -> handlers::openai::handle_completions
POST /v1/images/generations     -> handlers::openai::handle_images_generations
POST /v1/images/edits           -> handlers::openai::handle_images_edits
POST /v1/audio/transcriptions   -> handlers::audio::handle_audio_transcription
POST /v1/messages               -> handlers::claude::handle_messages
POST /v1/messages/count_tokens  -> handlers::claude::handle_count_tokens
GET  /v1/models/claude          -> handlers::claude::handle_list_models
```

Gemini native routes are also defined separately (lines 429-439).

### 10. Summary of Gaps and TODOs

1. **AudioUrl passthrough not implemented** (`openai/request.rs:301-305`): OpenAI `audio_url` content blocks are converted to text placeholders rather than actual audio data.

2. **Gemini handler has no ProviderRouter integration**: The Gemini native protocol handler (`handlers/gemini.rs`) is completely independent of the multi-provider system. It cannot dispatch to external providers.

3. **`ProviderRouter.map_model()` is dead code**: Defined in `router.rs` but never called by any handler. The handlers duplicate this logic in `zai_anthropic.rs` (`map_model_for_zai`, `map_model_for_provider`).

4. **Audio/Images handlers bypass ProviderRouter**: `handle_audio_transcription`, `handle_images_generations`, and `handle_images_edits` all use the legacy TokenManager path directly, with no multi-provider support.

5. **No TTS endpoint**: There is no `/v1/audio/speech` (text-to-speech) handler. Only transcriptions (STT) exists.

6. **DALL-E models routed through chat, not native**: Image generation model names containing "dall-e" are intercepted in `handle_chat_completions` and redirected to Gemini-based image generation. There is no native DALL-E passthrough to an OpenAI-compatible provider for image endpoints.

7. **AnthropicPassthrough forwarders are pure passthrough**: `forward_anthropic_json` and `forward_anthropic_with_provider` do not perform protocol conversion -- they forward Anthropic-format requests directly. This means OpenAI clients cannot reach Anthropic providers through the Gemini path; they must go through the `AnthropicPassthrough` branch in the OpenAI handler which calls `to_claude_body()` first.
