24	/// 创建从 Gemini SSE 流到 Claude SSE 流的转换
25	pub fn create_claude_sse_stream<S, E>(
26	    mut gemini_stream: Pin<Box<S>>,
27	    trace_id: String,
28	    email: String,
29	    session_id: Option<String>, // [NEW v3.3.17] Session ID for signature caching
30	    scaling_enabled: bool, // [NEW] Flag for context usage scaling
31	    context_limit: u32,
32	    estimated_prompt_tokens: Option<u32>, // [FIX] Estimated tokens for calibrator learning
33	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Message count for rewind detection
34	    client_adapter: Option<std::sync::Arc<dyn ClientAdapter>>, // [NEW] Adapter reference
35	    registered_tool_names: Vec<String>, // [FIX #MCP] Tool names for fuzzy matching
36	) -> Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, String>> + Send>> 
37	where
38	    S: Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, E>> + Send + ?Sized + 'static,
39	    E: std::fmt::Display + Send + 'static,
40	{
41	    use async_stream::stream;
42	    use bytes::BytesMut;
43	    use futures::StreamExt;
44	
45	    Box::pin(stream! {
46	        let mut state = StreamingState::new();
47	        state.session_id = session_id; // Set session ID for signature caching
48	        state.message_count = message_count; // [NEW v4.0.0] Set message count
49	        state.scaling_enabled = scaling_enabled; // Set scaling enabled flag
50	        state.context_limit = context_limit;
51	        state.estimated_prompt_tokens = estimated_prompt_tokens; // [FIX] Pass estimated tokens
52	        state.set_client_adapter(client_adapter); // [NEW] Set adapter
53	        state.set_registered_tool_names(registered_tool_names); // [FIX #MCP] Set tool names
54	        let mut buffer = BytesMut::new();
55	
56	        loop {
57	            // [NEW] 60秒心跳保活: 延长超时时间以增加网络抖动容错
58	            let next_chunk = tokio::time::timeout(
59	                std::time::Duration::from_secs(60),
60	                gemini_stream.next()
61	            ).await;
62	
63	            match next_chunk {
64	                Ok(Some(chunk_result)) => {
65	                    match chunk_result {
66	                        Ok(chunk) => {
67	                            buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
68	
69	                            // Process complete lines
70	                            while let Some(pos) = buffer.iter().position(|&b| b == b'\n') {
71	                                let line_raw = buffer.split_to(pos + 1);
72	                                if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&line_raw) {
73	                                    let line = line_str.trim();
74	                                    if line.is_empty() { continue; }
75	
76	                                    if let Some(sse_chunks) = process_sse_line(line, &mut state, &trace_id, &email) {
77	                                        for sse_chunk in sse_chunks {
78	                                            yield Ok(sse_chunk);
79	                                        }
80	                                    }
81	                                }
82	                            }
83	                        }
84	                        Err(e) => {
85	                            let error_json = serde_json::json!({
86	                                "error": {
87	                                    "message": format!("Stream error: {}", e),
88	                                    "type": "stream_error"
89	                                }
90	                            });
91	                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!("data: {}\n\n", error_json)));
92	                            break;
93	                        }
94	                    }
95	                }
96	                Ok(None) => break, // Stream 正常结束
97	                Err(_) => {
98	                    // 超时，发送心跳包 (SSE Comment 格式)
99	                    yield Ok(Bytes::from(": ping\n\n"));
100	                }
101	            }
102	        }
103	        
104	        // [FIX #1732] Mandatory Flush remaining buffer on stream termination
105	        // Prevents hangs when the last SSE chunk doesn't end with a newline (network fragmentation)
106	        if !buffer.is_empty() {
107	             if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&buffer) {
108	                 let line = line_str.trim();
109	                 if !line.is_empty() {
110	                     tracing::debug!("[{}] SSE Termination: Flushing remaining {} bytes in buffer", trace_id, buffer.len());
111	                     if let Some(sse_chunks) = process_sse_line(line, &mut state, &trace_id, &email) {
112	                         for sse_chunk in sse_chunks {
113	                             yield Ok(sse_chunk);
114	                         }
115	                     }
116	                 }
117	             }
118	             buffer.clear();
119	        }
120	
121	        // [FIX #859] Post-thinking interruption recovery
122	        // If we have sent thinking but NO content (text/tool_use) and the stream ended (or timed out without DONE),
123	        // we must provide a fallback to prevent 0-token errors on client side.
124	        if state.has_thinking && !state.has_content {
125	            tracing::warn!("[{}] Stream interrupted after thinking (No Content). Triggering recovery...", trace_id);
126	            
127	            // 1. Force close thinking block if open
128	            if state.current_block_type() == crate::proxy::mappers::claude::streaming::BlockType::Thinking {
129	               let close_chunks = state.end_block();
130	               for chunk in close_chunks {
131	                   yield Ok(chunk);
132	               }
133	            }
134	
135	            // 2. Inject system message to inform user
136	            // We use a new text block for this.
137	            let recovery_msg = "\n\n[System] Upstream model interrupted after thinking. (Recovered by Antigravity)";
138	            let start_chunks = state.start_block(
139	                crate::proxy::mappers::claude::streaming::BlockType::Text, 
140	                serde_json::json!({ "type": "text", "text": recovery_msg })
141	            );
142	            for chunk in start_chunks { yield Ok(chunk); }
143	            
144	            let stop_chunks = state.end_block();
145	            for chunk in stop_chunks { yield Ok(chunk); }
146	
147	            // 3. Mark as content received so we don't trigger this again (though loop is done)
148	            state.has_content = true;
149	
150	            // 4. Send a simulated usage update to ensure we have > 0 output tokens
151	            // Estimate based on some default if we didn't get any usage
152	            let recovery_usage = crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::Usage {
153	                input_tokens: 0, // We don't know input, but output is critical
154	                output_tokens: 100, // Arbitrary small number to satisfy client
155	                cache_read_input_tokens: None,
156	                cache_creation_input_tokens: None,
157	                server_tool_use: None,
158	            };
159	
160	            let delta = serde_json::json!({
161	                "type": "message_delta",
162	                "delta": { "stop_reason": "end_turn", "stop_sequence": null },
163	                "usage": recovery_usage
164	            });
165	
166	            yield Ok(state.emit("message_delta", delta));
167	        }
168	
169	        // Ensure termination events are sent
170	        for chunk in emit_force_stop(&mut state) {
171	            yield Ok(chunk);
172	        }
173	    })
174	}

305	pub fn emit_force_stop(state: &mut StreamingState) -> Vec<Bytes> {
306	    if !state.message_stop_sent {

535	        // 处理错误并重试

539	            .await
540	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| format!("HTTP {}", status_code));

570	        if apply_retry_strategy(strategy, attempt, max_attempts, status_code, &trace_id).await {

572	            if let Some(adapter) = &client_adapter {

8	/// Routes incoming requests to the appropriate upstream provider.
9	pub struct ProviderRouter {
10	    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
11	    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
12	}
13	
14	impl ProviderRouter {
15	    /// Build from config. If `providers` is empty, optionally migrate from legacy z.ai config.
16	    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
17	        let enabled: Vec<_> = providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect();
18	
19	        if enabled.is_empty() {
20	            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
21	                if zai.enabled && zai.dispatch_mode != crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
22	                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
23	                }
24	            }
25	        }
26	
27	        Self {
28	            providers: enabled,
29	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
30	        }
31	    }
32	
33	    /// Build a single-provider router from legacy z.ai configuration.
34	    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
35	        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
36	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
37	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
38	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
39	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
40	        };
41	
42	        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
43	            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
44	            enabled: true,
45	            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
46	            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
47	            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
48	            dispatch_mode,
49	            priority: 0,
50	            model_prefixes: Vec::new(), // wildcard
51	            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
52	            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
53	                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
54	                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
55	                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
56	            },
57	            request_timeout_secs: None,
58	        };
59	
60	        Self {
61	            providers: vec![provider],
62	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {
72	                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
73	                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
74	            })
75	            .collect()
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
129	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
130	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
131	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
132	            return mapped.clone();
133	        }
134	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
135	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
136	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
137	            .model_mapping
138	            .iter()
139	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
140	        {
141	            return mapped.clone();
142	        }
143	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
144	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
145	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
146	        }
147	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
148	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
149	            return incoming.to_string();
150	        }
151	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
152	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
153	            if m.contains("opus") {
154	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
155	            }
156	            if m.contains("haiku") {
157	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
158	            }
159	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
160	        }
161	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
162	        incoming.to_string()
163	    }

166	    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
167	        self.providers.is_empty()
168	    }

23	    }
24	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
25	        return original.to_string();
26	    }
27	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
28	        return original.to_string();
29	    }
30	    if m.contains("opus") {
31	        return state.models.opus.clone();
32	    }
33	    if m.contains("haiku") {
34	        return state.models.haiku.clone();
35	    }
36	    state.models.sonnet.clone()
37	}

39	fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
40	    let base = base.trim_end_matches('/');
41	    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
42	        path.to_string()
43	    } else {
44	        format!("/{}", path)
45	    };
46	    Ok(format!("{}{}", base, path))
47	}
48	
49	fn build_client(
50	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
51	    timeout_secs: u64,
52	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
54	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
55	
56	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
57	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
58	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
59	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
60	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
61	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    builder
66	        .tcp_nodelay(true) // [FIX #307] Disable Nagle's algorithm to improve latency for small requests
67	        .build()
68	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
69	}
70	
71	fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap {
72	    // Only forward a conservative set of headers to avoid leaking the local proxy key or cookies.
73	    let mut out = HeaderMap::new();
74	
75	    for (k, v) in incoming.iter() {
76	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
77	        match key.as_str() {
78	            "content-type" | "accept" | "anthropic-version" | "user-agent" => {
79	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
80	            }
81	            // Some clients use these for streaming; safe to pass through.
82	            "accept-encoding" | "cache-control" => {
83	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
84	            }
85	            _ => {}
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    out
90	}
91	
92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}
112	
113	/// Recursively remove cache_control from all nested objects/arrays
114	/// [FIX #290] This is a defensive fix that works regardless of serde annotations
115	pub fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
116	    match value {
117	        Value::Object(map) => {
118	            if let Some(v) = map.remove("cache_control") {
119	                tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep Cleaning found nested cache_control: {:?}", v);
120	            }
121	            for v in map.values_mut() {
122	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {
127	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}

134	pub async fn forward_anthropic_json(
135	    state: &AppState,
136	    method: Method,
137	    path: &str,
138	    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
139	    mut body: Value,
140	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Pass message count for rewind detection
141	) -> Response {
142	    let zai = state.zai.read().await.clone();
143	    if !zai.enabled || zai.dispatch_mode == crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
144	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai is disabled").into_response();
145	    }
146	
147	    if zai.api_key.trim().is_empty() {
148	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai api_key is not set").into_response();
149	    }
150	
151	    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
152	        let mapped = map_model_for_zai(model, &zai);
153	        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
154	
155	        // [FIX] Caching for z.ai (to support thinking-filter)
156	        if let Some(sig) = body.get("thinking").and_then(|t| t.get("signature")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
157	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_session_signature(
158	                "zai-session",
159	                sig.to_string(),
160	                message_count
161	            );
162	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), mapped);
163	        }
164	    }
165	
166	    let url = match join_base_url(&zai.base_url, path) {
167	        Ok(u) => u,
168	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
169	    };
170	
171	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);
172	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
173	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
174	        Ok(c) => c,
175	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
176	    };
177	
178	    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
179	    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, &zai.api_key);
180	
181	    // Ensure JSON content type.
182	    headers
183	        .entry(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
184	        .or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));
185	
186	    // [FIX #290] Clean cache_control before sending to Anthropic API
187	    // This prevents "Extra inputs are not permitted" errors
188	    if let Some(cc) = body.get("cache_control") {
189	        tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep cleaning cache_control from ROOT: {:?}", cc);
190	    }
191	    deep_remove_cache_control(&mut body);
192	
193	    // [FIX #307] Explicitly serialize body to Vec<u8> to ensure Content-Length is set correctly.
194	    // This avoids "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" for small bodies which caused connection errors.
195	    let body_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap_or_default();
196	    let body_len = body_bytes.len();
197	    
198	    tracing::debug!("Forwarding request to z.ai (len: {} bytes): {}", body_len, url);
199	
200	    let req = client.request(method, &url)
201	        .headers(headers)
202	        .body(body_bytes); // Use .body(Vec<u8>) instead of .json()
203	
204	    let resp = match req.send().await {
205	        Ok(r) => r,
206	        Err(e) => {
207	            return (
208	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
209	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
210	            )
211	                .into_response();
212	        }
213	    };
214	
215	    let status = StatusCode::from_u16(resp.status().as_u16()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
216	
217	    let mut out = Response::builder().status(status);
218	    if let Some(ct) = resp.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE) {
219	        out = out.header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct.clone());
220	    }
221	
222	    // Stream response body to the client (covers SSE and non-SSE).
223	    let stream = resp.bytes_stream().map(|chunk| match chunk {
224	        Ok(b) => Ok::<Bytes, std::io::Error>(b),
225	        Err(e) => Ok(Bytes::from(format!("Upstream stream error: {}", e))),
226	    });
227	
228	    out.body(Body::from_stream(stream)).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
229	        (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to build response").into_response()
230	    })
231	}

233	/// Generic Anthropic-compatible provider forwarding.
234	/// Used by the multi-provider API gateway to forward requests to any configured provider.
235	pub async fn forward_anthropic_with_provider(
236	    state: &AppState,
237	    base_url: &str,
238	    api_key: &str,
239	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
240	    default_models: &crate::proxy::config::ProviderModelDefaults,

246	) -> Response {
247	    if api_key.trim().is_empty() {
248	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "Provider api_key is not set").into_response();
249	    }
250	
251	    // Model mapping
252	    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
253	        let mapped = map_model_for_provider(model, model_mapping, default_models);
254	        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
255	
256	        // Signature caching
257	        if let Some(sig) = body.get("thinking").and_then(|t| t.get("signature")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
258	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_session_signature(
259	                "provider-session",
260	                sig.to_string(),
261	                message_count
262	            );
263	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), mapped);
264	        }
265	    }
266	
267	    let url = match join_base_url(base_url, path) {
268	        Ok(u) => u,
269	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
270	    };
271	
272	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);
273	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
274	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
275	        Ok(c) => c,
276	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
277	    };
278	
279	    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
280	    // Set auth using the provider's API key
281	    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, api_key);
282	
283	    // Ensure JSON content type
284	    headers
285	        .entry(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
286	        .or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));
287	
288	    deep_remove_cache_control(&mut body);
289	
290	    let body_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap_or_default();
291	    let body_len = body_bytes.len();
292	
293	    tracing::debug!("Forwarding request to provider (len: {} bytes): {}", body_len, url);
294	
295	    let req = client.request(method, &url)
296	        .headers(headers)
297	        .body(body_bytes);
298	
299	    let resp = match req.send().await {
300	        Ok(r) => r,
301	        Err(e) => {
302	            return (
303	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
304	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
305	            )
306	                .into_response();
307	        }
308	    };
309	
310	    let status = StatusCode::from_u16(resp.status().as_u16()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
311	
312	    let mut out = Response::builder().status(status);
313	    if let Some(ct) = resp.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE) {
314	        out = out.header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct.clone());
315	    }
316	
317	    let stream = resp.bytes_stream().map(|chunk| match chunk {
318	        Ok(b) => Ok::<Bytes, std::io::Error>(b),
319	        Err(e) => Ok(Bytes::from(format!("Upstream stream error: {}", e))),
320	    });
321	
322	    out.body(Body::from_stream(stream)).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
323	        (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to build response").into_response()
324	    })
325	}

327	/// Model mapping for generic providers (similar to map_model_for_zai but uses provider config).
328	fn map_model_for_provider(
329	    original: &str,
330	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
331	    default_models: &crate::proxy::config::ProviderModelDefaults,
332	) -> String {
333	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
334	    // 1. Exact match
335	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
336	        return mapped.clone();
337	    }
338	    // 2. Lowercase match
339	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
340	        return mapped.clone();
341	    }
342	    // 3. zai: prefix strip
343	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
344	        return original[4..].to_string();
345	    }
346	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
347	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
348	        return original.to_string();
349	    }
350	    // 5. Claude family defaults
351	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
352	        return original.to_string();
353	    }
354	    if m.contains("opus") {
355	        return default_models.opus.clone();
356	    }
357	    if m.contains("haiku") {
358	        return default_models.haiku.clone();
359	    }
360	    default_models.sonnet.clone()
361	}

13	/// Safety threshold levels for Gemini API
14	/// Can be configured via GEMINI_SAFETY_THRESHOLD environment variable
15	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
16	pub enum SafetyThreshold {
17	    /// Disable all safety filters (default for proxy compatibility)
18	    Off,
19	    /// Block low probability and above
20	    BlockLowAndAbove,
21	    /// Block medium probability and above
22	    BlockMediumAndAbove,
23	    /// Only block high probability content
24	    BlockOnlyHigh,
25	    /// Don't block anything (BLOCK_NONE)
26	    BlockNone,
27	}
28	
29	impl SafetyThreshold {
30	    /// Get threshold from environment variable or default to Off
31	    pub fn from_env() -> Self {
32	        match std::env::var("GEMINI_SAFETY_THRESHOLD").as_deref() {
33	            Ok("OFF") | Ok("off") => SafetyThreshold::Off,
34	            Ok("LOW") | Ok("low") => SafetyThreshold::BlockLowAndAbove,
35	            Ok("MEDIUM") | Ok("medium") => SafetyThreshold::BlockMediumAndAbove,
36	            Ok("HIGH") | Ok("high") => SafetyThreshold::BlockOnlyHigh,
37	            Ok("NONE") | Ok("none") => SafetyThreshold::BlockNone,
38	            _ => SafetyThreshold::Off, // Default: maintain current behavior
39	        }
40	    }
41	
42	    /// Convert to Gemini API threshold string
43	    pub fn to_gemini_threshold(&self) -> &'static str {
44	        match self {
45	            SafetyThreshold::Off => "OFF",
46	            SafetyThreshold::BlockLowAndAbove => "BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE",
47	            SafetyThreshold::BlockMediumAndAbove => "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE",
48	            SafetyThreshold::BlockOnlyHigh => "BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH",
49	            SafetyThreshold::BlockNone => "BLOCK_NONE",
50	        }

## Protocol Conversion Infrastructure Report

### 1. Mapper Module Structure (`src/proxy/mappers/mod.rs`)

This is the central protocol conversion module. It contains the following sub-modules:

| Sub-module | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `claude` | Claude to Gemini v1internal conversion |
| `common_utils` | Shared utilities (resolve_request_config, deep_clean_undefined) |
| `context_manager` | Context compression |
| `error_classifier` | Error classification for retries |
| `estimation_calibrated` | Token estimation calibration |
| `gemini` | Gemini v1internal wrap/unwrap |
| `model_limits` | Model-specific limits |
| `openai` | OpenAI to Gemini v1internal conversion |
| `signature_store` | Thinking signature management |
| `tool_result_compressor` | Tool result compression |

---

### 2. OpenAI Mapper (`src/proxy/mappers/openai/`)

**Module file**: `openai/mod.rs`
Exports: `models`, `request`, `response`, `streaming`, `collector`, `thinking_recovery`

#### 2a. Request Conversion (`openai/request.rs`)

**Key function: `transform_openai_request`** (line 8)
- **Signature**: `fn transform_openai_request(request: &OpenAIRequest, project_id: &str, mapped_model: &str, token: Option<&ProxyToken>) -> (Value, String, usize)`
- **Input**: OpenAI Chat Completions request (typed struct `OpenAIRequest`)
- **Output**: `(Value, String, usize)` -- a Gemini v1internal JSON body, session_id, and message_count
- **What it does**: Converts OpenAI messages (text, image_url, audio_url), tools, system prompts, thinking config, streaming flags into a Gemini `v1internal` wrapped request. Has special handling for Gemini 3 thinking models, Gemini flash thinking, Claude passthrough, and thinking auto-enable logic.

**Key function: `to_claude_body`** (line 1204)
- **Signature**: `fn to_claude_body(request: &OpenAIRequest) -> Value`
- **Input**: OpenAI Chat Completions request
- **Output**: Anthropic-style JSON body (`Value`)
- **What it does**: Converts OpenAI messages into Anthropic `messages` format for AnthropicPassthrough providers. System messages become top-level `system` field. Maps roles: `system`->`user`, `assistant`->`assistant`, `tool`/`function`->`user`.

**Known gaps**:
- Line 301-305: `AudioUrl` content blocks are converted to a plain text placeholder `[audio: {url}]` with the comment "Skipping audio_url (not yet implemented in v3.3.16)". Real audio passthrough to upstream is not supported.

#### 2b. Response Conversion (`openai/response.rs`)

**Key function: `transform_openai_response`** (line 5)
- **Signature**: `fn transform_openai_response(gemini_response: &Value, session_id: Option<&str>, message_count: usize) -> OpenAIResponse`
- **Input**: Gemini JSON response (`Value` -- raw `candidates[].content.parts[]` format)
- **Output**: `OpenAIResponse` typed struct (id, object, created, model, choices, usage)
- **What it does**: Extracts text, thought, tool_calls, grounding metadata (web search), and image inline data from Gemini response parts. Maps Gemini finish reasons (STOP->stop, MAX_TOKENS->length, SAFETY/RECITATION->content_filter). Maps usage metadata (promptTokenCount->prompt_tokens, etc.). Handles thoughtSignature caching.

---

### 3. Claude Mapper (`src/proxy/mappers/claude/`)

**Module file**: `claude/mod.rs`
Exports: `models`, `request`, `response`, `streaming`, `utils`, `thinking_utils`, `collector`

Public re-exports: `transform_claude_request_in`, `clean_cache_control_from_messages`, `merge_consecutive_messages`, `transform_response`, `PartProcessor`, `StreamingState`, `close_tool_loop_for_thinking`, `filter_invalid_thinking_blocks_with_family`, `collect_stream_to_json`

**Key function: `create_claude_sse_stream`** (line 25)
- **Signature**: Generic function converting a Gemini SSE byte stream into Claude SSE format
- **Input**: `Pin<Box<S>>` where S yields `Result<Bytes, E>` (Gemini SSE stream)
- **Output**: `Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, String>> + Send>>` (Claude SSE stream)
- **What it does**: Stateful streaming converter using `StreamingState`. Handles 60-second heartbeat/keepalive, buffering, post-thinking interruption recovery, mandatory flush on stream termination, and force-stop event emission.

#### 3a. Request Conversion (`claude/request.rs`)

**Key function: `transform_claude_request_in`** (line 335)
- **Signature**: `fn transform_claude_request_in(claude_req: &ClaudeRequest, project_id: &str, is_retry: bool, account_id: Option<&str>, session_id: &str, token: Option<&ProxyToken>) -> Result<Value, String>`
- **Input**: Typed `ClaudeRequest` (Anthropic messages API format)
- **Output**: Gemini v1internal wrapped JSON body (`Value`)
- **What it does**: Cleans cache_control, merges consecutive same-role messages, sorts thinking blocks first, injects default thinking config for models like Opus, converts Claude content blocks (text, image, tool_use, tool_result) into Gemini parts format, wraps in v1internal envelope (project, requestId, model, requestType, userAgent).

#### 3b. Response Conversion (`claude/response.rs`)

**Key function: `transform_response`** (line 540)
- **Signature**: `fn transform_response(gemini_response: &GeminiResponse, scaling_enabled: bool, context_limit: u32, session_id: Option<String>, model_name: String, message_count: usize) -> Result<ClaudeResponse, String>`
- **Input**: Typed `GeminiResponse` struct
- **Output**: `ClaudeResponse` typed struct (type, role, content, stop_reason, stop_sequence, usage, model)
- **What it does**: Uses `NonStreamingProcessor` internally to convert Gemini candidates/parts into Claude content blocks. Handles thinking blocks, tool calls, grounding metadata.

### 4. Gemini Mapper (`src/proxy/mappers/gemini/`)

**Module file**: `gemini/mod.rs`
Exports: `models`, `wrapper`, `collector`

#### 4a. Wrapper (`gemini/wrapper.rs`)

**Key function: `wrap_request`** (line 5)
- **Signature**: `fn wrap_request(body: &Value, project_id: &str, mapped_model: &str, account_id: Option<&str>, session_id: Option<&str>, token: Option<&ProxyToken>) -> Value`
- **Input**: Raw Gemini-format JSON body (`Value`)
- **Output**: v1internal wrapped JSON (`Value` with `project`, `request`, `model`, `userAgent`, `requestType` envelope)
- **What it does**: Wraps a Gemini native request in the Google v1internal envelope. Deep-cleans `[undefined]` strings, injects dummy tool call IDs for Claude models, and injects dynamic model specs from the token object.

**Key function: `unwrap_response`** (referenced in Gemini handler)
- **Input**: v1internal wrapped response (`Value`)
- **Output**: Inner Gemini response (`Value`)
- **What it does**: Extracts the `response` field if present, otherwise returns the input as-is.

### 5. Handler Dispatch Logic

#### 5a. OpenAI Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs`)

**`handle_chat_completions`** (line 28) -- Main dispatch:

1. **Image model redirection** (line 34-38): If model contains "image", "dall-e", or "midjourney", redirects to `intercept_chat_to_image` which internally calls the Gemini image generation path.

2. **Responses API auto-conversion** (line 46-91): Detects Responses API format (has `instructions`/`input` but no `messages`) and converts to Chat Completions format.

3. **ProviderRouter dispatch** (lines 150-186):
   ```
   router.select(&openai_req.model, None)
   ```
   - `AnthropicPassthrough` -> calls `to_claude_body()` then `forward_anthropic_with_provider()` to forward to upstream Anthropic-compatible provider
   - `OpenAICompatible` -> calls `forward_openai_compatible()` (direct passthrough, no conversion)
   - `GeminiV1Internal` -> falls through to the standard TokenManager + Gemini v1internal path

4. **Standard Gemini path** (lines 189+): Token acquisition, `transform_openai_request()` -> `call_v1_internal()` -> response via `create_openai_sse_stream()` or `transform_openai_response()`

**`forward_openai_compatible`** (line 2490):
- **Signature**: `async fn forward_openai_compatible(state, provider, openai_req, headers) -> Response`
- Pure passthrough: serializes `OpenAIRequest` to JSON, forwards to `{provider.base_url}/v1/chat/completions` with Bearer auth. No protocol conversion.

**`handle_images_generations`** (line ~1646): Image generation via Gemini API, wrapped as a chat response with image markdown.

#### 5b. Claude Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs`)

**`handle_messages`** (line 245) -- Main dispatch:

1. **Request parsing** with OpenCode variants thinking hints extraction (lines 40-158)

2. **ProviderRouter dispatch** (lines 313-356):
   ```
   router.select(&request.model, None)
   ```
   - If provider selected and protocol is `AnthropicPassthrough` -> `forward_anthropic_with_provider()` (direct Claude API passthrough, no Gemini conversion)
   - If no provider but `zai_enabled` in Fallback mode AND Google accounts unavailable -> falls back to legacy z.ai path via `forward_anthropic_json()`
   - Otherwise -> proceeds to Google Flow

3. **Pre-processing** (lines 358-385): clean_cache_control, merge_consecutive_messages, filter_invalid_thinking_blocks, close_tool_loop_for_thinking

4. **Warmup interception** (lines 390-396): Returns mock response to save quota

5. **Standard Gemini path**: `transform_claude_request_in()` -> `call_v1_internal()` -> response via `transform_response()` (non-streaming) or `create_claude_sse_stream()` (streaming)

#### 5c. Gemini Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/gemini.rs`)

**`handle_generate`** (line 26): Handles `generateContent` and `streamGenerateContent`

**ProviderRouter integration: NOT INTEGRATED.** The Gemini handler has zero references to `ProviderRouter`, `provider_router`, or `selected_provider`. It uses only the legacy `TokenManager` + `UpstreamClient.call_v1_internal()` path. This means:
- Gemini native protocol requests cannot be dispatched to multi-provider upstream targets
- No fallback from Gemini to other providers is possible
- The Gemini handler operates entirely on its own account pool system

---

### 6. ProviderRouter (`src/proxy/providers/router.rs`)

**Struct**: `ProviderRouter` -- holds `Vec<UpstreamProvider>` and an atomic round-robin counter.

**Key methods**:

| Method | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `new` | `fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self` | Builds router. Falls back to legacy z.ai config if providers list is empty. |
| `from_zai_config` | `fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self` | Creates single-provider router from legacy z.ai config. Protocol: `AnthropicPassthrough`. |
| `candidates_for_model` | `fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider>` | Filters providers by `model_prefixes` match (empty prefixes = wildcard). |
| `select` | `fn select(&self, model: &str, prev_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider>` | Selection priority: (1) Exclusive by priority sort, (2) Round-robin among Pooled, (3) First Fallback. |
| `map_model` | `fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String` | Model name resolution: exact match -> prefix match -> `zai:` prefix strip -> `glm-*` passthrough -> Claude family defaults -> passthrough. |
| `is_empty` | `fn is_empty(&self) -> bool` | Checks if any enabled providers exist. |

**Dispatch modes** (`ProviderDispatchMode`): `Exclusive`, `Pooled`, `Fallback`

**Protocol types** (`ProviderProtocol`): `AnthropicPassthrough`, `OpenAICompatible`, `GeminiV1Internal`

**Gap**: The `map_model` method is defined on `ProviderRouter` but is **never called** by any handler. The handlers use their own `map_model_for_zai` / `map_model_for_provider` functions in `zai_anthropic.rs` instead. This is dead code / duplicated logic.

---

### 7. zai_anthropic Forwarder (`src/proxy/providers/zai_anthropic.rs`)

**Key functions**:

| Function | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `forward_anthropic_json` | `async fn forward_anthropic_json(state, method, path, headers, body, message_count) -> Response` | Legacy z.ai passthrough. Validates z.ai is enabled, maps model name, builds HTTP client, copies passthrough headers, sets auth, cleans cache_control, forwards request, streams response back. |
| `forward_anthropic_with_provider` | `async fn forward_anthropic_with_provider(state, base_url, api_key, model_mapping, default_models, method, path, headers, body, message_count) -> Response` | Generic version of above. Used by ProviderRouter dispatch. Same logic but takes provider config directly instead of reading from state.zai. |
| `map_model_for_zai` | `fn map_model_for_zai(original: &str, state: &ZaiConfig) -> String` | Legacy model mapping for z.ai only. |
| `map_model_for_provider` | `fn map_model_for_provider(original: &str, model_mapping, default_models) -> String` | Generic model mapping for any provider. |
| `deep_remove_cache_control` | `fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value)` | Recursively strips `cache_control` fields from JSON. |
| `copy_passthrough_headers` | `fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap` | Conservative header forwarding: content-type, accept, anthropic-version, user-agent, accept-encoding, cache-control. |
| `set_zai_auth` | `fn set_zai_auth(headers, incoming, api_key)` | Sets x-api-key and/or Authorization Bearer based on what the incoming client used. |
| `join_base_url` | `fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String>` | URL path joining. |
| `build_client` | `fn build_client(upstream_proxy, timeout_secs) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String>` | HTTP client builder with optional proxy. |

**Note**: Both forwarding functions are **passthrough** -- they do NOT do protocol conversion. They forward Anthropic-format requests directly to Anthropic-compatible upstreams with model name mapping and cache_control cleaning.

### 8. Audio / Images / Other API Handlers

#### 8a. Audio Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/audio.rs`)

**`handle_audio_transcription`** (line 14)
- **Route**: `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions`
- **Input**: multipart/form-data with `file`, `model`, `prompt` fields (Whisper API compatible)
- **Output**: `{"text": "..."}` JSON
- **Flow**: Extracts audio bytes -> detects MIME type -> validates size (max 15MB) -> base64 encodes -> builds Gemini request with `inlineData` -> wraps in v1internal -> calls `call_v1_internal("generateContent")` -> extracts text response
- **Gap**: Uses the legacy TokenManager path only. No ProviderRouter integration. Hardcoded to `requestType: "text"`. No retry logic. No streaming support.

#### 8b. Audio Processor (`src/proxy/audio/mod.rs`)

Simple utility struct with three methods:
- `detect_mime_type(filename) -> Result<String, String>` -- mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, aiff/aif
- `encode_to_base64(audio_data) -> String`
- `exceeds_size_limit(size_bytes) -> bool` -- max 15MB

#### 8c. Image Handlers (in `openai.rs`)

- **Route**: `POST /v1/images/generations` -> `handle_images_generations`
- **Route**: `POST /v1/images/edits` -> `handle_images_edits`
- **Auto-redirect**: If a `/v1/chat/completions` request has a model containing "image", "dall-e", or "midjourney", it intercepts and calls `intercept_chat_to_image` which calls `handle_images_generations_internal`
- **Flow**: Extracts prompt from messages -> builds image generation request -> calls Gemini via internal path -> returns image URL as markdown in a chat completion response
- **Gap**: Images handlers also use only the legacy TokenManager path. No ProviderRouter integration.

### 9. Route Definitions (`src/proxy/server.rs`, lines 382-417)

```
POST /v1/chat/completions       -> handlers::openai::handle_chat_completions
POST /v1/completions            -> handlers::openai::handle_completions
POST /v1/responses              -> handlers::openai::handle_completions
POST /v1/images/generations     -> handlers::openai::handle_images_generations
POST /v1/images/edits           -> handlers::openai::handle_images_edits
POST /v1/audio/transcriptions   -> handlers::audio::handle_audio_transcription
POST /v1/messages               -> handlers::claude::handle_messages
POST /v1/messages/count_tokens  -> handlers::claude::handle_count_tokens
GET  /v1/models/claude          -> handlers::claude::handle_list_models
```

Gemini native routes are also defined separately (lines 429-439).

### 10. Summary of Gaps and TODOs

1. **AudioUrl passthrough not implemented** (`openai/request.rs:301-305`): OpenAI `audio_url` content blocks are converted to text placeholders rather than actual audio data.

2. **Gemini handler has no ProviderRouter integration**: The Gemini native protocol handler (`handlers/gemini.rs`) is completely independent of the multi-provider system. It cannot dispatch to external providers.

3. **`ProviderRouter.map_model()` is dead code**: Defined in `router.rs` but never called by any handler. The handlers duplicate this logic in `zai_anthropic.rs` (`map_model_for_zai`, `map_model_for_provider`).

4. **Audio/Images handlers bypass ProviderRouter**: `handle_audio_transcription`, `handle_images_generations`, and `handle_images_edits` all use the legacy TokenManager path directly, with no multi-provider support.

5. **No TTS endpoint**: There is no `/v1/audio/speech` (text-to-speech) handler. Only transcriptions (STT) exists.

6. **DALL-E models routed through chat, not native**: Image generation model names containing "dall-e" are intercepted in `handle_chat_completions` and redirected to Gemini-based image generation. There is no native DALL-E passthrough to an OpenAI-compatible provider for image endpoints.

7. **AnthropicPassthrough forwarders are pure passthrough**: `forward_anthropic_json` and `forward_anthropic_with_provider` do not perform protocol conversion -- they forward Anthropic-format requests directly. This means OpenAI clients cannot reach Anthropic providers through the Gemini path; they must go through the `AnthropicPassthrough` branch in the OpenAI handler which calls `to_claude_body()` first.

### 5. Response Conversion Chain Architecture

The clean architecture for response conversion is:

```
Input Protocol Handler
  |
  v
[Protocol] -> v1internal Request Mapper
  |
  v
Upstream Call (Gemini v1internal / Anthropic SSE / OpenAI SSE)
  |
  v
[Upstream Response] -> Output Protocol Response Mapper
  |
  v
Output Protocol SSE/JSON to Client
```

The key principle: **the handler knows the input protocol, and the response mapper knows the output protocol. They are the same.** The response conversion chain is always:

```
Upstream Response -> Gemini v1internal (unwrapped if needed) -> Output Protocol
```

For Anthropic-passthrough and OpenAI-compatible upstreams, the response comes back in the upstream's native format. A thin "bridge" function converts it to the client's expected format:

- Anthropic SSE -> OpenAI SSE: `create_openai_sse_from_anthropic_stream()`
- Anthropic SSE -> Claude SSE: Direct passthrough (no conversion needed)
- Anthropic SSE -> Gemini SSE: `create_gemini_sse_from_anthropic_stream()`
- OpenAI SSE -> Claude SSE: `create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream()` (new)
- OpenAI SSE -> OpenAI SSE: Direct passthrough
- OpenAI SSE -> Gemini SSE: `create_gemini_sse_from_openai_stream()` (new)

### 6. Dependency Graph

```
Phase 1 (OpenAI -> v1internal via ProviderRouter)
  depends on: existing mappers (no new mappers needed)
  
Phase 2 (Claude -> OpenAI-Compatible)
  depends on: claude_to_openai_body() [NEW]
  depends on: openai_to_claude_response() [NEW]
  depends on: create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream() [NEW]
  
Phase 3 (Gemini -> ProviderRouter)
  depends on: gemini_to_claude_body() [NEW]
  depends on: claude_to_gemini_response() [NEW]
  depends on: gemini_to_openai_body() [NEW]
  depends on: openai_to_gemini_response() [NEW]
  
Phase 4 (map_model cleanup)
  no dependencies, safe to do in parallel with any phase
  
Phase 5 (Audio/Images)
  depends on: Phase 1-3 patterns established
```

### 7. Risk Mitigation

- **Each phase is independently testable.** Phase 1 does not break anything -- it only fills in an empty match arm. Phase 2 only activates when `ProviderRouter` selects `OpenAICompatible` for a Claude request (which does not happen with current default config).
- **Empty providers = full backward compatibility.** The `router.is_empty()` check at the top of each handler ensures the existing TokenManager path is unchanged when no providers are configured.
- **`cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`** must pass after each phase.
- **New mappers should have unit tests** modeled after the existing tests in `response.rs`, `streaming.rs`, and `wrapper.rs`.

## Context

The project at `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/` is a Tauri desktop app that acts as a local AI API gateway. It currently converts web-based AI sessions into standardized API endpoints.

- **OpenAI Chat → Anthropic (passthrough)**: `to_claude_body()` in `proxy/mappers/openai/request.rs:1204`

- **NOT** integrated into Gemini handler, audio handler, or images handlers

1	use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
2	use std::sync::Arc;
3	
4	use crate::proxy::config::{
5	    ProviderDispatchMode, ProviderModelDefaults, ProviderProtocol, UpstreamProvider, ZaiConfig,
6	};
7	
8	/// Routes incoming requests to the appropriate upstream provider.
9	pub struct ProviderRouter {
10	    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
11	    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
12	}
13	
14	impl ProviderRouter {
15	    /// Build from config. If `providers` is empty, optionally migrate from legacy z.ai config.
16	    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
17	        let enabled: Vec<_> = providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect();
18	
19	        if enabled.is_empty() {
20	            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
21	                if zai.enabled && zai.dispatch_mode != crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
22	                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
23	                }
24	            }
25	        }
26	
27	        Self {
28	            providers: enabled,
29	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
30	        }
31	    }
32	
33	    /// Build a single-provider router from legacy z.ai configuration.
34	    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
35	        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
36	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
37	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
38	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
39	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
40	        };
41	
42	        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
43	            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
44	            enabled: true,
45	            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
46	            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
47	            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
48	            dispatch_mode,
49	            priority: 0,
50	            model_prefixes: Vec::new(), // wildcard
51	            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
52	            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
53	                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
54	                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
55	                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
56	            },
57	            request_timeout_secs: None,
58	        };
59	
60	        Self {
61	            providers: vec![provider],
62	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {
72	                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
73	                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
74	            })
75	            .collect()
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
129	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
130	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
131	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
132	            return mapped.clone();
133	        }
134	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
135	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
136	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
137	            .model_mapping
138	            .iter()
139	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
140	        {
141	            return mapped.clone();
142	        }
143	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
144	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
145	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
146	        }
147	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
148	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
149	            return incoming.to_string();
150	        }
151	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
152	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
153	            if m.contains("opus") {
154	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
155	            }
156	            if m.contains("haiku") {
157	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
158	            }
159	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
160	        }
161	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
162	        incoming.to_string()
163	    }
164	
165	    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
166	    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
167	        self.providers.is_empty()
168	    }
169	}

13	fn map_model_for_zai(original: &str, state: &crate::proxy::ZaiConfig) -> String {
14	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
15	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(original) {
16	        return mapped.clone();
17	    }
18	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(&m) {
19	        return mapped.clone();
20	    }
21	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
22	        return original[4..].to_string();
23	    }
24	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
25	        return original.to_string();
26	    }
27	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
28	        return original.to_string();
29	    }
30	    if m.contains("opus") {
31	        return state.models.opus.clone();
32	    }
33	    if m.contains("haiku") {
34	        return state.models.haiku.clone();
35	    }
36	    state.models.sonnet.clone()
37	}
38	
39	fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
40	    let base = base.trim_end_matches('/');
41	    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
42	        path.to_string()
43	    } else {
44	        format!("/{}", path)
45	    };
46	    Ok(format!("{}{}", base, path))
47	}
48	
49	fn build_client(
50	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
51	    timeout_secs: u64,
52	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
54	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
55	
56	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
57	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
58	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
59	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
60	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
61	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    builder
66	        .tcp_nodelay(true) // [FIX #307] Disable Nagle's algorithm to improve latency for small requests
67	        .build()
68	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
69	}
70	
71	fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap {
72	    // Only forward a conservative set of headers to avoid leaking the local proxy key or cookies.
73	    let mut out = HeaderMap::new();
74	
75	    for (k, v) in incoming.iter() {
76	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
77	        match key.as_str() {
78	            "content-type" | "accept" | "anthropic-version" | "user-agent" => {
79	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
80	            }
81	            // Some clients use these for streaming; safe to pass through.
82	            "accept-encoding" | "cache-control" => {
83	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
84	            }
85	            _ => {}
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    out
90	}
91	
92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}

113	/// Recursively remove cache_control from all nested objects/arrays
114	/// [FIX #290] This is a defensive fix that works regardless of serde annotations
115	pub fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
116	    match value {
117	        Value::Object(map) => {
118	            if let Some(v) = map.remove("cache_control") {
119	                tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep Cleaning found nested cache_control: {:?}", v);
120	            }
121	            for v in map.values_mut() {
122	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {
127	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}

206	        Err(e) => {
207	            return (
208	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
209	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
210	            )
211	                .into_response();
212	        }
213	    };
214	
215	    let status = StatusCode::from_u16(resp.status().as_u16()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
216	
217	    let mut out = Response::builder().status(status);
218	    if let Some(ct) = resp.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE) {
219	        out = out.header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct.clone());
220	    }
221	
222	    // Stream response body to the client (covers SSE and non-SSE).
223	    let stream = resp.bytes_stream().map(|chunk| match chunk {
224	        Ok(b) => Ok::<Bytes, std::io::Error>(b),
225	        Err(e) => Ok(Bytes::from(format!("Upstream stream error: {}", e))),
226	    });
227	
228	    out.body(Body::from_stream(stream)).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
229	        (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to build response").into_response()
230	    })
231	}
232	
233	/// Generic Anthropic-compatible provider forwarding.
234	/// Used by the multi-provider API gateway to forward requests to any configured provider.
235	pub async fn forward_anthropic_with_provider(
236	    state: &AppState,
237	    base_url: &str,
238	    api_key: &str,
239	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
240	    default_models: &crate::proxy::config::ProviderModelDefaults,
241	    method: Method,
242	    path: &str,
243	    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
244	    mut body: Value,
245	    message_count: usize,
246	) -> Response {
247	    if api_key.trim().is_empty() {
248	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "Provider api_key is not set").into_response();
249	    }
250	
251	    // Model mapping
252	    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
253	        let mapped = map_model_for_provider(model, model_mapping, default_models);
254	        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
255	
256	        // Signature caching
257	        if let Some(sig) = body.get("thinking").and_then(|t| t.get("signature")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
258	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_session_signature(
259	                "provider-session",
260	                sig.to_string(),
261	                message_count
262	            );
263	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), mapped);
264	        }
265	    }
266	
267	    let url = match join_base_url(base_url, path) {
268	        Ok(u) => u,
269	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
270	    };
271	
272	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);
273	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
274	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
275	        Ok(c) => c,
276	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
277	    };
278	
279	    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
280	    // Set auth using the provider's API key
281	    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, api_key);
282	
283	    // Ensure JSON content type
284	    headers
285	        .entry(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
286	        .or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));
287	
288	    deep_remove_cache_control(&mut body);
289	
290	    let body_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap_or_default();
291	    let body_len = body_bytes.len();
292	
293	    tracing::debug!("Forwarding request to provider (len: {} bytes): {}", body_len, url);
294	
295	    let req = client.request(method, &url)
296	        .headers(headers)
297	        .body(body_bytes);
298	
299	    let resp = match req.send().await {
300	        Ok(r) => r,
301	        Err(e) => {
302	            return (
303	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
304	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
305	            )
306	                .into_response();
307	        }
308	    };
309	
310	    let status = StatusCode::from_u16(resp.status().as_u16()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
311	
312	    let mut out = Response::builder().status(status);
313	    if let Some(ct) = resp.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE) {
314	        out = out.header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct.clone());
315	    }
316	
317	    let stream = resp.bytes_stream().map(|chunk| match chunk {
318	        Ok(b) => Ok::<Bytes, std::io::Error>(b),
319	        Err(e) => Ok(Bytes::from(format!("Upstream stream error: {}", e))),
320	    });
321	
322	    out.body(Body::from_stream(stream)).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
323	        (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to build response").into_response()
324	    })
325	}
326	
327	/// Model mapping for generic providers (similar to map_model_for_zai but uses provider config).
328	fn map_model_for_provider(
329	    original: &str,
330	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
331	    default_models: &crate::proxy::config::ProviderModelDefaults,
332	) -> String {
333	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
334	    // 1. Exact match
335	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
336	        return mapped.clone();
337	    }
338	    // 2. Lowercase match
339	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
340	        return mapped.clone();
341	    }
342	    // 3. zai: prefix strip
343	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
344	        return original[4..].to_string();
345	    }
346	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
347	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
348	        return original.to_string();
349	    }
350	    // 5. Claude family defaults
351	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
352	        return original.to_string();
353	    }
354	    if m.contains("opus") {
355	        return default_models.opus.clone();
356	    }
357	    if m.contains("haiku") {
358	        return default_models.haiku.clone();
359	    }
360	    default_models.sonnet.clone()
361	}
362

313	    // ProviderRouter replaces the old z.ai dispatch logic with a generic multi-provider system.
314	    let router = state.provider_router.read().await;
315	    let selected_provider = if !router.is_empty() {
316	        router.select(&request.model, None)
317	    } else {
318	        None
319	    };
320	
321	    // Determine routing decision and track which provider (if any) was selected
322	    let (use_zai, provider_name) = if let Some(provider) = selected_provider {
323	        let is_anthropic = matches!(provider.protocol, crate::proxy::config::ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough);
324	        (is_anthropic, Some(provider.name.clone()))
325	    } else if zai_enabled {
326	        // Legacy z.ai fallback when no providers are configured
327	        let use_legacy = match zai.dispatch_mode {
328	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => false,
329	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => true,
330	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => {
331	                if google_accounts == 0 {
332	                    tracing::info!("[{}] No Google accounts available, using fallback provider", trace_id);
333	                    true
334	                } else {
335	                    let has_available = state.token_manager.has_available_account("claude", &normalized_model).await;
336	                    if !has_available {
337	                        tracing::info!(
338	                            "[{}] All Google accounts unavailable (rate-limited or quota-protected for {}), using fallback provider",
339	                            trace_id,
340	                            request.model
341	                        );
342	                    }
343	                    !has_available
344	                }
345	            }
346	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => {
347	                let total = google_accounts.saturating_add(1).max(1);
348	                let slot = state.provider_rr.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % total;
349	                slot == 0
350	            }
351	        };
352	        (use_legacy, None) // None = legacy z.ai path
353	    } else {
354	        (false, None)
355	    };
356	    drop(router);
357	
358	    // [CRITICAL FIX] 预先清理所有消息中的 cache_control 字段 (Issue #744)
359	    // 必须在序列化之前处理，以确保 z.ai 和 Google Flow 都不受历史消息缓存标记干扰
360	    clean_cache_control_from_messages(&mut request.messages);
361	
362	    // [FIX #813] 合并连续的同角色消息 (Consecutive User Messages)
363	    // 这对于 z.ai (Anthropic 直接转发) 路径至关重要，因为原始结构必须符合协议
364	    merge_consecutive_messages(&mut request.messages);
365	
366	    // Get model family for signature validation
367	    let target_family = if use_zai {
368	        Some("claude")
369	    } else {
370	        let mapped_model = crate::proxy::common::model_mapping::map_claude_model_to_gemini(&request.model);
371	        if mapped_model.contains("gemini") {
372	            Some("gemini")
373	        } else {
374	            Some("claude")
375	        }
376	    };
377	
378	    // [CRITICAL FIX] 过滤并修复 Thinking 块签名 (Enhanced with family check)
379	    filter_invalid_thinking_blocks_with_family(&mut request.messages, target_family);
380	
381	    // [New] Recover from broken tool loops (where signatures were stripped)
382	    // This prevents "Assistant message must start with thinking" errors by closing the loop with synthetic messages
383	    if state.experimental.read().await.enable_tool_loop_recovery {
384	        close_tool_loop_for_thinking(&mut request.messages);
385	    }
386	
387	    // ===== [Issue #467 Fix] 拦截 Claude Code Warmup 请求 =====
388	    // Claude Code 会每 10 秒发送一次 warmup 请求来保持连接热身，
389	    // 这些请求会消耗大量配额。检测到 warmup 请求后直接返回模拟响应。
390	    if is_warmup_request(&request) {
391	        tracing::info!(
392	            "[{}] 🔥 拦截 Warmup 请求，返回模拟响应（节省配额）",
393	            trace_id
394	        );
395	        return create_warmup_response(&request, request.stream);
396	    }
397	
398	    if use_zai {
399	        // 重新序列化修复后的请求体
400	        let new_body = match serde_json::to_value(&request) {
401	            Ok(v) => v,
402	            Err(e) => {
403	                tracing::error!("Failed to serialize fixed request for upstream provider: {}", e);
404	                return StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.into_response();
405	            }
406	        };
407	
408	        // Route to either a configured upstream provider or the legacy z.ai path
409	        if let Some(ref name) = provider_name {
410	            // Find the provider by name from the router
411	            let router = state.provider_router.read().await;
412	            let providers: Vec<_> = router
413	                .candidates_for_model(&request.model)
414	                .into_iter()
415	                .filter(|p| &p.name == name)
416	                .collect();
417	            if let Some(provider) = providers.first() {
418	                return crate::proxy::providers::zai_anthropic::forward_anthropic_with_provider(
419	                    &state,
420	                    &provider.base_url,
421	                    &provider.api_key,
422	                    &provider.model_mapping,
423	                    &provider.default_models,
424	                    axum::http::Method::POST,
425	                    "/v1/messages",
426	                    &headers,
427	                    new_body,
428	                    request.messages.len(),
429	                )
430	                .await;
431	            }
432	            // Provider not found (shouldn't happen), fall through to Google path
433	            tracing::warn!("[{}] Provider '{}' not found, falling through to Google path", trace_id, name);
434	        } else {
435	            // Legacy z.ai path
436	            return crate::proxy::providers::zai_anthropic::forward_anthropic_json(
437	                &state,
438	                axum::http::Method::POST,
439	                "/v1/messages",
440	                &headers,
441	                new_body,
442	                request.messages.len(),
443	            )
444	            .await;
445	        }
446	    }
447	    
448	    // Google Flow 继续使用 request 对象
449	    // (后续代码不需要再次 filter_invalid_thinking_blocks)

45	                            // thought: true 时，text 是思考内容
46	                            thought_out.push_str(text);

48	                            // 正常内容
49	                            content_out.push_str(text);
50	                        }
51	                    }
52	
53	                    // 工具调用部分
54	                    if let Some(fc) = part.get("functionCall") {

56	                        let args = fc

61	                            .get("id")

65	
66	                        tool_calls.push(ToolCall {
67	                            id,
68	                            r#type: "function".to_string(),
69	                            function: ToolFunction {

71	                                arguments: args,
72	                            },
73	                        });
74	                    }
75	
76	                    // 图片处理 (响应中直接返回图片的情况)
77	                    if let Some(img) = part.get("inlineData") {

79	                            .get("mimeType")
80	                            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())

82	                        let data = img.get("data").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
83	                        if !data.is_empty() {
84	                            content_out
85	                                .push_str(&format!("![image](data:{};base64,{})", mime_type, data));
86	                        }
87	                    }
88	                }
89	            }

91	            // 提取并处理该候选结果的联网搜索引文 (Grounding Metadata)
92	            if let Some(grounding) = candidate.get("groundingMetadata") {
93	                let mut grounding_text = String::new();
94	
95	                // 1. 处理搜索词
96	                if let Some(queries) = grounding.get("webSearchQueries").and_then(|q| q.as_array())
97	                {
98	                    let query_list: Vec<&str> = queries.iter().filter_map(|v| v.as_str()).collect();
99	                    if !query_list.is_empty() {
100	                        grounding_text.push_str("\n\n---\n**🔍 已为您搜索：** ");
101	                        grounding_text.push_str(&query_list.join(", "));
102	                    }
103	                }
104	
105	                // 2. 处理来源链接 (Chunks)
106	                if let Some(chunks) = grounding.get("groundingChunks").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {

114	                            let uri = web.get("uri").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("#");
115	                            links.push(format!("[{}] [{}]({})", i + 1, title, uri));
116	                        }
117	                    }
118	
119	                    if !links.is_empty() {

121	                        grounding_text.push_str(&links.join("\n"));

123	                }
124	
125	                if !grounding_text.is_empty() {

138	                    "RECITATION" => "content_filter",

161	                    },
162	                    tool_call_id: None,
163	                    name: None,

165	                finish_reason: Some(finish_reason.to_string()),

171	    let usage = raw.get("usageMetadata").and_then(|u| {
172	        let prompt_tokens = u
173	            .get("promptTokenCount")
174	            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())

181	            .get("totalTokenCount")

184	        let cached_tokens = u
185	            .get("cachedContentTokenCount")
186	            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
187	            .map(|v| v as u32);
188	
189	        Some(super::models::OpenAIUsage {
190	            prompt_tokens,
191	            completion_tokens,
192	            total_tokens,
193	            prompt_tokens_details: cached_tokens.map(|ct| super::models::PromptTokensDetails {
194	                cached_tokens: Some(ct),
195	            }),
196	            completion_tokens_details: None,
197	        })
198	    });
199	
200	    OpenAIResponse {
201	        id: raw
202	            .get("responseId")
203	            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
204	            .unwrap_or("resp_unknown")
205	            .to_string(),

211	            .unwrap_or("unknown")
212	            .to_string(),

214	        usage,
215	    }
216	}
