24	/// 创建从 Gemini SSE 流到 Claude SSE 流的转换
25	pub fn create_claude_sse_stream<S, E>(
26	    mut gemini_stream: Pin<Box<S>>,
27	    trace_id: String,
28	    email: String,
29	    session_id: Option<String>, // [NEW v3.3.17] Session ID for signature caching
30	    scaling_enabled: bool, // [NEW] Flag for context usage scaling
31	    context_limit: u32,
32	    estimated_prompt_tokens: Option<u32>, // [FIX] Estimated tokens for calibrator learning
33	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Message count for rewind detection
34	    client_adapter: Option<std::sync::Arc<dyn ClientAdapter>>, // [NEW] Adapter reference
35	    registered_tool_names: Vec<String>, // [FIX #MCP] Tool names for fuzzy matching
36	) -> Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, String>> + Send>> 
37	where
38	    S: Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, E>> + Send + ?Sized + 'static,
39	    E: std::fmt::Display + Send + 'static,
40	{
41	    use async_stream::stream;
42	    use bytes::BytesMut;
43	    use futures::StreamExt;
44	
45	    Box::pin(stream! {
46	        let mut state = StreamingState::new();
47	        state.session_id = session_id; // Set session ID for signature caching
48	        state.message_count = message_count; // [NEW v4.0.0] Set message count
49	        state.scaling_enabled = scaling_enabled; // Set scaling enabled flag
50	        state.context_limit = context_limit;
51	        state.estimated_prompt_tokens = estimated_prompt_tokens; // [FIX] Pass estimated tokens
52	        state.set_client_adapter(client_adapter); // [NEW] Set adapter
53	        state.set_registered_tool_names(registered_tool_names); // [FIX #MCP] Set tool names
54	        let mut buffer = BytesMut::new();
55	
56	        loop {
57	            // [NEW] 60秒心跳保活: 延长超时时间以增加网络抖动容错
58	            let next_chunk = tokio::time::timeout(
59	                std::time::Duration::from_secs(60),
60	                gemini_stream.next()
61	            ).await;
62	
63	            match next_chunk {
64	                Ok(Some(chunk_result)) => {
65	                    match chunk_result {
66	                        Ok(chunk) => {
67	                            buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
68	
69	                            // Process complete lines
70	                            while let Some(pos) = buffer.iter().position(|&b| b == b'\n') {
71	                                let line_raw = buffer.split_to(pos + 1);
72	                                if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&line_raw) {
73	                                    let line = line_str.trim();
74	                                    if line.is_empty() { continue; }
75	
76	                                    if let Some(sse_chunks) = process_sse_line(line, &mut state, &trace_id, &email) {
77	                                        for sse_chunk in sse_chunks {
78	                                            yield Ok(sse_chunk);
79	                                        }
80	                                    }
81	                                }
82	                            }
83	                        }
84	                        Err(e) => {
85	                            let error_json = serde_json::json!({
86	                                "error": {
87	                                    "message": format!("Stream error: {}", e),
88	                                    "type": "stream_error"
89	                                }
90	                            });
91	                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!("data: {}\n\n", error_json)));
92	                            break;
93	                        }
94	                    }
95	                }
96	                Ok(None) => break, // Stream 正常结束
97	                Err(_) => {
98	                    // 超时，发送心跳包 (SSE Comment 格式)
99	                    yield Ok(Bytes::from(": ping\n\n"));
100	                }
101	            }
102	        }
103	        
104	        // [FIX #1732] Mandatory Flush remaining buffer on stream termination
105	        // Prevents hangs when the last SSE chunk doesn't end with a newline (network fragmentation)
106	        if !buffer.is_empty() {
107	             if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&buffer) {
108	                 let line = line_str.trim();
109	                 if !line.is_empty() {
110	                     tracing::debug!("[{}] SSE Termination: Flushing remaining {} bytes in buffer", trace_id, buffer.len());
111	                     if let Some(sse_chunks) = process_sse_line(line, &mut state, &trace_id, &email) {
112	                         for sse_chunk in sse_chunks {
113	                             yield Ok(sse_chunk);
114	                         }
115	                     }
116	                 }
117	             }
118	             buffer.clear();
119	        }
120	
121	        // [FIX #859] Post-thinking interruption recovery
122	        // If we have sent thinking but NO content (text/tool_use) and the stream ended (or timed out without DONE),
123	        // we must provide a fallback to prevent 0-token errors on client side.
124	        if state.has_thinking && !state.has_content {
125	            tracing::warn!("[{}] Stream interrupted after thinking (No Content). Triggering recovery...", trace_id);
126	            
127	            // 1. Force close thinking block if open
128	            if state.current_block_type() == crate::proxy::mappers::claude::streaming::BlockType::Thinking {
129	               let close_chunks = state.end_block();
130	               for chunk in close_chunks {
131	                   yield Ok(chunk);
132	               }
133	            }
134	
135	            // 2. Inject system message to inform user
136	            // We use a new text block for this.
137	            let recovery_msg = "\n\n[System] Upstream model interrupted after thinking. (Recovered by Antigravity)";
138	            let start_chunks = state.start_block(
139	                crate::proxy::mappers::claude::streaming::BlockType::Text, 
140	                serde_json::json!({ "type": "text", "text": recovery_msg })
141	            );
142	            for chunk in start_chunks { yield Ok(chunk); }
143	            
144	            let stop_chunks = state.end_block();
145	            for chunk in stop_chunks { yield Ok(chunk); }
146	
147	            // 3. Mark as content received so we don't trigger this again (though loop is done)
148	            state.has_content = true;
149	
150	            // 4. Send a simulated usage update to ensure we have > 0 output tokens
151	            // Estimate based on some default if we didn't get any usage
152	            let recovery_usage = crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::Usage {
153	                input_tokens: 0, // We don't know input, but output is critical
154	                output_tokens: 100, // Arbitrary small number to satisfy client
155	                cache_read_input_tokens: None,
156	                cache_creation_input_tokens: None,
157	                server_tool_use: None,
158	            };
159	
160	            let delta = serde_json::json!({
161	                "type": "message_delta",
162	                "delta": { "stop_reason": "end_turn", "stop_sequence": null },
163	                "usage": recovery_usage
164	            });
165	
166	            yield Ok(state.emit("message_delta", delta));
167	        }
168	
169	        // Ensure termination events are sent
170	        for chunk in emit_force_stop(&mut state) {
171	            yield Ok(chunk);
172	        }
173	    })
174	}
175	
176	/// 处理单行 SSE 数据
177	fn process_sse_line(line: &str, state: &mut StreamingState, trace_id: &str, email: &str) -> Option<Vec<Bytes>> {
178	    if !line.starts_with("data: ") {
179	        return None;
180	    }
181	
182	    let data_str = line[6..].trim();
183	    if data_str.is_empty() {
184	        return None;
185	    }
186	
187	    if data_str == "[DONE]" {
188	        let chunks = emit_force_stop(state);
189	        if chunks.is_empty() {
190	            return None;
191	        }
192	        return Some(chunks);
193	    }
194	
195	    // 解析 JSON
196	    let json_value: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_str(data_str) {
197	        Ok(v) => v,
198	        Err(_) => return None,
199	    };
200	
201	    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
202	
203	    // 解包 response 字段 (如果存在)
204	    let raw_json = json_value.get("response").unwrap_or(&json_value);
205	
206	    // 发送 message_start
207	    if !state.message_start_sent {
208	        chunks.push(state.emit_message_start(raw_json));
209	    }
210	
211	    // 捕获 groundingMetadata (Web Search)
212	    if let Some(candidate) = raw_json.get("candidates").and_then(|c| c.get(0)) {
213	        if let Some(grounding) = candidate.get("groundingMetadata") {
214	            // 提取搜索词
215	            if let Some(query) = grounding.get("webSearchQueries")
216	                .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
217	                .and_then(|arr| arr.get(0))
218	                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
219	            {
220	                state.web_search_query = Some(query.to_string());
221	            }
222	
223	            // 提取结果块

226	            } else if let Some(chunks_arr) = grounding.get("grounding_metadata").and_then(|m| m.get("groundingChunks")).and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
227	                state.grounding_chunks = Some(chunks_arr.clone());

229	        }
230	    }

232	    // 处理所有 parts
233	    if let Some(parts) = raw_json
234	        .get("candidates")
235	        .and_then(|c| c.get(0))
236	        .and_then(|cand| cand.get("content"))
237	        .and_then(|content| content.get("parts"))
238	        .and_then(|p| p.as_array())
239	    {
240	        for part_value in parts {
241	            if let Ok(part) = serde_json::from_value::<GeminiPart>(part_value.clone()) {
242	                let mut processor = PartProcessor::new(state);
243	                chunks.extend(processor.process(&part));
244	            }
245	        }
246	    }

248	    // Process grounding metadata (googleSearch results) and append as citations
249	    // [DISABLED] Temporarily disabled to fix Cherry Studio compatibility

265	    // 检查是否结束
266	    if let Some(finish_reason) = raw_json
267	        .get("candidates")
268	        .and_then(|c| c.get(0))
269	        .and_then(|cand| cand.get("finishReason"))
270	        .and_then(|f| f.as_str())
271	    {
272	        let usage = raw_json
273	            .get("usageMetadata")
274	            .and_then(|u| serde_json::from_value::<UsageMetadata>(u.clone()).ok());
275	
276	        if let Some(ref u) = usage {
277	            let cached_tokens = u.cached_content_token_count.unwrap_or(0);
278	            let cache_info = if cached_tokens > 0 {
279	                format!(", Cached: {}", cached_tokens)
280	            } else {
281	                String::new()
282	            };
283	            
284	             tracing::info!(
285	                 "[{}] ✓ Stream completed | Account: {} | In: {} tokens | Out: {} tokens{}", 
286	                 trace_id,
287	                 email,
288	                 u.prompt_token_count.unwrap_or(0).saturating_sub(cached_tokens), 
289	                 u.candidates_token_count.unwrap_or(0),
290	                 cache_info
291	             );
292	        }
293	
294	        chunks.extend(state.emit_finish(Some(finish_reason), usage.as_ref()));
295	    }
296	
297	    if chunks.is_empty() {
298	        None
299	    } else {
300	        Some(chunks)
301	    }
302	}

304	/// 发送强制结束事件
305	pub fn emit_force_stop(state: &mut StreamingState) -> Vec<Bytes> {
306	    if !state.message_stop_sent {
307	        let mut chunks = state.emit_finish(None, None);
308	        if chunks.is_empty() {
309	            chunks.push(Bytes::from(
310	                "event: message_stop\ndata: {\"type\":\"message_stop\"}\n\n",
311	            ));
312	            state.message_stop_sent = true;
313	        }
314	        return chunks;
315	    }
316	    vec![]
317	}

319	/// Process grounding metadata from Gemini's googleSearch and emit as Claude web_search blocks
320	#[allow(dead_code)] // Temporarily disabled for Cherry Studio compatibility, kept for future use
321	fn process_grounding_metadata(
322	    metadata: &serde_json::Value,
323	    state: &mut StreamingState,
324	) -> Option<Vec<Bytes>> {
325	    use serde_json::json;
326	
327	    // Extract search queries and grounding chunks
328	    let search_queries = metadata
329	        .get("webSearchQueries")
330	        .and_then(|q| q.as_array())
331	        .map(|arr| arr.iter().filter_map(|v| v.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>())
332	        .unwrap_or_default();
333	
334	    let grounding_chunks = metadata.get("groundingChunks").and_then(|c| c.as_array())?;
335	
336	    if grounding_chunks.is_empty() {
337	        return None;
338	    }
339	
340	    // Generate a unique tool_use_id
341	    let tool_use_id = format!(
342	        "srvtoolu_{}",
343	        crate::proxy::common::utils::generate_random_id()
344	    );
345	
346	    // Build search results array
347	    let mut search_results = Vec::new();
348	    for chunk in grounding_chunks.iter() {
349	        if let Some(web) = chunk.get("web") {
350	            let title = web
351	                .get("title")
352	                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())
353	                .unwrap_or("Source");
354	            let uri = web.get("uri").and_then(|u| u.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
355	            if !uri.is_empty() {
356	                search_results.push(json!({
357	                    "url": uri,
358	                    "title": title,
359	                    "encrypted_content": "", // Gemini doesn't provide this
360	                    "page_age": null
361	                }));
362	            }
363	        }
364	    }
365	
366	    if search_results.is_empty() {
367	        return None;
368	    }
369	
370	    let search_query = search_queries
371	        .first()
372	        .map(|s| s.to_string())
373	        .unwrap_or_default();
374	
375	    tracing::debug!(
376	        "[Grounding] Emitting {} search results for query: {}",
377	        search_results.len(),
378	        search_query
379	    );
380	
381	    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
382	
383	    // 1. Emit server_tool_use block (start)
384	    let server_tool_use_start = json!({
385	        "type": "content_block_start",
386	        "index": state.block_index,
387	        "content_block": {
388	            "type": "server_tool_use",
389	            "id": tool_use_id,
390	            "name": "web_search",
391	            "input": {
392	                "query": search_query
393	            }
394	        }
395	    });
396	    chunks.push(Bytes::from(format!(
397	        "event: content_block_start\ndata: {}\n\n",
398	        server_tool_use_start
399	    )));
400	
401	    // server_tool_use block stop
402	    let server_tool_use_stop = json!({
403	        "type": "content_block_stop",
404	        "index": state.block_index
405	    });
406	    chunks.push(Bytes::from(format!(
407	        "event: content_block_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
408	        server_tool_use_stop
409	    )));
410	    state.block_index += 1;
411	
412	    // 2. Emit web_search_tool_result block (start)
413	    let tool_result_start = json!({
414	        "type": "content_block_start",
415	        "index": state.block_index,
416	        "content_block": {
417	            "type": "web_search_tool_result",
418	            "tool_use_id": tool_use_id,
419	            "content": search_results
420	        }
421	    });
422	    chunks.push(Bytes::from(format!(
423	        "event: content_block_start\ndata: {}\n\n",
424	        tool_result_start
425	    )));
426	
427	    // web_search_tool_result block stop
428	    let tool_result_stop = json!({
429	        "type": "content_block_stop",
430	        "index": state.block_index
431	    });
432	    chunks.push(Bytes::from(format!(
433	        "event: content_block_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
434	        tool_result_stop
435	    )));
436	    state.block_index += 1;
437	
438	    Some(chunks)
439	}

**The problem is not missing converters -- it is missing ROUTING LOGIC that wires them together.**

---

### 5. Response Conversion Chain Architecture

The clean architecture for response conversion is:

```
Input Protocol Handler
  |
  v
[Protocol] -> v1internal Request Mapper
  |
  v
Upstream Call (Gemini v1internal / Anthropic SSE / OpenAI SSE)
  |
  v
[Upstream Response] -> Output Protocol Response Mapper
  |
  v
Output Protocol SSE/JSON to Client
```

The key principle: **the handler knows the input protocol, and the response mapper knows the output protocol. They are the same.** The response conversion chain is always:

```
Upstream Response -> Gemini v1internal (unwrapped if needed) -> Output Protocol
```

For Anthropic-passthrough and OpenAI-compatible upstreams, the response comes back in the upstream's native format. A thin "bridge" function converts it to the client's expected format:

- Anthropic SSE -> OpenAI SSE: `create_openai_sse_from_anthropic_stream()`
- Anthropic SSE -> Claude SSE: Direct passthrough (no conversion needed)
- Anthropic SSE -> Gemini SSE: `create_gemini_sse_from_anthropic_stream()`
- OpenAI SSE -> Claude SSE: `create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream()` (new)
- OpenAI SSE -> OpenAI SSE: Direct passthrough
- OpenAI SSE -> Gemini SSE: `create_gemini_sse_from_openai_stream()` (new)

### 6. Dependency Graph

```
Phase 1 (OpenAI -> v1internal via ProviderRouter)
  depends on: existing mappers (no new mappers needed)
  
Phase 2 (Claude -> OpenAI-Compatible)
  depends on: claude_to_openai_body() [NEW]
  depends on: openai_to_claude_response() [NEW]
  depends on: create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream() [NEW]
  
Phase 3 (Gemini -> ProviderRouter)
  depends on: gemini_to_claude_body() [NEW]
  depends on: claude_to_gemini_response() [NEW]
  depends on: gemini_to_openai_body() [NEW]
  depends on: openai_to_gemini_response() [NEW]
  
Phase 4 (map_model cleanup)
  no dependencies, safe to do in parallel with any phase
  
Phase 5 (Audio/Images)
  depends on: Phase 1-3 patterns established
```

### 7. Risk Mitigation

- **Each phase is independently testable.** Phase 1 does not break anything -- it only fills in an empty match arm. Phase 2 only activates when `ProviderRouter` selects `OpenAICompatible` for a Claude request (which does not happen with current default config).
- **Empty providers = full backward compatibility.** The `router.is_empty()` check at the top of each handler ensures the existing TokenManager path is unchanged when no providers are configured.
- **`cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`** must pass after each phase.
- **New mappers should have unit tests** modeled after the existing tests in `response.rs`, `streaming.rs`, and `wrapper.rs`.

# 计划：全协议转换矩阵

## Context

**已完成**：ProviderRouter 多供应商路由 + OpenAI/Claude Handler 的 ProviderRouter 集成。OpenAI Chat 和 Claude Messages 已支持路由到 AnthropicPassthrough / OpenAICompatible / GeminiV1Internal 三种上游。

**当前需求**：实现**全协议转换矩阵** — 任意客户端输入格式 → 任意上游协议 → 响应格式严格匹配输入格式。

**现状矩阵**（3 种输入 × 3 种上游）：

| 输入 \ 上游 | Anthropic 透传 | OpenAI 兼容 | Gemini v1internal |
|---|---|---|---|
| **OpenAI Chat** | ✅ `to_claude_body` + 透传 | ✅ `forward_openai_compatible` | ✅ TokenManager 路径 |
| **Claude Messages** | ✅ 透传 | ❌ **GAP 1** | ✅ TokenManager 路径 |
| **Gemini 原生** | ❌ **GAP 2** | ❌ **GAP 3** | ✅ TokenManager 路径 |

**未接入 ProviderRouter 的 Handler**：
- `gemini.rs` — 零 ProviderRouter 集成
- `audio.rs` — 仅 TokenManager 路径
- `handle_images_*` — 仅 TokenManager 路径

**用户确认的优先级**：
1. **Chat 文本对话优先**（OpenAI Chat / Claude / Gemini 三种核心协议）
2. **响应格式严格匹配输入格式**
3. Audio/Images 延后，根据上游供应商支持情况决定 STT/TTS 范围

### Phase 3: Gemini 原生 → ProviderRouter 集成

**问题**：`gemini.rs` 完全独立，不经过 ProviderRouter，无法路由到 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 兼容供应商。

\```rust
let router = state.provider_router.read().await;
let model_name = /* 从 URL 提取 */;
let client_wants_stream = /* 根据路径判断 */;

if let Some(provider) = router.select(&model_name, None) {
    match provider.protocol {
        ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough => {
            return forward_gemini_via_anthropic(
                &state, &provider, &body, &headers, client_wants_stream,
            ).await;
        }
        ProviderProtocol::OpenAICompatible => {
            return forward_gemini_via_openai_compat(
                &state, &provider, &body, &headers, client_wants_stream,
            ).await;
        }
        ProviderProtocol::GeminiV1Internal => {
            // fall through to existing TokenManager path
        }
    }
}
drop(router);
\```

# 计划：全协议转换矩阵

## Context

**已完成**：ProviderRouter 多供应商路由 + OpenAI/Claude Handler 的 ProviderRouter 集成。OpenAI Chat 和 Claude Messages 已支持路由到 AnthropicPassthrough / OpenAICompatible / GeminiV1Internal 三种上游。

**当前需求**：实现**全协议转换矩阵** — 任意客户端输入格式 → 任意上游协议 → 响应格式严格匹配输入格式。

**现状矩阵**（3 种输入 × 3 种上游）：

| 输入 \ 上游 | Anthropic 透传 | OpenAI 兼容 | Gemini v1internal |
|---|---|---|---|
| **OpenAI Chat** | ✅ `to_claude_body` + 透传 | ✅ `forward_openai_compatible` | ✅ TokenManager 路径 |
| **Claude Messages** | ✅ 透传 | ❌ **GAP 1** | ✅ TokenManager 路径 |
| **Gemini 原生** | ❌ **GAP 2** | ❌ **GAP 3** | ✅ TokenManager 路径 |

**未接入 ProviderRouter 的 Handler**：
- `gemini.rs` — 零 ProviderRouter 集成
- `audio.rs` — 仅 TokenManager 路径
- `handle_images_*` — 仅 TokenManager 路径

**用户确认的优先级**：
1. **Chat 文本对话优先**（OpenAI Chat / Claude / Gemini 三种核心协议）
2. **响应格式严格匹配输入格式**
3. Audio/Images 延后，根据上游供应商支持情况决定 STT/TTS 范围

---

## Research Findings

### 1. How `UpstreamClient` Works and Its Limitations

`UpstreamClient` is defined in `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/upstream/client.rs`. It has two important characteristics:

**The `UpstreamClient` is tightly coupled to the `TokenManager` path.** It cannot be used directly with custom `base_url + api_key` credentials. Here is why:

- **`call_v1_internal` and `call_v1_internal_with_headers`** (lines 240-417) take `access_token: &str` as a parameter -- this is a Google OAuth Bearer token obtained via `TokenManager::get_token()`, NOT an API key. The `access_token` is placed in an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (line 279-282).

- **`get_client(&self, account_id: Option<&str>) -> Client`** (lines 175-217) returns a cached `rquest::Client` based on account/proxy configuration. It does NOT accept custom base_url or api_key parameters. It only selects which HTTP client to use based on proxy routing, not authentication.

- **The hardcoded base URLs** (lines 46-57) are three Google Cloud Code endpoints:
  - `https://daily-cloudcode-pa.sandbox.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Sandbox, priority 1)
  - `https://daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Daily, priority 2)
  - `https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Prod, priority 3, last resort)

- **URL pattern**: The `build_url` helper (line 220) uses the format `"{base_url}:{method}"` or `"{base_url}:{method}?{query}"`. For example:
  - `https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:generateContent`
  - `https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse`

### 2. How `forward_anthropic_with_provider` in `zai_anthropic.rs` Works

The function at `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/zai_anthropic.rs` (lines 235-325) uses a completely different approach:

- **It builds a dedicated `reqwest::Client`** (not `UpstreamClient`) via the `build_client()` helper (lines 49-69). This is a fresh `reqwest::Client` per request, configured with:
  - Timeout from `state.request_timeout`
  - Upstream proxy if configured
  - `tcp_nodelay(true)` for latency

- **URL joining** uses `join_base_url(base_url, path)` (lines 39-47), a simple string concatenation: `base_url.trim_end_matches('/') + "/" + path.lstrip('/')`. For example: `"https://api.openai.com" + "/v1/messages"` = `"https://api.openai.com/v1/messages"`.

- **Authentication** is done via `set_zai_auth()` (lines 92-111), which places the API key in `x-api-key` and/or `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` headers. This is an API key auth scheme, not OAuth Bearer tokens.

- **The request is sent as**: `client.request(method, &url).headers(headers).body(body_bytes).send().await` with streaming response body forwarded back.

### 3. Direct Answers to Your Questions

**Q: Can I use `UpstreamClient` directly with a provider's base_url and api_key?**

**No.** `UpstreamClient` is designed exclusively for the Google Cloud Code v1internal OAuth flow. Its `call_v1_internal*` methods:
- Hardcode the three Google base URLs (no way to override)
- Expect an OAuth `access_token` (from `TokenManager`), not an API key
- Use the `:{method}` URL suffix pattern (Google-specific)
- Inject Google-specific headers (`x-client-name: antigravity`, `x-machine-id`, `x-vscode-sessionid`)

**Q: Do I need to build a separate `reqwest::Client`?**

**Yes, follow the `forward_anthropic_with_provider` pattern.** Build a `reqwest::Client` per call (or cache it if performance becomes a concern). The `build_client()` helper in `zai_anthropic.rs` is the template. Alternatively, you could extract that helper into `proxy/common/` for reuse.

**Q: What is the exact URL pattern for v1internal calls?**

For **Google v1internal** (the existing path via `UpstreamClient`):
```
{base_url}:{method}           // e.g., https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:generateContent
{base_url}:{method}?alt=sse   // e.g., https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse
```

Note the colon (`:`) separator between base URL and method name, NOT a slash. This is Google's API URL convention.

### 4. To Call v1internal with Custom Credentials (base_url + api_key)

You would need to write a new function that:

1. Builds a `reqwest::Client` (like `build_client()` in `zai_anthropic.rs`)
2. Constructs the URL using the `{base_url}:{method}` pattern from `UpstreamClient::build_url()`
3. Sets headers:
   - `Content-Type: application/json`
   - `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` (if the custom credential is a Bearer token)
   - Or `x-api-key: <api_key>` (if the custom credential is an API key)
4. Sends the POST request with `client.post(&url).headers(headers).json(&body).send().await`
5. Streams the response body back as an `axum::Body::from_stream()`

The existing `call_v1_internal` method on `UpstreamClient` cannot be repurposed for this without significant modification, because the base URLs are hardcoded constants and the auth scheme is fixed to OAuth Bearer tokens from `TokenManager`.

30	/// 邮箱脱敏：只显示前3位 + *** + @域名前2位 + ***
31	/// 例: "userexample@gmail.com" → "use***@gm***"
32	pub fn mask_email(email: &str) -> String {
33	    if let Some(at_pos) = email.find('@') {
34	        let local = &email[..at_pos];
35	        let domain = &email[at_pos + 1..];
36	        let local_prefix: String = local.chars().take(3).collect();
37	        let domain_prefix: String = domain.chars().take(2).collect();
38	        format!("{}***@{}***", local_prefix, domain_prefix)
39	    } else {
40	        // 不是合法邮箱格式，直接截取前5位
41	        let prefix: String = email.chars().take(5).collect();
42	        format!("{}***", prefix)
43	    }
44	}

87	                }

99	    /// Internal helper to build a client with optional upstream proxy config
100	    fn build_client_internal(
101	        proxy_config: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
102	    ) -> Result<Client, rquest::Error> {
103	        let mut builder = Client::builder()
104	            .emulation(rquest_util::Emulation::Chrome123)
105	            // Connection settings (优化连接复用，减少建立开销)
106	            .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
107	            .pool_max_idle_per_host(16) // 每主机最多 16 个空闲连接
108	            .pool_idle_timeout(Duration::from_secs(90)) // 空闲连接保持 90 秒
109	            .tcp_keepalive(Duration::from_secs(60)) // TCP 保活探测 60 秒
110	            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(600));
111	
112	        builder = Self::apply_default_user_agent(builder);
113	
114	        if let Some(config) = proxy_config {
115	            if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
116	                let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
117	                if let Ok(proxy) = rquest::Proxy::all(&url) {
118	                    builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
119	                    tracing::info!("UpstreamClient enabled proxy: {}", url);
120	                }
121	            }
122	        }
123	
124	        builder.build()
125	    }

127	    /// Build a client with a specific PoolProxyConfig (from ProxyPool)
128	    fn build_client_with_proxy(
129	        &self,
130	        proxy_config: crate::proxy::proxy_pool::PoolProxyConfig,
131	    ) -> Result<Client, rquest::Error> {
132	        // Reuse base settings similar to default client but with specific proxy
133	        let builder = Client::builder()
134	            .emulation(rquest_util::Emulation::Chrome123)
135	            .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
136	            .pool_max_idle_per_host(16)
137	            .pool_idle_timeout(Duration::from_secs(90))
138	            .tcp_keepalive(Duration::from_secs(60))
139	            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(600))
140	            .proxy(proxy_config.proxy); // Apply the specific proxy
141	
142	        Self::apply_default_user_agent(builder).build()
143	    }

148	            builder.user_agent(ua)

174	    /// Get client for a specific account (or default if no proxy bound)
175	    pub async fn get_client(&self, account_id: Option<&str>) -> Client {
176	        if let Some(pool) = &self.proxy_pool {
177	            if let Some(acc_id) = account_id {
178	                // Try to get per-account proxy
179	                match pool.get_proxy_for_account(acc_id).await {
180	                    Ok(Some(proxy_cfg)) => {
181	                        // Check cache
182	                        if let Some(client) = self.client_cache.get(&proxy_cfg.entry_id) {
183	                            return client.clone();
184	                        }
185	                        // Build new client and cache it
186	                        match self.build_client_with_proxy(proxy_cfg.clone()) {
187	                            Ok(client) => {
188	                                self.client_cache
189	                                    .insert(proxy_cfg.entry_id.clone(), client.clone());
190	                                tracing::info!(
191	                                    "Using ProxyPool proxy ID: {} for account: {}",
192	                                    proxy_cfg.entry_id,
193	                                    acc_id
194	                                );
195	                                return client;
196	                            }
197	                            Err(e) => {
198	                                tracing::error!("Failed to build client for proxy {}: {}, falling back to default", proxy_cfg.entry_id, e);
199	                            }
200	                        }
201	                    }
202	                    Ok(None) => {
203	                        // No proxy found or required for this account, use default
204	                    }
205	                    Err(e) => {
206	                        tracing::error!(
207	                            "Error getting proxy for account {}: {}, falling back to default",
208	                            acc_id,
209	                            e
210	                        );
211	                    }
212	                }
213	            }
214	        }
215	        // Fallback to default client
216	        self.default_client.clone()
217	    }

223	        } else {

228	    /// Determine if we should try next endpoint (fallback logic)
229	    fn should_try_next_endpoint(status: StatusCode) -> bool {
230	        status == StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
231	            || status == StatusCode::REQUEST_TIMEOUT
232	            || status == StatusCode::NOT_FOUND
233	            || status.is_server_error()
234	    }

239	    /// [UPDATED] Takes optional account_id for per-account proxy selection.
240	    pub async fn call_v1_internal(
241	        &self,
242	        method: &str,
243	        access_token: &str,
244	        body: Value,
245	        query_string: Option<&str>,
246	        account_id: Option<&str>, // [NEW] Account ID for proxy selection
247	    ) -> Result<UpstreamCallResult, String> {
248	        self.call_v1_internal_with_headers(
249	            method,

259	    /// [FIX #765] 调用 v1internal API，支持透传额外的 Headers
260	    /// [ENHANCED] 返回 UpstreamCallResult，包含降级尝试记录，用于 debug 日志
261	    pub async fn call_v1_internal_with_headers(
262	        &self,
263	        method: &str,
264	        access_token: &str,
265	        body: Value,
266	        query_string: Option<&str>,
267	        extra_headers: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
268	        account_id: Option<&str>, // [NEW] Account ID
269	    ) -> Result<UpstreamCallResult, String> {
270	        // [NEW] Get client based on account (cached in proxy pool manager)
271	        let client = self.get_client(account_id).await;
272	
273	        // 构建 Headers (所有端点复用)
274	        let mut headers = header::HeaderMap::new();
275	        headers.insert(
276	            header::CONTENT_TYPE,
277	            header::HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
278	        );
279	        headers.insert(
280	            header::AUTHORIZATION,
281	            header::HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", access_token))
282	                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
283	        );
284	
285	        headers.insert(
286	            header::USER_AGENT,
287	            header::HeaderValue::from_str(&self.get_user_agent().await).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
288	                tracing::warn!("Invalid User-Agent header value, using fallback: {}", e);
289	                header::HeaderValue::from_static("antigravity")
290	            }),
291	        );
292	
293	        // [ENHANCED] 注入 Antigravity 官方客户端关键特征 Headers
294	        // 1. Client Identity
295	        headers.insert(
296	            "x-client-name",
297	            header::HeaderValue::from_static("antigravity"),
298	        );
299	        if let Ok(ver) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&crate::constants::CURRENT_VERSION) {
300	            headers.insert("x-client-version", ver);
301	        }
302	
303	        // 2. Device & Session Identity
304	        // Machine ID (Persistent)
305	        if let Ok(mid) = machine_uid::get() {
306	             if let Ok(mid_val) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&mid) {
307	                 headers.insert("x-machine-id", mid_val);
308	             }
309	        }
310	        // Session ID (Per App Launch)
311	        if let Ok(sess_val) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&crate::constants::SESSION_ID) {
312	            headers.insert("x-vscode-sessionid", sess_val);
313	        }
314	
315	        // [REMOVED v4.1.24] x-goog-api-client (gl-node/fire/grpc) header has been removed.
316	        // This header belongs to the IDE's JS layer, not the official client's egress.
317	        // Sending it creates a contradictory "Electron + Node.js" fingerprint.
318	
319	        // 注入额外的 Headers (如 anthropic-beta)
320	        for (k, v) in extra_headers {
321	            if let Ok(hk) = header::HeaderName::from_bytes(k.as_bytes()) {
322	                if let Ok(hv) = header::HeaderValue::from_str(&v) {
323	                    headers.insert(hk, hv);
324	                }
325	            }
326	        }
327	
328	        // [DEBUG] Log headers for verification
329	        tracing::debug!(?headers, "Final Upstream Request Headers");
330	
331	        let mut last_err: Option<String> = None;
332	        // [NEW] 收集降级尝试记录
333	        let mut fallback_attempts: Vec<FallbackAttemptLog> = Vec::new();
334	
335	        // 遍历所有端点，失败时自动切换
336	        for (idx, base_url) in V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.iter().enumerate() {
337	            let url = Self::build_url(base_url, method, query_string);
338	            let has_next = idx + 1 < V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.len();
339	
340	            let response = client
341	                .post(&url)
342	                .headers(headers.clone())
343	                .json(&body)
344	                .send()
345	                .await;
346	
347	            match response {
348	                Ok(resp) => {
349	                    let status = resp.status();
350	                    if status.is_success() {
351	                        if idx > 0 {
352	                            tracing::info!(
353	                                "✓ Upstream fallback succeeded | Endpoint: {} | Status: {} | Next endpoints available: {}",
354	                                base_url,
355	                                status,
356	                                V1_INTERNAL_BASE_URL_FALLBACKS.len() - idx - 1
357	                            );
358	                        } else {
359	                            tracing::debug!(
360	                                "✓ Upstream request succeeded | Endpoint: {} | Status: {}",
361	                                base_url,
362	                                status
363	                            );
364	                        }
365	                        return Ok(UpstreamCallResult {
366	                            response: resp,
367	                            fallback_attempts,
368	                        });
369	                    }
370	
371	                    // 如果有下一个端点且当前错误可重试，则切换
372	                    if has_next && Self::should_try_next_endpoint(status) {
373	                        let err_msg = format!("Upstream {} returned {}", base_url, status);
374	                        tracing::warn!(
375	                            "Upstream endpoint returned {} at {} (method={}), trying next endpoint",
376	                            status,
377	                            base_url,
378	                            method
379	                        );
380	                        // [NEW] 记录降级尝试
381	                        fallback_attempts.push(FallbackAttemptLog {
382	                            endpoint_url: url.clone(),
383	                            status: Some(status.as_u16()),
384	                            error: err_msg.clone(),
385	                        });
386	                        last_err = Some(err_msg);
387	                        continue;
388	                    }
389	
390	                    // 不可重试的错误或已是最后一个端点，直接返回
391	                    return Ok(UpstreamCallResult {
392	                        response: resp,
393	                        fallback_attempts,
394	                    });
395	                }
396	                Err(e) => {
397	                    let msg = format!("HTTP request failed at {}: {}", base_url, e);
398	                    tracing::debug!("{}", msg);
399	                    // [NEW] 记录网络错误的降级尝试
400	                    fallback_attempts.push(FallbackAttemptLog {
401	                        endpoint_url: url.clone(),
402	                        status: None,
403	                        error: msg.clone(),
404	                    });
405	                    last_err = Some(msg);
406	
407	                    // 如果是最后一个端点，退出循环
408	                    if !has_next {
409	                        break;
410	                    }
411	                    continue;
412	                }
413	            }
414	        }
415	
416	        Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| "All endpoints failed".to_string()))
417	    }

13	fn map_model_for_zai(original: &str, state: &crate::proxy::ZaiConfig) -> String {
14	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
15	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(original) {
16	        return mapped.clone();
17	    }
18	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(&m) {
19	        return mapped.clone();
20	    }
21	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
22	        return original[4..].to_string();
23	    }
24	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
25	        return original.to_string();
26	    }
27	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
28	        return original.to_string();
29	    }
30	    if m.contains("opus") {
31	        return state.models.opus.clone();
32	    }
33	    if m.contains("haiku") {
34	        return state.models.haiku.clone();
35	    }
36	    state.models.sonnet.clone()
37	}

39	fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
40	    let base = base.trim_end_matches('/');
41	    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
42	        path.to_string()
43	    } else {
44	        format!("/{}", path)
45	    };
46	    Ok(format!("{}{}", base, path))
47	}
48	
49	fn build_client(
50	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
51	    timeout_secs: u64,
52	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
54	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
55	
56	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
57	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
58	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
59	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
60	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
61	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    builder
66	        .tcp_nodelay(true) // [FIX #307] Disable Nagle's algorithm to improve latency for small requests
67	        .build()
68	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
69	}
70	
71	fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap {
72	    // Only forward a conservative set of headers to avoid leaking the local proxy key or cookies.
73	    let mut out = HeaderMap::new();
74	
75	    for (k, v) in incoming.iter() {
76	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
77	        match key.as_str() {
78	            "content-type" | "accept" | "anthropic-version" | "user-agent" => {
79	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
80	            }
81	            // Some clients use these for streaming; safe to pass through.
82	            "accept-encoding" | "cache-control" => {
83	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
84	            }
85	            _ => {}
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    out
90	}
91	
92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}
112	
113	/// Recursively remove cache_control from all nested objects/arrays
114	/// [FIX #290] This is a defensive fix that works regardless of serde annotations
115	pub fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
116	    match value {
117	        Value::Object(map) => {
118	            if let Some(v) = map.remove("cache_control") {
119	                tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep Cleaning found nested cache_control: {:?}", v);
120	            }
121	            for v in map.values_mut() {
122	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {
127	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}

134	pub async fn forward_anthropic_json(
135	    state: &AppState,
136	    method: Method,
137	    path: &str,
138	    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
139	    mut body: Value,
140	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Pass message count for rewind detection
141	) -> Response {
142	    let zai = state.zai.read().await.clone();
143	    if !zai.enabled || zai.dispatch_mode == crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
144	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai is disabled").into_response();
145	    }
146	
147	    if zai.api_key.trim().is_empty() {
148	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai api_key is not set").into_response();
149	    }
150	
151	    if let Some(model) = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
152	        let mapped = map_model_for_zai(model, &zai);
153	        body["model"] = Value::String(mapped.clone());
154	
155	        // [FIX] Caching for z.ai (to support thinking-filter)
156	        if let Some(sig) = body.get("thinking").and_then(|t| t.get("signature")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
157	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_session_signature(
158	                "zai-session",
159	                sig.to_string(),
160	                message_count
161	            );
162	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), mapped);
163	        }
164	    }
165	
166	    let url = match join_base_url(&zai.base_url, path) {
167	        Ok(u) => u,
168	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
169	    };
170	
171	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);
172	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
173	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
174	        Ok(c) => c,
175	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
176	    };
177	
178	    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
179	    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, &zai.api_key);
180	
181	    // Ensure JSON content type.
182	    headers
183	        .entry(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
184	        .or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));
185	
186	    // [FIX #290] Clean cache_control before sending to Anthropic API
187	    // This prevents "Extra inputs are not permitted" errors
188	    if let Some(cc) = body.get("cache_control") {
189	        tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep cleaning cache_control from ROOT: {:?}", cc);
190	    }
191	    deep_remove_cache_control(&mut body);
192	
193	    // [FIX #307] Explicitly serialize body to Vec<u8> to ensure Content-Length is set correctly.
194	    // This avoids "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" for small bodies which caused connection errors.
195	    let body_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap_or_default();
196	    let body_len = body_bytes.len();
197	    
198	    tracing::debug!("Forwarding request to z.ai (len: {} bytes): {}", body_len, url);
199	
200	    let req = client.request(method, &url)
201	        .headers(headers)
202	        .body(body_bytes); // Use .body(Vec<u8>) instead of .json()
203	
204	    let resp = match req.send().await {
205	        Ok(r) => r,
206	        Err(e) => {
207	            return (
208	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
209	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
210	            )
211	                .into_response();
212	        }
213	    };
214	
215	    let status = StatusCode::from_u16(resp.status().as_u16()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
216	
217	    let mut out = Response::builder().status(status);
218	    if let Some(ct) = resp.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE) {
219	        out = out.header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct.clone());
220	    }
221	
222	    // Stream response body to the client (covers SSE and non-SSE).
223	    let stream = resp.bytes_stream().map(|chunk| match chunk {
224	        Ok(b) => Ok::<Bytes, std::io::Error>(b),
225	        Err(e) => Ok(Bytes::from(format!("Upstream stream error: {}", e))),
226	    });
227	
228	    out.body(Body::from_stream(stream)).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
229	        (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to build response").into_response()
230	    })
231	}

233	/// Generic Anthropic-compatible provider forwarding.
234	/// Used by the multi-provider API gateway to forward requests to any configured provider.
235	pub async fn forward_anthropic_with_provider(
236	    state: &AppState,
237	    base_url: &str,
238	    api_key: &str,
239	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,

250

259	                "provider-session",

261	                message_count
262	            );
263	            crate::proxy::SignatureCache::global().cache_thinking_family(sig.to_string(), mapped);
264	        }
265	    }
266	
267	    let url = match join_base_url(base_url, path) {
268	        Ok(u) => u,
269	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
270	    };
271	
272	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);

274	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
275	        Ok(c) => c,
276	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
277	    };
278	
279	    let mut headers = copy_passthrough_headers(incoming_headers);
280	    // Set auth using the provider's API key
281	    set_zai_auth(&mut headers, incoming_headers, api_key);
282	
283	    // Ensure JSON content type
284	    headers
285	        .entry(header::CONTENT_TYPE)
286	        .or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));
287	
288	    deep_remove_cache_control(&mut body);
289	
290	    let body_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap_or_default();
291	    let body_len = body_bytes.len();
292	
293	    tracing::debug!("Forwarding request to provider (len: {} bytes): {}", body_len, url);
294	
295	    let req = client.request(method, &url)
296	        .headers(headers)
297	        .body(body_bytes);
298	
299	    let resp = match req.send().await {
300	        Ok(r) => r,
301	        Err(e) => {
302	            return (
303	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
304	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
305	            )
306	                .into_response();
307	        }
308	    };
309	
310	    let status = StatusCode::from_u16(resp.status().as_u16()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY);
311	
312	    let mut out = Response::builder().status(status);
313	    if let Some(ct) = resp.headers().get(header::CONTENT_TYPE) {
314	        out = out.header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct.clone());
315	    }
316	
317	    let stream = resp.bytes_stream().map(|chunk| match chunk {
318	        Ok(b) => Ok::<Bytes, std::io::Error>(b),
319	        Err(e) => Ok(Bytes::from(format!("Upstream stream error: {}", e))),
320	    });
321	
322	    out.body(Body::from_stream(stream)).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
323	        (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to build response").into_response()
324	    })
325	}

327	/// Model mapping for generic providers (similar to map_model_for_zai but uses provider config).
328	fn map_model_for_provider(
329	    original: &str,
330	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
331	    default_models: &crate::proxy::config::ProviderModelDefaults,
332	) -> String {
333	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
334	    // 1. Exact match
335	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
336	        return mapped.clone();
337	    }
338	    // 2. Lowercase match
339	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
340	        return mapped.clone();
341	    }
342	    // 3. zai: prefix strip
343	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
344	        return original[4..].to_string();
345	    }
346	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
347	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
348	        return original.to_string();
349	    }
350	    // 5. Claude family defaults
351	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
352	        return original.to_string();
353	    }
354	    if m.contains("opus") {
355	        return default_models.opus.clone();
356	    }
357	    if m.contains("haiku") {
358	        return default_models.haiku.clone();
359	    }
360	    default_models.sonnet.clone()
361	}

---

## Research Findings

### 1. How `UpstreamClient` Works and Its Limitations

`UpstreamClient` is defined in `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/upstream/client.rs`. It has two important characteristics:

**The `UpstreamClient` is tightly coupled to the `TokenManager` path.** It cannot be used directly with custom `base_url + api_key` credentials. Here is why:

- **`call_v1_internal` and `call_v1_internal_with_headers`** (lines 240-417) take `access_token: &str` as a parameter -- this is a Google OAuth Bearer token obtained via `TokenManager::get_token()`, NOT an API key. The `access_token` is placed in an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (line 279-282).

- **`get_client(&self, account_id: Option<&str>) -> Client`** (lines 175-217) returns a cached `rquest::Client` based on account/proxy configuration. It does NOT accept custom base_url or api_key parameters. It only selects which HTTP client to use based on proxy routing, not authentication.

- **The hardcoded base URLs** (lines 46-57) are three Google Cloud Code endpoints:
  - `https://daily-cloudcode-pa.sandbox.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Sandbox, priority 1)
  - `https://daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Daily, priority 2)
  - `https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal` (Prod, priority 3, last resort)

- **URL pattern**: The `build_url` helper (line 220) uses the format `"{base_url}:{method}"` or `"{base_url}:{method}?{query}"`. For example:
  - `https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:generateContent`
  - `https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse`

### 2. How `forward_anthropic_with_provider` in `zai_anthropic.rs` Works

The function at `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/zai_anthropic.rs` (lines 235-325) uses a completely different approach:

- **It builds a dedicated `reqwest::Client`** (not `UpstreamClient`) via the `build_client()` helper (lines 49-69). This is a fresh `reqwest::Client` per request, configured with:
  - Timeout from `state.request_timeout`
  - Upstream proxy if configured
  - `tcp_nodelay(true)` for latency

- **URL joining** uses `join_base_url(base_url, path)` (lines 39-47), a simple string concatenation: `base_url.trim_end_matches('/') + "/" + path.lstrip('/')`. For example: `"https://api.openai.com" + "/v1/messages"` = `"https://api.openai.com/v1/messages"`.

- **Authentication** is done via `set_zai_auth()` (lines 92-111), which places the API key in `x-api-key` and/or `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` headers. This is an API key auth scheme, not OAuth Bearer tokens.

- **The request is sent as**: `client.request(method, &url).headers(headers).body(body_bytes).send().await` with streaming response body forwarded back.

### 3. Direct Answers to Your Questions

**Q: Can I use `UpstreamClient` directly with a provider's base_url and api_key?**

**No.** `UpstreamClient` is designed exclusively for the Google Cloud Code v1internal OAuth flow. Its `call_v1_internal*` methods:
- Hardcode the three Google base URLs (no way to override)
- Expect an OAuth `access_token` (from `TokenManager`), not an API key
- Use the `:{method}` URL suffix pattern (Google-specific)
- Inject Google-specific headers (`x-client-name: antigravity`, `x-machine-id`, `x-vscode-sessionid`)

**Q: Do I need to build a separate `reqwest::Client`?**

**Yes, follow the `forward_anthropic_with_provider` pattern.** Build a `reqwest::Client` per call (or cache it if performance becomes a concern). The `build_client()` helper in `zai_anthropic.rs` is the template. Alternatively, you could extract that helper into `proxy/common/` for reuse.

**Q: What is the exact URL pattern for v1internal calls?**

For **Google v1internal** (the existing path via `UpstreamClient`):
```
{base_url}:{method}           // e.g., https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:generateContent
{base_url}:{method}?alt=sse   // e.g., https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse
```

Note the colon (`:`) separator between base URL and method name, NOT a slash. This is Google's API URL convention.

### 4. To Call v1internal with Custom Credentials (base_url + api_key)

You would need to write a new function that:

1. Builds a `reqwest::Client` (like `build_client()` in `zai_anthropic.rs`)
2. Constructs the URL using the `{base_url}:{method}` pattern from `UpstreamClient::build_url()`
3. Sets headers:
   - `Content-Type: application/json`
   - `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` (if the custom credential is a Bearer token)
   - Or `x-api-key: <api_key>` (if the custom credential is an API key)
4. Sends the POST request with `client.post(&url).headers(headers).json(&body).send().await`
5. Streams the response body back as an `axum::Body::from_stream()`

The existing `call_v1_internal` method on `UpstreamClient` cannot be repurposed for this without significant modification, because the base URLs are hardcoded constants and the auth scheme is fixed to OAuth Bearer tokens from `TokenManager`.

use axum::{
    body::Body,
    http::{HeaderValue, StatusCode},
    response::Response,
};
use futures::StreamExt;
use serde_json::Value;
use tokio::time::Duration;

use crate::proxy::server::AppState;
use crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProvider;

/// Build a URL for Google v1internal API using the colon separator convention.
fn build_v1internal_url(base_url: &str, method: &str, query: Option<&str>) -> String {
    let base = base_url.trim_end_matches('/');
    match query {
        Some(q) => format!("{}:{}?{}", base, method, q),
        None => format!("{}:{}", base, method),
    }
}

/// Build a reqwest::Client for upstream v1internal calls.
fn build_v1internal_client(
    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
    timeout_secs: u64,
) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));

    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
        }
    }

    builder
        .tcp_nodelay(true)
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
}

/// Forward an OpenAI Chat request through a GeminiV1Internal provider,
/// returning the response in OpenAI format (SSE stream or JSON).
pub async fn forward_gemini_v1internal_with_provider(
    state: &AppState,
    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
    openai_req: &crate::proxy::mappers::openai::request::OpenAIRequest,
    headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap,
) -> Response {
    use crate::proxy::mappers::openai::{
        request::transform_openai_request,
        response::transform_openai_response,
        streaming::create_openai_sse_stream,
    };

    let trace_id = state
        .debug_cfg
        .read()
        .await
        .trace_id
        .clone()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string());

    // Map model name using provider config
    let mapped_model = crate::proxy::providers::zai_anthropic::map_model_for_provider(
        &openai_req.model,
        &provider.model_mapping,
        &provider.default_models,
    );

    // Use a placeholder project_id (v1internal provider with API key may not need it)
    let project_id = "default";

    // Transform OpenAI request to Gemini v1internal format
    let (gemini_body, _session_id, message_count) =
        transform_openai_request(openai_req, project_id, &mapped_model, None);

    let client_wants_stream = openai_req.stream;
    let force_stream_internally = !client_wants_stream;
    let actual_stream = client_wants_stream || force_stream_internally;

    let method = if actual_stream {
        "streamGenerateContent"
    } else {
        "generateContent"
    };
    let query_string = if actual_stream {
        Some("alt=sse")
    } else {
        None
    };

    let url = build_v1internal_url(&provider.base_url, method, query_string);

    let timeout_secs = provider
        .request_timeout_secs
        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout.as_secs().max(5) as u64);

    let client = match build_v1internal_client(state.upstream_proxy.clone(), timeout_secs) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                format!("Failed to build client: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    let body_bytes = match serde_json::to_vec(&gemini_body) {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                format!("Failed to serialize body: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    // Build request headers
    let mut req_headers = axum::http::HeaderMap::new();
    req_headers.insert(
        "content-type",
        HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
    );
    // v1internal uses Bearer token auth with the API key
    if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", provider.api_key)) {
        req_headers.insert("authorization", v);
    }
    // Copy conservative passthrough headers
    for (k, v) in headers.iter() {
        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
        match key.as_str() {
            "accept" | "user-agent" | "accept-encoding" => {
                req_headers.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    let response = match client
        .post(&url)
        .headers(req_headers)
        .body(body_bytes)
        .send()
        .await
    {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    let status = response.status();
    if !status.is_success() {
        let error_body = response.bytes().await.unwrap_or_default();
        return (status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&error_body).to_string()).into_response();
    }

    // Stream the response
    if actual_stream {
        // Always use streaming internally, convert to OpenAI SSE
        let gemini_stream = response.bytes_stream();
        let openai_stream = create_openai_sse_stream(
            Box::pin(gemini_stream),
            openai_req.model.clone(),
            String::new(), // session_id not available in provider path
            message_count,
        );

        Response::builder()
            .status(StatusCode::OK)
            .header("content-type", "text/event-stream")
            .header("cache-control", "no-cache")
            .header("connection", "keep-alive")
            .header("x-mapped-model", &mapped_model)
            .body(Body::from_stream(openai_stream))
            .unwrap()
    } else {
        // Non-streaming: collect JSON and convert
        let bytes = match response.bytes().await {
            Ok(b) => b,
            Err(e) => {
                return (
                    StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                    format!("Failed to read response body: {}", e),
                )
                    .into_response();
            }
        };

        let gemini_value: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(&bytes) {
            Ok(v) => v,
            Err(e) => {
                return (
                    StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                    format!("Failed to parse response JSON: {}", e),
                )
                    .into_response();
            }
        };

        // Unwrap v1internal envelope if present
        let inner = if let Some(response_field) = gemini_value.get("response") {
            response_field.clone()
        } else {
            gemini_value
        };

        let openai_resp = transform_openai_response(&inner, None, message_count);
        match serde_json::to_string(&openai_resp) {
            Ok(json) => Response::builder()
                .status(StatusCode::OK)
                .header("content-type", "application/json")
                .header("x-mapped-model", &mapped_model)
                .body(Body::from(json))
                .unwrap(),
            Err(e) => (
                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                format!("Failed to serialize response: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response(),
        }
    }
}

1204	pub fn to_claude_body(request: &OpenAIRequest) -> Value {

1206	
1207	    let messages: Vec<Value> = request
1208	        .messages
1209	        .iter()
1210	        .map(|m| {
1211	            let role = match m.role.to_lowercase().as_str() {
1212	                "system" => "user",
1213	                "assistant" => "assistant",
1214	                "tool" | "function" => "user",
1215	                _ => "user",
1216	            };
1217	            let content: Value = match &m.content {
1218	                Some(OpenAIContent::String(s)) => Value::String(s.clone()),
1219	                Some(OpenAIContent::Array(blocks)) => {
1220	                    let parts: Vec<Value> = blocks.iter().map(|b| match b {
1221	                        super::models::OpenAIContentBlock::Text { text } => {
1222	                            json!({ "type": "text", "text": text })
1223	                        }
1224	                        super::models::OpenAIContentBlock::ImageUrl { image_url } => {
1225	                            json!({ "type": "image", "source": { "type": "url", "url": &image_url.url } })
1226	                        }
1227	                        super::models::OpenAIContentBlock::AudioUrl { audio_url } => {
1228	                            json!({ "type": "text", "text": format!("[audio: {}]", audio_url.url) })
1229	                        }
1230	                    }).collect();
1231	                    if parts.len() == 1 {
1232	                        parts[0]["text"].clone()
1233	                    } else {
1234	                        Value::Array(parts)
1235	                    }
1236	                }
1237	                None => Value::String(String::new()),
1238	            };
1239	            json!({ "role": role, "content": content })
1240	        })
1241	        .collect();
1242	
1243	    // Extract system messages
1244	    let system: Vec<String> = request
1245	        .messages
1246	        .iter()
1247	        .filter(|m| m.role.to_lowercase() == "system")
1248	        .filter_map(|m| match &m.content {
1249	            Some(OpenAIContent::String(s)) => Some(s.clone()),
1250	            _ => None,
1251	        })
1252	        .collect();
1253	    let system_str = if system.is_empty() {
1254	        None
1255	    } else {
1256	        Some(system.join("\n"))
1257	    };
1258	
1259	    let mut body = json!({
1260	        "model": &request.model,
1261	        "messages": messages,
1262	        "stream": request.stream,
1263	    });
1264	
1265	    if let Some(ref s) = system_str {
1266	        body["system"] = Value::String(s.clone());
1267	    }
1268	    if let Some(mt) = request.max_tokens {
1269	        body["max_tokens"] = Value::Number(mt.into());
1270	    }
1271	    if let Some(t) = request.temperature {

1273	    }
1274	    if let Some(t) = request.top_p {
1275	        body["top_p"] = serde_json::Number::from_f64(t).unwrap_or(serde_json::Number::from_f64(1.0).unwrap()).into();
1276	    }
1277	    if let Some(ref thinking) = request.thinking {

1279	            "type": thinking.thinking_type.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "enabled".to_string()),
1280	            "budget_tokens": thinking.budget_tokens,
1281	            "effort": thinking.effort,
1282	        });
1283	    }

183	        // Check by type (preferred for server tools)
184	        if let Some(ref t) = self.type_ {
185	            if t.starts_with("web_search") {
186	                return true;
187	            }
188	        }
189	        // Check by name (fallback)
190	        if let Some(ref n) = self.name {
191	            if n == "web_search" {
192	                return true;
193	            }
194	        }
195	        false
196	    }
197	
198	    /// Get the effective tool name
199	    #[allow(dead_code)]
200	    pub fn get_name(&self) -> String {
201	        self.name.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
202	            // For server tools, derive name from type
203	            if let Some(ref t) = self.type_ {
204	                if t.starts_with("web_search") {
205	                    return "web_search".to_string();
206	                }
207	            }
208	            "unknown".to_string()
209	        })
210	    }

use crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::{ClaudeRequest, ContentBlock, MessageContent};
use serde_json::{json, Value};

/// Convert Claude Messages API request to OpenAI Chat Completions format.
///
/// This is the inverse of `to_claude_body()` in the OpenAI mapper.
pub fn claude_to_openai_body(request: &ClaudeRequest) -> Value {
    let mut messages: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();

    // Extract system prompt into a system message
    if let Some(ref system) = request.system {
        let system_text = match system {
            crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::SystemPrompt::String(s) => s.clone(),
            crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::SystemPrompt::Array(blocks) => blocks
                .iter()
                .map(|b| b.text.clone())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join("\n"),
        };
        if !system_text.is_empty() {
            messages.push(json!({
                "role": "system",
                "content": system_text,
            }));
        }
    }

    // Convert Claude messages to OpenAI messages
    for msg in &request.messages {
        let openai_role = match msg.role.as_str() {
            "user" => "user",
            "assistant" => "assistant",
            _ => "user",
        };

        match &msg.content {
            MessageContent::String(s) => {
                messages.push(json!({
                    "role": openai_role,
                    "content": s,
                }));
            }
            MessageContent::Array(blocks) => {
                // Check if all blocks are text and can be joined into a single string
                let all_text: Option<String> = blocks.iter().try_fold(
                    String::new(),
                    |mut acc, b| {
                        if let ContentBlock::Text { text } = b {
                            acc.push_str(text);
                            Some(acc)
                        } else {
                            None
                        }
                    },
                );

                if let Some(text) = all_text {
                    messages.push(json!({
                        "role": openai_role,
                        "content": text,
                    }));
                } else {
                    // Multi-modal: convert to OpenAI content blocks
                    let content_blocks: Vec<Value> = blocks
                        .iter()
                        .filter_map(|block| content_block_to_openai(block))
                        .collect();

                    if content_blocks.is_empty() {
                        messages.push(json!({
                            "role": openai_role,
                            "content": "",
                        }));
                    } else if content_blocks.len() == 1
                        && content_blocks[0].get("type").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) == Some("text")
                    {
                        // Single text block: use simple string content
                        messages.push(json!({
                            "role": openai_role,
                            "content": content_blocks[0].get("text").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or(""),
                        }));
                    } else {
                        messages.push(json!({
                            "role": openai_role,
                            "content": content_blocks,
                        }));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let mut body = json!({
        "model": &request.model,
        "messages": messages,
        "stream": request.stream,
    });

    if let Some(mt) = request.max_tokens {
        body["max_tokens"] = Value::Number(mt.into());
    }
    if let Some(t) = request.temperature {
        if let Some(n) = serde_json::Number::from_f64(t) {
            body["temperature"] = n.into();
        }
    }
    if let Some(t) = request.top_p {
        if let Some(n) = serde_json::Number::from_f64(t) {
            body["top_p"] = n.into();
        }
    }

    // Convert Claude tools to OpenAI tools format
    if let Some(ref tools) = request.tools {
        let openai_tools: Vec<Value> = tools
            .iter()
            .filter(|t| !t.is_web_search())
            .filter_map(|t| {
                if let Some(ref schema) = t.input_schema {
                    Some(json!({
                        "type": "function",
                        "function": {
                            "name": t.get_name(),
                            "description": t.description.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
                            "parameters": schema,
                        }
                    }))
                } else {
                    None
                }
            })
            .collect();
        if !openai_tools.is_empty() {
            body["tools"] = Value::Array(openai_tools);
        }
    }

    // Convert Claude thinking to OpenAI thinking format
    if let Some(ref thinking) = request.thinking {
        body["thinking"] = json!({
            "type": thinking.type_.clone(),
            "budget_tokens": thinking.budget_tokens,
            "effort": thinking.effort,
        });
    }

    body
}

/// Convert a single Claude ContentBlock to an OpenAI content block Value.
/// Returns None for block types that have no OpenAI equivalent.
fn content_block_to_openai(block: &ContentBlock) -> Option<Value> {
    match block {
        ContentBlock::Text { text } => Some(json!({
            "type": "text",
            "text": text,
        })),
        ContentBlock::Image { source, .. } => {
            // Convert base64 image to data URL
            let data_url = format!(
                "data:{};base64,{}",
                source.media_type, source.data
            );
            Some(json!({
                "type": "image_url",
                "image_url": {
                    "url": data_url,
                }
            }))
        }
        ContentBlock::Thinking { thinking, .. } => Some(json!({
            "type": "text",
            "text": format!("<thinking>{}</thinking>", thinking),
        })),
        ContentBlock::ToolUse { id, name, input, .. } => Some(json!({
            "type": "tool_use",
            "id": id,
            "name": name,
            "input": input,
        })),
        ContentBlock::ToolResult { tool_use_id, content, is_error } => {
            let text = match content {
                serde_json::Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
                other => serde_json::to_string(other).unwrap_or_default(),
            };
            let mut block = json!({
                "type": "tool_result",
                "tool_use_id": tool_use_id,
                "content": text,
            });
            if let Some(true) = is_error {
                block["is_error"] = Value::Bool(true);
            }
            Some(block)
        }
        // These types don't have direct OpenAI equivalents
        ContentBlock::Document { .. }
        | ContentBlock::RedactedThinking { .. }
        | ContentBlock::ServerToolUse { .. }
        | ContentBlock::WebSearchToolResult { .. } => None,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::{Message, MessageContent};

    #[test]
    fn test_basic_text_conversion() {
        let claude_req = ClaudeRequest {
            model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514".to_string(),
            messages: vec![
                Message {
                    role: "user".to_string(),
                    content: MessageContent::String("Hello".to_string()),
                },
            ],
            system: None,
            tools: None,
            stream: false,
            max_tokens: Some(1024),
            temperature: Some(0.7),
            top_p: None,
            top_k: None,
            thinking: None,
            metadata: None,
            output_config: None,
            size: None,
            quality: None,
        };

        let openai_body = claude_to_openai_body(&claude_req);

        assert_eq!(openai_body["model"], "claude-sonnet-4-20250514");
        assert_eq!(openai_body["stream"], false);
        assert_eq!(openai_body["max_tokens"], 1024);
        let msgs = openai_body["messages"].as_array().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(msgs.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(msgs[0]["role"], "user");
        assert_eq!(msgs[0]["content"], "Hello");
    }

    fn test_system_prompt_conversion() {
        let claude_req = ClaudeRequest {
            model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514".to_string(),
            messages: vec![Message {
                role: "user".to_string(),
                content: MessageContent::String("Hi".to_string()),
            }],
            system: Some(crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::SystemPrompt::String(
                "You are a helpful assistant.".to_string(),
            )),
            tools: None,
            stream: false,
            max_tokens: None,
            temperature: None,
            top_p: None,
            top_k: None,
            thinking: None,
            metadata: None,
            output_config: None,
            size: None,
            quality: None,
        };

        let openai_body = claude_to_openai_body(&claude_req);
        let msgs = openai_body["messages"].as_array().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(msgs.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(msgs[0]["role"], "system");
        assert_eq!(msgs[0]["content"], "You are a helpful assistant.");
        assert_eq!(msgs[1]["role"], "user");
    }
