use bytes::Bytes;
use futures::{Stream, StreamExt};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::pin::Pin;
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Convert an OpenAI Chat Completions SSE stream to a Claude Messages SSE stream.
pub fn create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream<S, E>(
    mut openai_stream: Pin<Box<S>>,
    model: String,
) -> Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, String>> + Send>>
where
    S: Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, E>> + Send + ?Sized + 'static,
    E: std::fmt::Display + Send + 'static,
{
    use bytes::BytesMut;

    let message_id = format!("msg_{}", Uuid::new_v4().replace('-', "").chars().take(24).collect::<String>());
    let created_ts = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() as u64;

    let stream = async_stream::stream! {
        let mut buffer = BytesMut::new();
        let mut content_block_index: u32 = 0;
        let mut emitted_message_start = false;
        let mut final_input_tokens: u32 = 0;
        let mut final_output_tokens: u32 = 0;
        let mut error_occurred = false;
        let mut tool_call_index: u32 = 0;

        let mut heartbeat_interval = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(15));
        heartbeat_interval.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Skip);

        loop {
            tokio::select! {
                item = openai_stream.next() => {
                    match item {
                        Some(Ok(bytes)) => {
                            buffer.extend_from_slice(&bytes);
                            while let Some(pos) = buffer.iter().position(|&b| b == b'\n') {
                                let line_raw = buffer.split_to(pos + 1);
                                if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&line_raw) {
                                    let line = line_str.trim();
                                    if line.is_empty() { continue; }
                                    if !line.starts_with("data: ") { continue; }
                                    let data = &line["data: ".len()..];
                                    if data == "[DONE]" {
                                        // End of stream - emit message_delta with stop_reason and usage, then message_stop
                                        let usage_json = json!({
                                            "input_tokens": final_input_tokens,
                                            "output_tokens": final_output_tokens,
                                        });
                                        let delta_event = json!({
                                            "type": "message_delta",
                                            "delta": {
                                                "stop_reason": "end_turn",
                                                "stop_sequence": null,
                                            },
                                            "usage": usage_json,
                                        });
                                        let delta_bytes = Bytes::from(format!(
                                            "event: message_delta\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                            serde_json::to_string(&delta_event).unwrap_or_default()
                                        ));
                                        yield Ok(delta_bytes);

                                        let stop_event = Bytes::from(
                                            "event: message_stop\ndata: {\"type\":\"message_stop\"}\n\n"
                                        );
                                        yield Ok(stop_event);
                                        break;
                                    }

                                    if let Ok(event) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(data) {
                                        // Emit message_start on first meaningful event
                                        if !emitted_message_start && event.get("choices").is_some() {
                                            emitted_message_start = true;
                                            let start_event = json!({
                                                "type": "message_start",
                                                "message": {
                                                    "id": message_id,
                                                    "type": "message",
                                                    "role": "assistant",
                                                    "content": [],
                                                    "model": model,
                                                    "stop_reason": null,
                                                    "stop_sequence": null,
                                                    "usage": {
                                                        "input_tokens": 0,
                                                        "output_tokens": 0,
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            });
                                            let start_bytes = Bytes::from(format!(
                                                "event: message_start\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                serde_json::to_string(&start_event).unwrap_or_default()
                                            ));
                                            yield Ok(start_bytes);
                                        }

                                        // Process choices
                                        if let Some(choices) = event.get("choices").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {
                                            for choice in choices {
                                                let index = choice.get("index").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0) as u32;
                                                if let Some(delta) = choice.get("delta") {
                                                    // Text content
                                                    if let Some(text) = delta.get("content").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                                                        if !text.is_empty() {
                                                            // Check if we need to start a new content block
                                                            let content_start = json!({
                                                                "type": "content_block_start",
                                                                "index": content_block_index,
                                                                "content_block": {
                                                                    "type": "text",
                                                                    "text": "",
                                                                }
                                                            });
                                                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                                "event: content_block_start\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                                serde_json::to_string(&content_start).unwrap_or_default()
                                                            )));

                                                            let content_delta = json!({
                                                                "type": "content_block_delta",
                                                                "index": content_block_index,
                                                                "delta": {
                                                                    "type": "text_delta",
                                                                    "text": text,
                                                                }
                                                            });
                                                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                                "event: content_block_delta\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                                serde_json::to_string(&content_delta).unwrap_or_default()
                                                            )));

                                                            let content_stop = json!({
                                                                "type": "content_block_stop",
                                                                "index": content_block_index,
                                                            });
                                                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                                "event: content_block_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                                serde_json::to_string(&content_stop).unwrap_or_default()
                                                            )));
                                                            content_block_index += 1;
                                                        }
                                                    }

                                                    // Reasoning / thinking content
                                                    if let Some(reasoning) = delta.get("reasoning_content").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                                                        if !reasoning.is_empty() {
                                                            let content_start = json!({
                                                                "type": "content_block_start",
                                                                "index": content_block_index,
                                                                "content_block": {
                                                                    "type": "thinking",
                                                                    "thinking": "",
                                                                    "signature": null,
                                                                }
                                                            });
                                                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                                "event: content_block_start\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                                serde_json::to_string(&content_start).unwrap_or_default()
                                                            )));

                                                            let content_delta = json!({
                                                                "type": "content_block_delta",
                                                                "index": content_block_index,
                                                                "delta": {
                                                                    "type": "thinking_delta",
                                                                    "thinking": reasoning,
                                                                }
                                                            });
                                                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                                "event: content_block_delta\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                                serde_json::to_string(&content_delta).unwrap_or_default()
                                                            )));

                                                            let content_stop = json!({
                                                                "type": "content_block_stop",
                                                                "index": content_block_index,
                                                            });
                                                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                                "event: content_block_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                                serde_json::to_string(&content_stop).unwrap_or_default()
                                                            )));
                                                            content_block_index += 1;
                                                        }
                                                    }

                                                    // Tool calls
                                                    if let Some(tool_calls) = delta.get("tool_calls").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
                                                        for tc in tool_calls {
                                                            let tc_index = tc.get("index").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(tool_call_index as u64);
                                                            if let Some(function) = tc.get("function") {
                                                                if let Some(name) = function.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                                                                    // Check if this is a new tool call
                                                                    if !delta.get("id").is_some() || tc_index as u32 == tool_call_index {
                                                                        let tool_id = tc.get("id")
                                                                            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                                                                            .unwrap_or(&format!("toolu_{}", Uuid::new_v4()))
                                                                            .to_string();
                                                                        let args = function.get("arguments")
                                                                            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                                                                            .unwrap_or("{}")
                                                                            .to_string();

                                                                        let content_start = json!({
                                                                            "type": "content_block_start",
                                                                            "index": content_block_index,
                                                                            "content_block": {
                                                                                "type": "tool_use",
                                                                                "id": tool_id,
                                                                                "name": name,
                                                                                "input": serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&args).unwrap_or(json!({})),
                                                                            }
                                                                        });
                                                                        yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                                            "event: content_block_start\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                                            serde_json::to_string(&content_start).unwrap_or_default()
                                                                        )));

                                                                        let content_stop = json!({
                                                                            "type": "content_block_stop",
                                                                            "index": content_block_index,
                                                                        });
                                                                        yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                                            "event: content_block_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                                            serde_json::to_string(&content_stop).unwrap_or_default()
                                                                        )));
                                                                        content_block_index += 1;
                                                                        tool_call_index += 1;
                                                                    }
                                                                }
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                }

                                                // Usage
                                                if let Some(usage) = choice.get("usage") {
                                                    final_input_tokens = usage.get("prompt_tokens")
                                                        .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
                                                        .unwrap_or(0) as u32;
                                                    final_output_tokens = usage.get("completion_tokens")
                                                        .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
                                                        .unwrap_or(0) as u32;
                                                }

                                                // Finish reason
                                                if let Some(finish_reason) = choice.get("finish_reason").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                                                    let stop_reason = match finish_reason {
                                                        "stop" => "end_turn",
                                                        "length" => "max_tokens",
                                                        "tool_calls" => "tool_use",
                                                        "content_filter" => "end_turn",
                                                        _ => "end_turn",
                                                    };
                                                    // Only emit message_delta if message_start was emitted
                                                    if emitted_message_start {
                                                        let usage_json = json!({
                                                            "input_tokens": final_input_tokens,
                                                            "output_tokens": final_output_tokens,
                                                        });
                                                        let delta_event = json!({
                                                            "type": "message_delta",
                                                            "delta": {
                                                                "stop_reason": stop_reason,
                                                                "stop_sequence": null,
                                                            },
                                                            "usage": usage_json,
                                                        });
                                                        yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                                            "event: message_delta\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                                            serde_json::to_string(&delta_event).unwrap_or_default()
                                                        )));
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Some(Err(e)) => {
                            error_occurred = true;
                            let err_event = json!({
                                "type": "error",
                                "error": {
                                    "type": "upstream_error",
                                    "message": format!("Stream error: {}", e),
                                }
                            });
                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                "event: error\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                serde_json::to_string(&err_event).unwrap_or_default()
                            )));
                            break;
                        }
                        None => {
                            // Stream ended without [DONE]
                            if emitted_message_start {
                                let usage_json = json!({
                                    "input_tokens": final_input_tokens,
                                    "output_tokens": final_output_tokens,
                                });
                                let delta_event = json!({
                                    "type": "message_delta",
                                    "delta": {
                                        "stop_reason": if error_occurred { "stop_sequence" } else { "end_turn" },
                                        "stop_sequence": null,
                                    },
                                    "usage": usage_json,
                                });
                                yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!(
                                    "event: message_delta\ndata: {}\n\n",
                                    serde_json::to_string(&delta_event).unwrap_or_default()
                                )));
                            }
                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(
                                "event: message_stop\ndata: {\"type\":\"message_stop\"}\n\n"
                            ));
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                _ = heartbeat_interval.tick() => {
                    yield Ok(Bytes::from(": ping - heartbeat\n\n"));
                }
            }
        }
    };

    Box::pin(stream)
}

/// Convert an OpenAI Chat Completions JSON response to a Value suitable for Claude format.
/// This returns a JSON Value that matches the Claude Messages API non-streaming response shape.
pub fn openai_to_claude_response(openai_response: &Value, model: &str) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let message_id = format!("msg_{}", Uuid::new_v4().replace('-', "").chars().take(24).collect::<String>());

    let choices = openai_response
        .get("choices")
        .and_then(|c| c.as_array())
        .ok_or_else(|| "Missing choices in OpenAI response".to_string())?;

    let mut content_blocks: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();
    let mut stop_reason = "end_turn";

    for choice in choices {
        if let Some(message) = choice.get("message") {
            // Text content
            if let Some(text) = message.get("content").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                if !text.is_empty() {
                    content_blocks.push(json!({
                        "type": "text",
                        "text": text,
                    }));
                }
            }

            // Reasoning content
            if let Some(reasoning) = message.get("reasoning_content").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                if !reasoning.is_empty() {
                    content_blocks.push(json!({
                        "type": "thinking",
                        "thinking": reasoning,
                        "signature": null,
                    }));
                }
            }

            // Tool calls
            if let Some(tool_calls) = message.get("tool_calls").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
                for tc in tool_calls {
                    if let Some(function) = tc.get("function") {
                        let id = tc.get("id")
                            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                            .unwrap_or("toolu_unknown")
                            .to_string();
                        let name = function.get("name")
                            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                            .unwrap_or("unknown")
                            .to_string();
                        let input = function.get("arguments")
                            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                            .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(s).ok())
                            .unwrap_or(json!({}));
                        content_blocks.push(json!({
                            "type": "tool_use",
                            "id": id,
                            "name": name,
                            "input": input,
                        }));
                        stop_reason = "tool_use";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if let Some(fr) = choice.get("finish_reason").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
            stop_reason = match fr {
                "stop" => "end_turn",
                "length" => "max_tokens",
                "tool_calls" => "tool_use",
                "content_filter" => "end_turn",
                _ => "end_turn",
            };
        }
    }

    // Extract usage
    let usage = openai_response.get("usage").map(|u| {
        json!({
            "input_tokens": u.get("prompt_tokens").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0),
            "output_tokens": u.get("completion_tokens").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0),
        })
    }).unwrap_or(json!({
        "input_tokens": 0,
        "output_tokens": 0,
    }));

    let claude_resp = json!({
        "id": message_id,
        "type": "message",
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": content_blocks,
        "model": model,
        "stop_reason": stop_reason,
        "stop_sequence": null,
        "usage": usage,
    });

    Ok(claude_resp)
}

24	/// 创建从 Gemini SSE 流到 Claude SSE 流的转换
25	pub fn create_claude_sse_stream<S, E>(
26	    mut gemini_stream: Pin<Box<S>>,
27	    trace_id: String,
28	    email: String,
29	    session_id: Option<String>, // [NEW v3.3.17] Session ID for signature caching
30	    scaling_enabled: bool, // [NEW] Flag for context usage scaling
31	    context_limit: u32,
32	    estimated_prompt_tokens: Option<u32>, // [FIX] Estimated tokens for calibrator learning
33	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Message count for rewind detection
34	    client_adapter: Option<std::sync::Arc<dyn ClientAdapter>>, // [NEW] Adapter reference
35	    registered_tool_names: Vec<String>, // [FIX #MCP] Tool names for fuzzy matching
36	) -> Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, String>> + Send>> 
37	where
38	    S: Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, E>> + Send + ?Sized + 'static,
39	    E: std::fmt::Display + Send + 'static,
40	{
41	    use async_stream::stream;
42	    use bytes::BytesMut;
43	    use futures::StreamExt;
44	
45	    Box::pin(stream! {
46	        let mut state = StreamingState::new();
47	        state.session_id = session_id; // Set session ID for signature caching
48	        state.message_count = message_count; // [NEW v4.0.0] Set message count
49	        state.scaling_enabled = scaling_enabled; // Set scaling enabled flag
50	        state.context_limit = context_limit;
51	        state.estimated_prompt_tokens = estimated_prompt_tokens; // [FIX] Pass estimated tokens
52	        state.set_client_adapter(client_adapter); // [NEW] Set adapter
53	        state.set_registered_tool_names(registered_tool_names); // [FIX #MCP] Set tool names
54	        let mut buffer = BytesMut::new();
55	
56	        loop {
57	            // [NEW] 60秒心跳保活: 延长超时时间以增加网络抖动容错
58	            let next_chunk = tokio::time::timeout(
59	                std::time::Duration::from_secs(60),
60	                gemini_stream.next()
61	            ).await;
62	
63	            match next_chunk {
64	                Ok(Some(chunk_result)) => {
65	                    match chunk_result {
66	                        Ok(chunk) => {
67	                            buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
68	
69	                            // Process complete lines
70	                            while let Some(pos) = buffer.iter().position(|&b| b == b'\n') {
71	                                let line_raw = buffer.split_to(pos + 1);
72	                                if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&line_raw) {
73	                                    let line = line_str.trim();
74	                                    if line.is_empty() { continue; }
75	
76	                                    if let Some(sse_chunks) = process_sse_line(line, &mut state, &trace_id, &email) {
77	                                        for sse_chunk in sse_chunks {
78	                                            yield Ok(sse_chunk);
79	                                        }
80	                                    }
81	                                }
82	                            }
83	                        }
84	                        Err(e) => {
85	                            let error_json = serde_json::json!({
86	                                "error": {
87	                                    "message": format!("Stream error: {}", e),
88	                                    "type": "stream_error"
89	                                }
90	                            });
91	                            yield Ok(Bytes::from(format!("data: {}\n\n", error_json)));
92	                            break;
93	                        }
94	                    }
95	                }
96	                Ok(None) => break, // Stream 正常结束
97	                Err(_) => {
98	                    // 超时，发送心跳包 (SSE Comment 格式)
99	                    yield Ok(Bytes::from(": ping\n\n"));
100	                }
101	            }
102	        }
103	        
104	        // [FIX #1732] Mandatory Flush remaining buffer on stream termination
105	        // Prevents hangs when the last SSE chunk doesn't end with a newline (network fragmentation)
106	        if !buffer.is_empty() {
107	             if let Ok(line_str) = std::str::from_utf8(&buffer) {
108	                 let line = line_str.trim();
109	                 if !line.is_empty() {
110	                     tracing::debug!("[{}] SSE Termination: Flushing remaining {} bytes in buffer", trace_id, buffer.len());
111	                     if let Some(sse_chunks) = process_sse_line(line, &mut state, &trace_id, &email) {
112	                         for sse_chunk in sse_chunks {
113	                             yield Ok(sse_chunk);
114	                         }
115	                     }
116	                 }
117	             }
118	             buffer.clear();
119	        }
120	
121	        // [FIX #859] Post-thinking interruption recovery
122	        // If we have sent thinking but NO content (text/tool_use) and the stream ended (or timed out without DONE),
123	        // we must provide a fallback to prevent 0-token errors on client side.
124	        if state.has_thinking && !state.has_content {
125	            tracing::warn!("[{}] Stream interrupted after thinking (No Content). Triggering recovery...", trace_id);
126	            
127	            // 1. Force close thinking block if open
128	            if state.current_block_type() == crate::proxy::mappers::claude::streaming::BlockType::Thinking {
129	               let close_chunks = state.end_block();
130	               for chunk in close_chunks {
131	                   yield Ok(chunk);
132	               }
133	            }
134	
135	            // 2. Inject system message to inform user
136	            // We use a new text block for this.
137	            let recovery_msg = "\n\n[System] Upstream model interrupted after thinking. (Recovered by Antigravity)";
138	            let start_chunks = state.start_block(
139	                crate::proxy::mappers::claude::streaming::BlockType::Text, 
140	                serde_json::json!({ "type": "text", "text": recovery_msg })
141	            );
142	            for chunk in start_chunks { yield Ok(chunk); }
143	            
144	            let stop_chunks = state.end_block();
145	            for chunk in stop_chunks { yield Ok(chunk); }
146	
147	            // 3. Mark as content received so we don't trigger this again (though loop is done)
148	            state.has_content = true;
149	
150	            // 4. Send a simulated usage update to ensure we have > 0 output tokens
151	            // Estimate based on some default if we didn't get any usage
152	            let recovery_usage = crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::Usage {
153	                input_tokens: 0, // We don't know input, but output is critical
154	                output_tokens: 100, // Arbitrary small number to satisfy client
155	                cache_read_input_tokens: None,
156	                cache_creation_input_tokens: None,
157	                server_tool_use: None,
158	            };
159	
160	            let delta = serde_json::json!({
161	                "type": "message_delta",
162	                "delta": { "stop_reason": "end_turn", "stop_sequence": null },
163	                "usage": recovery_usage
164	            });
165	
166	            yield Ok(state.emit("message_delta", delta));
167	        }
168	
169	        // Ensure termination events are sent
170	        for chunk in emit_force_stop(&mut state) {
171	            yield Ok(chunk);
172	        }
173	    })
174	}

176	/// 处理单行 SSE 数据
177	fn process_sse_line(line: &str, state: &mut StreamingState, trace_id: &str, email: &str) -> Option<Vec<Bytes>> {
178	    if !line.starts_with("data: ") {
179	        return None;
180	    }
181	
182	    let data_str = line[6..].trim();
183	    if data_str.is_empty() {
184	        return None;
185	    }
186	
187	    if data_str == "[DONE]" {
188	        let chunks = emit_force_stop(state);
189	        if chunks.is_empty() {
190	            return None;
191	        }
192	        return Some(chunks);
193	    }
194	
195	    // 解析 JSON
196	    let json_value: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_str(data_str) {
197	        Ok(v) => v,
198	        Err(_) => return None,
199	    };
200	
201	    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
202	
203	    // 解包 response 字段 (如果存在)
204	    let raw_json = json_value.get("response").unwrap_or(&json_value);
205	
206	    // 发送 message_start
207	    if !state.message_start_sent {
208	        chunks.push(state.emit_message_start(raw_json));
209	    }
210	
211	    // 捕获 groundingMetadata (Web Search)
212	    if let Some(candidate) = raw_json.get("candidates").and_then(|c| c.get(0)) {
213	        if let Some(grounding) = candidate.get("groundingMetadata") {
214	            // 提取搜索词
215	            if let Some(query) = grounding.get("webSearchQueries")
216	                .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
217	                .and_then(|arr| arr.get(0))
218	                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
219	            {
220	                state.web_search_query = Some(query.to_string());
221	            }
222	
223	            // 提取结果块
224	            if let Some(chunks_arr) = grounding.get("groundingChunks").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
225	                state.grounding_chunks = Some(chunks_arr.clone());
226	            } else if let Some(chunks_arr) = grounding.get("grounding_metadata").and_then(|m| m.get("groundingChunks")).and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
227	                state.grounding_chunks = Some(chunks_arr.clone());
228	            }
229	        }
230	    }
231	
232	    // 处理所有 parts
233	    if let Some(parts) = raw_json
234	        .get("candidates")
235	        .and_then(|c| c.get(0))
236	        .and_then(|cand| cand.get("content"))
237	        .and_then(|content| content.get("parts"))
238	        .and_then(|p| p.as_array())
239	    {
240	        for part_value in parts {
241	            if let Ok(part) = serde_json::from_value::<GeminiPart>(part_value.clone()) {
242	                let mut processor = PartProcessor::new(state);
243	                chunks.extend(processor.process(&part));
244	            }
245	        }
246	    }
247	
248	    // Process grounding metadata (googleSearch results) and append as citations
249	    // [DISABLED] Temporarily disabled to fix Cherry Studio compatibility
250	    // Cherry Studio doesn't recognize "web_search_tool_result" type, causing validation errors
251	    // Search results are still displayed via Markdown text block in streaming.rs (lines 341-381)
252	
253	    /*
254	    if let Some(grounding) = raw_json
255	        .get("candidates")
256	        .and_then(|c| c.get(0))
257	        .and_then(|cand| cand.get("groundingMetadata"))
258	    {
259	        if let Some(citation_chunks) = process_grounding_metadata(grounding, state) {
260	            chunks.extend(citation_chunks);
261	        }
262	    }
263	    */
264	
265	    // 检查是否结束
266	    if let Some(finish_reason) = raw_json
267	        .get("candidates")
268	        .and_then(|c| c.get(0))
269	        .and_then(|cand| cand.get("finishReason"))
270	        .and_then(|f| f.as_str())
271	    {
272	        let usage = raw_json
273	            .get("usageMetadata")
274	            .and_then(|u| serde_json::from_value::<UsageMetadata>(u.clone()).ok());
275	
276	        if let Some(ref u) = usage {
277	            let cached_tokens = u.cached_content_token_count.unwrap_or(0);
278	            let cache_info = if cached_tokens > 0 {
279	                format!(", Cached: {}", cached_tokens)
280	            } else {
281	                String::new()
282	            };
283	            
284	             tracing::info!(
285	                 "[{}] ✓ Stream completed | Account: {} | In: {} tokens | Out: {} tokens{}", 
286	                 trace_id,
287	                 email,
288	                 u.prompt_token_count.unwrap_or(0).saturating_sub(cached_tokens), 
289	                 u.candidates_token_count.unwrap_or(0),
290	                 cache_info
291	             );
292	        }
293	
294	        chunks.extend(state.emit_finish(Some(finish_reason), usage.as_ref()));
295	    }
296	
297	    if chunks.is_empty() {
298	        None
299	    } else {
300	        Some(chunks)
301	    }
302	}

304	/// 发送强制结束事件
305	pub fn emit_force_stop(state: &mut StreamingState) -> Vec<Bytes> {
306	    if !state.message_stop_sent {
307	        let mut chunks = state.emit_finish(None, None);
308	        if chunks.is_empty() {
309	            chunks.push(Bytes::from(
310	                "event: message_stop\ndata: {\"type\":\"message_stop\"}\n\n",
311	            ));
312	            state.message_stop_sent = true;
313	        }
314	        return chunks;
315	    }
316	    vec![]
317	}

319	/// Process grounding metadata from Gemini's googleSearch and emit as Claude web_search blocks
320	#[allow(dead_code)] // Temporarily disabled for Cherry Studio compatibility, kept for future use
321	fn process_grounding_metadata(
322	    metadata: &serde_json::Value,
323	    state: &mut StreamingState,
324	) -> Option<Vec<Bytes>> {
325	    use serde_json::json;
326	
327	    // Extract search queries and grounding chunks
328	    let search_queries = metadata
329	        .get("webSearchQueries")
330	        .and_then(|q| q.as_array())
331	        .map(|arr| arr.iter().filter_map(|v| v.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>())
332	        .unwrap_or_default();
333	
334	    let grounding_chunks = metadata.get("groundingChunks").and_then(|c| c.as_array())?;
335	
336	    if grounding_chunks.is_empty() {
337	        return None;
338	    }
339	
340	    // Generate a unique tool_use_id
341	    let tool_use_id = format!(
342	        "srvtoolu_{}",
343	        crate::proxy::common::utils::generate_random_id()
344	    );
345	
346	    // Build search results array
347	    let mut search_results = Vec::new();
348	    for chunk in grounding_chunks.iter() {
349	        if let Some(web) = chunk.get("web") {
350	            let title = web
351	                .get("title")
352	                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())
353	                .unwrap_or("Source");
354	            let uri = web.get("uri").and_then(|u| u.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
355	            if !uri.is_empty() {
356	                search_results.push(json!({
357	                    "url": uri,
358	                    "title": title,
359	                    "encrypted_content": "", // Gemini doesn't provide this
360	                    "page_age": null
361	                }));
362	            }
363	        }
364	    }
365	
366	    if search_results.is_empty() {
367	        return None;
368	    }
369	
370	    let search_query = search_queries
371	        .first()
372	        .map(|s| s.to_string())
373	        .unwrap_or_default();
374	
375	    tracing::debug!(
376	        "[Grounding] Emitting {} search results for query: {}",
377	        search_results.len(),
378	        search_query
379	    );
380	
381	    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
382	
383	    // 1. Emit server_tool_use block (start)
384	    let server_tool_use_start = json!({
385	        "type": "content_block_start",
386	        "index": state.block_index,
387	        "content_block": {
388	            "type": "server_tool_use",
389	            "id": tool_use_id,
390	            "name": "web_search",
391	            "input": {
392	                "query": search_query
393	            }
394	        }
395	    });
396	    chunks.push(Bytes::from(format!(
397	        "event: content_block_start\ndata: {}\n\n",
398	        server_tool_use_start
399	    )));
400	
401	    // server_tool_use block stop
402	    let server_tool_use_stop = json!({
403	        "type": "content_block_stop",
404	        "index": state.block_index
405	    });
406	    chunks.push(Bytes::from(format!(
407	        "event: content_block_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
408	        server_tool_use_stop
409	    )));
410	    state.block_index += 1;
411	
412	    // 2. Emit web_search_tool_result block (start)
413	    let tool_result_start = json!({
414	        "type": "content_block_start",
415	        "index": state.block_index,
416	        "content_block": {
417	            "type": "web_search_tool_result",
418	            "tool_use_id": tool_use_id,
419	            "content": search_results
420	        }
421	    });
422	    chunks.push(Bytes::from(format!(
423	        "event: content_block_start\ndata: {}\n\n",
424	        tool_result_start
425	    )));
426	
427	    // web_search_tool_result block stop
428	    let tool_result_stop = json!({
429	        "type": "content_block_stop",
430	        "index": state.block_index
431	    });
432	    chunks.push(Bytes::from(format!(
433	        "event: content_block_stop\ndata: {}\n\n",
434	        tool_result_stop
435	    )));
436	    state.block_index += 1;
437	
438	    Some(chunks)
439	}

use axum::{
    body::Body,
    http::{HeaderValue, StatusCode},
    response::{IntoResponse, Response},
};
use serde_json::Value;
use tokio::time::Duration;

use crate::proxy::server::AppState;
use crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProvider;
use crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::ClaudeRequest;

/// Build a URL for OpenAI-compatible API.
fn build_openai_compat_url(base_url: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let base = base_url.trim_end_matches('/');
    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
        path.to_string()
    } else {
        format!("/{}", path)
    };
    Ok(format!("{}{}", base, path))
}

/// Build a reqwest::Client for upstream OpenAI-compatible calls.
fn build_openai_compat_client(
    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
    timeout_secs: u64,
) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));

    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
        }
    }

    builder
        .tcp_nodelay(true)
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
}

/// Forward a Claude Messages request through an OpenAI-Compatible provider.
/// Converts Claude → OpenAI request, then OpenAI response → Claude SSE/JSON.
pub async fn forward_claude_via_openai_compat(
    state: &AppState,
    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
    claude_req: &ClaudeRequest,
    headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap,
) -> Response {
    use crate::proxy::mappers::claude::request_bridge::claude_to_openai_body;
    use crate::proxy::mappers::claude::response_bridge::{
        create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream, openai_to_claude_response,
    };

    let trace_id = format!(
        "req_{}",
        chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_subsec_millis()
    );
    let _trace_id = &trace_id;

    // Map model name
    let mapped_model = crate::proxy::providers::zai_anthropic::map_model_for_provider(
        &claude_req.model,
        &provider.model_mapping,
        &provider.default_models,
    );

    // Convert Claude request to OpenAI format
    let openai_body = claude_to_openai_body(claude_req);
    let client_wants_stream = claude_req.stream;

    let url = match build_openai_compat_url(&provider.base_url, "/v1/chat/completions") {
        Ok(u) => u,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                format!("Failed to build URL: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    let timeout_secs = provider
        .request_timeout_secs
        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout.max(5));

    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
    let client = match build_openai_compat_client(upstream_proxy, timeout_secs) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                format!("Failed to build client: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    let body_bytes = match serde_json::to_vec(&openai_body) {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                format!("Failed to serialize body: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    // Build request headers
    let mut req_headers = axum::http::HeaderMap::new();
    req_headers.insert(
        "content-type",
        HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
    );
    // Bearer token auth
    if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", provider.api_key)) {
        req_headers.insert("authorization", v);
    }
    // Passthrough headers
    for (k, v) in headers.iter() {
        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
        match key.as_str() {
            "accept" | "user-agent" | "accept-encoding" => {
                req_headers.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    let response = match client
        .post(&url)
        .headers(req_headers)
        .body(body_bytes)
        .send()
        .await
    {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    let status = response.status();
    if !status.is_success() {
        let error_body = response.bytes().await.unwrap_or_default();
        return (status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&error_body).to_string()).into_response();
    }

    if client_wants_stream {
        // Stream: wrap OpenAI SSE through Claude SSE converter
        let openai_stream = response.bytes_stream();
        let claude_stream = create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream(
            Box::pin(openai_stream),
            mapped_model.clone(),
        );

        Response::builder()
            .status(StatusCode::OK)
            .header("content-type", "text/event-stream")
            .header("cache-control", "no-cache")
            .header("connection", "keep-alive")
            .header("x-mapped-model", &mapped_model)
            .body(Body::from_stream(claude_stream))
            .unwrap()
    } else {
        // Non-streaming: collect JSON and convert
        let bytes = match response.bytes().await {
            Ok(b) => b,
            Err(e) => {
                return (
                    StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                    format!("Failed to read response body: {}", e),
                )
                    .into_response();
            }
        };

        let openai_value: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(&bytes) {
            Ok(v) => v,
            Err(e) => {
                return (
                    StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                    format!("Failed to parse response JSON: {}", e),
                )
                    .into_response();
            }
        };

        let claude_resp = match openai_to_claude_response(&openai_value, &mapped_model) {
            Ok(v) => v,
            Err(e) => {
                return (
                    StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                    format!("Failed to convert response: {}", e),
                )
                    .into_response();
            }
        };

        match serde_json::to_string(&claude_resp) {
            Ok(json) => Response::builder()
                .status(StatusCode::OK)
                .header("content-type", "application/json")
                .header("x-mapped-model", &mapped_model)
                .body(Body::from(json))
                .unwrap(),
            Err(e) => (
                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                format!("Failed to serialize response: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response(),
        }
    }
}

```

use serde_json::{json, Value};

/// Convert a Gemini native request body to Claude Messages API format.
/// This is a basic conversion — complex features (tool calling, system instructions)
/// are preserved as-is where possible.
pub fn gemini_to_claude_body(body: &Value, model: &str) -> Value {
    let mut messages: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();
    let mut system_text = String::new();

    // Extract system instruction
    if let Some(sys) = body.get("systemInstruction") {
        if let Some(parts) = sys.get("parts").and_then(|p| p.as_array()) {
            for part in parts {
                if let Some(text) = part.get("text").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
                    if !system_text.is_empty() {
                        system_text.push_str("\n");
                    }
                    system_text.push_str(text);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Convert contents to messages
    if let Some(contents) = body.get("contents").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {
        for content in contents {
            let role = content
                .get("role")
                .and_then(|r| r.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("user");
            let claude_role = match role {
                "user" => "user",
                "model" => "assistant",
                _ => "user",
            };

            if let Some(parts) = content.get("parts").and_then(|p| p.as_array()) {
                // Collect text parts
                let texts: Vec<String> = parts
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|part| part.get("text").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).map(String::from))
                    .collect();

                let content_value = if texts.len() == 1 {
                    Value::String(texts[0].clone())
                } else if !texts.is_empty() {
                    Value::String(texts.join("\n"))
                } else {
                    Value::String(String::new())
                };

                messages.push(json!({
                    "role": claude_role,
                    "content": content_value,
                }));
            }
        }
    }

    let mut result = json!({
        "model": model,
        "messages": messages,
        "stream": false,
    });

    if !system_text.is_empty() {
        result["system"] = Value::String(system_text);
    }

    // Map generationConfig to Claude parameters
    if let Some(config) = body.get("generationConfig") {
        if let Some(max_tokens) = config.get("maxOutputTokens").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()) {
            result["max_tokens"] = Value::Number(max_tokens.into());
        }
        if let Some(temp) = config.get("temperature").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()) {
            if let Some(n) = serde_json::Number::from_f64(temp) {
                result["temperature"] = n.into();
            }
        }
        if let Some(top_p) = config.get("topP").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()) {
            if let Some(n) = serde_json::Number::from_f64(top_p) {
                result["top_p"] = n.into();
            }
        }
    }

    result
}

/// Convert a Claude Messages API response to Gemini native format.
pub fn claude_to_gemini_response(claude_response: &Value) -> Value {
    let mut text_parts: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();

    if let Some(content) = claude_response.get("content").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {
        for block in content {
            match block.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
                Some("text") => {
                    if let Some(text) = block.get("text").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
                        text_parts.push(json!({ "text": text }));
                    }
                }
                Some("thinking") => {
                    if let Some(thinking) = block.get("thinking").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
                        text_parts.push(json!({
                            "text": thinking,
                            "thought": true,
                        }));
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }

    let model = claude_response
        .get("model")
        .and_then(|m| m.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("unknown")
        .to_string();

    json!({
        "candidates": [{
            "content": {
                "role": "model",
                "parts": text_parts,
            },
            "finishReason": "STOP",
        }],
        "modelVersion": model,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_gemini_to_claude_basic() {
        let gemini = json!({
            "contents": [{
                "role": "user",
                "parts": [{"text": "Hello"}]
            }],
            "generationConfig": {
                "temperature": 0.7,
                "maxOutputTokens": 1024,
            }
        });

        let claude = gemini_to_claude_body(&gemini, "claude-sonnet-4-20250514");
        assert_eq!(claude["model"], "claude-sonnet-4-20250514");
        assert_eq!(claude["messages"][0]["role"], "user");
        assert_eq!(claude["messages"][0]["content"], "Hello");
        assert_eq!(claude["max_tokens"], 1024);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_claude_to_gemini_basic() {
        let claude = json!({
            "id": "msg_123",
            "type": "message",
            "role": "assistant",
            "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Hi there"}],
            "model": "claude-sonnet-4",
            "stop_reason": "end_turn",
            "stop_sequence": null,
            "usage": {"input_tokens": 10, "output_tokens": 5},
        });

        let gemini = claude_to_gemini_response(&claude);
        assert!(gemini.get("candidates").is_some());
        let candidates = gemini["candidates"].as_array().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(candidates[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"], "Hi there");
    }
}

use serde_json::{json, Value};

/// Convert a Gemini native request body to OpenAI Chat Completions format.
pub fn gemini_to_openai_body(body: &Value, model: &str) -> Value {
    let mut messages: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();

    // Extract system instruction as system message
    if let Some(sys) = body.get("systemInstruction") {
        if let Some(parts) = sys.get("parts").and_then(|p| p.as_array()) {
            let texts: Vec<String> = parts
                .iter()
                .filter_map(|part| part.get("text").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).map(String::from))
                .collect();
            if !texts.is_empty() {
                messages.push(json!({
                    "role": "system",
                    "content": texts.join("\n"),
                }));
            }
        }
    }

    // Convert contents to OpenAI messages
    if let Some(contents) = body.get("contents").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {
        for content in contents {
            let role = content
                .get("role")
                .and_then(|r| r.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("user");
            let openai_role = match role {
                "user" => "user",
                "model" => "assistant",
                _ => "user",
            };

            if let Some(parts) = content.get("parts").and_then(|p| p.as_array()) {
                let texts: Vec<String> = parts
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|part| part.get("text").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).map(String::from))
                    .collect();

                let content_value = if texts.len() == 1 {
                    Value::String(texts[0].clone())
                } else if !texts.is_empty() {
                    Value::String(texts.join("\n"))
                } else {
                    Value::String(String::new())
                };

                messages.push(json!({
                    "role": openai_role,
                    "content": content_value,
                }));
            }
        }
    }

    let mut result = json!({
        "model": model,
        "messages": messages,
        "stream": false,
    });

    // Map generationConfig
    if let Some(config) = body.get("generationConfig") {
        if let Some(max_tokens) = config.get("maxOutputTokens").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()) {
            result["max_tokens"] = Value::Number(max_tokens.into());
        }
        if let Some(temp) = config.get("temperature").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()) {
            if let Some(n) = serde_json::Number::from_f64(temp) {
                result["temperature"] = n.into();
            }
        }
        if let Some(top_p) = config.get("topP").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()) {
            if let Some(n) = serde_json::Number::from_f64(top_p) {
                result["top_p"] = n.into();
            }
        }
    }

    result
}

/// Convert an OpenAI Chat Completions response to Gemini native format.
pub fn openai_to_gemini_response(openai_response: &Value) -> Value {
    let mut text_parts: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();
    let mut model_version = "unknown".to_string();

    if let Some(choices) = openai_response.get("choices").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {
        for choice in choices {
            if let Some(message) = choice.get("message") {
                if let Some(text) = message.get("content").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
                    if !text.is_empty() {
                        text_parts.push(json!({ "text": text }));
                    }
                }
                if let Some(reasoning) = message.get("reasoning_content").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
                    if !reasoning.is_empty() {
                        text_parts.push(json!({
                            "text": reasoning,
                            "thought": true,
                        }));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some(m) = openai_response.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
        model_version = m.to_string();
    }

    json!({
        "candidates": [{
            "content": {
                "role": "model",
                "parts": text_parts,
            },
            "finishReason": "STOP",
        }],
        "modelVersion": model_version,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_gemini_to_openai_basic() {
        let gemini = json!({
            "contents": [{
                "role": "user",
                "parts": [{"text": "Hello"}]
            }],
            "systemInstruction": {
                "parts": [{"text": "Be helpful"}]
            }
        });

        let openai = gemini_to_openai_body(&gemini, "gpt-4");
        assert_eq!(openai["model"], "gpt-4");
        assert_eq!(openai["messages"][0]["role"], "system");
        assert_eq!(openai["messages"][0]["content"], "Be helpful");
        assert_eq!(openai["messages"][1]["role"], "user");
        assert_eq!(openai["messages"][1]["content"], "Hello");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_openai_to_gemini_basic() {
        let openai = json!({
            "id": "chatcmpl-123",
            "object": "chat.completion",
            "model": "gpt-4",
            "choices": [{
                "index": 0,
                "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "Hi there"},
                "finish_reason": "stop",
            }]
        });

        let gemini = openai_to_gemini_response(&openai);
        assert!(gemini.get("candidates").is_some());
        let candidates = gemini["candidates"].as_array().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(candidates[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"], "Hi there");
        assert_eq!(gemini["modelVersion"], "gpt-4");
    }
}

13	/// Build a URL for Google v1internal API using the colon separator convention.
14	fn build_v1internal_url(base_url: &str, method: &str, query: Option<&str>) -> String {
15	    let base = base_url.trim_end_matches('/');
16	    match query {
17	        Some(q) => format!("{}:{}?{}", base, method, q),
18	        None => format!("{}:{}", base, method),
19	    }
20	}
21	
22	/// Build a reqwest::Client for upstream v1internal calls.
23	fn build_v1internal_client(
24	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
25	    timeout_secs: u64,
26	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
27	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
28	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
29	
30	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
31	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
32	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
33	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
34	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
35	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
36	        }
37	    }
38	
39	    builder
40	        .tcp_nodelay(true)
41	        .build()
42	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
43	}

45	/// Forward an OpenAI Chat request through a GeminiV1Internal provider,
46	/// returning the response in OpenAI format (SSE stream or JSON).
47	pub async fn forward_gemini_v1internal_with_provider(
48	    state: &AppState,
49	    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
50	    openai_req: &OpenAIRequest,
51	    headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap,
52	) -> Response {
53	    use crate::proxy::mappers::openai::{
54	        transform_openai_request, transform_openai_response,
55	        streaming::create_openai_sse_stream,
56	    };
57	
58	    let trace_id = format!(
59	        "req_{}",
60	        chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_subsec_millis()
61	    );
62	    let _trace_id = &trace_id; // reserved for future debug logging
63	
64	    // Map model name using provider config
65	    let mapped_model = crate::proxy::providers::zai_anthropic::map_model_for_provider(
66	        &openai_req.model,
67	        &provider.model_mapping,
68	        &provider.default_models,
69	    );
70	
71	    // Use a placeholder project_id (v1internal provider with API key may not need it)
72	    let project_id = "default";
73	
74	    // Transform OpenAI request to Gemini v1internal format
75	    let (gemini_body, _session_id, message_count) =
76	        transform_openai_request(openai_req, project_id, &mapped_model, None);
77	
78	    let client_wants_stream = openai_req.stream;
79	    let force_stream_internally = !client_wants_stream;
80	    let actual_stream = client_wants_stream || force_stream_internally;
81	
82	    let method = if actual_stream {
83	        "streamGenerateContent"
84	    } else {
85	        "generateContent"
86	    };
87	    let query_string = if actual_stream {
88	        Some("alt=sse")
89	    } else {
90	        None
91	    };
92	
93	    let url = build_v1internal_url(&provider.base_url, method, query_string);
94	
95	    let timeout_secs = provider
96	        .request_timeout_secs
97	        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout.max(5));
98	
99	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
100	    let client = match build_v1internal_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
101	        Ok(c) => c,
102	        Err(e) => {
103	            return (
104	                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
105	                format!("Failed to build client: {}", e),
106	            )
107	                .into_response();
108	        }
109	    };
110	
111	    let body_bytes = match serde_json::to_vec(&gemini_body) {
112	        Ok(b) => b,
113	        Err(e) => {
114	            return (
115	                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
116	                format!("Failed to serialize body: {}", e),
117	            )
118	                .into_response();
119	        }
120	    };
121	
122	    // Build request headers
123	    let mut req_headers = axum::http::HeaderMap::new();
124	    req_headers.insert(
125	        "content-type",
126	        HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
127	    );
128	    // v1internal uses Bearer token auth with the API key
129	    if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", provider.api_key)) {
130	        req_headers.insert("authorization", v);
131	    }
132	    // Copy conservative passthrough headers
133	    for (k, v) in headers.iter() {
134	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
135	        match key.as_str() {
136	            "accept" | "user-agent" | "accept-encoding" => {
137	                req_headers.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
138	            }
139	            _ => {}
140	        }
141	    }
142	
143	    let response = match client
144	        .post(&url)
145	        .headers(req_headers)
146	        .body(body_bytes)
147	        .send()
148	        .await
149	    {
150	        Ok(r) => r,
151	        Err(e) => {
152	            return (
153	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
154	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
155	            )
156	                .into_response();
157	        }
158	    };
159	
160	    let status = response.status();
161	    if !status.is_success() {
162	        let error_body = response.bytes().await.unwrap_or_default();
163	        return (status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&error_body).to_string()).into_response();
164	    }
165

174	            message_count,
175	        );
176	
177	        Response::builder()
178	            .status(StatusCode::OK)
179	            .header("content-type", "text/event-stream")
180	            .header("cache-control", "no-cache")
181	            .header("connection", "keep-alive")
182	            .header("x-mapped-model", &mapped_model)
183	            .body(Body::from_stream(openai_stream))
184	            .unwrap()
185	    } else {

194	                    .into_response();

206	            }
207	        };

213	            gemini_value
214	        };
215	
216	        let openai_resp = transform_openai_response(&inner, None, message_count);
217	        match serde_json::to_string(&openai_resp) {
218	            Ok(json) => Response::builder()

220	                .header("content-type", "application/json")
221	                .header("x-mapped-model", &mapped_model)
222	                .body(Body::from(json))
223	                .unwrap(),
224	            Err(e) => (

Here is the full analysis.

---

## 1. Audio Transcription Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/audio.rs`)

**Full flow:**
1. Parses `multipart/form-data` (fields: `file`, `model`, `prompt`). Default model is `"gemini-2.0-flash-exp"`.
2. Detects MIME type via `AudioProcessor::detect_mime_type()` (supports mp3, wav, m4a/aac, ogg, flac, aiff).
3. Validates file size (max 15 MB).
4. Encodes audio as base64 inline data.
5. Builds a Gemini `generateContent` request with the prompt text + `inlineData` audio part.
6. Gets a token via `TokenManager.get_token("text", false, None, &model)`.
7. Wraps the request in `v1internal` format with `requestType: "text"`.
8. Calls `upstream.call_v1_internal("generateContent", ...)`.
9. Extracts text from the Gemini response (`candidates[0].content.parts[0].text`).
10. Returns `{"text": "..."}` with `X-Account-Email` header.

**Upstream protocol:** TokenManager + v1internal (Gemini `generateContent` via the internal proxy).

**Model targeted:** `gemini-2.0-flash-exp` (hardcoded default, but user-overridable via the `model` form field).

**Retry logic:** None. Zero retry. Single attempt, single account.

**What would need to change for ProviderRouter:**
- The handler currently hardcodes the `v1internal` protocol. ProviderRouter would need to check for providers that support audio/capabilities.
- Currently `ProviderProtocol` enum has `AnthropicPassthrough`, `OpenAICompatible`, and `GeminiV1Internal` -- none of which are audio-specific.
- A new `requestType` like `"audio"` would need to be added (currently uses `"text"` which is semantically wrong).
- The multipart parsing + base64 encoding + Gemini request body construction is protocol-specific. A ProviderRouter integration would need either: (a) audio-specific protocol adapters (like `AnthropicPassthrough` but for audio), or (b) a decision to keep this as Gemini-only and just add retry/rotation on top.
- No `ProviderRouter.read().await` call exists -- would need to be added at the top, similar to the gemini handler pattern.

---

## 2. Images Generation Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` lines 1783-2098)

**Full flow:**
1. Parses JSON body: `prompt`, `model` (default `"gemini-3-pro-image"`), `n`, `size`, `response_format`, `quality`, `image_size`, `style`.
2. Uses `parse_image_config_with_params()` from `common_utils` to compute image config (aspect ratio, size, etc.).
3. Prompt enhancement: appends quality/style suffixes.
4. Spawns `n` concurrent `tokio::spawn` tasks (one per requested image).
5. Each task has a retry loop (up to `MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS`, capped at `pool_size + 1`, minimum 2).
6. Inside the retry loop: `token_manager.get_token("image_gen", attempt > 0, None, &model)`.
7. Builds `v1internal` Gemini request with `requestType: "image_gen"`, `generationConfig.imageConfig`, and safety settings all OFF.
8. Calls `upstream.call_v1_internal("generateContent", ...)`.
9. On 429/500/503: calls `token_manager.mark_rate_limited_async()` and continues retry loop.
10. Extracts `inlineData` base64 from response parts, formats as `b64_json` or `data:` URL.
11. Collects results, handles partial failures, returns OpenAI-compatible `{"created": ..., "data": [...]}`.
12. On success, triggers `account::refresh_all_quotas_logic()` in a background task.

**Upstream protocol:** TokenManager + v1internal (Gemini `generateContent`).

**Model targeted:** `gemini-3-pro-image` (default, user-overridable).

**Retry logic:** Yes. Up to 3 attempts (or pool_size+1, minimum 2). Retries on 429/500/503 with token rotation. 500ms sleep between attempts. Marks rate-limited accounts.

**What would need to change for ProviderRouter:**
- Currently no `provider_router` lookup. Would need to add `state.provider_router.read().await` and `router.select(&model, None)` at the top.
- The request body construction is tightly coupled to Gemini's `v1internal` format. For `OpenAICompatible` providers, the handler would need to build a standard OpenAI `/v1/images/generations` request instead.
- The response parsing (extracting `inlineData` from Gemini `candidates`) is Gemini-specific. An `OpenAICompatible` provider would return a different structure (or already OpenAI-compatible).
- The retry/account rotation logic is TokenManager-specific. ProviderRouter providers using API keys (not TokenManager) would use a different retry model.
- `response_format`, `n` concurrency, prompt enhancement, and safety settings are all Gemini-specific concerns.

---

## 3. Images Edits Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` lines 2100-2489)

**Full flow:**
1. Parses `multipart/form-data`: `image`, `mask`, `image1`/`image2`... (reference images), `prompt`, `n`, `size`, `image_size`, `aspect_ratio`, `style`, `response_format`, `model` (default `"gemini-3-pro-image"`).
2. Validates prompt is non-empty.
3. Computes image config via `parse_image_config_with_params()`.
4. Builds `contents` parts array: prompt text + optional main image (inlineData) + optional mask (inlineData) + optional reference images (inlineData).
5. Spawns `n` concurrent tasks, each with a retry loop (same `MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` logic).
6. `token_manager.get_token("image_gen", attempt > 0, None, "gemini-3-pro-image")` -- note the model is hardcoded here, ignoring the `model` variable from parsing.
7. Builds `v1internal` request with `requestType: "image_gen"`, `generationConfig.imageConfig`, and safety settings.
8. Same retry logic as generations (429/500/503).
9. Extracts `inlineData` from response, formats as `b64_json` or `data:` URL.
10. Returns OpenAI-compatible response.

**Upstream protocol:** TokenManager + v1internal (Gemini `generateContent`).

**Model targeted:** `gemini-3-pro-image` (default, but the token lookup hardcodes it regardless of what the user passes).

**Retry logic:** Yes. Same as generations -- up to 3 attempts with token rotation on 429/500/503.

**What would need to change for ProviderRouter:**
- Same as generations: no `provider_router` lookup currently.
- The multipart parsing and inlineData construction is Gemini-specific. `OpenAICompatible` providers typically expect different formats for image edits.
- Bug/note: line 2291 hardcodes `"gemini-3-pro-image"` in the `get_token` call instead of using the `model` variable parsed from the request. This is likely unintentional.
- The response parsing is identical to generations.

---

## 4. Audio/Speech (TTS) Handlers

**No TTS/audio-speech handlers exist.** A search for `audio/speech`, `tts`, and `synthesize` returned zero results. The only registered audio route is `/v1/audio/transcriptions` (transcription only, no speech synthesis).

---

## 5. Route Registrations (`src/proxy/server.rs`)

Three routes are registered:
- `/v1/images/generations` -> `handlers::openai::handle_images_generations` (POST)
- `/v1/images/edits` -> `handlers::openai::handle_images_edits` (POST)
- `/v1/audio/transcriptions` -> `handlers::audio::handle_audio_transcription` (POST)

---

## 6. Audio Processor Module (`src/proxy/audio/mod.rs`)

A simple utility struct with three static methods:
- `detect_mime_type(filename)` -- maps file extension to MIME string (mp3, wav, m4a->aac, ogg, flac, aiff).
- `encode_to_base64(data)` -- standard base64 encoding.
- `exceeds_size_limit(size_bytes)` -- checks against 15 MB limit.

This module has no dependency on upstream protocols or TokenManager -- it is pure utility code.

---

## 7. ProviderRouter Context

The `ProviderRouter` (at `src/proxy/providers/router.rs`) is already wired into `AppState` as `state.provider_router: Arc<RwLock<ProviderRouter>>`. It supports three protocols: `AnthropicPassthrough`, `OpenAICompatible`, and `GeminiV1Internal`.

The gemini handler (line 89-113) shows the established integration pattern:
```rust
let router = state.provider_router.read().await;
let provider_match = if !router.is_empty() {
    router.select(&model_name, None)
} else {
    None
};
if let Some(provider) = provider_match {
    match provider.protocol {
        AnthropicPassthrough => return forward_via_anthropic(...);
        OpenAICompatible => return forward_via_openai_compat(...);
        GeminiV1Internal => { /* fall through to existing TokenManager path */ }
    }
}
drop(router);
```

---

## Summary Table

| Handler | Protocol | Model | Retry | ProviderRouter Ready? |
|---------|----------|-------|-------|----------------------|
| Audio Transcription | TokenManager + v1internal | `gemini-2.0-flash-exp` (default) | No | No -- uses hardcoded v1internal |
| Images Generations | TokenManager + v1internal | `gemini-3-pro-image` (default) | Yes (3 attempts, 429/500/503) | No -- no router lookup |
| Images Edits | TokenManager + v1internal | `gemini-3-pro-image` (default) | Yes (3 attempts, 429/500/503) | No -- no router lookup |
| Audio/Speech (TTS) | Not implemented | N/A | N/A | N/A |

**Key insight for ProviderRouter integration:** All three handlers currently use the Gemini `v1internal` protocol exclusively. Adding ProviderRouter dispatch would require: (1) adding the `provider_router.select()` pattern at the top of each handler, (2) building protocol-agnostic request bodies or adding protocol-specific branches (like the gemini handler does), and (3) for audio specifically, either adding retry logic first or folding it into the ProviderRouter selection. The images handlers already have retry/rotation which would need to be reconciled with ProviderRouter's own dispatch strategy.
