61	            providers: vec![provider],
62	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {
72	                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
73	                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
74	            })
75	            .collect()
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
129	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
130	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
131	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
132	            return mapped.clone();
133	        }
134	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
135	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
136	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
137	            .model_mapping
138	            .iter()
139	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
140	        {
141	            return mapped.clone();
142	        }
143	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
144	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
145	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
146	        }
147	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
148	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
149	            return incoming.to_string();
150	        }
151	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
152	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
153	            if m.contains("opus") {
154	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
155	            }
156	            if m.contains("haiku") {
157	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
158	            }
159	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
160	        }
161	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
162	        incoming.to_string()
163	    }
164	
165	    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
166	    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
167	        self.providers.is_empty()
168	    }
169	}

171	/// Map a model name to the provider's expected model name.
172	/// This is a free function so it can be used without holding a `ProviderRouter` lock.
173	pub fn map_model_for_provider(
174	    original: &str,
175	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
176	    default_models: &ProviderModelDefaults,
177	) -> String {
178	    // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
179	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
180	        return mapped.clone();
181	    }
182	    // 2. Lowercase match
183	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
184	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
185	        return mapped.clone();
186	    }
187	    // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
188	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
189	        return original[4..].to_string();
190	    }
191	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
192	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
193	        return original.to_string();
194	    }
195	    // 5. Claude family defaults
196	    if m.starts_with("claude-") {
197	        if m.contains("opus") {
198	            return default_models.opus.clone();
199	        }
200	        if m.contains("haiku") {
201	            return default_models.haiku.clone();
202	        }
203	        return default_models.sonnet.clone();
204	    }
205	    // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
206	    original.to_string()
207	}

_**Agent - sidechain (qwen3.6-plus 2026-04-10 06:26:53Z)**_

Here is the full analysis.

---

## 1. Audio Transcription Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/audio.rs`)

**Full flow:**
1. Parses `multipart/form-data` (fields: `file`, `model`, `prompt`). Default model is `"gemini-2.0-flash-exp"`.
2. Detects MIME type via `AudioProcessor::detect_mime_type()` (supports mp3, wav, m4a/aac, ogg, flac, aiff).
3. Validates file size (max 15 MB).
4. Encodes audio as base64 inline data.
5. Builds a Gemini `generateContent` request with the prompt text + `inlineData` audio part.
6. Gets a token via `TokenManager.get_token("text", false, None, &model)`.
7. Wraps the request in `v1internal` format with `requestType: "text"`.
8. Calls `upstream.call_v1_internal("generateContent", ...)`.
9. Extracts text from the Gemini response (`candidates[0].content.parts[0].text`).
10. Returns `{"text": "..."}` with `X-Account-Email` header.

**Upstream protocol:** TokenManager + v1internal (Gemini `generateContent` via the internal proxy).

**Model targeted:** `gemini-2.0-flash-exp` (hardcoded default, but user-overridable via the `model` form field).

**Retry logic:** None. Zero retry. Single attempt, single account.

**What would need to change for ProviderRouter:**
- The handler currently hardcodes the `v1internal` protocol. ProviderRouter would need to check for providers that support audio/capabilities.
- Currently `ProviderProtocol` enum has `AnthropicPassthrough`, `OpenAICompatible`, and `GeminiV1Internal` -- none of which are audio-specific.
- A new `requestType` like `"audio"` would need to be added (currently uses `"text"` which is semantically wrong).
- The multipart parsing + base64 encoding + Gemini request body construction is protocol-specific. A ProviderRouter integration would need either: (a) audio-specific protocol adapters (like `AnthropicPassthrough` but for audio), or (b) a decision to keep this as Gemini-only and just add retry/rotation on top.
- No `ProviderRouter.read().await` call exists -- would need to be added at the top, similar to the gemini handler pattern.

---

## 2. Images Generation Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` lines 1783-2098)

**Full flow:**
1. Parses JSON body: `prompt`, `model` (default `"gemini-3-pro-image"`), `n`, `size`, `response_format`, `quality`, `image_size`, `style`.
2. Uses `parse_image_config_with_params()` from `common_utils` to compute image config (aspect ratio, size, etc.).
3. Prompt enhancement: appends quality/style suffixes.
4. Spawns `n` concurrent `tokio::spawn` tasks (one per requested image).
5. Each task has a retry loop (up to `MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS`, capped at `pool_size + 1`, minimum 2).
6. Inside the retry loop: `token_manager.get_token("image_gen", attempt > 0, None, &model)`.
7. Builds `v1internal` Gemini request with `requestType: "image_gen"`, `generationConfig.imageConfig`, and safety settings all OFF.
8. Calls `upstream.call_v1_internal("generateContent", ...)`.
9. On 429/500/503: calls `token_manager.mark_rate_limited_async()` and continues retry loop.
10. Extracts `inlineData` base64 from response parts, formats as `b64_json` or `data:` URL.
11. Collects results, handles partial failures, returns OpenAI-compatible `{"created": ..., "data": [...]}`.
12. On success, triggers `account::refresh_all_quotas_logic()` in a background task.

**Upstream protocol:** TokenManager + v1internal (Gemini `generateContent`).

**Model targeted:** `gemini-3-pro-image` (default, user-overridable).

**Retry logic:** Yes. Up to 3 attempts (or pool_size+1, minimum 2). Retries on 429/500/503 with token rotation. 500ms sleep between attempts. Marks rate-limited accounts.

**What would need to change for ProviderRouter:**
- Currently no `provider_router` lookup. Would need to add `state.provider_router.read().await` and `router.select(&model, None)` at the top.
- The request body construction is tightly coupled to Gemini's `v1internal` format. For `OpenAICompatible` providers, the handler would need to build a standard OpenAI `/v1/images/generations` request instead.
- The response parsing (extracting `inlineData` from Gemini `candidates`) is Gemini-specific. An `OpenAICompatible` provider would return a different structure (or already OpenAI-compatible).
- The retry/account rotation logic is TokenManager-specific. ProviderRouter providers using API keys (not TokenManager) would use a different retry model.
- `response_format`, `n` concurrency, prompt enhancement, and safety settings are all Gemini-specific concerns.

---

## 3. Images Edits Handler (`src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` lines 2100-2489)

**Full flow:**
1. Parses `multipart/form-data`: `image`, `mask`, `image1`/`image2`... (reference images), `prompt`, `n`, `size`, `image_size`, `aspect_ratio`, `style`, `response_format`, `model` (default `"gemini-3-pro-image"`).
2. Validates prompt is non-empty.
3. Computes image config via `parse_image_config_with_params()`.
4. Builds `contents` parts array: prompt text + optional main image (inlineData) + optional mask (inlineData) + optional reference images (inlineData).
5. Spawns `n` concurrent tasks, each with a retry loop (same `MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` logic).
6. `token_manager.get_token("image_gen", attempt > 0, None, "gemini-3-pro-image")` -- note the model is hardcoded here, ignoring the `model` variable from parsing.
7. Builds `v1internal` request with `requestType: "image_gen"`, `generationConfig.imageConfig`, and safety settings.
8. Same retry logic as generations (429/500/503).
9. Extracts `inlineData` from response, formats as `b64_json` or `data:` URL.
10. Returns OpenAI-compatible response.

**Upstream protocol:** TokenManager + v1internal (Gemini `generateContent`).

**Model targeted:** `gemini-3-pro-image` (default, but the token lookup hardcodes it regardless of what the user passes).

**Retry logic:** Yes. Same as generations -- up to 3 attempts with token rotation on 429/500/503.

**What would need to change for ProviderRouter:**
- Same as generations: no `provider_router` lookup currently.
- The multipart parsing and inlineData construction is Gemini-specific. `OpenAICompatible` providers typically expect different formats for image edits.
- Bug/note: line 2291 hardcodes `"gemini-3-pro-image"` in the `get_token` call instead of using the `model` variable parsed from the request. This is likely unintentional.
- The response parsing is identical to generations.

---

## 4. Audio/Speech (TTS) Handlers

**No TTS/audio-speech handlers exist.** A search for `audio/speech`, `tts`, and `synthesize` returned zero results. The only registered audio route is `/v1/audio/transcriptions` (transcription only, no speech synthesis).

---

## 5. Route Registrations (`src/proxy/server.rs`)

Three routes are registered:
- `/v1/images/generations` -> `handlers::openai::handle_images_generations` (POST)
- `/v1/images/edits` -> `handlers::openai::handle_images_edits` (POST)
- `/v1/audio/transcriptions` -> `handlers::audio::handle_audio_transcription` (POST)

---

## 6. Audio Processor Module (`src/proxy/audio/mod.rs`)

A simple utility struct with three static methods:
- `detect_mime_type(filename)` -- maps file extension to MIME string (mp3, wav, m4a->aac, ogg, flac, aiff).
- `encode_to_base64(data)` -- standard base64 encoding.
- `exceeds_size_limit(size_bytes)` -- checks against 15 MB limit.

This module has no dependency on upstream protocols or TokenManager -- it is pure utility code.

---

## 7. ProviderRouter Context

The `ProviderRouter` (at `src/proxy/providers/router.rs`) is already wired into `AppState` as `state.provider_router: Arc<RwLock<ProviderRouter>>`. It supports three protocols: `AnthropicPassthrough`, `OpenAICompatible`, and `GeminiV1Internal`.

The gemini handler (line 89-113) shows the established integration pattern:
```rust
let router = state.provider_router.read().await;
let provider_match = if !router.is_empty() {
    router.select(&model_name, None)
} else {
    None
};
if let Some(provider) = provider_match {
    match provider.protocol {
        AnthropicPassthrough => return forward_via_anthropic(...);
        OpenAICompatible => return forward_via_openai_compat(...);
        GeminiV1Internal => { /* fall through to existing TokenManager path */ }
    }
}
drop(router);
```

---

## Summary Table

| Handler | Protocol | Model | Retry | ProviderRouter Ready? |
|---------|----------|-------|-------|----------------------|
| Audio Transcription | TokenManager + v1internal | `gemini-2.0-flash-exp` (default) | No | No -- uses hardcoded v1internal |
| Images Generations | TokenManager + v1internal | `gemini-3-pro-image` (default) | Yes (3 attempts, 429/500/503) | No -- no router lookup |
| Images Edits | TokenManager + v1internal | `gemini-3-pro-image` (default) | Yes (3 attempts, 429/500/503) | No -- no router lookup |
| Audio/Speech (TTS) | Not implemented | N/A | N/A | N/A |

**Key insight for ProviderRouter integration:** All three handlers currently use the Gemini `v1internal` protocol exclusively. Adding ProviderRouter dispatch would require: (1) adding the `provider_router.select()` pattern at the top of each handler, (2) building protocol-agnostic request bodies or adding protocol-specific branches (like the gemini handler does), and (3) for audio specifically, either adding retry logic first or folding it into the ProviderRouter selection. The images handlers already have retry/rotation which would need to be reconciled with ProviderRouter's own dispatch strategy.

use axum::{
    body::Body,
    http::{HeaderValue, StatusCode},
    response::IntoResponse,
    Json,
};
use bytes::Bytes;
use futures::stream;
use serde_json::Value;
use tokio::time::Duration;

use crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProvider;
use crate::proxy::server::AppState;

/// Build a reqwest::Client for upstream OpenAI-compatible audio calls.
fn build_audio_client(
    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
    timeout_secs: u64,
) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));

    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
        }
    }

    builder
        .tcp_nodelay(true)
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
}

/// Forward an audio transcription request to an OpenAI-compatible provider.
///
/// Sends multipart/form-data (file + model + prompt) to `{base_url}/v1/audio/transcriptions`
/// and returns OpenAI-compatible `{"text": "..."}` response.
pub async fn forward_audio_to_openai_compat(
    state: &AppState,
    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
    audio_bytes: &[u8],
    mime_type: &str,
    model: &str,
    prompt: &str,
) -> axum::response::Response {
    use reqwest::multipart;

    // Build multipart/form-data body
    let file_part = multipart::Part::bytes(audio_bytes.to_vec())
        .file_name("audio.wav")
        .mime_str(mime_type)
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| multipart::Part::bytes(audio_bytes.to_vec()));

    let form = multipart::Form::new()
        .part("file", file_part)
        .text("model", model.to_string())
        .text("prompt", prompt.to_string());

    let url = format!(
        "{}{}",
        provider.base_url.trim_end_matches('/'),
        "/v1/audio/transcriptions"
    );

    let timeout_secs = provider
        .request_timeout_secs
        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout.max(5));

    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
    let client = match build_audio_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    let mut headers = axum::http::HeaderMap::new();
    if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", provider.api_key)) {
        headers.insert("authorization", v);
    }

    tracing::debug!("Forwarding audio to provider: {}", url);

    let response = match client
        .post(&url)
        .multipart(form)
        .headers(headers)
        .send()
        .await
    {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    let status = response.status();
    if !status.is_success() {
        let error_body = response.bytes().await.unwrap_or_default();
        return (status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&error_body).to_string()).into_response();
    }

    let bytes = match response.bytes().await {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(e) => {
            return (
                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                format!("Failed to read response body: {}", e),
            )
                .into_response();
        }
    };

    // Parse and return OpenAI-compatible response
    match serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&bytes) {
        Ok(value) => {
            // Extract text if present, otherwise return raw response
            let text = value
                .get("text")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("");
            (
                StatusCode::OK,
                Json(serde_json::json!({ "text": text })),
            )
                .into_response()
        }
        Err(_) => {
            // Return raw response as-is
            (
                StatusCode::OK,
                Json(serde_json::json!({
                    "text": String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes),
                    "raw_response": String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes)
                })),
            )
                .into_response()
        }
    }
}

use axum::{
    body::Body,
    http::{HeaderValue, StatusCode},
    response::IntoResponse,
    Json,
};
use bytes::Bytes;
use futures::StreamExt;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use tokio::time::Duration;

use crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProvider;
use crate::proxy::server::AppState;

/// Build a reqwest::Client for upstream OpenAI-compatible image calls.
fn build_images_client(
    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
    timeout_secs: u64,
) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(30))); // Images take longer

    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
        }
    }

    builder
        .tcp_nodelay(true)
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
}

/// Forward a single image generation request to an OpenAI-compatible provider.
///
/// POSTs JSON body to `{base_url}/v1/images/generations` and returns
/// OpenAI-compatible `{"created": ..., "data": [{"url": ...} | {"b64_json": ...}]}`.
async fn forward_single_image(
    state: &AppState,
    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
    prompt: &str,
    model: &str,
    n: usize,
    size: Option<&str>,
    quality: Option<&str>,
    style: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(Value, String), (StatusCode, String)> {
    let url = format!(
        "{}{}",
        provider.base_url.trim_end_matches('/'),
        "/v1/images/generations"
    );

    let timeout_secs = provider
        .request_timeout_secs
        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout.max(30));

    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
    let client = build_images_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs)
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e))?;

    let mut body = json!({
        "model": model,
        "prompt": prompt,
        "n": n
    });

    if let Some(s) = size {
        body["size"] = Value::String(s.to_string());
    }
    if let Some(q) = quality {
        body["quality"] = Value::String(q.to_string());
    }
    if let Some(s) = style {
        body["style"] = Value::String(s.to_string());
    }

    let mut headers = axum::http::HeaderMap::new();
    headers.insert(
        "content-type",
        HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
    );
    if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", provider.api_key)) {
        headers.insert("authorization", v);
    }

    tracing::debug!("Forwarding image generation to provider: {}", url);

    let response = client
        .post(&url)
        .headers(headers)
        .json(&body)
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY, format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e)))?;

    let status = response.status();
    if !status.is_success() {
        let error_body = response.bytes().await.unwrap_or_default();
        return Err((
            status,
            format!(
                "Provider error {}: {}",
                status,
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&error_body)
            ),
        ));
    }

    let bytes = response
        .bytes()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY, format!("Failed to read response: {}", e)))?;

    let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|e| {
        (
            StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
            format!("Failed to parse response JSON: {}", e),
        )
    })?;

    // Use first task's email (not available in provider path)
    Ok((value, String::new()))
}

/// Forward image generations to an OpenAI-compatible provider.
///
/// Handles concurrency by spawning tokio tasks (one per image).
/// Returns `(email_header, openai_response_json)` on success.
pub async fn forward_images_to_openai_compat(
    state: &AppState,
    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
    body: &Value,
) -> Result<(String, Value), (StatusCode, String)> {
    let prompt = body
        .get("prompt")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .ok_or((
            StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
            "Missing 'prompt' field".to_string(),
        ))?;

    let model = body
        .get("model")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("dall-e-3");

    let n = body.get("n").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(1) as usize;
    let size = body.get("size").and_then(|v| v.as_str());
    let quality = body.get("quality").and_then(|v| v.as_str());
    let style = body.get("style").and_then(|v| v.as_str());
    let response_format = body
        .get("response_format")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("b64_json");

    let max_attempts = 3;

    let mut images: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();
    let mut errors: Vec<String> = Vec::new();

    // Spawn concurrent tasks (one per image)
    let mut tasks = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..n {
        let state = state.clone();
        let provider = provider.clone();
        let prompt = prompt.to_string();
        let model = model.to_string();
        let size = size.map(|s| s.to_string());
        let quality = quality.map(|q| q.to_string());
        let style = style.map(|s| s.to_string());

        tasks.push(tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut last_error = String::new();
            for attempt in 0..max_attempts {
                match forward_single_image(
                    &state,
                    &provider,
                    &prompt,
                    &model,
                    1,
                    size.as_deref(),
                    quality.as_deref(),
                    style.as_deref(),
                )
                .await
                {
                    Ok((resp, _email)) => return Ok(resp),
                    Err((_, e)) => {
                        last_error = e;
                        if attempt < max_attempts - 1 {
                            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(last_error)
        }));
    }

    for (idx, task) in tasks.into_iter().enumerate() {
        match task.await {
            Ok(Ok(resp)) => {
                // Extract image data from OpenAI-compatible response
                if let Some(data_array) = resp.get("data").and_then(|d| d.as_array()) {
                    for item in data_array {
                        if let Some(url) = item.get("url").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                            images.push(json!({ "url": url }));
                        } else if let Some(b64) = item.get("b64_json").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                            if response_format == "url" {
                                images.push(json!({
                                    "url": format!("data:image/png;base64,{}", b64)
                                }));
                            } else {
                                images.push(json!({ "b64_json": b64 }));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                tracing::debug!("[Images] Provider task {} succeeded", idx);
            }
            Ok(Err(e)) => {
                tracing::error!("[Images] Provider task {} failed: {}", idx, e);
                errors.push(e);
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let err_msg = format!("Task join error: {}", e);
                tracing::error!("[Images] Task {} join error: {}", idx, e);
                errors.push(err_msg);
            }
        }
    }

    if images.is_empty() {
        let error_msg = if !errors.is_empty() {
            errors.join("; ")
        } else {
            "No images generated".to_string()
        };
        let status = if error_msg.contains("429") {
            StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
        } else if error_msg.contains("503") {
            StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
        } else {
            StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY
        };
        return Err((status, error_msg));
    }

    if !errors.is_empty() {
        tracing::warn!(
            "[Images] Partial success: {} out of {} succeeded. Errors: {}",
            images.len(),
            n,
            errors.join("; ")
        );
    }

    let openai_response = json!({
        "created": chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
        "data": images
    });

    Ok((String::new(), openai_response))
}

/// Forward an image edits request to an OpenAI-compatible provider.
///
/// POSTs multipart/form-data to `{base_url}/v1/images/edits`.
/// For simplicity, converts to JSON body with base64 image data.
pub async fn forward_images_edits_to_openai_compat(
    state: &AppState,
    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
    image_data: Option<String>,
    mask_data: Option<String>,
    reference_images: Vec<String>,
    prompt: &str,
    model: &str,
    n: usize,
    size: &str,
    response_format: &str,
    style: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(String, String, Value), (StatusCode, String)> {
    let mut contents_parts = Vec::new();

    contents_parts.push(json!({ "text": prompt }));

    if let Some(s) = style {
        contents_parts[0] = json!({ "text": format!("{}, style: {}", prompt, s) });
    }

    if let Some(data) = image_data {
        contents_parts.push(json!({
            "inlineData": {
                "mimeType": "image/png",
                "data": data
            }
        }));
    }
    if let Some(data) = mask_data {
        contents_parts.push(json!({
            "inlineData": {
                "mimeType": "image/png",
                "data": data
            }
        }));
    }
    for ref_data in reference_images {
        contents_parts.push(json!({
            "inlineData": {
                "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
                "data": ref_data
            }
        }));
    }

    // For OpenAI-compatible providers that support image edits, use the standard endpoint.
    // Most providers use JSON with image data inline, not multipart.
    // We fall back to a generations-style request with inline images.
    let url = format!(
        "{}{}",
        provider.base_url.trim_end_matches('/'),
        "/v1/images/generations"
    );

    let timeout_secs = provider
        .request_timeout_secs
        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout.max(30));

    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
    let client = build_images_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs)
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e))?;

    let body = json!({
        "model": model,
        "prompt": prompt,
        "n": n,
        "size": size,
        "images": contents_parts
    });

    let mut headers = axum::http::HeaderMap::new();
    headers.insert(
        "content-type",
        HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
    );
    if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", provider.api_key)) {
        headers.insert("authorization", v);
    }

    tracing::debug!("Forwarding image edits to provider: {}", url);

    let response = client
        .post(&url)
        .headers(headers)
        .json(&body)
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY, format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e)))?;

    let status = response.status();
    if !status.is_success() {
        let error_body = response.bytes().await.unwrap_or_default();
        return Err((
            status,
            format!("Provider error {}: {}", status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&error_body)),
        ));
    }

    let bytes = response
        .bytes()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY, format!("Failed to read response: {}", e)))?;

    let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|e| {
        (
            StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
            format!("Failed to parse response JSON: {}", e),
        )
    })?;

    let mut images: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();
    if let Some(data_array) = value.get("data").and_then(|d| d.as_array()) {
        for item in data_array {
            if let Some(url) = item.get("url").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                images.push(json!({ "url": url }));
            } else if let Some(b64) = item.get("b64_json").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                if response_format == "url" {
                    images.push(json!({
                        "url": format!("data:image/png;base64,{}", b64)
                    }));
                } else {
                    images.push(json!({ "b64_json": b64 }));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let openai_response = json!({
        "created": chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
        "data": images
    });

    Ok((String::new(), response_format.to_string(), openai_response))
}

```

use axum::{
    extract::{Multipart, State},
    http::StatusCode,
    response::IntoResponse,
    Json,
};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use tracing::{debug, info, warn};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::proxy::{
    audio::AudioProcessor,
    config::ProviderProtocol,
    providers::zai_audio::forward_audio_to_openai_compat,
    server::AppState,
};

/// 处理音频转录请求 (OpenAI Whisper API 兼容)
pub async fn handle_audio_transcription(
    State(state): State<AppState>,
    mut multipart: Multipart,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, (StatusCode, String)> {
    let mut audio_data: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;
    let mut filename: Option<String> = None;
    let mut model = "gemini-2.0-flash-exp".to_string();
    let mut prompt = "Generate a transcript of the speech.".to_string();

    // 1. 解析 multipart/form-data
    while let Some(field) = multipart
        .next_field()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, format!("解析表单失败: {}", e)))?
    {
        let name = field.name().unwrap_or("").to_string();

        match name.as_str() {
            "file" => {
                filename = field.file_name().map(|s| s.to_string());
                audio_data = Some(
                    field
                        .bytes()
                        .await
                        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, format!("读取文件失败: {}", e)))?
                        .to_vec(),
                );
            }
            "model" => {
                model = field.text().await.unwrap_or(model);
            }
            "prompt" => {
                prompt = field.text().await.unwrap_or(prompt);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    let audio_bytes = audio_data.ok_or((StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "缺少音频文件".to_string()))?;

    let file_name = filename.ok_or((StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "无法获取文件名".to_string()))?;

    info!(
        "收到音频转录请求: 文件={}, 大小={} bytes, 模型={}",
        file_name,
        audio_bytes.len(),
        model
    );

    // 2. 检测 MIME 类型
    let mime_type =
        AudioProcessor::detect_mime_type(&file_name).map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e))?;

    // 3. 验证文件大小
    if AudioProcessor::exceeds_size_limit(audio_bytes.len()) {
        let size_mb = audio_bytes.len() as f64 / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
        return Err((
            StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE,
            format!(
                "音频文件过大 ({:.1} MB)。最大支持 15 MB (约 16 分钟 MP3)。建议: 1) 压缩音频质量 2) 分段上传",
                size_mb
            ),
        ));
    }

    // 4. ProviderRouter dispatch (new)
    let router = state.provider_router.read().await;
    if !router.is_empty() {
        if let Some(provider) = router.select(&model, None) {
            match provider.protocol {
                ProviderProtocol::OpenAICompatible => {
                    drop(router);
                    let max_attempts = 2;
                    let mut last_error = String::new();

                    for attempt in 0..max_attempts {
                        match forward_audio_to_openai_compat(
                            &state,
                            &provider,
                            &audio_bytes,
                            &mime_type,
                            &model,
                            &prompt,
                        )
                        .await
                        {
                            resp if resp.status() < 400 => return Ok(resp),
                            resp => {
                                last_error = format!(
                                    "Provider {} attempt {} failed with status {}",
                                    provider.name,
                                    attempt + 1,
                                    resp.status()
                                );
                                warn!("[Audio] {}", last_error);
                                if attempt < max_attempts - 1 {
                                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
                                    // Try next provider if available
                                    if let Some(next) = router.select(&model, Some(&provider.name)) {
                                        if matches!(next.protocol, ProviderProtocol::OpenAICompatible) {
                                            last_error = format!("Switching to provider {}", next.name);
                                            continue;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    return Err((StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY, last_error));
                }
                ProviderProtocol::GeminiV1Internal | ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough => {
                    // Fall through to TokenManager path
                }
            }
        }
    }
    drop(router);

    // 5. Use Inline Data mode (existing TokenManager path)
    debug!("使用 Inline Data 方式处理");
    let base64_audio = AudioProcessor::encode_to_base64(&audio_bytes);

    // 6. 构建 Gemini 请求
    let gemini_request = json!({
        "contents": [{
            "parts": [
                {"text": prompt},
                {
                    "inlineData": {
                        "mimeType": mime_type,
                        "data": base64_audio
                    }
                }
            ]
        }]
    });

    // 7. 获取 Token 和上游客户端
    let token_manager = state.token_manager;
    let (access_token, project_id, email, account_id, _wait_ms) = token_manager
        .get_token("text", false, None, &model)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, e))?;

    info!("使用账号: {}", email);

    // 8. 包装请求为 v1internal 格式
    let wrapped_body = json!({
        "project": project_id,
        "requestId": format!("audio-{}", Uuid::new_v4()),
        "request": gemini_request,
        "model": model,
        "userAgent": "antigravity",
        "requestType": "text"
    });

    // 9. 发送请求到 Gemini
    let upstream = state.upstream.clone();
    let response = upstream
        .call_v1_internal(
            "generateContent",
            &access_token,
            wrapped_body,
            None,
            Some(account_id.as_str()),
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY, format!("上游请求失败: {}", e)))?
        .response;

    if !response.status().is_success() {
        let error_text = response
            .text()
            .await
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "Unknown error".to_string());
        return Err((
            StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
            format!("Gemini API 错误: {}", error_text),
        ));
    }

    let result: Value = response
        .json()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY, format!("解析响应失败: {}", e)))?;

    // 10. 提取文本响应（解包 v1internal 响应）
    let inner_response = result.get("response").unwrap_or(&result);
    let text = inner_response
        .get("candidates")
        .and_then(|c| c.get(0))
        .and_then(|c| c.get("content"))
        .and_then(|c| c.get("parts"))
        .and_then(|p| p.get(0))
        .and_then(|p| p.get("text"))
        .and_then(|t| t.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("");

    info!("音频转录完成，返回 {} 字符", text.len());

    // 11. 返回标准格式响应
    Ok((
        StatusCode::OK,
        [("X-Account-Email", email.as_str())],
        Json(json!({
            "text": text
        })),
    )
        .into_response())
}

```

Here is a complete summary of the frontend navigation and routing system, plus the z.ai configuration section on the ApiProxy page.

---

## 1. Sidebar/Navigation Menu Definition

**Navigation is NOT a sidebar.** The app uses a **top horizontal navbar** (not a sidebar). The menu is defined in:

**`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/components/navbar/Navbar.tsx`** (lines 21-30)

```typescript
const navItems: NavItem[] = [
    { path: '/', label: t('nav.dashboard'), icon: LayoutDashboard, priority: 'high' },
    { path: '/accounts', label: t('nav.accounts'), icon: Users, priority: 'high' },
    { path: '/api-proxy', label: t('nav.proxy'), icon: Network, priority: 'high' },
    { path: '/monitor', label: t('nav.call_records'), icon: Activity, priority: 'medium' },
    { path: '/token-stats', label: t('nav.token_stats', 'Token 统计'), icon: BarChart3, priority: 'low' },
    { path: '/user-token', label: t('nav.user_token', 'User Tokens'), icon: Users, priority: 'low' },
    { path: '/security', label: t('nav.security'), icon: Lock, priority: 'low' },
    { path: '/settings', label: t('nav.settings'), icon: Settings, priority: 'high' },
];
```

The `NavItem` type is defined in:
**`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/components/navbar/constants.ts`** (lines 4-9)

```typescript
export interface NavItem {
    path: string;
    label: string;
    icon: LucideIcon;
    priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
}
```

The menu is rendered by **`NavMenu.tsx`** (`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/components/navbar/NavMenu.tsx`), which filters out hidden items via `isMenuItemHidden()` from the config store, and renders the nav links at multiple responsive breakpoints.

## 2. How Pages Are Added to the Menu

To add a new page to the menu, you need to do **two things**:

1. **Add a route** in `App.tsx` (line 24-63) -- add a new child object to the `createBrowserRouter` array with a `path` and `element`.
2. **Add a nav item** in `Navbar.tsx` (line 21-30) -- add a new object to the `navItems` array with `path`, `label` (using i18n `t()`), `icon` (from lucide-react), and `priority`.

The `priority` field controls visibility at different screen sizes -- `high` items are always shown, while `low` priority items get collapsed into a dropdown on smaller screens.

## 3. Current Page List and Route Paths

| Route Path | Page Component | File |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | Dashboard | `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` |
| `/accounts` | Accounts | `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/Accounts.tsx` |
| `/api-proxy` | ApiProxy | `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/ApiProxy.tsx` |
| `/monitor` | Monitor | `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/Monitor.tsx` |
| `/token-stats` | TokenStats | `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/TokenStats.tsx` |
| `/user-token` | UserToken | `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/UserToken.tsx` |
| `/security` | Security | `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/Security.tsx` |
| `/settings` | Settings | `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/Settings.tsx` |

All routes are nested under the `Layout` component (which renders the Navbar + `<Outlet />`).

Routing uses `react-router-dom` via `createBrowserRouter` in:
**`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/App.tsx`**

## 4. How the ApiProxy Page Displays z.ai Configuration

The z.ai configuration is rendered in **`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/ApiProxy.tsx`** starting around **line 1524**.

It is displayed as two collapsible cards:

### Card 1: z.ai (GLM) Dispatcher (line ~1524-1685)
- **Title**: `t('proxy.config.zai.title')`
- **Icon**: `Zap` (amber)
- **Toggle**: `appConfig.proxy.zai?.enabled`
- **Fields**:
  - **Base URL** -- input, defaults to `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic`
  - **Dispatch Mode** -- dropdown: `off`, `exclusive`, `pooled`, `fallback`
  - **API Key** -- password input
  - **Model Selection** -- three default model family inputs (opus, sonnet, haiku) with a refresh button that calls `fetch_zai_models` from the Tauri backend
  - **Advanced Model Mapping** -- expandable `<details>` section showing a `from -> to` mapping table with add/remove functionality

### Card 2: MCP System (line ~1687-1743)
- **Title**: `t('proxy.config.zai.mcp.title')`
- **Icon**: `Puzzle` (blue)
- **Toggle**: `appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.enabled`
- **Checkboxes**: web_search, web_reader, vision
- **Local Endpoints**: Shows MCP server URLs based on which features are enabled

### Key z.ai functions (lines 775-858):
- `refreshZaiModels()` -- calls Tauri `fetch_zai_models` to get available models
- `updateZaiDefaultModels()` -- updates default model selections (opus/sonnet/haiku)
- `upsertZaiModelMapping()` / `removeZaiModelMapping()` -- manages custom model mappings
- `updateZaiGeneralConfig()` -- updates top-level z.ai config fields

### z.ai Type Definition (`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/types/config.ts`, line 89-97):
```typescript
export interface ZaiConfig {
    enabled: boolean;
    base_url: string;
    api_key: string;
    dispatch_mode: ZaiDispatchMode;
    model_mapping?: Record<string, string>;
    models: ZaiModelDefaults;
    mcp: ZaiMcpConfig;
}
```
```

12	function Layout() {
13	    const { isMiniView } = useViewStore();
14	
15	    // Ensure correct window state when in Full View (not Mini View)
16	    // This handles the case where the app was closed in Mini View (small size, no decorations)
17	    // and restarted (defaults to Full View state but keeps last window properties)
18	    useEffect(() => {
19	        if (!isMiniView && isTauri()) {
20	            ensureFullViewState();
21	        }
22	    }, [isMiniView]);
23	
24	    if (isMiniView) {

30	            </>

32	    }
33	
34	    return (

38	                className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-9"
39	                style={{

17	    const { t } = useTranslation();
18	    const { config, saveConfig } = useConfigStore();

20	    // 创建导航项(包含翻译后的标签)

22	        { path: '/', label: t('nav.dashboard'), icon: LayoutDashboard, priority: 'high' },
23	        { path: '/accounts', label: t('nav.accounts'), icon: Users, priority: 'high' },
24	        { path: '/api-proxy', label: t('nav.proxy'), icon: Network, priority: 'high' },
25	        { path: '/monitor', label: t('nav.call_records'), icon: Activity, priority: 'medium' },
26	        { path: '/token-stats', label: t('nav.token_stats', 'Token 统计'), icon: BarChart3, priority: 'low' },
27	        { path: '/user-token', label: t('nav.user_token', 'User Tokens'), icon: Users, priority: 'low' },
28	        { path: '/security', label: t('nav.security'), icon: Lock, priority: 'low' },
29	        { path: '/settings', label: t('nav.settings'), icon: Settings, priority: 'high' },
30	    ];
31	
32	    // 主题切换逻辑(带 View Transition 动画)
33	    const toggleTheme = async (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
34	        if (!config) return;
35	
36	        const newTheme = config.theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
37	
38	        // Use View Transition API if supported, but skip on Linux (may cause crash)
39	        if ('startViewTransition' in document && !isLinux()) {
40	            const x = event.clientX;
41	            const y = event.clientY;
42	            const endRadius = Math.hypot(
43	                Math.max(x, window.innerWidth - x),
44	                Math.max(y, window.innerHeight - y)
45	            );
46	
47	            // @ts-ignore
48	            const transition = document.startViewTransition(async () => {
49	                saveConfig({
50	                    ...config,
51	                    theme: newTheme,
52	                    language: config.language
53	                }, true);
54	            });
55	
56	            transition.ready.then(() => {
57	                const isDarkMode = newTheme === 'dark';
58	                const clipPath = isDarkMode
59	                    ? [`circle(${endRadius}px at ${x}px ${y}px)`, `circle(0px at ${x}px ${y}px)`]
60	                    : [`circle(0px at ${x}px ${y}px)`, `circle(${endRadius}px at ${x}px ${y}px)`];
61	
62	                document.documentElement.animate(
63	                    {
64	                        clipPath: clipPath
65	                    },
66	                    {
67	                        duration: 500,
68	                        easing: 'ease-in-out',
69	                        fill: 'forwards',
70	                        pseudoElement: isDarkMode ? '::view-transition-old(root)' : '::view-transition-new(root)'
71	                    }
72	                );
73	            });
74	        } else {
75	            // Fallback: direct switch (Linux or browsers without View Transition)
76	            await saveConfig({
77	                ...config,
78	                theme: newTheme,
79	                language: config.language
80	            }, true);
81	        }
82	    };
83	
84	    // 语言切换逻辑
85	    const handleLanguageChange = async (langCode: string) => {
86	        if (!config) return;
87	
88	        await saveConfig({
89	            ...config,
90	            language: langCode,
91	            theme: config.theme
92	        }, true);
93	    };
94	
95	    return (
96	        <nav
97	            style={{ position: 'sticky', top: 0, zIndex: 50 }}
98	            className="pt-9 transition-all duration-200 bg-[#FAFBFC] dark:bg-base-300"
99	        >
100	            {/* 窗口拖拽区域 - Tauri 专用 */}
101	            {isTauri() && (
102	                <div
103	                    className="absolute top-9 left-0 right-0 h-16"
104	                    style={{ zIndex: 5, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.001)' }}
105	                    data-tauri-drag-region
106	                />
107	            )}
108	
109	            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-8 relative" style={{ zIndex: 10 }}>
110	                {/* Flexbox 布局 - 子组件自己处理响应式 */}
111	                <div className="flex items-center h-16 gap-4">
112	                    {/* Logo - 使用父容器宽度做响应式 */}
113	                    <div className="@container/logo basis-[200px] shrink min-w-0">
114	                        <NavLogo />
115	                    </div>
116	
117	                    {/* 导航菜单 - 自己处理响应式 */}
118	                    <div className="flex-1 flex justify-center">
119	                        <NavMenu navItems={navItems} />
120	                    </div>
121	
122	                    {/* 设置按钮 - 自己处理响应式 */}

126	                        onThemeToggle={toggleTheme}
127	                        onLanguageChange={handleLanguageChange}
128	                    />
129	                </div>
130	            </div>
131	        </nav>
132	    );

## 1. Sidebar/Navigation Menu Definition

**Navigation is NOT a sidebar.** The app uses a **top horizontal navbar** (not a sidebar). The menu is defined in:

**`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/components/navbar/Navbar.tsx`** (lines 21-30)

```typescript

The `NavItem` type is defined in:
**`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/components/navbar/constants.ts`** (lines 4-9)

```typescript
export interface NavItem {
    path: string;
    label: string;
    icon: LucideIcon;
    priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
}
```

The menu is rendered by **`NavMenu.tsx`** (`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/components/navbar/NavMenu.tsx`), which filters out hidden items via `isMenuItemHidden()` from the config store, and renders the nav links at multiple responsive breakpoints.

## 2. How Pages Are Added to the Menu

To add a new page to the menu, you need to do **two things**:

1. **Add a route** in `App.tsx` (line 24-63) -- add a new child object to the `createBrowserRouter` array with a `path` and `element`.
2. **Add a nav item** in `Navbar.tsx` (line 21-30) -- add a new object to the `navItems` array with `path`, `label` (using i18n `t()`), `icon` (from lucide-react), and `priority`.

The `priority` field controls visibility at different screen sizes -- `high` items are always shown, while `low` priority items get collapsed into a dropdown on smaller screens.

I now have a comprehensive understanding of the entire configuration system. Here is my analysis:

---

## 1. The z.ai Config Struct (`ZaiConfig`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs` (lines 224-256)

`ZaiConfig` is defined as:

```rust
pub struct ZaiConfig {
    pub enabled: bool,                           // whether z.ai is enabled
    pub base_url: String,                        // default: "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic"
    pub api_key: String,
    pub dispatch_mode: ZaiDispatchMode,          // Off | Exclusive | Pooled | Fallback
    pub model_mapping: HashMap<String, String>,  // per-model overrides
    pub models: ZaiModelDefaults,               // opus/sonnet/haiku defaults
    pub mcp: ZaiMcpConfig,                      // web_search, web_reader, vision toggles
}
```

It lives inside `ProxyConfig` as the field `zai: ZaiConfig` (line 617 of config.rs). It is kept for backward compatibility -- when `providers` (the new multi-provider list) is non-empty, the legacy `zai` field is ignored.

The `ZaiDispatchMode` enum (lines 161-170) has four variants: `Off`, `Exclusive`, `Pooled`, `Fallback`.

## 2. Tauri Commands for Reading/Writing Config

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/commands/mod.rs` (lines 330-393)

There are two Tauri commands:

- **`load_config()`** (line 331) -- calls `modules::load_app_config()` which reads `gui_config.json` from the data directory, runs migration logic (anthropic_mapping/openai_mapping to custom_mapping), and returns an `AppConfig`.

- **`save_config(config: AppConfig)`** (line 337) -- does two things:
  1. Persists to disk via `modules::save_app_config(&config)` (JSON write to `gui_config.json`).
  2. Emits a `"config://updated"` Tauri event to notify the UI.
  3. If the proxy service is running, it performs **hot-update** of all runtime state on the live `AxumServer` instance by calling:
     - `update_mapping()` -- custom model mapping
     - `update_proxy()` -- upstream proxy
     - `update_security()` -- auth mode
     - `update_zai()` -- z.ai config
     - `update_experimental()` -- experimental features
     - `update_debug_logging()` -- debug logging
     - `update_user_agent()` -- User-Agent header
     - `update_thinking_budget_config()` -- global thinking budget (via `OnceLock` global)
     - `update_global_system_prompt_config()` -- global system prompt (via `OnceLock` global)
     - `update_image_thinking_mode()` -- image thinking mode (via `OnceLock` global)
     - `update_proxy_pool()` -- proxy pool config
     - `update_circuit_breaker_config()` -- circuit breaker

Both commands are registered in `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/lib.rs` (lines 449-450) via `tauri::generate_handler![]`.

## 3. How `provider_router` is Initialized and Updated at Runtime

**Initialization:** In `AxumServer::start()` (server.rs lines 324-328):

```rust
let provider_router = {
    let router = crate::proxy::providers::router::ProviderRouter::new(
        providers_config.clone(),
        Some(&zai_config),
    );
    Arc::new(RwLock::new(router))
};
```

The `ProviderRouter::new()` constructor (router.rs lines 16-31):
1. Filters `providers` to only `enabled` ones.
2. If the list is empty AND `legacy_zai` is `Some` and z.ai is enabled, it falls back to `from_zai_config()` which creates a single `UpstreamProvider` named "z.ai" with `AnthropicPassthrough` protocol.
3. Stores the enabled providers and a round-robin counter.

**Runtime update:** The `AxumServer` struct has a `zai_state: Arc<RwLock<ZaiConfig>>` field (server.rs line 222). The `update_zai()` method (line 262) simply replaces this value:

```rust
pub async fn update_zai(&self, config: &ProxyConfig) {
    let mut zai = self.zai_state.write().await;
    *zai = config.zai.clone();
    tracing::info!("z.ai configuration updated");
}
```

However, notably there is **no `update_provider_router()` method** on `AxumServer`. The `provider_router` is only created at startup. The `zai_state` is updated in-place, and the handlers read it directly.

The `provider_router` is used by the protocol handlers (claude.rs line 314, openai.rs line 150, gemini.rs line 89, audio.rs line 85) by acquiring a read lock on `state.provider_router`.

## 4. `UpstreamProvider` Struct and `ProviderProtocol` Enum

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs`

**`ProviderProtocol`** (lines 259-269):
```rust
pub enum ProviderProtocol {
    AnthropicPassthrough,  // Provider speaks Anthropic Messages API
    OpenAICompatible,      // Provider speaks OpenAI Chat Completions API
    GeminiV1Internal,      // Provider speaks Google v1internal (Gemini) API
}
```

**`UpstreamProvider`** (lines 317-343):
```rust
pub struct UpstreamProvider {
    pub name: String,
    pub enabled: bool,                    // default: true
    pub base_url: String,
    pub api_key: String,
    pub protocol: ProviderProtocol,       // default: AnthropicPassthrough
    pub dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode, // default: Pooled
    pub priority: u8,                     // default: 0
    pub model_prefixes: Vec<String>,      // empty = wildcard
    pub model_mapping: HashMap<String, String>,
    pub default_models: ProviderModelDefaults,
    pub request_timeout_secs: Option<u64>,
}
```

The `ProviderRouter` (router.rs) uses these to route requests:
- **Exclusive** providers get priority (sorted by `priority`).
- **Pooled** providers use round-robin (via `AtomicUsize` counter).
- **Fallback** providers are used only when higher-priority providers fail.

The `map_model()` method (router.rs lines 129-163) handles model name translation: exact match in `model_mapping`, prefix match, strip `zai:` prefix, pass through `glm-*` models, Claude family defaults, or pass through as-is.

## 5. How Config Changes Are Persisted to Disk

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/modules/config.rs`

Config is stored as **pretty-printed JSON** in a file named `gui_config.json` in the application data directory.

**`load_app_config()`** (lines 11-87):
1. Gets data dir via `get_data_dir()`.
2. If file does not exist, creates default `AppConfig` and auto-saves it.
3. Reads the JSON file and parses it as `serde_json::Value`.
4. Runs migration logic: migrates legacy `anthropic_mapping` and `openai_mapping` fields into the unified `custom_mapping` field.
5. Deserializes into `AppConfig`.
6. If migration occurred, auto-saves the cleaned config.

**`save_app_config()`** (lines 90-99):
```rust
pub fn save_app_config(config: &AppConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
    let data_dir = get_data_dir()?;
    let config_path = data_dir.join(CONFIG_FILE);
    let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(config)?;
    fs::write(&config_path, content)
}
```

Simple JSON serialization and `fs::write`.

The overall config hierarchy is:
```
AppConfig (models/config.rs)
  +-- proxy: ProxyConfig (proxy/config.rs)
        +-- zai: ZaiConfig
        +-- providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>
        +-- experimental: ExperimentalConfig
        +-- thinking_budget: ThinkingBudgetConfig
        +-- ...many more fields
```

10	/// Load application configuration
11	pub fn load_app_config() -> Result<AppConfig, String> {
12	    let data_dir = get_data_dir()?;
13	    let config_path = data_dir.join(CONFIG_FILE);
14	    
15	    if !config_path.exists() {
16	        let config = AppConfig::new();
17	        // [FIX #1460] Persist initial config to prevent new API Key on every refresh
18	        let _ = save_app_config(&config);
19	        return Ok(config);
20	    }
21	    
22	    let content = fs::read_to_string(&config_path)
23	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_read_config_file: {}", e))?;
24	    
25	    let mut v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content)
26	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_parse_config_file: {}", e))?;
27	    
28	    let mut modified = false;
29	
30	    // Migration logic
31	    if let Some(proxy) = v.get_mut("proxy") {
32	        // [FIX #1738] Enhanced type checking for custom_mapping
33	        // Ensures the field is always parsed as an object, preventing type mismatch errors
34	        let mut custom_mapping = match proxy.get("custom_mapping") {
35	            Some(m) if m.is_object() => m.as_object().unwrap().clone(),
36	            Some(m) => {
37	                // If custom_mapping is not an object type (e.g., string), log warning and reset to empty
38	                tracing::warn!("Invalid custom_mapping type (expected object, got {:?}), resetting to empty", m);
39	                serde_json::Map::new()
40	            }
41	            None => serde_json::Map::new(),
42	        };
43	
44	        // Migrate Anthropic mapping
45	        if let Some(anthropic) = proxy.get_mut("anthropic_mapping").and_then(|m| m.as_object_mut()) {
46	            for (k, v) in anthropic.iter() {
47	                // Only move non-series fields, as series fields are now handled by Preset logic or builtin tables
48	                if !k.ends_with("-series") {
49	                    if !custom_mapping.contains_key(k) {
50	                        custom_mapping.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
51	                    }
52	                }
53	            }
54	            // Remove old field
55	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("anthropic_mapping");
56	            modified = true;
57	        }
58	
59	        // Migrate OpenAI mapping
60	        if let Some(openai) = proxy.get_mut("openai_mapping").and_then(|m| m.as_object_mut()) {
61	            for (k, v) in openai.iter() {
62	                if !k.ends_with("-series") {
63	                    if !custom_mapping.contains_key(k) {
64	                        custom_mapping.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
65	                    }
66	                }
67	            }
68	            // Remove old field
69	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("openai_mapping");
70	            modified = true;
71	        }
72	
73	        if modified {
74	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().insert("custom_mapping".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(custom_mapping));
75	        }
76	    }
77	
78	    let config: AppConfig = serde_json::from_value(v)
79	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_convert_config_after_migration: {}", e))?;
80	    
81	    // If migration occurred, auto-save once to clean up the file
82	    if modified {
83	        let _ = save_app_config(&config);
84	    }
85	
86	    Ok(config)
87	}

89	/// Save application configuration
90	pub fn save_app_config(config: &AppConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
91	    let data_dir = get_data_dir()?;
92	    let config_path = data_dir.join(CONFIG_FILE);
93	    
94	    let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(config)
95	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_serialize_config: {}", e))?;
96	    
97	    fs::write(&config_path, content)
98	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_save_config: {}", e))

547	#[tauri::command]
548	pub async fn sync_account_from_db(
549	    app: tauri::AppHandle,
550	    proxy_state: tauri::State<'_, crate::commands::proxy::ProxyServiceState>,
551	) -> Result<Option<Account>, String> {
552	    // 1. 获取 DB 中的 Refresh Token
553	    let db_refresh_token = match modules::migration::get_refresh_token_from_db() {
554	        Ok(token) => token,
555	        Err(e) => {
556	            modules::logger::log_info(&format!("自动同步跳过: {}", e));
557	            return Ok(None);
558	        }
559	    };
560	
561	    // 2. 获取 Manager 当前账号
562	    let curr_account = modules::account::get_current_account()?;
563	
564	    // 3. 对比：如果 Refresh Token 相同，说明账号没变，无需导入
565	    if let Some(acc) = curr_account {
566	        if acc.token.refresh_token == db_refresh_token {
567	            // 账号未变，由于已经是周期性任务，我们可以选择性刷新一下配额，或者直接返回
568	            // 这里为了节省 API 流量，直接返回
569	            return Ok(None);
570	        }
571	        modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
572	            "检测到账号切换 ({} -> DB新账号)，正在同步...",
573	            acc.email
574	        ));
575	    } else {
576	        modules::logger::log_info("检测到新登录账号，正在自动同步...");
577	    }
578	
579	    // 4. 执行完整导入
580	    let account = import_from_db(app, proxy_state).await?;
581	    Ok(Some(account))
582	}

584	fn validate_path(path: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
585	    if path.contains("..") {
586	        return Err("非法路径: 不允许目录遍历".to_string());
587	    }
588	
589	    // 检查是否指向系统敏感路径 (基础黑名单)
590	    let lower_path = path.to_lowercase();
591	    let sensitive_prefixes = [
592	        "/etc/",
593	        "/var/spool/cron",
594	        "/root/",
595	        "/proc/",
596	        "/sys/",
597	        "/dev/",
598	        "c:\\windows",
599	        "c:\\users\\administrator",
600	        "c:\\pagefile.sys",
601	    ];
602	
603	    for prefix in sensitive_prefixes {
604	        if lower_path.starts_with(prefix) {
605	            return Err(format!("安全拒绝: 禁止访问系统敏感路径 ({})", prefix));
606	        }
607	    }
608	
609	    Ok(())
610	}

792	/// 切换账号的反代禁用状态
793	#[tauri::command]
794	pub async fn toggle_proxy_status(
795	    app: tauri::AppHandle,
796	    proxy_state: tauri::State<'_, crate::commands::proxy::ProxyServiceState>,
797	    account_id: String,
798	    enable: bool,
799	    reason: Option<String>,
800	) -> Result<(), String> {
801	    modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
802	        "切换账号反代状态: {} -> {}",
803	        account_id,
804	        if enable { "启用" } else { "禁用" }
805	    ));
806	
807	    // 1. 读取账号文件
808	    let data_dir = modules::account::get_data_dir()?;
809	    let account_path = data_dir
810	        .join("accounts")
811	        .join(format!("{}.json", account_id));
812	
813	    if !account_path.exists() {
814	        return Err(format!("账号文件不存在: {}", account_id));
815	    }
816	
817	    let content =
818	        std::fs::read_to_string(&account_path).map_err(|e| format!("读取账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
819	
820	    let mut account_json: serde_json::Value =
821	        serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| format!("解析账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
822	
823	    // 2. 更新 proxy_disabled 字段
824	    if enable {
825	        // 启用反代
826	        account_json["proxy_disabled"] = serde_json::Value::Bool(false);
827	        account_json["proxy_disabled_reason"] = serde_json::Value::Null;
828	        account_json["proxy_disabled_at"] = serde_json::Value::Null;
829	    } else {
830	        // 禁用反代
831	        let now = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
832	        account_json["proxy_disabled"] = serde_json::Value::Bool(true);
833	        account_json["proxy_disabled_at"] = serde_json::Value::Number(now.into());
834	        account_json["proxy_disabled_reason"] =
835	            serde_json::Value::String(reason.unwrap_or_else(|| "用户手动禁用".to_string()));
836	    }
837	
838	    // 3. 保存到磁盘
839	    let json_str = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&account_json)
840	        .map_err(|e| format!("序列化账号数据失败: {}", e))?;
841	    std::fs::write(&account_path, json_str).map_err(|e| format!("写入账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
842	
843	    modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
844	        "账号反代状态已更新: {} ({})",
845	        account_id,
846	        if enable { "已启用" } else { "已禁用" }
847	    ));
848	
849	    // 4. 如果反代服务正在运行,立刻同步到内存池（避免禁用后仍被选中）
850	    {
851	        let instance_lock = proxy_state.instance.read().await;
852	        if let Some(instance) = instance_lock.as_ref() {
853	            // 如果禁用的是当前固定账号，则自动关闭固定模式（内存 + 配置持久化）
854	            if !enable {
855	                let pref_id = instance.token_manager.get_preferred_account().await;
856	                if pref_id.as_deref() == Some(&account_id) {
857	                    instance.token_manager.set_preferred_account(None).await;
858	
859	                    if let Ok(mut cfg) = crate::modules::config::load_app_config() {
860	                        if cfg.proxy.preferred_account_id.as_deref() == Some(&account_id) {
861	                            cfg.proxy.preferred_account_id = None;
862	                            let _ = crate::modules::config::save_app_config(&cfg);
863	                        }
864	                    }
865	                }
866	            }
867	
868	            instance
869	                .token_manager
870	                .reload_account(&account_id)
871	                .await
872	                .map_err(|e| format!("同步账号失败: {}", e))?;
873	        }
874	    }
875	
876	    // 5. 更新托盘菜单
877	    crate::modules::tray::update_tray_menus(&app);
878	
879	    Ok(())
880	}

894	/// 更新账号自定义标签
895	#[tauri::command]
896	pub async fn update_account_label(account_id: String, label: String) -> Result<(), String> {
897	    // 验证标签长度（按字符数计算，支持中文）
898	    if label.chars().count() > 15 {
899	        return Err("标签长度不能超过15个字符".to_string());
900	    }
901	
902	    modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
903	        "更新账号标签: {} -> {:?}",
904	        account_id,
905	        if label.is_empty() { "无" } else { &label }
906	    ));
907	
908	    // 1. 读取账号文件
909	    let data_dir = modules::account::get_data_dir()?;
910	    let account_path = data_dir
911	        .join("accounts")
912	        .join(format!("{}.json", account_id));
913	
914	    if !account_path.exists() {
915	        return Err(format!("账号文件不存在: {}", account_id));
916	    }
917	
918	    let content =
919	        std::fs::read_to_string(&account_path).map_err(|e| format!("读取账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
920	
921	    let mut account_json: serde_json::Value =
922	        serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| format!("解析账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
923	
924	    // 2. 更新 custom_label 字段
925	    if label.is_empty() {
926	        account_json["custom_label"] = serde_json::Value::Null;
927	    } else {
928	        account_json["custom_label"] = serde_json::Value::String(label.clone());
929	    }
930	
931	    // 3. 保存到磁盘
932	    let json_str = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&account_json)
933	        .map_err(|e| format!("序列化账号数据失败: {}", e))?;
934	    std::fs::write(&account_path, json_str).map_err(|e| format!("写入账号文件失败: {}", e))?;
935	
936	    modules::logger::log_info(&format!(

1	use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
2	use std::sync::Arc;
3	
4	use crate::proxy::config::{
5	    ProviderDispatchMode, ProviderModelDefaults, ProviderProtocol, UpstreamProvider, ZaiConfig,
6	};
7	
8	/// Routes incoming requests to the appropriate upstream provider.
9	pub struct ProviderRouter {
10	    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
11	    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
12	}
13	
14	impl ProviderRouter {
15	    /// Build from config. If `providers` is empty, optionally migrate from legacy z.ai config.
16	    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
17	        let enabled: Vec<_> = providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect();
18	
19	        if enabled.is_empty() {
20	            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
21	                if zai.enabled && zai.dispatch_mode != crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
22	                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
23	                }
24	            }
25	        }
26	
27	        Self {
28	            providers: enabled,
29	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
30	        }
31	    }
32	
33	    /// Build a single-provider router from legacy z.ai configuration.
34	    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
35	        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
36	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
37	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
38	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
39	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
40	        };
41	
42	        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
43	            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
44	            enabled: true,
45	            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
46	            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
47	            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
48	            dispatch_mode,
49	            priority: 0,
50	            model_prefixes: Vec::new(), // wildcard
51	            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
52	            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
53	                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
54	                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
55	                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
56	            },
57	            request_timeout_secs: None,
58	        };
59	
60	        Self {
61	            providers: vec![provider],
62	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {
72	                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
73	                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
74	            })
75	            .collect()
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
129	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
130	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
131	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
132	            return mapped.clone();
133	        }
134	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
135	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
136	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
137	            .model_mapping
138	            .iter()
139	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
140	        {
141	            return mapped.clone();
142	        }
143	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
144	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
145	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
146	        }
147	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
148	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
149	            return incoming.to_string();
150	        }
151	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
152	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
153	            if m.contains("opus") {
154	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
155	            }
156	            if m.contains("haiku") {
157	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
158	            }
159	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
160	        }
161	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
162	        incoming.to_string()
163	    }
164	
165	    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
166	    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
167	        self.providers.is_empty()
168	    }
169	}

171	/// Map a model name to the provider's expected model name.
172	/// This is a free function so it can be used without holding a `ProviderRouter` lock.
173	pub fn map_model_for_provider(
174	    original: &str,
175	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
176	    default_models: &ProviderModelDefaults,
177	) -> String {
178	    // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
179	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
180	        return mapped.clone();
181	    }
182	    // 2. Lowercase match
183	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
184	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
185	        return mapped.clone();
186	    }
187	    // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
188	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
189	        return original[4..].to_string();
190	    }
191	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
192	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
193	        return original.to_string();
194	    }
195	    // 5. Claude family defaults
196	    if m.starts_with("claude-") {
197	        if m.contains("opus") {
198	            return default_models.opus.clone();
199	        }
200	        if m.contains("haiku") {
201	            return default_models.haiku.clone();
202	        }
203	        return default_models.sonnet.clone();
204	    }
205	    // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
206	    original.to_string()
207	}

76	/// Increase file descriptor limit for macOS to prevent "Too many open files" errors
77	#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
78	fn increase_nofile_limit() {
79	    unsafe {
80	        let mut rl = libc::rlimit {
81	            rlim_cur: 0,
82	            rlim_max: 0,
83	        };
84	
85	        if libc::getrlimit(libc::RLIMIT_NOFILE, &mut rl) == 0 {
86	            info!("Current open file limit: soft={}, hard={}", rl.rlim_cur, rl.rlim_max);
87	
88	            // Attempt to increase to 4096 or maximum hard limit
89	            let target = 4096.min(rl.rlim_max);
90	            if rl.rlim_cur < target {
91	                rl.rlim_cur = target;
92	                if libc::setrlimit(libc::RLIMIT_NOFILE, &rl) == 0 {
93	                    info!("Successfully increased hard file limit to {}", target);
94	                } else {
95	                    warn!("Failed to increase file descriptor limit");
96	                }
97	            }
98	        }
99	    }
100	}

624	                        let _ = window.set_focus();

    pub base_url: String,                        // default: "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic"
    pub api_key: String,
    pub dispatch_mode: ZaiDispatchMode,          // Off | Exclusive | Pooled | Fallback
    pub model_mapping: HashMap<String, String>,  // per-model overrides
