18	    Form,
19	    Switch,
20	    Popconfirm,
21	    InputNumber,
22	    Empty,
23	    Collapse,
24	    Space,
25	    message,
26	} from 'antd';
27	import type { ColumnsType } from 'antd/es/table';
28	import { useConfigStore } from '../stores/useConfigStore';
29	import type {
30	    UpstreamProvider,
31	    ProviderProtocol,
32	    ProviderDispatchMode,
33	    ProviderModelDefaults,
34	} from '../types/config';
35	
36	const DEFAULT_MODELS: ProviderModelDefaults = {
37	    opus: 'glm-4.7',
38	    sonnet: 'glm-4.7',
39	    haiku: 'glm-4.5-air',
40	};
41	
42	const PROTOCOL_OPTIONS = [
43	    { value: 'anthropic_passthrough', label: 'Anthropic' },
44	    { value: 'openai_compatible', label: 'OpenAI' },
45	    { value: 'gemini_v1internal', label: 'Gemini' },
46	];
47	
48	const DISPATCH_OPTIONS = [
49	    { value: 'exclusive', label: 'Exclusive' },
50	    { value: 'pooled', label: 'Pooled' },
51	    { value: 'fallback', label: 'Fallback' },
52	];
53	
54	const PROTOCOL_COLORS: Record<ProviderProtocol, string> = {
55	    anthropic_passthrough: 'blue',
56	    openai_compatible: 'green',
57	    gemini_v1internal: 'orange',
58	};
59	
60	function createEmptyProvider(): UpstreamProvider {
61	    return {
62	        name: '',
63	        enabled: true,
64	        base_url: 'https://',
65	        api_key: '',
66	        protocol: 'anthropic_passthrough',
67	        dispatch_mode: 'pooled',
68	        priority: 0,
69	        model_prefixes: [],
70	        model_mapping: {},
71	        default_models: { ...DEFAULT_MODELS },
72	    };
73	}
74	
75	function ProviderManager() {
76	    const { t } = useTranslation();
77	    const { config, saveConfig } = useConfigStore();
78	
79	    const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState('');
80	    const [protocolFilter, setProtocolFilter] = useState<string>('');
81	    const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
82	    const [editingProvider, setEditingProvider] = useState<UpstreamProvider | null>(null);
83	    const [form] = Form.useForm<UpstreamProvider>();
84	    const [modelMappings, setModelMappings] = useState<{ from: string; to: string }[]>([]);
85	    const [newMappingFrom, setNewMappingFrom] = useState('');
86	    const [newMappingTo, setNewMappingTo] = useState('');
87	    const [showMappingForm, setShowMappingForm] = useState(false);
88	
89	    const providers: UpstreamProvider[] = useMemo(() => {
90	        return config?.proxy?.providers ?? [];
91	    }, [config?.proxy?.providers]);
92	
93	    // Check for legacy z.ai config to migrate
94	    const hasLegacyZai = useMemo(() => {
95	        return config?.proxy?.zai?.enabled && (providers.length === 0);
96	    }, [config?.proxy?.zai?.enabled, providers.length]);
97	
98	    const migrateZaiConfig = useCallback(() => {
99	        const zai = config?.proxy?.zai;
100	        if (!zai || !config) return;
101	
102	        const newProvider: UpstreamProvider = {
103	            name: 'z.ai',
104	            enabled: zai.enabled,
105	            base_url: zai.base_url,
106	            api_key: zai.api_key,
107	            protocol: 'anthropic_passthrough',
108	            dispatch_mode: zai.dispatch_mode === 'off' ? 'pooled' : zai.dispatch_mode as ProviderDispatchMode,
109	            priority: 0,
110	            model_prefixes: [],
111	            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping || {},
112	            default_models: {
113	                opus: zai.models?.opus || DEFAULT_MODELS.opus,
114	                sonnet: zai.models?.sonnet || DEFAULT_MODELS.sonnet,
115	                haiku: zai.models?.haiku || DEFAULT_MODELS.haiku,
116	            },
117	        };
118	
119	        const newConfig = {
120	            ...config,
121	            proxy: {
122	                ...config.proxy,
123	                providers: [newProvider],
124	            },
125	        };
126	        saveConfig(newConfig);
127	        message.success(t('providers.migrate_success'));
128	    }, [config, saveConfig, t]);
129	
130	    const skipMigration = useCallback(() => {
131	        // Just acknowledge — do nothing, user can add providers manually
132	    }, []);
133	
134	    // Filtered providers
135	    const filteredProviders = useMemo(() => {
136	        let result = providers;
137	        if (searchText) {
138	            const lower = searchText.toLowerCase();
139	            result = result.filter((p) => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(lower));
140	        }
141	        if (protocolFilter) {
142	            result = result.filter((p) => p.protocol === protocolFilter);
143	        }
144	        return result;
145	    }, [providers, searchText, protocolFilter]);
146	
147	    const handleAdd = () => {
148	        setEditingProvider(null);
149	        form.resetFields();
150	        form.setFieldsValue(createEmptyProvider());
151	        setModelMappings([]);
152	        setShowMappingForm(false);
153	        setIsModalOpen(true);
154	    };
155	
156	    const handleEdit = (provider: UpstreamProvider) => {
157	        setEditingProvider(provider);
158	        form.setFieldsValue({
159	            ...provider,
160	            request_timeout_secs: provider.request_timeout_secs ?? undefined,
161	        });
162	        setModelMappings(
163	            Object.entries(provider.model_mapping || {}).map(([from, to]) => ({ from, to }))
164	        );
165	        setShowMappingForm(false);
166	        setIsModalOpen(true);
167	    };
168	
169	    const handleDelete = async (provider: UpstreamProvider) => {
170	        if (!config) return;
171	        const newProviders = providers.filter((p) => p.name !== provider.name);
172	        const newConfig = {
173	            ...config,
174	            proxy: {
175	                ...config.proxy,
176	                providers: newProviders,
177	            },
178	        };
179	        await saveConfig(newConfig);
180	        message.success(t('providers.delete.success'));
181	    };
182	
183	    const handleToggleEnabled = async (provider: UpstreamProvider) => {
184	        if (!config) return;
185	        const newProviders = providers.map((p) =>
186	            p.name === provider.name ? { ...p, enabled: !p.enabled } : p
187	        );
188	        const newConfig = {
189	            ...config,
190	            proxy: {
191	                ...config.proxy,
192	                providers: newProviders,
193	            },
194	        };
195	        await saveConfig(newConfig);
196	    };
197	
198	    const handleModalOk = async () => {
199	        try {
200	            const values = await form.validateFields();
201	            if (!config) return;
202	
203	            // Build model_mapping from state
204	            const model_mapping: Record<string, string> = {};
205	            for (const m of modelMappings) {
206	                if (m.from.trim()) {
207	                    model_mapping[m.from.trim()] = m.to.trim();
208	                }
209	            }
210	
211	            const updated: UpstreamProvider = {
212	                name: values.name,
213	                enabled: values.enabled ?? true,
214	                base_url: values.base_url,
215	                api_key: values.api_key,
216	                protocol: values.protocol,
217	                dispatch_mode: values.dispatch_mode,
218	                priority: values.priority ?? 0,
219	                model_prefixes: values.model_prefixes ?? [],
220	                model_mapping,
221	                default_models: {
222	                    opus: values.default_models?.opus || DEFAULT_MODELS.opus,
223	                    sonnet: values.default_models?.sonnet || DEFAULT_MODELS.sonnet,
224	                    haiku: values.default_models?.haiku || DEFAULT_MODELS.haiku,
225	                },
226	                request_timeout_secs: values.request_timeout_secs || undefined,
227	            };
228	
229	            let newProviders: UpstreamProvider[];
230	            if (editingProvider) {
231	                // If name changed, update by old name
232	                newProviders = providers.map((p) =>
233	                    p.name === editingProvider.name ? updated : p
234	                );
235	            } else {
236	                // Check for duplicate name
237	                if (providers.some((p) => p.name === updated.name)) {
238	                    message.error('Provider name already exists');
239	                    return;
240	                }
241	                newProviders = [...providers, updated];
242	            }
243	
244	            const newConfig = {
245	                ...config,
246	                proxy: {
247	                    ...config.proxy,
248	                    providers: newProviders,
249	                },
250	            };
251	            await saveConfig(newConfig);
252	            message.success(t('providers.form.save_success'));
253	            setIsModalOpen(false);
254	        } catch {
255	            // validation failed
256	        }
257	    };
258	
259	    const addMapping = () => {
260	        if (newMappingFrom.trim() && newMappingTo.trim()) {
261	            setModelMappings([...modelMappings, { from: newMappingFrom.trim(), to: newMappingTo.trim() }]);
262	            setNewMappingFrom('');
263	            setNewMappingTo('');
264	        }
265	    };
266	
267	    const removeMapping = (index: number) => {
268	        setModelMappings(modelMappings.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
269	    };
270	
271	    // Table columns
272	    const columns: ColumnsType<UpstreamProvider> = [
273	        {
274	            title: t('providers.columns.status'),
275	            key: 'enabled',
276	            width: 70,
277	            render: (_, record) => (
278	                <Switch
279	                    size="small"
280	                    checked={record.enabled}
281	                    onChange={() => handleToggleEnabled(record)}
282	                />
283	            ),
284	        },
285	        {
286	            title: t('providers.columns.name'),
287	            dataIndex: 'name',
288	            key: 'name',
289	            width: 140,
290	            render: (text: string) => <span className="font-medium">{text}</span>,
291	        },
292	        {
293	            title: t('providers.columns.base_url'),
294	            dataIndex: 'base_url',
295	            key: 'base_url',
296	            ellipsis: true,
297	            render: (text: string) => (
298	                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-gray-500">{text}</span>
299	            ),
300	        },
301	        {
302	            title: t('providers.columns.protocol'),
303	            dataIndex: 'protocol',
304	            key: 'protocol',
305	            width: 120,
306	            render: (protocol: ProviderProtocol) => (
307	                <Tag color={PROTOCOL_COLORS[protocol]}>
308	                    {t(`providers.protocols.${protocol}`)}
309	                </Tag>
310	            ),
311	        },
312	        {
313	            title: t('providers.columns.dispatch_mode'),
314	            dataIndex: 'dispatch_mode',
315	            key: 'dispatch_mode',
316	            width: 110,
317	            render: (mode: ProviderDispatchMode) => {
318	                const modeLabels: Record<string, string> = {
319	                    exclusive: t('providers.dispatch_modes.exclusive'),
320	                    pooled: t('providers.dispatch_modes.pooled'),
321	                    fallback: t('providers.dispatch_modes.fallback'),
322	                };
323	                return <span className="text-xs">{modeLabels[mode] || mode}</span>;
324	            },
325	        },
326	        {
327	            title: t('providers.columns.priority'),
328	            dataIndex: 'priority',
329	            key: 'priority',
330	            width: 80,
331	            render: (p: number) => <span className="text-xs">{p}</span>,
332	        },
333	        {
334	            title: t('providers.columns.actions'),
335	            key: 'actions',
336	            width: 120,
337	            render: (_, record) => (
338	                <Space size="small">
339	                    <Button
340	                        type="link"
341	                        size="small"
342	                        icon={<Edit2 size={14} />}
343	                        onClick={() => handleEdit(record)}
344	                    >
345	                        {t('providers.edit_button')}
346	                    </Button>
347	                    <Popconfirm
348	                        title={t('providers.delete.title')}
349	                        description={t('providers.delete.description', { name: record.name })}
350	                        onConfirm={() => handleDelete(record)}
351	                        okText={t('providers.delete.confirm')}
352	                        cancelText={t('providers.delete.cancel')}
353	                        okButtonProps={{ danger: true }}
354	                    >
355	                        <Button type="link" size="small" danger icon={<Trash2 size={14} />}>
356	                            {t('providers.delete_button')}
357	                        </Button>
358	                    </Popconfirm>
359	                </Space>
360	            ),
361	        },
362	    ];
363	
364	    return (
365	        <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 dark:bg-base-300/30">
366	            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6">
367	                {/* Header */}
368	                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
369	                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
370	                        <Server size={24} className="text-indigo-500" />
371	                        <div>
372	                            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
373	                                {t('providers.title')}
374	                            </h1>
375	                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
376	                                {t('providers.subtitle')}
377	                            </p>
378	                        </div>
379	                    </div>
380	                    <Button
381	                        type="primary"
382	                        icon={<Plus size={16} />}
383	                        onClick={handleAdd}
384	                    >
385	                        {t('providers.add_button')}
386	                    </Button>
387	                </div>
388	
389	                {/* Migration banner */}
390	                {hasLegacyZai && (
391	                    <div className="mb-4 p-4 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
392	                        <AlertCircle size={20} className="text-amber-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
393	                        <div className="flex-1">
394	                            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
395	                                {t('providers.migrate_zai_title')}
396	                            </p>
397	                            <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 mt-1">
398	                                {t('providers.migrate_zai_description')}
399	                            </p>
400	                            <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
401	                                <Button
402	                                    size="small"
403	                                    type="primary"
404	                                    onClick={migrateZaiConfig}
405	                                >
406	                                    {t('providers.migrate_button')}
407	                                </Button>
408	                                <Button size="small" onClick={skipMigration}>
409	                                    {t('providers.skip_button')}
410	                                </Button>
411	                            </div>
412	                        </div>
413	                    </div>
414	                )}
415	
416	                {/* Filters */}
417	                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-base-200 rounded-lg p-4 mb-4 shadow-sm">
418	                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
419	                        <Input
420	                            prefix={<Search size={14} className="text-gray-400" />}
421	                            placeholder={t('providers.search_placeholder')}
422	                            value={searchText}
423	                            onChange={(e) => setSearchText(e.target.value)}
424	                            className="max-w-xs"
425	                            size="small"
426	                            allowClear
427	                        />
428	                        <Select
429	                            value={protocolFilter || undefined}
430	                            placeholder={t('providers.filter_all')}
431	                            onChange={(v) => setProtocolFilter(v || '')}
432	                            size="small"
433	                            className="w-40"
434	                            allowClear
435	                            options={[
436	                                { value: 'anthropic_passthrough', label: 'Anthropic' },
437	                                { value: 'openai_compatible', label: 'OpenAI' },
438	                                { value: 'gemini_v1internal', label: 'Gemini' },
439	                            ]}
440	                        />
441	                        <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 ml-auto">
442	                            {t('providers.total', { count: filteredProviders.length })}
443	                        </span>
444	                    </div>
445	                </div>
446	
447	                {/* Table */}
448	                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-base-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm">
449	                    {providers.length === 0 ? (
450	                        <div className="py-16">
451	                            <Empty
452	                                image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
453	                                description={
454	                                    <span className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
455	                                        {t('providers.empty_description')}
456	                                    </span>
457	                                }
458	                            >
459	                                <Button type="primary" onClick={handleAdd}>
460	                                    {t('providers.empty_action')}
461	                                </Button>
462	                            </Empty>
463	                        </div>
464	                    ) : (
465	                        <Table
466	                            columns={columns}
467	                            dataSource={filteredProviders}
468	                            rowKey="name"
469	                            size="middle"
470	                            pagination={false}
471	                            className="dark:[&_.ant-table]:border-base-100 dark:[&_.ant-table-cell]:!border-base-100"
472	                        />
473	                    )}
474	                </div>
475	            </div>
476	
477	            {/* Add/Edit Modal */}
478	            <Modal
479	                title={
480	                    editingProvider
481	                        ? t('providers.form.edit_title')
482	                        : t('providers.form.add_title')
483	                }
484	                open={isModalOpen}
485	                onOk={handleModalOk}
486	                onCancel={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
487	                width={600}
488	                okText={t('providers.form.confirm')}
489	                cancelText={t('providers.form.cancel')}
490	            >
491	                <Form
492	                    form={form}
493	                    layout="vertical"
494	                    className="mt-4"
495	                    initialValues={createEmptyProvider()}
496	                >
497	                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
498	                        <Form.Item
499	                            name="name"
500	                            label={t('providers.form.name_label')}
501	                            rules={[{ required: true, message: t('providers.form.name_required') }]}
502	                        >
503	                            <Input
504	                                placeholder={t('providers.form.name_placeholder')}
505	                                disabled={!!editingProvider}
506	                            />
507	                        </Form.Item>
508	                        <Form.Item
509	                            name="protocol"
510	                            label={t('providers.form.protocol_label')}
511	                        >
512	                            <Select options={PROTOCOL_OPTIONS} />
513	                        </Form.Item>
514	                    </div>
515	                    <Form.Item
516	                        name="base_url"
517	                        label={t('providers.form.base_url_label')}
518	                        rules={[{ required: true, message: t('providers.form.base_url_required') }]}
519	                    >
520	                        <Input
521	                            placeholder={t('providers.form.base_url_placeholder')}
522	                            className="font-mono text-xs"
523	                        />
524	                    </Form.Item>
525	                    <Form.Item
526	                        name="api_key"
527	                        label={t('providers.form.api_key_label')}
528	                        rules={[{ required: true, message: t('providers.form.api_key_required') }]}
529	                    >
530	                        <Input.Password
531	                            placeholder={t('providers.form.api_key_placeholder')}
532	                        />
533	                    </Form.Item>
534	                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
535	                        <Form.Item
536	                            name="dispatch_mode"
537	                            label={t('providers.form.dispatch_mode_label')}
538	                        >
539	                            <Select options={DISPATCH_OPTIONS} />
540	                        </Form.Item>
541	                        <Form.Item
542	                            name="priority"
543	                            label={t('providers.form.priority_label')}
544	                        >
545	                            <InputNumber
546	                                min={0}
547	                                max={99}
548	                                className="w-full"
549	                                placeholder={t('providers.form.priority_placeholder')}
550	                            />
551	                        </Form.Item>
552	                        <Form.Item
553	                            name="request_timeout_secs"
554	                            label={t('providers.form.timeout_label')}
555	                        >
556	                            <InputNumber
557	                                min={5}
558	                                className="w-full"
559	                                placeholder={t('providers.form.timeout_placeholder')}
560	                            />
561	                        </Form.Item>
562	                    </div>
563	
564	                    {/* Default models */}
565	                    <Collapse
566	                        items={[
567	                            {
568	                                key: '1',
569	                                label: (
570	                                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
571	                                        {t('providers.form.model_mapping_title')}
572	                                    </span>
573	                                ),
574	                                children: (
575	                                    <div className="space-y-3">
576	                                        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
577	                                            <Form.Item
578	                                                name={['default_models', 'opus']}
579	                                                label={t('providers.form.opus_label')}
580	                                            >
581	                                                <Input size="small" />
582	                                            </Form.Item>
583	                                            <Form.Item
584	                                                name={['default_models', 'sonnet']}
585	                                                label={t('providers.form.sonnet_label')}
586	                                            >
587	                                                <Input size="small" />
588	                                            </Form.Item>
589	                                            <Form.Item
590	                                                name={['default_models', 'haiku']}
591	                                                label={t('providers.form.haiku_label')}
592	                                            >
593	                                                <Input size="small" />
594	                                            </Form.Item>
595	                                        </div>
596	
597	                                        {/* Model prefix tags */}
598	                                        <Form.Item
599	                                            name="model_prefixes"
600	                                            label={t('providers.form.prefixes_label')}
601	                                        >
602	                                            <Select
603	                                                mode="tags"
604	                                                placeholder={t('providers.form.prefixes_placeholder')}
605	                                                size="small"
606	                                            />
607	                                        </Form.Item>
608	
609	                                        {/* Custom model mapping */}
610	                                        <div className="space-y-2">
611	                                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
612	                                                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
613	                                                    {t('providers.form.model_mapping_title')}
614	                                                </span>
615	                                                <Button
616	                                                    type="link"
617	                                                    size="small"
618	                                                    onClick={() => setShowMappingForm(!showMappingForm)}
619	                                                >
620	                                                    {t('providers.form.model_mapping_add')}
621	                                                </Button>
622	                                            </div>
623	                                            {showMappingForm && (
624	                                                <div className="flex gap-2">
625	                                                    <Input
626	                                                        size="small"
627	                                                        placeholder={t('providers.form.model_mapping_from')}
628	                                                        value={newMappingFrom}
629	                                                        onChange={(e) => setNewMappingFrom(e.target.value)}
630	                                                        onPressEnter={addMapping}
631	                                                    />
632	                                                    <Input
633	                                                        size="small"
634	                                                        placeholder={t('providers.form.model_mapping_to')}
635	                                                        value={newMappingTo}
636	                                                        onChange={(e) => setNewMappingTo(e.target.value)}
637	                                                        onPressEnter={addMapping}
638	                                                    />
639	                                                    <Button size="small" type="primary" onClick={addMapping}>
640	                                                        OK
641	                                                    </Button>
642	                                                </div>
643	                                            )}
644	                                            {modelMappings.length > 0 && (
645	                                                <div className="space-y-1 max-h-32 overflow-auto">
646	                                                    {modelMappings.map((m, i) => (
647	                                                        <div
648	                                                            key={i}
649	                                                            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs bg-gray-50 dark:bg-base-300 px-2 py-1 rounded"
650	                                                        >
651	                                                            <span className="font-mono">{m.from}</span>
652	                                                            <span className="text-gray-400">→</span>
653	                                                            <span className="font-mono">{m.to}</span>
654	                                                            <button
655	                                                                className="ml-auto text-red-500 hover:text-red-600"
656	                                                                onClick={() => removeMapping(i)}
657	                                                            >
658	                                                                ×
659	                                                            </button>
660	                                                        </div>
661	                                                    ))}

import type {
    UpstreamProvider,
    ProviderProtocol,
    ProviderDispatchMode,
    ProviderModelDefaults,
} from '../types/config';

const DEFAULT_MODELS: ProviderModelDefaults = {
    opus: 'glm-4.7',
    sonnet: 'glm-4.7',
    haiku: 'glm-4.5-air',
};

const PROTOCOL_OPTIONS: { value: ProviderProtocol; label: string }[] = [

const DISPATCH_OPTIONS: { value: ProviderDispatchMode; label: string }[] = [
    { value: 'exclusive', label: 'Exclusive' },

    { value: 'fallback', label: 'Fallback' },
];

const PROTOCOL_COLORS: Record<ProviderProtocol, string> = {
    anthropic_passthrough: 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800',
    openai_compatible: 'bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 text-green-700 dark:text-green-300 border-green-200 dark:border-green-800',
    gemini_v1internal: 'bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-900/30 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-300 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800',
};

function createEmptyProvider(): UpstreamProvider {
    return {
        name: '',
        enabled: true,
        base_url: 'https://',
        api_key: '',
        protocol: 'anthropic_passthrough',
        dispatch_mode: 'pooled',
        priority: 0,
        model_prefixes: [],
        model_mapping: {},
        default_models: { ...DEFAULT_MODELS },
    };
}

/* ─── Custom Modal Dialog for Add/Edit ─── */

interface ProviderFormModalProps {
    isOpen: boolean;
    editingProvider: UpstreamProvider | null;
    initialData: UpstreamProvider;
    onConfirm: (values: UpstreamProvider, mappings: { from: string; to: string }[]) => void;
    onCancel: () => void;
}

function ProviderFormModal({ isOpen, editingProvider, initialData, onConfirm, onCancel }: ProviderFormModalProps) {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const [formData, setFormData] = useState<UpstreamProvider>(initialData);
    const [modelMappings, setModelMappings] = useState<{ from: string; to: string }[]>([]);
    const [newMappingFrom, setNewMappingFrom] = useState('');
    const [newMappingTo, setNewMappingTo] = useState('');
    const [showMappingForm, setShowMappingForm] = useState(false);
    const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);
    const nameInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        setFormData(initialData);
        setModelMappings(
            Object.entries(initialData.model_mapping || {}).map(([from, to]) => ({ from, to }))
        );
        setShowMappingForm(false);
        setNewMappingFrom('');
        setNewMappingTo('');
        setShowAdvanced(false);
    }, [initialData]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (isOpen && nameInputRef.current) {
            setTimeout(() => nameInputRef.current?.focus(), 100);
        }
    }, [isOpen]);

    if (!isOpen) return null;

    const updateField = <K extends keyof UpstreamProvider>(field: K, value: UpstreamProvider[K]) => {
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    };

    const updateDefaultModel = (field: keyof ProviderModelDefaults, value: string) => {
        setFormData(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            default_models: { ...prev.default_models, [field]: value },
        }));
    };

    const addMapping = () => {
        if (newMappingFrom.trim() && newMappingTo.trim()) {
            setModelMappings(prev => [...prev, { from: newMappingFrom.trim(), to: newMappingTo.trim() }]);
            setNewMappingFrom('');
            setNewMappingTo('');
        }
    };

    const removeMapping = (index: number) => {
        setModelMappings(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
    };

    const handleConfirm = () => {
        if (!formData.name.trim()) {
            showToast(t('providers.form.name_required'), 'error');
            return;
        }
        if (!formData.base_url.trim()) {
            showToast(t('providers.form.base_url_required'), 'error');
            return;
        }
        if (!formData.api_key.trim()) {
            showToast(t('providers.form.api_key_required'), 'error');
            return;
        }
        onConfirm(formData, modelMappings);
    };

    return createPortal(
        <div className="modal modal-open z-[100]">
            <div data-tauri-drag-region className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-8 z-[110]" />
            <div className="modal-box relative max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-100 shadow-2xl rounded-2xl p-0 overflow-hidden transform transition-all animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col">
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 pt-6 pb-4 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200">
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-base-content">
                        {editingProvider ? t('providers.form.edit_title') : t('providers.form.add_title')}
                    </h3>
                    <button
                        className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm btn-circle text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-300"
                        onClick={onCancel}
                    >
                        <X size={18} />
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* Body - scrollable */}
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-4 space-y-4">
                    {/* Name + Protocol */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                {t('providers.form.name_label')} <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                            </label>
                            <input
                                ref={nameInputRef}
                                type="text"
                                className="input input-sm input-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-sm"
                                value={formData.name}
                                onChange={e => updateField('name', e.target.value)}
                                placeholder={t('providers.form.name_placeholder')}
                                disabled={!!editingProvider}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                {t('providers.form.protocol_label')}
                            </label>
                            <select
                                className="select select-sm select-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-sm"
                                value={formData.protocol}
                                onChange={e => updateField('protocol', e.target.value as ProviderProtocol)}
                            >
                                {PROTOCOL_OPTIONS.map(opt => (
                                    <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
                                ))}
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Base URL */}
                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                            {t('providers.form.base_url_label')} <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                        </label>
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            className="input input-sm input-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-sm font-mono"
                            value={formData.base_url}
                            onChange={e => updateField('base_url', e.target.value)}
                            placeholder={t('providers.form.base_url_placeholder')}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {/* API Key */}
                    <div>
                        <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                            {t('providers.form.api_key_label')} <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                        </label>
                        <input
                            type="password"
                            className="input input-sm input-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-sm"
                            value={formData.api_key}
                            onChange={e => updateField('api_key', e.target.value)}
                            placeholder={t('providers.form.api_key_placeholder')}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {/* Dispatch + Priority + Timeout */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                {t('providers.form.dispatch_mode_label')}
                            </label>
                            <select
                                className="select select-sm select-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-sm"
                                value={formData.dispatch_mode}
                                onChange={e => updateField('dispatch_mode', e.target.value as ProviderDispatchMode)}
                            >
                                {DISPATCH_OPTIONS.map(opt => (
                                    <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
                                ))}
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                {t('providers.form.priority_label')}
                            </label>
                            <input
                                type="number"
                                className="input input-sm input-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-sm"
                                value={formData.priority}
                                onChange={e => updateField('priority', parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                                min={0}
                                max={99}
                                placeholder={t('providers.form.priority_placeholder')}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                {t('providers.form.timeout_label')}
                            </label>
                            <input
                                type="number"
                                className="input input-sm input-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-sm"
                                value={formData.request_timeout_secs ?? ''}
                                onChange={e => {
                                    const v = parseInt(e.target.value);
                                    updateField('request_timeout_secs', isNaN(v) ? undefined : v);
                                }}
                                min={5}
                                placeholder={t('providers.form.timeout_placeholder')}
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Advanced section */}
                    <details className="collapse collapse-arrow border border-gray-200 dark:border-base-300 rounded-lg" open={showAdvanced} onToggle={e => setShowAdvanced((e.target as HTMLDetailsElement).open)}>
                        <summary className="collapse-title text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                            {t('providers.form.model_mapping_title')}
                        </summary>
                        <div className="collapse-content space-y-3 pt-0">
                            {/* Default models */}
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                                <div>
                                    <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                        {t('providers.form.opus_label')}
                                    </label>
                                    <input
                                        type="text"
                                        className="input input-xs input-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-xs"
                                        value={formData.default_models.opus}
                                        onChange={e => updateDefaultModel('opus', e.target.value)}
                                    />
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                        {t('providers.form.sonnet_label')}
                                    </label>
                                    <input
                                        type="text"
                                        className="input input-xs input-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-xs"
                                        value={formData.default_models.sonnet}
                                        onChange={e => updateDefaultModel('sonnet', e.target.value)}
                                    />
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                        {t('providers.form.haiku_label')}
                                    </label>
                                    <input
                                        type="text"
                                        className="input input-xs input-bordered w-full bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-xs"
                                        value={formData.default_models.haiku}
                                        onChange={e => updateDefaultModel('haiku', e.target.value)}
                                    />
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Model prefixes */}
                            <div>
                                <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                    {t('providers.form.prefixes_label')}
                                </label>
                                <ModelPrefixTags
                                    prefixes={formData.model_prefixes}
                                    onChange={prefixes => updateField('model_prefixes', prefixes)}
                                />
                            </div>

                            {/* Model mapping */}
                            <div className="space-y-2">
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                                        {t('providers.form.custom_mapping_label', 'Custom Mapping')}
                                    </span>
                                    <button
                                        className="text-xs text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-600"
                                        onClick={() => setShowMappingForm(!showMappingForm)}
                                    >
                                        {t('providers.form.model_mapping_add')}
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                {showMappingForm && (
                                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                                        <input
                                            type="text"
                                            className="input input-xs input-bordered flex-1 bg-white dark:bg-base-200"
                                            placeholder={t('providers.form.model_mapping_from')}
                                            value={newMappingFrom}
                                            onChange={e => setNewMappingFrom(e.target.value)}
                                            onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && addMapping()}
                                        />
                                        <input
                                            type="text"
                                            className="input input-xs input-bordered flex-1 bg-white dark:bg-base-200"
                                            placeholder={t('providers.form.model_mapping_to')}
                                            value={newMappingTo}
                                            onChange={e => setNewMappingTo(e.target.value)}
                                            onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && addMapping()}
                                        />
                                        <button
                                            className="btn btn-xs btn-primary"
                                            onClick={addMapping}
                                        >
                                            OK
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                )}
                                {modelMappings.length > 0 && (
                                    <div className="space-y-1 max-h-28 overflow-y-auto">
                                        {modelMappings.map((m, i) => (
                                            <div
                                                key={i}
                                                className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs bg-gray-50 dark:bg-base-300 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg"
                                            >
                                                <code className="font-mono">{m.from}</code>
                                                <span className="text-gray-400">→</span>
                                                <code className="font-mono">{m.to}</code>
                                                <button
                                                    className="ml-auto text-red-400 hover:text-red-500"
                                                    onClick={() => removeMapping(i)}
                                                >
                                                    <X size={12} />
                                                </button>
                                            </div>
                                        ))}
                                    </div>
                                )}
                                {modelMappings.length === 0 && !showMappingForm && (
                                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 text-center py-2">
                                        {t('providers.form.model_mapping_empty', 'No custom mappings')}
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </details>
                </div>

                {/* Footer */}
                <div className="flex gap-3 px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200">
                    <button
                        className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-base-200 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 font-medium rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-base-300 transition-colors"
                        onClick={onCancel}
                    >
                        {t('providers.form.cancel')}
                    </button>
                    <button
                        className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 text-white font-medium rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all"
                        onClick={handleConfirm}
                    >
                        {t('providers.form.confirm')}
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-backdrop bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm fixed inset-0 z-[-1]" onClick={onCancel}></div>
        </div>,
        document.body
    );
}

/* ─── Model Prefix Tags ─── */

function ModelPrefixTags({ prefixes, onChange }: { prefixes: string[]; onChange: (prefixes: string[]) => void }) {
    const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');

    const addTag = () => {
        const trimmed = inputValue.trim();
        if (trimmed && !prefixes.includes(trimmed)) {
            onChange([...prefixes, trimmed]);
        }
        setInputValue('');
    };

    const removeTag = (index: number) => {
        onChange(prefixes.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
    };

    return (
        <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {prefixes.map((prefix, i) => (
                    <span
                        key={i}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs bg-gray-100 dark:bg-base-300 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 border border-gray-200 dark:border-base-200"
                    >
                        {prefix}
                        <button className="text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => removeTag(i)}>
                            <X size={10} />
                        </button>
                    </span>
                ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                    type="text"
                    className="input input-xs input-bordered flex-1 bg-white dark:bg-base-200"
                    placeholder="Add prefix..."
                    value={inputValue}
                    onChange={e => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); addTag(); } }}
                />
                <button className="btn btn-xs" onClick={addTag}>+</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

/* ─── Main Page ─── */

function ProviderManager() {
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const { config, saveConfig } = useConfigStore();

    const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState('');
    const [protocolFilter, setProtocolFilter] = useState<string>('');
    const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const [editingProvider, setEditingProvider] = useState<UpstreamProvider | null>(null);
    const [modalData, setModalData] = useState<UpstreamProvider>(createEmptyProvider());
    const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<UpstreamProvider | null>(null);

    const providers: UpstreamProvider[] = useMemo(() => {
        return config?.proxy?.providers ?? [];
    }, [config?.proxy?.providers]);

    // Check for legacy z.ai config to migrate
    const hasLegacyZai = useMemo(() => {
        return config?.proxy?.zai?.enabled && (providers.length === 0);
    }, [config?.proxy?.zai?.enabled, providers.length]);

    const migrateZaiConfig = useCallback(() => {
        const zai = config?.proxy?.zai;
        if (!zai || !config) return;

        const newProvider: UpstreamProvider = {
            name: 'z.ai',
            enabled: zai.enabled,
            base_url: zai.base_url,
            api_key: zai.api_key,
            protocol: 'anthropic_passthrough',
            dispatch_mode: zai.dispatch_mode === 'off' ? 'pooled' : zai.dispatch_mode as ProviderDispatchMode,
            priority: 0,
            model_prefixes: [],
            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping || {},
            default_models: {
                opus: zai.models?.opus || DEFAULT_MODELS.opus,
                sonnet: zai.models?.sonnet || DEFAULT_MODELS.sonnet,
                haiku: zai.models?.haiku || DEFAULT_MODELS.haiku,
            },
        };

        const newConfig = {
            ...config,
            proxy: {
                ...config.proxy,
                providers: [newProvider],
            },
        };
        saveConfig(newConfig);
        showToast(t('providers.migrate_success'), 'success');
    }, [config, saveConfig, t]);

    // Filtered providers
    const filteredProviders = useMemo(() => {
        let result = providers;
        if (searchText) {
            const lower = searchText.toLowerCase();
            result = result.filter((p) => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(lower));
        }
        if (protocolFilter) {
            result = result.filter((p) => p.protocol === protocolFilter);
        }
        return result;
    }, [providers, searchText, protocolFilter]);

    const handleAdd = () => {
        setEditingProvider(null);
        setModalData(createEmptyProvider());
        setIsModalOpen(true);
    };

    const handleEdit = (provider: UpstreamProvider) => {
        setEditingProvider(provider);
        setModalData({ ...provider });
        setIsModalOpen(true);
    };

    const handleDeleteConfirm = async () => {
        if (!deleteTarget || !config) return;
        const newProviders = providers.filter((p) => p.name !== deleteTarget.name);
        const newConfig = {
            ...config,
            proxy: {
                ...config.proxy,
                providers: newProviders,
            },
        };
        await saveConfig(newConfig);
        showToast(t('providers.delete.success'), 'success');
        setDeleteTarget(null);
    };

    const handleToggleEnabled = async (provider: UpstreamProvider) => {
        if (!config) return;
        const newProviders = providers.map((p) =>
            p.name === provider.name ? { ...p, enabled: !p.enabled } : p
        );
        const newConfig = {
            ...config,
            proxy: {
                ...config.proxy,
                providers: newProviders,
            },
        };
        await saveConfig(newConfig);
    };

    const handleModalConfirm = async (values: UpstreamProvider, mappings: { from: string; to: string }[]) => {
        if (!config) return;

        // Build model_mapping
        const model_mapping: Record<string, string> = {};
        for (const m of mappings) {
            if (m.from.trim()) {
                model_mapping[m.from.trim()] = m.to.trim();
            }
        }

        const updated: UpstreamProvider = {
            ...values,
            model_mapping,
        };

        let newProviders: UpstreamProvider[];
        if (editingProvider) {
            newProviders = providers.map((p) =>
                p.name === editingProvider.name ? updated : p
            );
        } else {
            if (providers.some((p) => p.name === updated.name)) {
                showToast('Provider name already exists', 'error');
                return;
            }
            newProviders = [...providers, updated];
        }

        const newConfig = {
            ...config,
            proxy: {
                ...config.proxy,
                providers: newProviders,
            },
        };
        await saveConfig(newConfig);
        showToast(t('providers.form.save_success'), 'success');
        setIsModalOpen(false);
    };

    return (
        <div className="h-full flex flex-col p-5 gap-4 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <Server size={22} className="text-indigo-500" />
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            {t('providers.title')}
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                            {t('providers.subtitle')}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button
                    className="btn btn-sm btn-primary gap-1"
                    onClick={handleAdd}
                >
                    <Plus size={14} />
                    {t('providers.add_button')}
                </button>
            </div>

            {/* Migration banner */}
            {hasLegacyZai && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3">
                    <AlertCircle size={18} className="text-amber-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <div className="flex-1">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
                            {t('providers.migrate_zai_title')}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 mt-0.5">
                            {t('providers.migrate_zai_description')}
                        </p>
                        <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
                            <button
                                className="btn btn-xs btn-primary"
                                onClick={migrateZaiConfig}
                            >
                                {t('providers.migrate_button')}
                            </button>
                            <button
                                className="btn btn-xs btn-ghost"
                                onClick={() => { }}
                            >
                                {t('providers.skip_button')}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* Search & Filter Bar */}
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-base-100 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="relative">
                        <Search size={14} className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            className="pl-9 pr-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-base-100 text-sm border border-gray-200 dark:border-base-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none w-56"
                            placeholder={t('providers.search_placeholder')}
                            value={searchText}
                            onChange={e => setSearchText(e.target.value)}
                        />
                        {searchText && (
                            <button
                                className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                                onClick={() => setSearchText('')}
                            >
                                <X size={12} />
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Protocol filter buttons */}
                    <div className="bg-gray-100 dark:bg-base-200 p-1 rounded-lg flex gap-0.5">
                        <button
                            className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-md transition-all ${!protocolFilter
                                    ? 'bg-white dark:bg-base-100 text-blue-600 shadow-sm font-medium'
                                    : 'text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700'
                                }`}
                            onClick={() => setProtocolFilter('')}
                        >
                            {t('providers.filter_all')}
                        </button>
                        {PROTOCOL_OPTIONS.map(opt => (
                            <button
                                key={opt.value}
                                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-md transition-all ${protocolFilter === opt.value
                                        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-base-100 text-blue-600 shadow-sm font-medium'
                                        : 'text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700'
                                    }`}
                                onClick={() => setProtocolFilter(protocolFilter === opt.value ? '' : opt.value)}
                            >
                                {opt.label}
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>

                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 ml-auto">
                        {t('providers.total', { count: filteredProviders.length })}
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Table */}
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-base-100 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
                {providers.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
                        <Server size={48} className="text-gray-300 dark:text-gray-600 mb-4" />
                        <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-sm">
                            {t('providers.empty_description')}
                        </p>
                        <button
                            className="btn btn-sm btn-primary mt-3"
                            onClick={handleAdd}
                        >
                            <Plus size={14} />
                            {t('providers.empty_action')}
                        </button>
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="overflow-auto flex-1">
                        <table className="w-full">
                            <thead className="sticky top-0 z-10">
                                <tr className="border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-base-200">
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 w-16">
                                        {t('providers.columns.status')}
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 w-36">
                                        {t('providers.columns.name')}
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                                        {t('providers.columns.base_url')}
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 w-32">
                                        {t('providers.columns.protocol')}
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 w-28">
                                        {t('providers.columns.dispatch_mode')}
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 w-20">
                                        {t('providers.columns.priority')}
                                    </th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 w-32">
                                        {t('providers.columns.actions')}
                                    </th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                {filteredProviders.length === 0 ? (
                                    <tr>
                                        <td colSpan={7} className="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">
                                            {t('providers.no_results', 'No matching providers')}
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                ) : (
                                    filteredProviders.map((provider) => (
                                        <tr
                                            key={provider.name}
                                            className="border-b border-gray-50 dark:border-base-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-300/50 transition-colors"
                                        >
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <input
                                                    type="checkbox"
                                                    className="toggle toggle-sm bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 border-gray-300 checked:bg-blue-500 checked:border-blue-500"
                                                    checked={provider.enabled}
                                                    onChange={() => handleToggleEnabled(provider)}
                                                />
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <span className="font-medium text-sm">{provider.name}</span>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <code className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 font-mono truncate block max-w-xs">
                                                    {provider.base_url}
                                                </code>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold shadow-sm border ${PROTOCOL_COLORS[provider.protocol]}`}>
                                                    {t(`providers.protocols.${provider.protocol}`)}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                                                    {t(`providers.dispatch_modes.${provider.dispatch_mode}`)}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                                                    {provider.priority}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                                                    <button
                                                        className="btn btn-ghost btn-xs gap-1 text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/20"
                                                        onClick={() => handleEdit(provider)}
                                                    >
                                                        <Edit2 size={12} />
                                                        {t('providers.edit_button')}
                                                    </button>
                                                    <button
                                                        className="btn btn-ghost btn-xs gap-1 text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20"
                                                        onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(provider)}
                                                    >
                                                        <Trash2 size={12} />
                                                        {t('providers.delete_button')}
                                                    </button>
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    ))
                                )}
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>

            {/* Add/Edit Modal */}
            <ProviderFormModal
                isOpen={isModalOpen}
                editingProvider={editingProvider}
                initialData={modalData}
                onConfirm={handleModalConfirm}
                onCancel={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
            />

            {/* Delete Confirmation */}
            <ModalDialog
                isOpen={!!deleteTarget}
                title={t('providers.delete.title')}
                message={deleteTarget ? t('providers.delete.description', { name: deleteTarget.name }) : undefined}
                type="confirm"
                isDestructive
                onConfirm={handleDeleteConfirm}
                onCancel={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
                confirmText={t('providers.delete.confirm')}
                cancelText={t('providers.delete.cancel')}
            />
        </div>
    );
}

export default ProviderManager;
